Psa.78.6.kjv: That the generation to come might know them, even the children which should be born; who should arise and declare them to their children:

Psa.78.7.bsb: that they should put their confidence in God, not forgetting His works, but keeping His commandments.
Psa.78.7.kjv: That they might set their hope in God, and not forget the works of God, but keep his commandments:

Psa.78.8.bsb: Then they will not be like their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation, whose heart was not loyal, whose spirit was not faithful to God.
Psa.78.8.kjv: And might not be as their fathers, a stubborn and rebellious generation; a generation that set not their heart aright, and whose spirit was not stedfast with God.

Psa.37.26.bsb: They are ever generous and quick to lend, and their children are a blessing.
Psa.37.26.kjv: He is ever merciful, and lendeth; and his seed is blessed.

Psa.102.28.bsb: The children of Your servants will dwell securely, and their descendants will be established before You.”
Psa.102.28.kjv: The children of thy servants shall continue, and their seed shall be established before thee.

Psa.103.17.bsb: But from everlasting to everlasting the loving devotion of the LORD extends to those who fear Him, and His righteousness to their children’s children—
Psa.103.17.kjv: But the mercy of the Lord is from everlasting to everlasting upon them that fear him, and his righteousness unto children’s children;

Psa.103.18.bsb: to those who keep His covenant and remember to obey His precepts.
Psa.103.18.kjv: To such as keep his covenant, and to those that remember his commandments to do them.

Psa.112.3.bsb: Wealth and riches are in his house, and his righteousness endures forever.
Psa.112.3.kjv: Wealth and riches shall be in his house: and his righteousness endureth for ever.

Psa.8.2.bsb: From the mouths of children and infants You have ordained praise on account of Your adversaries, to silence the enemy and avenger.
Psa.8.2.kjv: Out of the mouth of babes and sucklings hast thou ordained strength because of thine enemies, that thou mightest still the enemy and the avenger.

Psa.71.5.bsb: For You are my hope, O Lord GOD, my confidence from my youth.
Psa.71.5.kjv: For thou art my hope, O Lord God: thou art my trust from my youth.

Psa.71.17.bsb: O God, You have taught me from my youth, and to this day I proclaim Your marvelous deeds.
Psa.71.17.kjv: O God, thou hast taught me from my youth: and hitherto have I declared thy wondrous works.

Psa.144.7.bsb: Reach down from on high; set me free and rescue me from the deep waters, from the grasp of foreigners,
Psa.144.7.kjv: Send thine hand from above; rid me, and deliver me out of great waters, from the hand of strange children;

Psa.144.8.bsb: whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
Psa.144.8.kjv: Whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood.

Psa.144.11.bsb: Set me free and rescue me from the grasp of foreigners, whose mouths speak falsehood, whose right hands are deceitful.
Psa.144.11.kjv: Rid me, and deliver me from the hand of strange children, whose mouth speaketh vanity, and their right hand is a right hand of falsehood:

Psa.65.4.bsb: Blessed is the one You choose and bring near to dwell in Your courts! We are filled with the goodness of Your house, the holiness of Your temple.
Psa.65.4.kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou choosest, and causest to approach unto thee, that he may dwell in thy courts: we shall be satisfied with the goodness of thy house, even of thy holy temple.

Psa.84.2.bsb: My soul longs, even faints, for the courts of the LORD; my heart and my flesh cry out for the living God.
Psa.84.2.kjv: My soul longeth, yea, even fainteth for the courts of the Lord: my heart and my flesh crieth out for the living God.

Psa.84.10.bsb: For better is one day in Your courts than a thousand elsewhere. I would rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God than dwell in the tents of the wicked.
Psa.84.10.kjv: For a day in thy courts is better than a thousand. I had rather be a doorkeeper in the house of my God, than to dwell in the tents of wickedness.

Psa.92.13.bsb: Planted in the house of the LORD, they will flourish in the courts of our God.
Psa.92.13.kjv: Those that be planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God.

Psa.96.8.bsb: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; bring an offering and enter His courts.
Psa.96.8.kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come into his courts.

Psa.100.4.bsb: Enter His gates with thanksgiving and His courts with praise; give thanks to Him and bless His name.
Psa.100.4.kjv: Enter into his gates with thanksgiving, and into his courts with praise: be thankful unto him, and bless his name.

Psa.116.19.bsb: in the courts of the LORD’s house, in your midst, O Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
Psa.116.19.kjv: In the courts of the Lord’s house, in the midst of thee, O Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.52.8.bsb: But I am like an olive tree flourishing in the house of God; I trust in the loving devotion of God forever and ever.
Psa.52.8.kjv: But I am like a green olive tree in the house of God: I trust in the mercy of God for ever and ever.

Psa.23.6.bsb: Surely goodness and mercy will follow me all the days of my life, and I will dwell in the house of the LORD forever.
Psa.23.6.kjv: Surely goodness and mercy shall follow me all the days of my life: and I will dwell in the house of the Lord for ever.

Psa.27.4.bsb: One thing I have asked of the LORD; this is what I desire: to dwell in the house of the LORD all the days of my life, to gaze on the beauty of the LORD and seek Him in His temple.
Psa.27.4.kjv: One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life, to behold the beauty of the Lord, and to enquire in his temple.

Psa.118.26.bsb: Blessed is he who comes in the name of the LORD. From the house of the LORD we bless you.
Psa.118.26.kjv: Blessed be he that cometh in the name of the Lord: we have blessed you out of the house of the Lord.

Psa.122.9.bsb: For the sake of the house of the LORD our God, I will seek your prosperity.
Psa.122.9.kjv: Because of the house of the Lord our God I will seek thy good.

Psa.134.1.bsb: A song of ascents. Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD!
Psa.134.1.kjv: A Song of degrees. Behold, bless ye the Lord, all ye servants of the Lord, which by night stand in the house of the Lord.

Psa.20.2.bsb: May He send you help from the sanctuary and sustain you from Zion.
Psa.20.2.kjv: Send thee help from the sanctuary, and strengthen thee out of Zion;

Psa.68.24.bsb: They have seen Your procession, O God—the march of my God and King into the sanctuary.
Psa.68.24.kjv: They have seen thy goings, O God; even the goings of my God, my King, in the sanctuary.

Psa.74.3.bsb: Turn Your steps to the everlasting ruins, to everything in the sanctuary the enemy has destroyed.
Psa.74.3.kjv: Lift up thy feet unto the perpetual desolations; even all that the enemy hath done wickedly in the sanctuary.

Psa.74.7.bsb: They have burned Your sanctuary to the ground; they have defiled the dwelling place of Your Name.
Psa.74.7.kjv: They have cast fire into thy sanctuary, they have defiled by casting down the dwelling place of thy name to the ground.

Psa.77.13.bsb: Your way, O God, is holy. What god is so great as our God?
Psa.77.13.kjv: Thy way, O God, is in the sanctuary: who is so great a God as our God?

Psa.78.69.bsb: He built His sanctuary like the heights, like the earth He has established forever.
Psa.78.69.kjv: And he built his sanctuary like high palaces, like the earth which he hath established for ever.

Psa.150.1.bsb: Hallelujah! Praise God in His sanctuary. Praise Him in His mighty heavens.
Psa.150.1.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise God in his sanctuary: praise him in the firmament of his power.

Psa.15.1.bsb: A Psalm of David. O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?
Psa.15.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. Lord, who shall abide in thy tabernacle? who shall dwell in thy holy hill?

Psa.61.4.bsb: Let me dwell in Your tent forever and take refuge in the shelter of Your wings. Selah
Psa.61.4.kjv: I will abide in thy tabernacle for ever: I will trust in the covert of thy wings. Selah.

Psa.76.2.bsb: His tent is in Salem, His dwelling place in Zion.
Psa.76.2.kjv: In Salem also is his tabernacle, and his dwelling place in Zion.

Psa.5.7.bsb: But I will enter Your house by the abundance of Your loving devotion; in reverence I will bow down toward Your holy temple.
Psa.5.7.kjv: But as for me, I will come into thy house in the multitude of thy mercy: and in thy fear will I worship toward thy holy temple.

Psa.11.4.bsb: The LORD is in His holy temple; the LORD is on His heavenly throne. His eyes are watching closely; they examine the sons of men.
Psa.11.4.kjv: The Lord is in his holy temple, the Lord’s throne is in heaven: his eyes behold, his eyelids try, the children of men.

Psa.29.9.bsb: The voice of the LORD twists the oaks and strips the forests bare. And in His temple all cry, “Glory!”
Psa.29.9.kjv: The voice of the Lord maketh the hinds to calve, and discovereth the forests: and in his temple doth every one speak of his glory.

Psa.48.9.bsb: Within Your temple, O God, we contemplate Your loving devotion.
Psa.48.9.kjv: We have thought of thy lovingkindness, O God, in the midst of thy temple.

Psa.68.29.bsb: Because of Your temple at Jerusalem kings will bring You gifts.
Psa.68.29.kjv: Because of thy temple at Jerusalem shall kings bring presents unto thee.

Psa.9.11.bsb: Sing praises to the LORD, who dwells in Zion; proclaim His deeds among the nations.
Psa.9.11.kjv: Sing praises to the Lord, which dwelleth in Zion: declare among the people his doings.

Psa.48.11.bsb: Mount Zion is glad, the daughters of Judah rejoice, on account of Your judgments.
Psa.48.11.kjv: Let mount Zion rejoice, let the daughters of Judah be glad, because of thy judgments.

Psa.74.2.bsb: Remember Your congregation, which You purchased long ago and redeemed as the tribe of Your inheritance—Mount Zion, where You dwell.
Psa.74.2.kjv: Remember thy congregation, which thou hast purchased of old; the rod of thine inheritance, which thou hast redeemed; this mount Zion, wherein thou hast dwelt.

Psa.132.13.bsb: For the LORD has chosen Zion; He has desired it for His home:
Psa.132.13.kjv: For the Lord hath chosen Zion; he hath desired it for his habitation.

Psa.137.1.bsb: By the rivers of Babylon we sat and wept when we remembered Zion.
Psa.137.1.kjv: By the rivers of Babylon, there we sat down, yea, we wept, when we remembered Zion.

Psa.24.3.bsb: Who may ascend the hill of the LORD? Who may stand in His holy place?
Psa.24.3.kjv: Who shall ascend into the hill of the Lord? or who shall stand in his holy place?

Psa.46.4.bsb: There is a river whose streams delight the city of God, the holy place where the Most High dwells.
Psa.46.4.kjv: There is a river, the streams whereof shall make glad the city of God, the holy place of the tabernacles of the most High.

Psa.79.1.bsb: A Psalm of Asaph. The nations, O God, have invaded Your inheritance; they have defiled Your holy temple and reduced Jerusalem to rubble.
Psa.79.1.kjv: A Psalm of Asaph. O God, the heathen are come into thine inheritance; thy holy temple have they defiled; they have laid Jerusalem on heaps.

Psa.138.2.bsb: I bow down toward Your holy temple and give thanks to Your name for Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness; You have exalted Your name and Your word above all else.
Psa.138.2.kjv: I will worship toward thy holy temple, and praise thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: for thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

Psa.89.7.bsb: In the council of the holy ones, God is greatly feared, and awesome above all who surround Him.
Psa.89.7.kjv: God is greatly to be feared in the assembly of the saints, and to be had in reverence of all them that are about him.

Psa.111.1.bsb: Hallelujah! I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart in the council of the upright and in the assembly.
Psa.111.1.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. I will praise the Lord with my whole heart, in the assembly of the upright, and in the congregation.

Psa.149.1.bsb: Hallelujah! Sing to the LORD a new song—His praise in the assembly of the godly.
Psa.149.1.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Sing unto the Lord a new song, and his praise in the congregation of saints.

Psa.74.19.bsb: Do not deliver the soul of Your dove to beasts; do not forget the lives of Your afflicted forever.
Psa.74.19.kjv: O deliver not the soul of thy turtledove unto the multitude of the wicked: forget not the congregation of thy poor for ever.

Psa.28.9.bsb: Save Your people and bless Your inheritance; shepherd them and carry them forever.
Psa.28.9.kjv: Save thy people, and bless thine inheritance: feed them also, and lift them up for ever.

Psa.103.19.bsb: The LORD has established His throne in heaven, and His kingdom rules over all.
Psa.103.19.kjv: The Lord hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all.

Psa.145.13.bsb: Your kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and Your dominion endures through all generations. The LORD is faithful in all His words and kind in all His actions.
Psa.145.13.kjv: Thy kingdom is an everlasting kingdom, and thy dominion endureth throughout all generations.

Psa.114.2.bsb: Judah became God’s sanctuary, Israel His dominion.
Psa.114.2.kjv: Judah was his sanctuary, and Israel his dominion.

Psa.87.7.bsb: Singers and pipers will proclaim, “All my springs of joy are in You.”
Psa.87.7.kjv: As well the singers as the players on instruments shall be there: all my springs are in thee.

Psa.137.5.bsb: If I forget you, O Jerusalem, may my right hand cease to function.
Psa.137.5.kjv: If I forget thee, O Jerusalem, let my right hand forget her cunning.

Psa.46.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. Of the sons of Korah. According to Alamoth. A song. God is our refuge and strength, an ever-present help in times of trouble.
Psa.46.1.kjv: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, A Song upon Alamoth. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

Psa.46.2.bsb: Therefore we will not fear, though the earth is transformed and the mountains are toppled into the depths of the seas,
Psa.46.2.kjv: Therefore will not we fear, though the earth be removed, and though the mountains be carried into the midst of the sea;

Psa.46.5.bsb: God is within her; she will not be moved. God will help her when morning dawns.
Psa.46.5.kjv: God is in the midst of her; she shall not be moved: God shall help her, and that right early.

Psa.89.18.bsb: Surely our shield belongs to the LORD, and our king to the Holy One of Israel.
Psa.89.18.kjv: For the Lord is our defence; and the Holy One of Israel is our king.

Psa.36.8.bsb: They feast on the abundance of Your house, and You give them drink from Your river of delights.
Psa.36.8.kjv: They shall be abundantly satisfied with the fatness of thy house; and thou shalt make them drink of the river of thy pleasures.

Psa.87.5.bsb: And it will be said of Zion: “This one and that one were born in her, and the Most High Himself will establish her.”
Psa.87.5.kjv: And of Zion it shall be said, This and that man was born in her: and the highest himself shall establish her.

Psa.9.14.bsb: that I may declare all Your praises—that within the gates of Daughter Zion I may rejoice in Your salvation.
Psa.9.14.kjv: That I may shew forth all thy praise in the gates of the daughter of Zion: I will rejoice in thy salvation.

Psa.14.7.bsb: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When the LORD restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
Psa.14.7.kjv: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! when the Lord bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

Psa.48.1.bsb: A song. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, His holy mountain.
Psa.48.1.kjv: A Song and Psalm for the sons of Korah. Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised in the city of our God, in the mountain of his holiness.

Psa.51.18.bsb: In Your good pleasure, cause Zion to prosper; build up the walls of Jerusalem.
Psa.51.18.kjv: Do good in thy good pleasure unto Zion: build thou the walls of Jerusalem.

Psa.53.6.bsb: Oh, that the salvation of Israel would come from Zion! When God restores His captive people, let Jacob rejoice, let Israel be glad!
Psa.53.6.kjv: Oh that the salvation of Israel were come out of Zion! When God bringeth back the captivity of his people, Jacob shall rejoice, and Israel shall be glad.

Psa.65.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. Praise awaits You, O God, in Zion; to You our vows will be fulfilled.
Psa.65.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm and Song of David. Praise waiteth for thee, O God, in Sion: and unto thee shall the vow be performed.

Psa.69.35.bsb: For God will save Zion and rebuild the cities of Judah, that they may dwell there and possess it.
Psa.69.35.kjv: For God will save Zion, and will build the cities of Judah: that they may dwell there, and have it in possession.

Psa.69.36.bsb: The descendants of His servants will inherit it, and those who love His name will settle in it.
Psa.69.36.kjv: The seed also of his servants shall inherit it: and they that love his name shall dwell therein.

Psa.84.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. How lovely is Your dwelling place, O LORD of Hosts!
Psa.84.1.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. How amiable are thy tabernacles, O Lord of hosts!

Psa.84.3.bsb: Even the sparrow has found a home, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she places her young near Your altars, O LORD of Hosts, my King and my God.
Psa.84.3.kjv: Yea, the sparrow hath found an house, and the swallow a nest for herself, where she may lay her young, even thine altars, O Lord of hosts, my King, and my God.

Psa.84.4.bsb: How blessed are those who dwell in Your house! They are ever praising You. Selah
Psa.84.4.kjv: Blessed are they that dwell in thy house: they will be still praising thee. Selah.

Psa.84.5.bsb: Blessed are those whose strength is in You, whose hearts are set on pilgrimage.
Psa.84.5.kjv: Blessed is the man whose strength is in thee; in whose heart are the ways of them.

Psa.84.6.bsb: As they pass through the Valley of Baca, they make it a place of springs; even the autumn rain covers it with pools.
Psa.84.6.kjv: Who passing through the valley of Baca make it a well; the rain also filleth the pools.

Psa.84.7.bsb: They go from strength to strength, until each appears before God in Zion.
Psa.84.7.kjv: They go from strength to strength, every one of them in Zion appeareth before God.

Psa.84.8.bsb: O LORD God of Hosts, hear my prayer; give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah
Psa.84.8.kjv: O Lord God of hosts, hear my prayer: give ear, O God of Jacob. Selah.

Psa.84.9.bsb: Take notice of our shield, O God, and look with favor on the face of Your anointed.
Psa.84.9.kjv: Behold, O God our shield, and look upon the face of thine anointed.

Psa.87.1.bsb: A Psalm of the sons of Korah. A song. He has founded His city on the holy mountains.
Psa.87.1.kjv: A Psalm or Song for the sons of Korah. His foundation is in the holy mountains.

Psa.87.2.bsb: The LORD loves the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.
Psa.87.2.kjv: The Lord loveth the gates of Zion more than all the dwellings of Jacob.

Psa.87.3.bsb: Glorious things are ascribed to you, O city of God. Selah
Psa.87.3.kjv: Glorious things are spoken of thee, O city of God. Selah.

Psa.87.4.bsb: “I will mention Rahab and Babylon among those who know Me—along with Philistia, Tyre, and Cush—when I say, ‘This one was born in Zion.’”
Psa.87.4.kjv: I will make mention of Rahab and Babylon to them that know me: behold Philistia, and Tyre, with Ethiopia; this man was born there.

Psa.87.6.bsb: The LORD will record in the register of the peoples: “This one was born in Zion.” Selah
Psa.87.6.kjv: The Lord shall count, when he writeth up the people, that this man was born there. Selah.

Psa.99.2.bsb: Great is the LORD in Zion; He is exalted above all the peoples.
Psa.99.2.kjv: The Lord is great in Zion; and he is high above all the people.

Psa.102.13.bsb: You will rise up and have compassion on Zion, for it is time to show her favor—the appointed time has come.
Psa.102.13.kjv: Thou shalt arise, and have mercy upon Zion: for the time to favour her, yea, the set time, is come.

Psa.102.14.bsb: For Your servants delight in her stones and take pity on her dust.
Psa.102.14.kjv: For thy servants take pleasure in her stones, and favour the dust thereof.

Psa.102.19.bsb: For He looked down from the heights of His sanctuary; the LORD gazed out from heaven to earth
Psa.102.19.kjv: For he hath looked down from the height of his sanctuary; from heaven did the Lord behold the earth;

Psa.102.20.bsb: to hear a prisoner’s groaning, to release those condemned to death,
Psa.102.20.kjv: To hear the groaning of the prisoner; to loose those that are appointed to death;

Psa.102.21.bsb: that they may proclaim the name of the LORD in Zion and praise Him in Jerusalem,
Psa.102.21.kjv: To declare the name of the Lord in Zion, and his praise in Jerusalem;

Psa.110.2.bsb: The LORD extends Your mighty scepter from Zion: “Rule in the midst of Your enemies.”
Psa.110.2.kjv: The Lord shall send the rod of thy strength out of Zion: rule thou in the midst of thine enemies.

Psa.125.1.bsb: A song of ascents. Those who trust in the LORD are like Mount Zion. It cannot be moved; it abides forever.
Psa.125.1.kjv: A Song of degrees. They that trust in the Lord shall be as mount Zion, which cannot be removed, but abideth for ever.

Psa.126.1.bsb: A song of ascents. When the LORD restored the captives of Zion, we were like dreamers.
Psa.126.1.kjv: A Song of degrees. When the Lord turned again the captivity of Zion, we were like them that dream.

Psa.126.2.bsb: Then our mouths were filled with laughter, our tongues with shouts of joy. Then it was said among the nations, “The LORD has done great things for them.”
Psa.126.2.kjv: Then was our mouth filled with laughter, and our tongue with singing: then said they among the heathen, The Lord hath done great things for them.

Psa.129.5.bsb: May all who hate Zion be turned back in shame.
Psa.129.5.kjv: Let them all be confounded and turned back that hate Zion.

Psa.132.14.bsb: “This is My resting place forever and ever; here I will dwell, for I have desired this home.
Psa.132.14.kjv: This is my rest for ever: here will I dwell; for I have desired it.

Psa.132.15.bsb: I will bless her with abundant provisions; I will satisfy her poor with bread.
Psa.132.15.kjv: I will abundantly bless her provision: I will satisfy her poor with bread.

Psa.132.16.bsb: I will clothe her priests with salvation, and her saints will sing out in joy.
Psa.132.16.kjv: I will also clothe her priests with salvation: and her saints shall shout aloud for joy.

Psa.133.3.bsb: It is like the dew of Hermon falling on the mountains of Zion. For there the LORD has bestowed the blessing of life forevermore.
Psa.133.3.kjv: As the dew of Hermon, and as the dew that descended upon the mountains of Zion: for there the Lord commanded the blessing, even life for evermore.

Psa.134.2.bsb: Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD!
Psa.134.2.kjv: Lift up your hands in the sanctuary, and bless the Lord.

Psa.134.3.bsb: May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
Psa.134.3.kjv: The Lord that made heaven and earth bless thee out of Zion.

Psa.137.2.bsb: There on the willows we hung our harps,
Psa.137.2.kjv: We hanged our harps upon the willows in the midst thereof.

Psa.137.3.bsb: for there our captors requested a song; our tormentors demanded songs of joy: “Sing us a song of Zion.”
Psa.137.3.kjv: For there they that carried us away captive required of us a song; and they that wasted us required of us mirth, saying, Sing us one of the songs of Zion.

Psa.137.4.bsb: How can we sing a song of the LORD in a foreign land?
Psa.137.4.kjv: How shall we sing the Lord’s song in a strange land?

Psa.137.6.bsb: May my tongue cling to the roof of my mouth if I do not remember you, if I do not exalt Jerusalem as my greatest joy!
Psa.137.6.kjv: If I do not remember thee, let my tongue cleave to the roof of my mouth; if I prefer not Jerusalem above my chief joy.

Psa.149.2.bsb: Let Israel rejoice in their Maker; let the children of Zion rejoice in their King.
Psa.149.2.kjv: Let Israel rejoice in him that made him: let the children of Zion be joyful in their King.

Psa.12.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. According to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. Help, O LORD, for the godly are no more; the faithful have vanished from among men.
Psa.12.1.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David. Help, Lord; for the godly man ceaseth; for the faithful fail from among the children of men.

Psa.80.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies of the Covenant.” A Psalm of Asaph. Hear us, O Shepherd of Israel, who leads Joseph like a flock; You who sit enthroned between the cherubim, shine forth
Psa.80.1.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim–Eduth, A Psalm of Asaph. Give ear, O Shepherd of Israel, thou that leadest Joseph like a flock; thou that dwellest between the cherubims, shine forth.

Psa.80.2.bsb: before Ephraim, Benjamin, and Manasseh. Rally Your mighty power and come to save us.
Psa.80.2.kjv: Before Ephraim and Benjamin and Manasseh stir up thy strength, and come and save us.

Psa.80.8.bsb: You uprooted a vine from Egypt; You drove out the nations and transplanted it.
Psa.80.8.kjv: Thou hast brought a vine out of Egypt: thou hast cast out the heathen, and planted it.

Psa.80.9.bsb: You cleared the ground for it, and it took root and filled the land.
Psa.80.9.kjv: Thou preparedst room before it, and didst cause it to take deep root, and it filled the land.

Psa.80.10.bsb: The mountains were covered by its shade, and the mighty cedars with its branches.
Psa.80.10.kjv: The hills were covered with the shadow of it, and the boughs thereof were like the goodly cedars.

Psa.80.11.bsb: It sent out its branches to the Sea, and its shoots toward the River.
Psa.80.11.kjv: She sent out her boughs unto the sea, and her branches unto the river.

Psa.80.12.bsb: Why have You broken down its walls, so that all who pass by pick its fruit?
Psa.80.12.kjv: Why hast thou then broken down her hedges, so that all they which pass by the way do pluck her?

Psa.80.13.bsb: The boar from the forest ravages it, and the creatures of the field feed upon it.
Psa.80.13.kjv: The boar out of the wood doth waste it, and the wild beast of the field doth devour it.

Psa.118.23.bsb: This is from the LORD, and it is marvelous in our eyes.
Psa.118.23.kjv: This is the Lord’s doing; it is marvellous in our eyes.

Psa.128.5.bsb: May the LORD bless you from Zion, that you may see the prosperity of Jerusalem all the days of your life,
Psa.128.5.kjv: The Lord shall bless thee out of Zion: and thou shalt see the good of Jerusalem all the days of thy life.

Psa.2.8.bsb: Ask Me, and I will make the nations Your inheritance, the ends of the earth Your possession.
Psa.2.8.kjv: Ask of me, and I shall give thee the heathen for thine inheritance, and the uttermost parts of the earth for thy possession.

Psa.22.27.bsb: All the ends of the earth will remember and turn to the LORD. All the families of the nations will bow down before Him.
Psa.22.27.kjv: All the ends of the world shall remember and turn unto the Lord: and all the kindreds of the nations shall worship before thee.

Psa.22.28.bsb: For dominion belongs to the LORD and He rules over the nations.
Psa.22.28.kjv: For the kingdom is the Lord’s: and he is the governor among the nations.

Psa.22.29.bsb: All the rich of the earth will feast and worship; all who go down to the dust will kneel before Him—even those unable to preserve their lives.
Psa.22.29.kjv: All they that be fat upon earth shall eat and worship: all they that go down to the dust shall bow before him: and none can keep alive his own soul.

Psa.22.30.bsb: Posterity will serve Him; they will declare the Lord to a new generation.
Psa.22.30.kjv: A seed shall serve him; it shall be accounted to the Lord for a generation.

Psa.22.31.bsb: They will come and proclaim His righteousness to a people yet unborn—all that He has done.
Psa.22.31.kjv: They shall come, and shall declare his righteousness unto a people that shall be born, that he hath done this.

Psa.46.10.bsb: “Be still and know that I am God; I will be exalted among the nations, I will be exalted over the earth.”
Psa.46.10.kjv: Be still, and know that I am God: I will be exalted among the heathen, I will be exalted in the earth.

Psa.66.4.bsb: All the earth bows down to You; they sing praise to You; they sing praise to Your name.” Selah
Psa.66.4.kjv: All the earth shall worship thee, and shall sing unto thee; they shall sing to thy name. Selah.

Psa.68.31.bsb: Envoys will arrive from Egypt; Cush will stretch out her hands to God.
Psa.68.31.kjv: Princes shall come out of Egypt; Ethiopia shall soon stretch out her hands unto God.

Psa.68.32.bsb: Sing to God, O kingdoms of the earth; sing praises to the Lord—Selah
Psa.68.32.kjv: Sing unto God, ye kingdoms of the earth; O sing praises unto the Lord; Selah:

Psa.72.1.bsb: Of Solomon. Endow the king with Your justice, O God, and the son of the king with Your righteousness.
Psa.72.1.kjv: A Psalm for Solomon. Give the king thy judgments, O God, and thy righteousness unto the king’s son.

Psa.72.2.bsb: May he judge Your people with righteousness and Your afflicted with justice.
Psa.72.2.kjv: He shall judge thy people with righteousness, and thy poor with judgment.

Psa.72.3.bsb: May the mountains bring peace to the people, and the hills bring righteousness.
Psa.72.3.kjv: The mountains shall bring peace to the people, and the little hills, by righteousness.

Psa.72.4.bsb: May he vindicate the afflicted among the people; may he save the children of the needy and crush the oppressor.
Psa.72.4.kjv: He shall judge the poor of the people, he shall save the children of the needy, and shall break in pieces the oppressor.

Psa.72.5.bsb: May they fear him as long as the sun shines, as long as the moon remains, through all generations.
Psa.72.5.kjv: They shall fear thee as long as the sun and moon endure, throughout all generations.

Psa.72.6.bsb: May he be like rain that falls on freshly cut grass, like spring showers that water the earth.
Psa.72.6.kjv: He shall come down like rain upon the mown grass: as showers that water the earth.

Psa.72.7.bsb: May the righteous flourish in his days and prosperity abound until the moon is no more.
Psa.72.7.kjv: In his days shall the righteous flourish; and abundance of peace so long as the moon endureth.

Psa.72.9.bsb: May the nomads bow before him, and his enemies lick the dust.
Psa.72.9.kjv: They that dwell in the wilderness shall bow before him; and his enemies shall lick the dust.

Psa.72.11.bsb: May all kings bow down to him and all nations serve him.
Psa.72.11.kjv: Yea, all kings shall fall down before him: all nations shall serve him.

Psa.72.12.bsb: For he will deliver the needy who cry out and the afflicted who have no helper.
Psa.72.12.kjv: For he shall deliver the needy when he crieth; the poor also, and him that hath no helper.

Psa.72.13.bsb: He will take pity on the poor and needy and save the lives of the oppressed.
Psa.72.13.kjv: He shall spare the poor and needy, and shall save the souls of the needy.

Psa.72.14.bsb: He will redeem them from oppression and violence, for their blood is precious in his sight.
Psa.72.14.kjv: He shall redeem their soul from deceit and violence: and precious shall their blood be in his sight.

Psa.72.15.bsb: Long may he live! May gold from Sheba be given him. May people ever pray for him; may they bless him all day long.
Psa.72.15.kjv: And he shall live, and to him shall be given of the gold of Sheba: prayer also shall be made for him continually; and daily shall he be praised.

Psa.72.16.bsb: May there be an abundance of grain in the land; may it sway atop the hills. May its fruit trees flourish like the forests of Lebanon, the people of its cities like the grass of the field.
Psa.72.16.kjv: There shall be an handful of corn in the earth upon the top of the mountains; the fruit thereof shall shake like Lebanon: and they of the city shall flourish like grass of the earth.

Psa.72.18.bsb: Blessed be the LORD God, the God of Israel, who alone does marvelous deeds.
Psa.72.18.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God, the God of Israel, who only doeth wondrous things.

Psa.72.19.bsb: And blessed be His glorious name forever; may all the earth be filled with His glory. Amen and amen.
Psa.72.19.kjv: And blessed be his glorious name for ever: and let the whole earth be filled with his glory; Amen, and Amen.

Psa.72.20.bsb: Thus conclude the prayers of David son of Jesse.
Psa.72.20.kjv: The prayers of David the son of Jesse are ended.

Psa.85.10.bsb: Loving devotion and faithfulness have joined together; righteousness and peace have kissed.
Psa.85.10.kjv: Mercy and truth are met together; righteousness and peace have kissed each other.

Psa.85.11.bsb: Faithfulness sprouts from the earth, and righteousness looks down from heaven.
Psa.85.11.kjv: Truth shall spring out of the earth; and righteousness shall look down from heaven.

Psa.85.12.bsb: The LORD will indeed provide what is good, and our land will yield its increase.
Psa.85.12.kjv: Yea, the Lord shall give that which is good; and our land shall yield her increase.

Psa.86.9.bsb: All the nations You have made will come and bow before You, O Lord, and they will glorify Your name.
Psa.86.9.kjv: All nations whom thou hast made shall come and worship before thee, O Lord; and shall glorify thy name.

Psa.89.1.bsb: A Maskil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the loving devotion of the LORD forever; with my mouth I will proclaim Your faithfulness to all generations.
Psa.89.1.kjv: Maschil of Ethan the Ezrahite. I will sing of the mercies of the Lord for ever: with my mouth will I make known thy faithfulness to all generations.

Psa.89.2.bsb: For I have said, “Loving devotion is built up forever; in the heavens You establish Your faithfulness.”
Psa.89.2.kjv: For I have said, Mercy shall be built up for ever: thy faithfulness shalt thou establish in the very heavens.

Psa.89.3.bsb: You said, “I have made a covenant with My chosen one, I have sworn to David My servant:
Psa.89.3.kjv: I have made a covenant with my chosen, I have sworn unto David my servant,

Psa.89.4.bsb: ‘I will establish your offspring forever and build up your throne for all generations.’” Selah
Psa.89.4.kjv: Thy seed will I establish for ever, and build up thy throne to all generations. Selah.

Psa.89.5.bsb: The heavens praise Your wonders, O LORD—Your faithfulness as well—in the assembly of the holy ones.
Psa.89.5.kjv: And the heavens shall praise thy wonders, O Lord: thy faithfulness also in the congregation of the saints.

Psa.89.6.bsb: For who in the skies can compare with the LORD? Who among the heavenly beings is like the LORD?
Psa.89.6.kjv: For who in the heaven can be compared unto the Lord? who among the sons of the mighty can be likened unto the Lord?

Psa.89.8.bsb: O LORD God of Hosts, who is like You? O mighty LORD, Your faithfulness surrounds You.
Psa.89.8.kjv: O Lord God of hosts, who is a strong Lord like unto thee? or to thy faithfulness round about thee?

Psa.89.9.bsb: You rule the raging sea; when its waves mount up, You still them.
Psa.89.9.kjv: Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.

Psa.89.10.bsb: You crushed Rahab like a carcass; You scattered Your enemies with Your mighty arm.
Psa.89.10.kjv: Thou hast broken Rahab in pieces, as one that is slain; thou hast scattered thine enemies with thy strong arm.

Psa.89.11.bsb: The heavens are Yours, and also the earth. The earth and its fullness You founded.
Psa.89.11.kjv: The heavens are thine, the earth also is thine: as for the world and the fulness thereof, thou hast founded them.

Psa.89.12.bsb: North and south You created; Tabor and Hermon shout for joy at Your name.
Psa.89.12.kjv: The north and the south thou hast created them: Tabor and Hermon shall rejoice in thy name.

Psa.89.13.bsb: Mighty is Your arm; strong is Your hand. Your right hand is exalted.
Psa.89.13.kjv: Thou hast a mighty arm: strong is thy hand, and high is thy right hand.

Psa.89.14.bsb: Righteousness and justice are the foundation of Your throne; loving devotion and faithfulness go before You.
Psa.89.14.kjv: Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

Psa.89.15.bsb: Blessed are those who know the joyful sound, who walk, O LORD, in the light of Your presence.
Psa.89.15.kjv: Blessed is the people that know the joyful sound: they shall walk, O Lord, in the light of thy countenance.

Psa.89.16.bsb: They rejoice in Your name all day long, and in Your righteousness they exult.
Psa.89.16.kjv: In thy name shall they rejoice all the day: and in thy righteousness shall they be exalted.

Psa.89.17.bsb: For You are the glory of their strength, and by Your favor our horn is exalted.
Psa.89.17.kjv: For thou art the glory of their strength: and in thy favour our horn shall be exalted.

Psa.89.19.bsb: You once spoke in a vision; to Your godly ones You said, “I have bestowed help on a warrior; I have exalted one chosen from the people.
Psa.89.19.kjv: Then thou spakest in vision to thy holy one, and saidst, I have laid help upon one that is mighty; I have exalted one chosen out of the people.

Psa.89.20.bsb: I have found My servant David; with My sacred oil I have anointed him.
Psa.89.20.kjv: I have found David my servant; with my holy oil have I anointed him:

Psa.89.21.bsb: My hand will sustain him; surely My arm will strengthen him.
Psa.89.21.kjv: With whom my hand shall be established: mine arm also shall strengthen him.

Psa.89.22.bsb: No enemy will exact tribute; no wicked man will oppress him.
Psa.89.22.kjv: The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

Psa.89.23.bsb: I will crush his foes before him and strike down those who hate him.
Psa.89.23.kjv: And I will beat down his foes before his face, and plague them that hate him.

Psa.89.24.bsb: My faithfulness and loving devotion will be with him, and through My name his horn will be exalted.
Psa.89.24.kjv: But my faithfulness and my mercy shall be with him: and in my name shall his horn be exalted.

Psa.89.25.bsb: I will set his hand over the sea, and his right hand upon the rivers.
Psa.89.25.kjv: I will set his hand also in the sea, and his right hand in the rivers.

Psa.89.26.bsb: He will call to Me, ‘You are my Father, my God, the Rock of my salvation.’
Psa.89.26.kjv: He shall cry unto me, Thou art my father, my God, and the rock of my salvation.

Psa.89.27.bsb: I will indeed appoint him as My firstborn, the highest of the kings of the earth.
Psa.89.27.kjv: Also I will make him my firstborn, higher than the kings of the earth.

Psa.89.28.bsb: I will forever preserve My loving devotion for him, and My covenant with him will stand fast.
Psa.89.28.kjv: My mercy will I keep for him for evermore, and my covenant shall stand fast with him.

Psa.89.29.bsb: I will establish his line forever, his throne as long as the heavens endure.
Psa.89.29.kjv: His seed also will I make to endure for ever, and his throne as the days of heaven.

Psa.89.30.bsb: If his sons forsake My law and do not walk in My judgments,
Psa.89.30.kjv: If his children forsake my law, and walk not in my judgments;

Psa.89.31.bsb: if they violate My statutes and fail to keep My commandments,
Psa.89.31.kjv: If they break my statutes, and keep not my commandments;

Psa.89.32.bsb: I will attend to their transgression with the rod, and to their iniquity with stripes.
Psa.89.32.kjv: Then will I visit their transgression with the rod, and their iniquity with stripes.

Psa.89.33.bsb: But I will not withdraw My loving devotion from him, nor ever betray My faithfulness.
Psa.89.33.kjv: Nevertheless my lovingkindness will I not utterly take from him, nor suffer my faithfulness to fail.

Psa.89.34.bsb: I will not violate My covenant or alter the utterance of My lips.
Psa.89.34.kjv: My covenant will I not break, nor alter the thing that is gone out of my lips.

Psa.89.37.bsb: like the moon, established forever, a faithful witness in the sky.” Selah
Psa.89.37.kjv: It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.

Psa.96.1.bsb: Sing to the LORD a new song; sing to the LORD, all the earth.
Psa.96.1.kjv: O sing unto the Lord a new song: sing unto the Lord, all the earth.

Psa.96.2.bsb: Sing to the LORD, bless His name; proclaim His salvation day after day.
Psa.96.2.kjv: Sing unto the Lord, bless his name; shew forth his salvation from day to day.

Psa.96.3.bsb: Declare His glory among the nations, His wonders among all peoples.
Psa.96.3.kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen, his wonders among all people.

Psa.96.4.bsb: For great is the LORD, and greatly to be praised; He is to be feared above all gods.
Psa.96.4.kjv: For the Lord is great, and greatly to be praised: he is to be feared above all gods.

Psa.96.5.bsb: For all the gods of the nations are idols, but it is the LORD who made the heavens.
Psa.96.5.kjv: For all the gods of the nations are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.

Psa.96.7.bsb: Ascribe to the LORD, O families of the nations, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Psa.96.7.kjv: Give unto the Lord, O ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

Psa.96.9.bsb: Worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness; tremble before Him, all the earth.
Psa.96.9.kjv: O worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness: fear before him, all the earth.

Psa.96.10.bsb: Declare among the nations: “The LORD reigns!” The world is firmly established; it cannot be moved; He will judge the peoples with equity.
Psa.96.10.kjv: Say among the heathen that the Lord reigneth: the world also shall be established that it shall not be moved: he shall judge the people righteously.

Psa.96.11.bsb: Let the heavens be glad and the earth rejoice; let the sea resound, and all that fills it.
Psa.96.11.kjv: Let the heavens rejoice, and let the earth be glad; let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof.

Psa.96.12.bsb: Let the fields exult, and all that is in them. Then all the trees of the forest will sing for joy
Psa.96.12.kjv: Let the field be joyful, and all that is therein: then shall all the trees of the wood rejoice

Psa.96.13.bsb: before the LORD, for He is coming—He is coming to judge the earth. He will judge the world in righteousness and the peoples in His faithfulness.
Psa.96.13.kjv: Before the Lord: for he cometh, for he cometh to judge the earth: he shall judge the world with righteousness, and the people with his truth.

Psa.102.15.bsb: So the nations will fear the name of the LORD, and all the kings of the earth will fear Your glory.
Psa.102.15.kjv: So the heathen shall fear the name of the Lord, and all the kings of the earth thy glory.

Psa.102.18.bsb: Let this be written for the generation to come, so that a people not yet created may praise the LORD.
Psa.102.18.kjv: This shall be written for the generation to come: and the people which shall be created shall praise the Lord.

Psa.102.22.bsb: when peoples and kingdoms assemble to serve the LORD.
Psa.102.22.kjv: When the people are gathered together, and the kingdoms, to serve the Lord.

Psa.110.3.bsb: Your people shall be willing on Your day of battle. Arrayed in holy splendor, from the womb of the dawn, to You belongs the dew of Your youth.
Psa.110.3.kjv: Thy people shall be willing in the day of thy power, in the beauties of holiness from the womb of the morning: thou hast the dew of thy youth.

Psa.110.6.bsb: He will judge the nations, heaping up the dead; He will crush the leaders far and wide.
Psa.110.6.kjv: He shall judge among the heathen, he shall fill the places with the dead bodies; he shall wound the heads over many countries.

Psa.110.7.bsb: He will drink from the brook by the road; therefore He will lift up His head.
Psa.110.7.kjv: He shall drink of the brook in the way: therefore shall he lift up the head.

Psa.113.3.bsb: From where the sun rises to where it sets, the name of the LORD is praised.
Psa.113.3.kjv: From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the Lord’s name is to be praised.

Psa.118.24.bsb: This is the day that the LORD has made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.
Psa.118.24.kjv: This is the day which the Lord hath made; we will rejoice and be glad in it.

Psa.126.5.bsb: Those who sow in tears will reap with shouts of joy.
Psa.126.5.kjv: They that sow in tears shall reap in joy.

Psa.126.6.bsb: He who goes out weeping, bearing a trail of seed, will surely return with shouts of joy, carrying sheaves of grain.
Psa.126.6.kjv: He that goeth forth and weepeth, bearing precious seed, shall doubtless come again with rejoicing, bringing his sheaves with him.

Psa.132.17.bsb: There I will make a horn grow for David; I have prepared a lamp for My anointed one.
Psa.132.17.kjv: There will I make the horn of David to bud: I have ordained a lamp for mine anointed.

Psa.138.4.bsb: All the kings of the earth will give You thanks, O LORD, when they hear the words of Your mouth.
Psa.138.4.kjv: All the kings of the earth shall praise thee, O Lord, when they hear the words of thy mouth.

Psa.51.17.bsb: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit; a broken and a contrite heart, O God, You will not despise.
Psa.51.17.kjv: The sacrifices of God are a broken spirit: a broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

Psa.105.9.bsb: the covenant He made with Abraham, and the oath He swore to Isaac.
Psa.105.9.kjv: Which covenant he made with Abraham, and his oath unto Isaac;

Psa.105.8.bsb: He remembers His covenant forever, the word He ordained for a thousand generations—
Psa.105.8.kjv: He hath remembered his covenant for ever, the word which he commanded to a thousand generations.

Psa.105.10.bsb: He confirmed it to Jacob as a decree, to Israel as an everlasting covenant:
Psa.105.10.kjv: And confirmed the same unto Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant:

Psa.105.11.bsb: “I will give you the land of Canaan as the portion of your inheritance.”
Psa.105.11.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance:

Psa.106.45.bsb: And He remembered His covenant with them, and relented by the abundance of His loving devotion.
Psa.106.45.kjv: And he remembered for them his covenant, and repented according to the multitude of his mercies.

Psa.111.5.bsb: He provides food for those who fear Him; He remembers His covenant forever.
Psa.111.5.kjv: He hath given meat unto them that fear him: he will ever be mindful of his covenant.

Psa.21.3.bsb: For You welcomed him with rich blessings; You placed on his head a crown of pure gold.
Psa.21.3.kjv: For thou preventest him with the blessings of goodness: thou settest a crown of pure gold on his head.

Psa.115.17.bsb: It is not the dead who praise the LORD, nor any who descend into silence.
Psa.115.17.kjv: The dead praise not the Lord, neither any that go down into silence.

Psa.104.29.bsb: When You hide Your face, they are terrified; when You take away their breath, they die and return to dust.
Psa.104.29.kjv: Thou hidest thy face, they are troubled: thou takest away their breath, they die, and return to their dust.

Psa.6.5.bsb: For there is no mention of You in death; who can praise You from Sheol?
Psa.6.5.kjv: For in death there is no remembrance of thee: in the grave who shall give thee thanks?

Psa.30.9.bsb: “What gain is there in my bloodshed, in my descent to the Pit? Will the dust praise You? Will it proclaim Your faithfulness?
Psa.30.9.kjv: What profit is there in my blood, when I go down to the pit? Shall the dust praise thee? shall it declare thy truth?

Psa.49.7.bsb: No man can possibly redeem his brother or pay his ransom to God.
Psa.49.7.kjv: None of them can by any means redeem his brother, nor give to God a ransom for him:

Psa.49.9.bsb: that he should live on forever and not see decay.
Psa.49.9.kjv: That he should still live for ever, and not see corruption.

Psa.68.20.bsb: Our God is a God of deliverance; the Lord GOD is our rescuer from death.
Psa.68.20.kjv: He that is our God is the God of salvation; and unto God the Lord belong the issues from death.

Psa.82.7.bsb: But like mortals you will die, and like rulers you will fall.”
Psa.82.7.kjv: But ye shall die like men, and fall like one of the princes.

Psa.88.9.bsb: My eyes grow dim with grief. I call to You daily, O LORD; I spread out my hands to You.
Psa.88.9.kjv: Mine eye mourneth by reason of affliction: Lord, I have called daily upon thee, I have stretched out my hands unto thee.

Psa.88.10.bsb: Do You work wonders for the dead? Do departed spirits rise up to praise You? Selah
Psa.88.10.kjv: Wilt thou shew wonders to the dead? shall the dead arise and praise thee? Selah.

Psa.88.11.bsb: Can Your loving devotion be proclaimed in the grave, Your faithfulness in Abaddon?
Psa.88.11.kjv: Shall thy lovingkindness be declared in the grave? or thy faithfulness in destruction?

Psa.88.12.bsb: Will Your wonders be known in the darkness, or Your righteousness in the land of oblivion?
Psa.88.12.kjv: Shall thy wonders be known in the dark? and thy righteousness in the land of forgetfulness?

Psa.88.13.bsb: But to You, O LORD, I cry for help; in the morning my prayer comes before You.
Psa.88.13.kjv: But unto thee have I cried, O Lord; and in the morning shall my prayer prevent thee.

Psa.88.14.bsb: Why, O LORD, do You reject me? Why do You hide Your face from me?
Psa.88.14.kjv: Lord, why castest thou off my soul? why hidest thou thy face from me?

Psa.89.48.bsb: What man can live and never see death? Can he deliver his soul from the power of Sheol? Selah
Psa.89.48.kjv: What man is he that liveth, and shall not see death? shall he deliver his soul from the hand of the grave? Selah.

Psa.103.14.bsb: For He knows our frame; He is mindful that we are dust.
Psa.103.14.kjv: For he knoweth our frame; he remembereth that we are dust.

Psa.103.15.bsb: As for man, his days are like grass—he blooms like a flower of the field;
Psa.103.15.kjv: As for man, his days are as grass: as a flower of the field, so he flourisheth.

Psa.103.16.bsb: when the wind passes over, it vanishes, and its place remembers it no more.
Psa.103.16.kjv: For the wind passeth over it, and it is gone; and the place thereof shall know it no more.

Psa.143.3.bsb: For the enemy has pursued my soul, crushing my life to the ground, making me dwell in darkness like those long since dead.
Psa.143.3.kjv: For the enemy hath persecuted my soul; he hath smitten my life down to the ground; he hath made me to dwell in darkness, as those that have been long dead.

Psa.146.4.bsb: When his spirit departs, he returns to the ground; on that very day his plans perish.
Psa.146.4.kjv: His breath goeth forth, he returneth to his earth; in that very day his thoughts perish.

Psa.90.12.bsb: So teach us to number our days, that we may present a heart of wisdom.
Psa.90.12.kjv: So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

Psa.31.5.bsb: Into Your hands I commit my spirit; You have redeemed me, O LORD, God of truth.
Psa.31.5.kjv: Into thine hand I commit my spirit: thou hast redeemed me, O Lord God of truth.

Psa.37.37.bsb: Consider the blameless and observe the upright, for posterity awaits the man of peace.
Psa.37.37.kjv: Mark the perfect man, and behold the upright: for the end of that man is peace.

Psa.49.15.bsb: But God will redeem my life from Sheol, for He will surely take me to Himself. Selah
Psa.49.15.kjv: But God will redeem my soul from the power of the grave: for he shall receive me. Selah.

Psa.116.15.bsb: Precious in the sight of the LORD is the death of His saints.
Psa.116.15.kjv: Precious in the sight of the Lord is the death of his saints.

Psa.37.1.bsb: Of David. Do not fret over those who do evil; do not envy those who do wrong.
Psa.37.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. Fret not thyself because of evildoers, neither be thou envious against the workers of iniquity.

Psa.37.2.bsb: For they wither quickly like grass and wilt like tender plants.
Psa.37.2.kjv: For they shall soon be cut down like the grass, and wither as the green herb.

Psa.37.9.bsb: For the evildoers will be cut off, but those who hope in the LORD will inherit the land.
Psa.37.9.kjv: For evildoers shall be cut off: but those that wait upon the Lord, they shall inherit the earth.

Psa.37.10.bsb: Yet a little while, and the wicked will be no more; though you look for them, they will not be found.
Psa.37.10.kjv: For yet a little while, and the wicked shall not be: yea, thou shalt diligently consider his place, and it shall not be.

Psa.37.35.bsb: I have seen a wicked, ruthless man flourishing like a well-rooted native tree,
Psa.37.35.kjv: I have seen the wicked in great power, and spreading himself like a green bay tree.

Psa.37.36.bsb: yet he passed away and was no more; though I searched, he could not be found.
Psa.37.36.kjv: Yet he passed away, and, lo, he was not: yea, I sought him, but he could not be found.

Psa.49.10.bsb: For it is clear that wise men die, and the foolish and the senseless both perish and leave their wealth to others.
Psa.49.10.kjv: For he seeth that wise men die, likewise the fool and the brutish person perish, and leave their wealth to others.

Psa.49.14.bsb: Like sheep they are destined for Sheol. Death will be their shepherd. The upright will rule them in the morning, and their form will decay in Sheol, far from their lofty abode.
Psa.49.14.kjv: Like sheep they are laid in the grave; death shall feed on them; and the upright shall have dominion over them in the morning; and their beauty shall consume in the grave from their dwelling.

Psa.49.17.bsb: For when he dies, he will carry nothing away; his abundance will not follow him down.
Psa.49.17.kjv: For when he dieth he shall carry nothing away: his glory shall not descend after him.

Psa.49.19.bsb: he will join the generation of his fathers, who will never see the light of day.
Psa.49.19.kjv: He shall go to the generation of his fathers; they shall never see light.

Psa.49.20.bsb: A man who has riches without understanding is like the beasts that perish.
Psa.49.20.kjv: Man that is in honour, and understandeth not, is like the beasts that perish.

Psa.55.23.bsb: But You, O God, will bring them down to the Pit of destruction; men of bloodshed and deceit will not live out half their days. But I will trust in You.
Psa.55.23.kjv: But thou, O God, shalt bring them down into the pit of destruction: bloody and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; but I will trust in thee.

Psa.58.9.bsb: Before your pots can feel the burning thorns—whether green or dry—He will sweep them away.
Psa.58.9.kjv: Before your pots can feel the thorns, he shall take them away as with a whirlwind, both living, and in his wrath.

Psa.92.7.bsb: that though the wicked sprout like grass, and all evildoers flourish, they will be forever destroyed.
Psa.92.7.kjv: When the wicked spring as the grass, and when all the workers of iniquity do flourish; it is that they shall be destroyed for ever:

Psa.5.9.bsb: For not a word they speak can be trusted; destruction lies within them. Their throats are open graves; their tongues practice deceit.
Psa.5.9.kjv: For there is no faithfulness in their mouth; their inward part is very wickedness; their throat is an open sepulchre; they flatter with their tongue.

Psa.53.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. According to Mahalath. A Maskil of David. The fool says in his heart, “There is no God.” They are corrupt; their ways are vile. There is no one who does good.
Psa.53.1.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Mahalath, Maschil, A Psalm of David. The fool hath said in his heart, There is no God. Corrupt are they, and have done abominable iniquity: there is none that doeth good.

Psa.53.2.bsb: God looks down from heaven upon the sons of men to see if any understand, if any seek God.
Psa.53.2.kjv: God looked down from heaven upon the children of men, to see if there were any that did understand, that did seek God.

Psa.53.3.bsb: All have turned away, they have together become corrupt; there is no one who does good, not even one.
Psa.53.3.kjv: Every one of them is gone back: they are altogether become filthy; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.

Psa.58.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David. Do you indeed speak justly, O rulers? Do you judge uprightly, O sons of men?
Psa.58.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, Al–taschith, Michtam of David. Do ye indeed speak righteousness, O congregation? do ye judge uprightly, O ye sons of men?

Psa.58.2.bsb: No, in your hearts you devise injustice; with your hands you mete out violence on the earth.
Psa.58.2.kjv: Yea, in heart ye work wickedness; ye weigh the violence of your hands in the earth.

Psa.58.4.bsb: Their venom is like the venom of a snake, like a cobra that shuts its ears,
Psa.58.4.kjv: Their poison is like the poison of a serpent: they are like the deaf adder that stoppeth her ear;

Psa.58.5.bsb: refusing to hear the tune of the charmer who skillfully weaves his spell.
Psa.58.5.kjv: Which will not hearken to the voice of charmers, charming never so wisely.

Psa.94.11.bsb: The LORD knows the thoughts of man, that they are futile.
Psa.94.11.kjv: The Lord knoweth the thoughts of man, that they are vanity.

Psa.130.3.bsb: If You, O LORD, kept track of iniquities, then who, O Lord, could stand?
Psa.130.3.kjv: If thou, Lord, shouldest mark iniquities, O Lord, who shall stand?

Psa.31.23.bsb: Love the LORD, all His saints. The LORD preserves the faithful, but fully repays the arrogant.
Psa.31.23.kjv: O love the Lord, all ye his saints: for the Lord preserveth the faithful, and plentifully rewardeth the proud doer.

Psa.37.7.bsb: Be still before the LORD and wait patiently for Him; do not fret when men prosper in their ways, when they carry out wicked schemes.
Psa.37.7.kjv: Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him: fret not thyself because of him who prospereth in his way, because of the man who bringeth wicked devices to pass.

Psa.49.16.bsb: Do not be afraid when a man grows rich, when the splendor of his house increases.
Psa.49.16.kjv: Be not thou afraid when one is made rich, when the glory of his house is increased;

Psa.112.10.bsb: The wicked man will see and be grieved; he will gnash his teeth and waste away; the desires of the wicked will perish.
Psa.112.10.kjv: The wicked shall see it, and be grieved; he shall gnash with his teeth, and melt away: the desire of the wicked shall perish.

Psa.106.16.bsb: In the camp they envied Moses, as well as Aaron, the holy one of the LORD.
Psa.106.16.kjv: They envied Moses also in the camp, and Aaron the saint of the Lord.

Psa.106.17.bsb: The earth opened up and swallowed Dathan; it covered the assembly of Abiram.
Psa.106.17.kjv: The earth opened and swallowed up Dathan, and covered the company of Abiram.

Psa.106.18.bsb: Then fire blazed through their company; flames consumed the wicked.
Psa.106.18.kjv: And a fire was kindled in their company; the flame burned up the wicked.

Psa.2.12.bsb: Kiss the Son, lest He be angry and you perish in your rebellion, when His wrath ignites in an instant. Blessed are all who take refuge in Him.
Psa.2.12.kjv: Kiss the Son, lest he be angry, and ye perish from the way, when his wrath is kindled but a little. Blessed are all they that put their trust in him.

Psa.5.11.bsb: But let all who take refuge in You rejoice; let them ever shout for joy. May You shelter them, that those who love Your name may rejoice in You.
Psa.5.11.kjv: But let all those that put their trust in thee rejoice: let them ever shout for joy, because thou defendest them: let them also that love thy name be joyful in thee.

Psa.7.1.bsb: A Shiggaion of David, which he sang to the LORD concerning the words of Cush, a Benjamite. O LORD my God, I take refuge in You; save me and deliver me from all my pursuers,
Psa.7.1.kjv: Shiggaion of David, which he sang unto the Lord, concerning the words of Cush the Benjamite. O Lord my God, in thee do I put my trust: save me from all them that persecute me, and deliver me:

Psa.9.9.bsb: The LORD is a refuge for the oppressed, a stronghold in times of trouble.
Psa.9.9.kjv: The Lord also will be a refuge for the oppressed, a refuge in times of trouble.

Psa.9.10.bsb: Those who know Your name trust in You, for You, O LORD, have not forsaken those who seek You.
Psa.9.10.kjv: And they that know thy name will put their trust in thee: for thou, Lord, hast not forsaken them that seek thee.

Psa.18.30.bsb: As for God, His way is perfect; the word of the LORD is flawless. He is a shield to all who take refuge in Him.
Psa.18.30.kjv: As for God, his way is perfect: the word of the Lord is tried: he is a buckler to all those that trust in him.

Psa.32.10.bsb: Many are the sorrows of the wicked, but loving devotion surrounds him who trusts in the LORD.
Psa.32.10.kjv: Many sorrows shall be to the wicked: but he that trusteth in the Lord, mercy shall compass him about.

Psa.33.18.bsb: Surely the eyes of the LORD are on those who fear Him, on those whose hope is in His loving devotion
Psa.33.18.kjv: Behold, the eye of the Lord is upon them that fear him, upon them that hope in his mercy;

Psa.33.19.bsb: to deliver them from death and keep them alive in famine.
Psa.33.19.kjv: To deliver their soul from death, and to keep them alive in famine.

Psa.34.1.bsb: Of David, when he pretended to be insane before Abimelech, so that the king drove him away. I will bless the LORD at all times; His praise will always be on my lips.
Psa.34.1.kjv: A Psalm of David, when he changed his behaviour before Abimelech; who drove him away, and he departed. I will bless the Lord at all times: his praise shall continually be in my mouth.

Psa.34.2.bsb: My soul boasts in the LORD; let the oppressed hear and rejoice.
Psa.34.2.kjv: My soul shall make her boast in the Lord: the humble shall hear thereof, and be glad.

Psa.34.3.bsb: Magnify the LORD with me; let us exalt His name together.
Psa.34.3.kjv: O magnify the Lord with me, and let us exalt his name together.

Psa.34.5.bsb: Those who look to Him are radiant with joy; their faces shall never be ashamed.
Psa.34.5.kjv: They looked unto him, and were lightened: and their faces were not ashamed.

Psa.34.8.bsb: Taste and see that the LORD is good; blessed is the man who takes refuge in Him!
Psa.34.8.kjv: O taste and see that the Lord is good: blessed is the man that trusteth in him.

Psa.34.22.bsb: The LORD redeems His servants, and none who take refuge in Him will be condemned.
Psa.34.22.kjv: The Lord redeemeth the soul of his servants: and none of them that trust in him shall be desolate.

Psa.40.4.bsb: Blessed is the man who has made the LORD his trust, who has not turned to the proud, nor to those who lapse into falsehood.
Psa.40.4.kjv: Blessed is that man that maketh the Lord his trust, and respecteth not the proud, nor such as turn aside to lies.

Psa.64.10.bsb: Let the righteous rejoice in the LORD and take refuge in Him; let all the upright in heart exult.
Psa.64.10.kjv: The righteous shall be glad in the Lord, and shall trust in him; and all the upright in heart shall glory.

Psa.84.12.bsb: O LORD of Hosts, how blessed is the man who trusts in You!
Psa.84.12.kjv: O Lord of hosts, blessed is the man that trusteth in thee.

Psa.112.5.bsb: It is well with the man who is generous and lends freely, whose affairs are guided by justice.
Psa.112.5.kjv: A good man sheweth favour, and lendeth: he will guide his affairs with discretion.

Psa.112.7.bsb: He does not fear bad news; his heart is steadfast, trusting in the LORD.
Psa.112.7.kjv: He shall not be afraid of evil tidings: his heart is fixed, trusting in the Lord.

Psa.112.8.bsb: His heart is assured; he does not fear, until he looks in triumph on his foes.
Psa.112.8.kjv: His heart is established, he shall not be afraid, until he see his desire upon his enemies.

Psa.118.9.bsb: It is better to take refuge in the LORD than to trust in princes.
Psa.118.9.kjv: It is better to trust in the Lord than to put confidence in princes.

Psa.147.11.bsb: The LORD is pleased with those who fear Him, who hope in His loving devotion.
Psa.147.11.kjv: The Lord taketh pleasure in them that fear him, in those that hope in his mercy.

Psa.4.5.bsb: Offer the sacrifices of the righteous and trust in the LORD.
Psa.4.5.kjv: Offer the sacrifices of righteousness, and put your trust in the Lord.

Psa.27.14.bsb: Wait patiently for the LORD; be strong and courageous. Wait patiently for the LORD!
Psa.27.14.kjv: Wait on the Lord: be of good courage, and he shall strengthen thine heart: wait, I say, on the Lord.

Psa.31.19.bsb: How great is Your goodness which You have laid up for those who fear You, which You have bestowed before the sons of men on those who take refuge in You!
Psa.31.19.kjv: Oh how great is thy goodness, which thou hast laid up for them that fear thee; which thou hast wrought for them that trust in thee before the sons of men!

Psa.31.24.bsb: Be strong and courageous, all you who hope in the LORD.
Psa.31.24.kjv: Be of good courage, and he shall strengthen your heart, all ye that hope in the Lord.

Psa.37.3.bsb: Trust in the LORD and do good; dwell in the land and cultivate faithfulness.
Psa.37.3.kjv: Trust in the Lord, and do good; so shalt thou dwell in the land, and verily thou shalt be fed.

Psa.37.5.bsb: Commit your way to the LORD; trust in Him, and He will do it.
Psa.37.5.kjv: Commit thy way unto the Lord; trust also in him; and he shall bring it to pass.

Psa.37.39.bsb: The salvation of the righteous is from the LORD; He is their stronghold in time of trouble.
Psa.37.39.kjv: But the salvation of the righteous is of the Lord: he is their strength in the time of trouble.

Psa.37.40.bsb: The LORD helps and delivers them; He rescues and saves them from the wicked, because they take refuge in Him.
Psa.37.40.kjv: And the Lord shall help them, and deliver them: he shall deliver them from the wicked, and save them, because they trust in him.

Psa.55.22.bsb: Cast your burden upon the LORD and He will sustain you; He will never let the righteous be shaken.
Psa.55.22.kjv: Cast thy burden upon the Lord, and he shall sustain thee: he shall never suffer the righteous to be moved.

Psa.115.9.bsb: O Israel, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
Psa.115.9.kjv: O Israel, trust thou in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

Psa.115.11.bsb: You who fear the LORD, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
Psa.115.11.kjv: Ye that fear the Lord, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

Psa.130.7.bsb: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, for with the LORD is loving devotion, and with Him is redemption in abundance.
Psa.130.7.kjv: Let Israel hope in the Lord: for with the Lord there is mercy, and with him is plenteous redemption.

Psa.3.5.bsb: I lie down and sleep; I wake again, for the LORD sustains me.
Psa.3.5.kjv: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord sustained me.

Psa.3.6.bsb: I will not fear the myriads set against me on every side.
Psa.3.6.kjv: I will not be afraid of ten thousands of people, that have set themselves against me round about.

Psa.4.3.bsb: Know that the LORD has set apart the godly for Himself; the LORD hears when I call to Him.
Psa.4.3.kjv: But know that the Lord hath set apart him that is godly for himself: the Lord will hear when I call unto him.

Psa.4.8.bsb: I will lie down and sleep in peace, for You alone, O LORD, make me dwell in safety.
Psa.4.8.kjv: I will both lay me down in peace, and sleep: for thou, Lord, only makest me dwell in safety.

Psa.6.8.bsb: Depart from me, all you workers of iniquity, for the LORD has heard my weeping.
Psa.6.8.kjv: Depart from me, all ye workers of iniquity; for the Lord hath heard the voice of my weeping.

Psa.6.9.bsb: The LORD has heard my cry for mercy; the LORD accepts my prayer.
Psa.6.9.kjv: The Lord hath heard my supplication; the Lord will receive my prayer.

Psa.7.10.bsb: My shield is with God, who saves the upright in heart.
Psa.7.10.kjv: My defence is of God, which saveth the upright in heart.

Psa.9.3.bsb: When my enemies retreat, they stumble and perish before You.
Psa.9.3.kjv: When mine enemies are turned back, they shall fall and perish at thy presence.

Psa.9.4.bsb: For You have upheld my just cause; You sit on Your throne judging righteously.
Psa.9.4.kjv: For thou hast maintained my right and my cause; thou satest in the throne judging right.

Psa.11.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. Of David. In the LORD I take refuge. How then can you say to me: “Flee like a bird to your mountain!
Psa.11.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. In the Lord put I my trust: how say ye to my soul, Flee as a bird to your mountain?

Psa.13.5.bsb: But I have trusted in Your loving devotion; my heart will rejoice in Your salvation.
Psa.13.5.kjv: But I have trusted in thy mercy; my heart shall rejoice in thy salvation.

Psa.16.1.bsb: A Miktam of David. Preserve me, O God, for in You I take refuge.
Psa.16.1.kjv: Michtam of David. Preserve me, O God: for in thee do I put my trust.

Psa.16.5.bsb: The LORD is my chosen portion and my cup; You have made my lot secure.
Psa.16.5.kjv: The Lord is the portion of mine inheritance and of my cup: thou maintainest my lot.

Psa.17.6.bsb: I call on You, O God, for You will answer me. Incline Your ear to me; hear my words.
Psa.17.6.kjv: I have called upon thee, for thou wilt hear me, O God: incline thine ear unto me, and hear my speech.

Psa.18.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. Of David the servant of the LORD, who sang this song to the LORD on the day the LORD had delivered him from the hand of all his enemies and from the hand of Saul. He said: I love You, O LORD, my strength.
Psa.18.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, the servant of the Lord, who spake unto the Lord the words of this song in the day that the Lord delivered him from the hand of all his enemies, and from the hand of Saul: And he said, I will love thee, O Lord, my strength.

Psa.18.2.bsb: The LORD is my rock, my fortress, and my deliverer. My God is my rock, in whom I take refuge, my shield, and the horn of my salvation, my stronghold.
Psa.18.2.kjv: The Lord is my rock, and my fortress, and my deliverer; my God, my strength, in whom I will trust; my buckler, and the horn of my salvation, and my high tower.

Psa.18.3.bsb: I will call upon the LORD, who is worthy to be praised; so shall I be saved from my enemies.
Psa.18.3.kjv: I will call upon the Lord, who is worthy to be praised: so shall I be saved from mine enemies.

Psa.18.18.bsb: They confronted me in my day of calamity, but the LORD was my support.
Psa.18.18.kjv: They prevented me in the day of my calamity: but the Lord was my stay.

Psa.18.28.bsb: For You, O LORD, light my lamp; my God lights up my darkness.
Psa.18.28.kjv: For thou wilt light my candle: the Lord my God will enlighten my darkness.

Psa.18.29.bsb: For in You I can charge an army, and with my God I can scale a wall.
Psa.18.29.kjv: For by thee I have run through a troop; and by my God have I leaped over a wall.

Psa.20.5.bsb: May we shout for joy at your victory and raise a banner in the name of our God. May the LORD grant all your petitions.
Psa.20.5.kjv: We will rejoice in thy salvation, and in the name of our God we will set up our banners: the Lord fulfil all thy petitions.

Psa.20.6.bsb: Now I know that the LORD saves His anointed; He answers him from His holy heaven with the saving power of His right hand.
Psa.20.6.kjv: Now know I that the Lord saveth his anointed; he will hear him from his holy heaven with the saving strength of his right hand.

Psa.20.7.bsb: Some trust in chariots and others in horses, but we trust in the name of the LORD our God.
Psa.20.7.kjv: Some trust in chariots, and some in horses: but we will remember the name of the Lord our God.

Psa.21.7.bsb: For the king trusts in the LORD; through the loving devotion of the Most High, he will not be shaken.
Psa.21.7.kjv: For the king trusteth in the Lord, and through the mercy of the most High he shall not be moved.

Psa.22.4.bsb: In You our fathers trusted; they trusted and You delivered them.
Psa.22.4.kjv: Our fathers trusted in thee: they trusted, and thou didst deliver them.

Psa.22.5.bsb: They cried out to You and were set free; they trusted in You and were not disappointed.
Psa.22.5.kjv: They cried unto thee, and were delivered: they trusted in thee, and were not confounded.

Psa.23.1.bsb: A Psalm of David. The LORD is my shepherd; I shall not want.
Psa.23.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. The Lord is my shepherd; I shall not want.

Psa.23.2.bsb: He makes me lie down in green pastures; He leads me beside quiet waters.
Psa.23.2.kjv: He maketh me to lie down in green pastures: he leadeth me beside the still waters.

Psa.23.3.bsb: He restores my soul; He guides me in the paths of righteousness for the sake of His name.
Psa.23.3.kjv: He restoreth my soul: he leadeth me in the paths of righteousness for his name’s sake.

Psa.25.2.bsb: in You, my God, I trust. Do not let me be put to shame; do not let my enemies exult over me.
Psa.25.2.kjv: O my God, I trust in thee: let me not be ashamed, let not mine enemies triumph over me.

Psa.25.5.bsb: Guide me in Your truth and teach me, for You are the God of my salvation; all day long I wait for You.
Psa.25.5.kjv: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me: for thou art the God of my salvation; on thee do I wait all the day.

Psa.25.15.bsb: My eyes are always on the LORD, for He will free my feet from the mesh.
Psa.25.15.kjv: Mine eyes are ever toward the Lord; for he shall pluck my feet out of the net.

Psa.25.20.bsb: Guard my soul and deliver me; let me not be put to shame, for I take refuge in You.
Psa.25.20.kjv: O keep my soul, and deliver me: let me not be ashamed; for I put my trust in thee.

Psa.26.1.bsb: Of David. Vindicate me, O LORD! For I have walked with integrity; I have trusted in the LORD without wavering.
Psa.26.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. Judge me, O Lord; for I have walked in mine integrity: I have trusted also in the Lord; therefore I shall not slide.

Psa.26.12.bsb: My feet stand on level ground; in the congregations I will bless the LORD.
Psa.26.12.kjv: My foot standeth in an even place: in the congregations will I bless the Lord.

Psa.27.1.bsb: Of David. The LORD is my light and my salvation—whom shall I fear? The LORD is the stronghold of my life—whom shall I dread?
Psa.27.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. The Lord is my light and my salvation; whom shall I fear? the Lord is the strength of my life; of whom shall I be afraid?

Psa.27.5.bsb: For in the day of trouble He will hide me in His shelter; He will conceal me under the cover of His tent; He will set me high upon a rock.
Psa.27.5.kjv: For in the time of trouble he shall hide me in his pavilion: in the secret of his tabernacle shall he hide me; he shall set me up upon a rock.

Psa.28.7.bsb: The LORD is my strength and my shield; my heart trusts in Him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart rejoices, and I give thanks to Him with my song.
Psa.28.7.kjv: The Lord is my strength and my shield; my heart trusted in him, and I am helped: therefore my heart greatly rejoiceth; and with my song will I praise him.

Psa.31.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame; save me by Your righteousness.
Psa.31.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust; let me never be ashamed: deliver me in thy righteousness.

Psa.31.3.bsb: For You are my rock and my fortress; lead me and guide me for the sake of Your name.
Psa.31.3.kjv: For thou art my rock and my fortress; therefore for thy name’s sake lead me, and guide me.

Psa.31.4.bsb: You free me from the net laid out for me, for You are my refuge.
Psa.31.4.kjv: Pull me out of the net that they have laid privily for me: for thou art my strength.

Psa.31.6.bsb: I hate those who cling to worthless idols, but in the LORD I trust.
Psa.31.6.kjv: I have hated them that regard lying vanities: but I trust in the Lord.

Psa.31.14.bsb: But I trust in You, O LORD; I say, “You are my God.”
Psa.31.14.kjv: But I trusted in thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my God.

Psa.31.15.bsb: My times are in Your hands; deliver me from my enemies and from those who pursue me.
Psa.31.15.kjv: My times are in thy hand: deliver me from the hand of mine enemies, and from them that persecute me.

Psa.32.7.bsb: You are my hiding place. You protect me from trouble; You surround me with songs of deliverance. Selah
Psa.32.7.kjv: Thou art my hiding place; thou shalt preserve me from trouble; thou shalt compass me about with songs of deliverance. Selah.

Psa.33.20.bsb: Our soul waits for the LORD; He is our help and our shield.
Psa.33.20.kjv: Our soul waiteth for the Lord: he is our help and our shield.

Psa.33.21.bsb: For our hearts rejoice in Him, since we trust in His holy name.
Psa.33.21.kjv: For our heart shall rejoice in him, because we have trusted in his holy name.

Psa.33.22.bsb: May Your loving devotion rest on us, O LORD, as we put our hope in You.
Psa.33.22.kjv: Let thy mercy, O Lord, be upon us, according as we hope in thee.

Psa.35.10.bsb: All my bones will exclaim, “Who is like You, O LORD, who delivers the afflicted from the aggressor, the poor and needy from the robber?”
Psa.35.10.kjv: All my bones shall say, Lord, who is like unto thee, which deliverest the poor from him that is too strong for him, yea, the poor and the needy from him that spoileth him?

Psa.38.9.bsb: O Lord, my every desire is before You; my groaning is not hidden from You.
Psa.38.9.kjv: Lord, all my desire is before thee; and my groaning is not hid from thee.

Psa.39.7.bsb: And now, O Lord, for what do I wait? My hope is in You.
Psa.39.7.kjv: And now, Lord, what wait I for? my hope is in thee.

Psa.40.3.bsb: He put a new song in my mouth, a hymn of praise to our God. Many will see and fear and put their trust in the LORD.
Psa.40.3.kjv: And he hath put a new song in my mouth, even praise unto our God: many shall see it, and fear, and shall trust in the Lord.

Psa.40.17.bsb: But I am poor and needy; may the Lord think of me. You are my helper and deliverer; O my God, do not delay.
Psa.40.17.kjv: But I am poor and needy; yet the Lord thinketh upon me: thou art my help and my deliverer; make no tarrying, O my God.

Psa.41.12.bsb: In my integrity You uphold me and set me in Your presence forever.
Psa.41.12.kjv: And as for me, thou upholdest me in mine integrity, and settest me before thy face for ever.

Psa.42.5.bsb: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him for the salvation of His presence.
Psa.42.5.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted in me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance.

Psa.42.6.bsb: O my God, my soul despairs within me. Therefore I remember You from the land of Jordan and the peaks of Hermon—even from Mount Mizar.
