Psa.42.6.kjv: O my God, my soul is cast down within me: therefore will I remember thee from the land of Jordan, and of the Hermonites, from the hill Mizar.

Psa.42.8.bsb: The LORD decrees His loving devotion by day, and at night His song is with me as a prayer to the God of my life.
Psa.42.8.kjv: Yet the Lord will command his lovingkindness in the daytime, and in the night his song shall be with me, and my prayer unto the God of my life.

Psa.43.5.bsb: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
Psa.43.5.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

Psa.44.5.bsb: Through You we repel our foes; through Your name we trample our enemies.
Psa.44.5.kjv: Through thee will we push down our enemies: through thy name will we tread them under that rise up against us.

Psa.44.8.bsb: In God we have boasted all day long, and Your name we will praise forever. Selah
Psa.44.8.kjv: In God we boast all the day long, and praise thy name for ever. Selah.

Psa.46.3.bsb: though their waters roar and foam and the mountains quake in the surge. Selah
Psa.46.3.kjv: Though the waters thereof roar and be troubled, though the mountains shake with the swelling thereof. Selah.

Psa.46.7.bsb: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
Psa.46.7.kjv: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

Psa.47.3.bsb: He subdues nations beneath us, and peoples under our feet.
Psa.47.3.kjv: He shall subdue the people under us, and the nations under our feet.

Psa.47.4.bsb: He chooses our inheritance for us, the pride of Jacob, whom He loves. Selah
Psa.47.4.kjv: He shall choose our inheritance for us, the excellency of Jacob whom he loved. Selah.

Psa.48.14.bsb: For this God is our God forever and ever; He will be our guide even till death.
Psa.48.14.kjv: For this God is our God for ever and ever: he will be our guide even unto death.

Psa.54.4.bsb: Surely God is my helper; the Lord is the sustainer of my soul.
Psa.54.4.kjv: Behold, God is mine helper: the Lord is with them that uphold my soul.

Psa.55.16.bsb: But I call to God, and the LORD saves me.
Psa.55.16.kjv: As for me, I will call upon God; and the Lord shall save me.

Psa.56.3.bsb: When I am afraid, I put my trust in You.
Psa.56.3.kjv: What time I am afraid, I will trust in thee.

Psa.56.4.bsb: In God, whose word I praise—in God I trust. I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Psa.56.4.kjv: In God I will praise his word, in God I have put my trust; I will not fear what flesh can do unto me.

Psa.56.8.bsb: You have taken account of my wanderings. Put my tears in Your bottle—are they not in Your book?
Psa.56.8.kjv: Thou tellest my wanderings: put thou my tears into thy bottle: are they not in thy book?

Psa.56.11.bsb: in God I trust; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Psa.56.11.kjv: In God have I put my trust: I will not be afraid what man can do unto me.

Psa.57.2.bsb: I cry out to God Most High, to God who fulfills His purpose for me.
Psa.57.2.kjv: I will cry unto God most high; unto God that performeth all things for me.

Psa.57.3.bsb: He reaches down from heaven and saves me; He rebukes those who trample me. Selah God sends forth His loving devotion and His truth.
Psa.57.3.kjv: He shall send from heaven, and save me from the reproach of him that would swallow me up. Selah. God shall send forth his mercy and his truth.

Psa.59.9.bsb: I will keep watch for You, O my strength, because You, O God, are my fortress.
Psa.59.9.kjv: Because of his strength will I wait upon thee: for God is my defence.

Psa.59.10.bsb: My God of loving devotion will come to meet me; God will let me stare down my foes.
Psa.59.10.kjv: The God of my mercy shall prevent me: God shall let me see my desire upon mine enemies.

Psa.59.17.bsb: To You, O my strength, I sing praises, for You, O God, are my fortress, my God of loving devotion.
Psa.59.17.kjv: Unto thee, O my strength, will I sing: for God is my defence, and the God of my mercy.

Psa.60.9.bsb: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
Psa.60.9.kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

Psa.60.10.bsb: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
Psa.60.10.kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, which hadst cast us off? and thou, O God, which didst not go out with our armies?

Psa.60.12.bsb: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
Psa.60.12.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

Psa.61.2.bsb: From the ends of the earth I call out to You whenever my heart is faint. Lead me to the rock that is higher than I.
Psa.61.2.kjv: From the end of the earth will I cry unto thee, when my heart is overwhelmed: lead me to the rock that is higher than I.

Psa.61.6.bsb: Increase the days of the king’s life; may his years span many generations.
Psa.61.6.kjv: Thou wilt prolong the king’s life: and his years as many generations.

Psa.61.7.bsb: May he sit enthroned in God’s presence forever; appoint Your loving devotion and Your faithfulness to guard him.
Psa.61.7.kjv: He shall abide before God for ever: O prepare mercy and truth, which may preserve him.

Psa.62.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. In God alone my soul finds rest; my salvation comes from Him.
Psa.62.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David. Truly my soul waiteth upon God: from him cometh my salvation.

Psa.62.5.bsb: Rest in God alone, O my soul, for my hope comes from Him.
Psa.62.5.kjv: My soul, wait thou only upon God; for my expectation is from him.

Psa.62.6.bsb: He alone is my rock and my salvation; He is my fortress; I will not be shaken.
Psa.62.6.kjv: He only is my rock and my salvation: he is my defence; I shall not be moved.

Psa.62.7.bsb: My salvation and my honor rest on God, my strong rock; my refuge is in God.
Psa.62.7.kjv: In God is my salvation and my glory: the rock of my strength, and my refuge, is in God.

Psa.63.6.bsb: When I remember You on my bed, I think of You through the watches of the night.
Psa.63.6.kjv: When I remember thee upon my bed, and meditate on thee in the night watches.

Psa.63.7.bsb: For You are my help; I will sing for joy in the shadow of Your wings.
Psa.63.7.kjv: Because thou hast been my help, therefore in the shadow of thy wings will I rejoice.

Psa.66.9.bsb: He preserves our lives and keeps our feet from slipping.
Psa.66.9.kjv: Which holdeth our soul in life, and suffereth not our feet to be moved.

Psa.67.6.bsb: The earth has yielded its harvest; God, our God, blesses us.
Psa.67.6.kjv: Then shall the earth yield her increase; and God, even our own God, shall bless us.

Psa.69.19.bsb: You know my reproach, my shame and disgrace. All my adversaries are before You.
Psa.69.19.kjv: Thou hast known my reproach, and my shame, and my dishonour: mine adversaries are all before thee.

Psa.70.5.bsb: But I am poor and needy; hurry to me, O God. You are my help and my deliverer; O LORD, do not delay.
Psa.70.5.kjv: But I am poor and needy: make haste unto me, O God: thou art my help and my deliverer; O Lord, make no tarrying.

Psa.71.1.bsb: In You, O LORD, I have taken refuge; let me never be put to shame.
Psa.71.1.kjv: In thee, O Lord, do I put my trust: let me never be put to confusion.

Psa.71.3.bsb: Be my rock of refuge, where I can always go. Give the command to save me, for You are my rock and my fortress.
Psa.71.3.kjv: Be thou my strong habitation, whereunto I may continually resort: thou hast given commandment to save me; for thou art my rock and my fortress.

Psa.71.6.bsb: I have leaned on You since birth; You pulled me from my mother’s womb. My praise is always for You.
Psa.71.6.kjv: By thee have I been holden up from the womb: thou art he that took me out of my mother’s bowels: my praise shall be continually of thee.

Psa.71.7.bsb: I have become a portent to many, but You are my strong refuge.
Psa.71.7.kjv: I am as a wonder unto many; but thou art my strong refuge.

Psa.71.14.bsb: But I will always hope and will praise You more and more.
Psa.71.14.kjv: But I will hope continually, and will yet praise thee more and more.

Psa.71.16.bsb: I will come in the strength of the Lord GOD; I will proclaim Your righteousness—Yours alone.
Psa.71.16.kjv: I will go in the strength of the Lord God: I will make mention of thy righteousness, even of thine only.

Psa.71.20.bsb: Though You have shown me many troubles and misfortunes, You will revive me once again. Even from the depths of the earth You will bring me back up.
Psa.71.20.kjv: Thou, which hast shewed me great and sore troubles, shalt quicken me again, and shalt bring me up again from the depths of the earth.

Psa.71.21.bsb: You will increase my honor and comfort me once again.
Psa.71.21.kjv: Thou shalt increase my greatness, and comfort me on every side.

Psa.74.12.bsb: Yet God is my King from ancient times, working salvation on the earth.
Psa.74.12.kjv: For God is my King of old, working salvation in the midst of the earth.

Psa.77.10.bsb: So I said, “I am grieved that the right hand of the Most High has changed.”
Psa.77.10.kjv: And I said, This is my infirmity: but I will remember the years of the right hand of the most High.

Psa.77.11.bsb: I will remember the works of the LORD; yes, I will remember Your wonders of old.
Psa.77.11.kjv: I will remember the works of the Lord: surely I will remember thy wonders of old.

Psa.77.12.bsb: I will reflect on all You have done and ponder Your mighty deeds.
Psa.77.12.kjv: I will meditate also of all thy work, and talk of thy doings.

Psa.86.2.bsb: Preserve my soul, for I am godly. You are my God; save Your servant who trusts in You.
Psa.86.2.kjv: Preserve my soul; for I am holy: O thou my God, save thy servant that trusteth in thee.

Psa.90.1.bsb: A prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, You have been our dwelling place through all generations.
Psa.90.1.kjv: A Prayer of Moses the man of God. Lord, thou hast been our dwelling place in all generations.

Psa.91.1.bsb: He who dwells in the shelter of the Most High will abide in the shadow of the Almighty.
Psa.91.1.kjv: He that dwelleth in the secret place of the most High shall abide under the shadow of the Almighty.

Psa.91.2.bsb: I will say to the LORD, “You are my refuge and my fortress, my God, in whom I trust.”
Psa.91.2.kjv: I will say of the Lord, He is my refuge and my fortress: my God; in him will I trust.

Psa.91.9.bsb: Because you have made the LORD your dwelling—my refuge, the Most High—
Psa.91.9.kjv: Because thou hast made the Lord, which is my refuge, even the most High, thy habitation;

Psa.91.10.bsb: no evil will befall you, no plague will approach your tent.
Psa.91.10.kjv: There shall no evil befall thee, neither shall any plague come nigh thy dwelling.

Psa.92.15.bsb: to proclaim, “The LORD is upright; He is my Rock, and in Him there is no unrighteousness.”
Psa.92.15.kjv: To shew that the Lord is upright: he is my rock, and there is no unrighteousness in him.

Psa.94.14.bsb: For the LORD will not forsake His people; He will never abandon His heritage.
Psa.94.14.kjv: For the Lord will not cast off his people, neither will he forsake his inheritance.

Psa.94.15.bsb: Surely judgment will again be righteous, and all the upright in heart will follow it.
Psa.94.15.kjv: But judgment shall return unto righteousness: and all the upright in heart shall follow it.

Psa.94.17.bsb: Unless the LORD had been my helper, I would soon have dwelt in the abode of silence.
Psa.94.17.kjv: Unless the Lord had been my help, my soul had almost dwelt in silence.

Psa.94.18.bsb: If I say, “My foot is slipping,” Your loving devotion, O LORD, supports me.
Psa.94.18.kjv: When I said, My foot slippeth; thy mercy, O Lord, held me up.

Psa.94.22.bsb: But the LORD has been my stronghold, and my God is my rock of refuge.
Psa.94.22.kjv: But the Lord is my defence; and my God is the rock of my refuge.

Psa.108.10.bsb: Who will bring me to the fortified city? Who will lead me to Edom?
Psa.108.10.kjv: Who will bring me into the strong city? who will lead me into Edom?

Psa.108.11.bsb: Have You not rejected us, O God? Will You no longer march out, O God, with our armies?
Psa.108.11.kjv: Wilt not thou, O God, who hast cast us off? and wilt not thou, O God, go forth with our hosts?

Psa.108.12.bsb: Give us aid against the enemy, for the help of man is worthless.
Psa.108.12.kjv: Give us help from trouble: for vain is the help of man.

Psa.108.13.bsb: With God we will perform with valor, and He will trample our enemies.
Psa.108.13.kjv: Through God we shall do valiantly: for he it is that shall tread down our enemies.

Psa.115.12.bsb: The LORD is mindful of us; He will bless us. He will bless the house of Israel; He will bless the house of Aaron;
Psa.115.12.kjv: The Lord hath been mindful of us: he will bless us; he will bless the house of Israel; he will bless the house of Aaron.

Psa.115.13.bsb: He will bless those who fear the LORD—small and great alike.
Psa.115.13.kjv: He will bless them that fear the Lord, both small and great.

Psa.115.14.bsb: May the LORD give you increase, both you and your children.
Psa.115.14.kjv: The Lord shall increase you more and more, you and your children.

Psa.116.7.bsb: Return to your rest, O my soul, for the LORD has been good to you.
Psa.116.7.kjv: Return unto thy rest, O my soul; for the Lord hath dealt bountifully with thee.

Psa.118.6.bsb: The LORD is on my side; I will not be afraid. What can man do to me?
Psa.118.6.kjv: The Lord is on my side; I will not fear: what can man do unto me?

Psa.118.7.bsb: The LORD is on my side; He is my helper. Therefore I will look in triumph on those who hate me.
Psa.118.7.kjv: The Lord taketh my part with them that help me: therefore shall I see my desire upon them that hate me.

Psa.118.10.bsb: All the nations surrounded me, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
Psa.118.10.kjv: All nations compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord will I destroy them.

Psa.118.14.bsb: The LORD is my strength and my song, and He has become my salvation.
Psa.118.14.kjv: The Lord is my strength and song, and is become my salvation.

Psa.118.17.bsb: I will not die, but I will live and proclaim what the LORD has done.
Psa.118.17.kjv: I shall not die, but live, and declare the works of the Lord.

Psa.119.42.bsb: Then I can answer him who taunts, for I trust in Your word.
Psa.119.42.kjv: So shall I have wherewith to answer him that reproacheth me: for I trust in thy word.

Psa.119.43.bsb: Never take Your word of truth from my mouth, for I hope in Your judgments.
Psa.119.43.kjv: And take not the word of truth utterly out of my mouth; for I have hoped in thy judgments.

Psa.119.57.bsb: The LORD is my portion; I have promised to keep Your words.
Psa.119.57.kjv: ח CHETH. Thou art my portion, O Lord: I have said that I would keep thy words.

Psa.119.74.bsb: May those who fear You see me and rejoice, for I have hoped in Your word.
Psa.119.74.kjv: They that fear thee will be glad when they see me; because I have hoped in thy word.

Psa.119.81.bsb: My soul faints for Your salvation; I wait for Your word.
Psa.119.81.kjv: כ CAPH. My soul fainteth for thy salvation: but I hope in thy word.

Psa.119.114.bsb: You are my hiding place and my shield; I put my hope in Your word.
Psa.119.114.kjv: Thou art my hiding place and my shield: I hope in thy word.

Psa.119.151.bsb: You are near, O LORD, and all Your commandments are true.
Psa.119.151.kjv: Thou art near, O Lord; and all thy commandments are truth.

Psa.119.166.bsb: I wait for Your salvation, O LORD, and I carry out Your commandments.
Psa.119.166.kjv: Lord, I have hoped for thy salvation, and done thy commandments.

Psa.121.2.bsb: My help comes from the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
Psa.121.2.kjv: My help cometh from the Lord, which made heaven and earth.

Psa.130.5.bsb: I wait for the LORD; my soul does wait, and in His word I put my hope.
Psa.130.5.kjv: I wait for the Lord, my soul doth wait, and in his word do I hope.

Psa.130.6.bsb: My soul waits for the Lord more than watchmen wait for the morning—more than watchmen wait for the morning.
Psa.130.6.kjv: My soul waiteth for the Lord more than they that watch for the morning: I say, more than they that watch for the morning.

Psa.138.7.bsb: If I walk in the midst of trouble, You preserve me from the anger of my foes; You extend Your hand, and Your right hand saves me.
Psa.138.7.kjv: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me: thou shalt stretch forth thine hand against the wrath of mine enemies, and thy right hand shall save me.

Psa.138.8.bsb: The LORD will fulfill His purpose for me. O LORD, Your loving devotion endures forever—do not abandon the works of Your hands.
Psa.138.8.kjv: The Lord will perfect that which concerneth me: thy mercy, O Lord, endureth for ever: forsake not the works of thine own hands.

Psa.140.6.bsb: I say to the LORD, “You are my God.” Hear, O LORD, my cry for help.
Psa.140.6.kjv: I said unto the Lord, Thou art my God: hear the voice of my supplications, O Lord.

Psa.140.12.bsb: I know that the LORD upholds justice for the poor and defends the cause of the needy.
Psa.140.12.kjv: I know that the Lord will maintain the cause of the afflicted, and the right of the poor.

Psa.141.8.bsb: But my eyes are fixed on You, O GOD the Lord. In You I seek refuge; do not leave my soul defenseless.
Psa.141.8.kjv: But mine eyes are unto thee, O God the Lord: in thee is my trust; leave not my soul destitute.

Psa.142.3.bsb: Although my spirit grows faint within me, You know my way. Along the path I travel they have hidden a snare for me.
Psa.142.3.kjv: When my spirit was overwhelmed within me, then thou knewest my path. In the way wherein I walked have they privily laid a snare for me.

Psa.142.5.bsb: I cry to You, O LORD: “You are my refuge, my portion in the land of the living.”
Psa.142.5.kjv: I cried unto thee, O Lord: I said, Thou art my refuge and my portion in the land of the living.

Psa.143.8.bsb: Let me hear Your loving devotion in the morning, for I have put my trust in You. Teach me the way I should walk, for to You I lift up my soul.
Psa.143.8.kjv: Cause me to hear thy lovingkindness in the morning; for in thee do I trust: cause me to know the way wherein I should walk; for I lift up my soul unto thee.

Psa.143.9.bsb: Deliver me from my enemies, O LORD; I flee to You for refuge.
Psa.143.9.kjv: Deliver me, O Lord, from mine enemies: I flee unto thee to hide me.

Psa.144.2.bsb: He is my steadfast love and my fortress, my stronghold and my deliverer. He is my shield, in whom I take refuge, who subdues peoples under me.
Psa.144.2.kjv: My goodness, and my fortress; my high tower, and my deliverer; my shield, and he in whom I trust; who subdueth my people under me.

Psa.144.10.bsb: to Him who gives victory to kings, who frees His servant David from the deadly sword.
Psa.144.10.kjv: It is he that giveth salvation unto kings: who delivereth David his servant from the hurtful sword.

Psa.101.7.bsb: No one who practices deceit shall dwell in my house; no one who tells lies shall stand in my presence.
Psa.101.7.kjv: He that worketh deceit shall not dwell within my house: he that telleth lies shall not tarry in my sight.

Psa.101.2.bsb: I will ponder the way that is blameless—when will You come to me? I will walk in my house with integrity of heart.
Psa.101.2.kjv: I will behave myself wisely in a perfect way. O when wilt thou come unto me? I will walk within my house with a perfect heart.

Psa.83.18.bsb: May they know that You alone, whose name is the LORD, are Most High over all the earth.
Psa.83.18.kjv: That men may know that thou, whose name alone is Jehovah, art the most high over all the earth.

Psa.111.9.bsb: He has sent redemption to His people; He has ordained His covenant forever; holy and awesome is His name.
Psa.111.9.kjv: He sent redemption unto his people: he hath commanded his covenant for ever: holy and reverend is his name.

Psa.97.6.bsb: The heavens proclaim His righteousness; all the peoples see His glory.
Psa.97.6.kjv: The heavens declare his righteousness, and all the people see his glory.

Psa.104.2.bsb: He wraps Himself in light as with a garment; He stretches out the heavens like a tent,
Psa.104.2.kjv: Who coverest thyself with light as with a garment: who stretchest out the heavens like a curtain:

Psa.104.3.bsb: laying the beams of His chambers in the waters above, making the clouds His chariot, walking on the wings of the wind.
Psa.104.3.kjv: Who layeth the beams of his chambers in the waters: who maketh the clouds his chariot: who walketh upon the wings of the wind:

Psa.104.5.bsb: He set the earth on its foundations, never to be moved.
Psa.104.5.kjv: Who laid the foundations of the earth, that it should not be removed for ever.

Psa.104.6.bsb: You covered it with the deep like a garment; the waters stood above the mountains.
Psa.104.6.kjv: Thou coveredst it with the deep as with a garment: the waters stood above the mountains.

Psa.104.7.bsb: At Your rebuke the waters fled; at the sound of Your thunder they hurried away—
Psa.104.7.kjv: At thy rebuke they fled; at the voice of thy thunder they hasted away.

Psa.104.8.bsb: the mountains rose and the valleys sank to the place You assigned for them—
Psa.104.8.kjv: They go up by the mountains; they go down by the valleys unto the place which thou hast founded for them.

Psa.104.9.bsb: You set a boundary they cannot cross, that they may never again cover the earth.
Psa.104.9.kjv: Thou hast set a bound that they may not pass over; that they turn not again to cover the earth.

Psa.104.10.bsb: He sends forth springs in the valleys; they flow between the mountains.
Psa.104.10.kjv: He sendeth the springs into the valleys, which run among the hills.

Psa.104.11.bsb: They give drink to every beast of the field; the wild donkeys quench their thirst.
Psa.104.11.kjv: They give drink to every beast of the field: the wild asses quench their thirst.

Psa.104.12.bsb: The birds of the air nest beside the springs; they sing among the branches.
Psa.104.12.kjv: By them shall the fowls of the heaven have their habitation, which sing among the branches.

Psa.104.13.bsb: He waters the mountains from His chambers; the earth is satisfied by the fruit of His works.
Psa.104.13.kjv: He watereth the hills from his chambers: the earth is satisfied with the fruit of thy works.

Psa.104.14.bsb: He makes the grass grow for the livestock and provides crops for man to cultivate, bringing forth food from the earth:
Psa.104.14.kjv: He causeth the grass to grow for the cattle, and herb for the service of man: that he may bring forth food out of the earth;

Psa.104.15.bsb: wine that gladdens the heart of man, oil that makes his face to shine, and bread that sustains his heart.
Psa.104.15.kjv: And wine that maketh glad the heart of man, and oil to make his face to shine, and bread which strengtheneth man’s heart.

Psa.104.16.bsb: The trees of the LORD have their fill, the cedars of Lebanon that He planted,
Psa.104.16.kjv: The trees of the Lord are full of sap; the cedars of Lebanon, which he hath planted;

Psa.104.17.bsb: where the birds build their nests; the stork makes her home in the cypresses.
Psa.104.17.kjv: Where the birds make their nests: as for the stork, the fir trees are her house.

Psa.104.18.bsb: The high mountains are for the wild goats, the cliffs a refuge for the rock badgers.
Psa.104.18.kjv: The high hills are a refuge for the wild goats; and the rocks for the conies.

Psa.104.19.bsb: He made the moon to mark the seasons; the sun knows when to set.
Psa.104.19.kjv: He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.

Psa.104.20.bsb: You bring darkness, and it becomes night, when all the beasts of the forest prowl.
Psa.104.20.kjv: Thou makest darkness, and it is night: wherein all the beasts of the forest do creep forth.

Psa.104.21.bsb: The young lions roar for their prey and seek their food from God.
Psa.104.21.kjv: The young lions roar after their prey, and seek their meat from God.

Psa.104.22.bsb: The sun rises, and they withdraw; they lie down in their dens.
Psa.104.22.kjv: The sun ariseth, they gather themselves together, and lay them down in their dens.

Psa.104.23.bsb: Man goes forth to his work and to his labor until evening.
Psa.104.23.kjv: Man goeth forth unto his work and to his labour until the evening.

Psa.104.25.bsb: Here is the sea, vast and wide, teeming with creatures beyond number, living things both great and small.
Psa.104.25.kjv: So is this great and wide sea, wherein are things creeping innumerable, both small and great beasts.

Psa.104.26.bsb: There the ships pass, and Leviathan, which You formed to frolic there.
Psa.104.26.kjv: There go the ships: there is that leviathan, whom thou hast made to play therein.

Psa.104.27.bsb: All creatures look to You to give them their food in due season.
Psa.104.27.kjv: These wait all upon thee; that thou mayest give them their meat in due season.

Psa.104.28.bsb: When You give it to them, they gather it up; when You open Your hand, they are satisfied with good things.
Psa.104.28.kjv: That thou givest them they gather: thou openest thine hand, they are filled with good.

Psa.104.32.bsb: He looks on the earth, and it trembles; He touches the mountains, and they smolder.
Psa.104.32.kjv: He looketh on the earth, and it trembleth: he toucheth the hills, and they smoke.

Psa.107.23.bsb: Others went out to sea in ships, conducting trade on the mighty waters.
Psa.107.23.kjv: They that go down to the sea in ships, that do business in great waters;

Psa.107.24.bsb: They saw the works of the LORD, and His wonders in the deep.
Psa.107.24.kjv: These see the works of the Lord, and his wonders in the deep.

Psa.107.25.bsb: For He spoke and raised a tempest that lifted the waves of the sea.
Psa.107.25.kjv: For he commandeth, and raiseth the stormy wind, which lifteth up the waves thereof.

Psa.107.26.bsb: They mounted up to the heavens, then sunk to the depths; their courage melted in their anguish.
Psa.107.26.kjv: They mount up to the heaven, they go down again to the depths: their soul is melted because of trouble.

Psa.119.90.bsb: Your faithfulness continues through all generations; You established the earth, and it endures.
Psa.119.90.kjv: Thy faithfulness is unto all generations: thou hast established the earth, and it abideth.

Psa.119.91.bsb: Your ordinances stand to this day, for all things are servants to You.
Psa.119.91.kjv: They continue this day according to thine ordinances: for all are thy servants.

Psa.135.7.bsb: He causes the clouds to rise from the ends of the earth. He generates the lightning with the rain and brings forth the wind from His storehouses.
Psa.135.7.kjv: He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.

Psa.147.15.bsb: He sends forth His command to the earth; His word runs swiftly.
Psa.147.15.kjv: He sendeth forth his commandment upon earth: his word runneth very swiftly.

Psa.147.16.bsb: He spreads the snow like wool; He scatters the frost like ashes;
Psa.147.16.kjv: He giveth snow like wool: he scattereth the hoarfrost like ashes.

Psa.147.17.bsb: He casts forth His hail like pebbles. Who can withstand His icy blast?
Psa.147.17.kjv: He casteth forth his ice like morsels: who can stand before his cold?

Psa.147.18.bsb: He sends forth His word and melts them; He unleashes His winds, and the waters flow.
Psa.147.18.kjv: He sendeth out his word, and melteth them: he causeth his wind to blow, and the waters flow.

Psa.148.3.bsb: Praise Him, O sun and moon; praise Him, all you shining stars.
Psa.148.3.kjv: Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.

Psa.148.4.bsb: Praise Him, O highest heavens, and you waters above the skies.
Psa.148.4.kjv: Praise him, ye heavens of heavens, and ye waters that be above the heavens.

Psa.148.6.bsb: He established them forever and ever; He issued a decree that will never pass away.
Psa.148.6.kjv: He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.

Psa.24.4.bsb: He who has clean hands and a pure heart, who does not lift up his soul to an idol or swear deceitfully.
Psa.24.4.kjv: He that hath clean hands, and a pure heart; who hath not lifted up his soul unto vanity, nor sworn deceitfully.

Psa.43.2.bsb: For You are the God of my refuge. Why have You rejected me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?
Psa.43.2.kjv: For thou art the God of my strength: why dost thou cast me off? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

Psa.19.4.bsb: their voice has gone out into all the earth, their words to the ends of the world. In the heavens He has pitched a tent for the sun.
Psa.19.4.kjv: Their line is gone out through all the earth, and their words to the end of the world. In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun,

Psa.24.1.bsb: A Psalm of David. The earth is the LORD’s, and the fullness thereof, the world and all who dwell therein.
Psa.24.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. The earth is the Lord’s, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

Psa.24.2.bsb: For He has founded it upon the seas and established it upon the waters.
Psa.24.2.kjv: For he hath founded it upon the seas, and established it upon the floods.

Psa.33.7.bsb: He piles up the waters of the sea; He puts the depths into storehouses.
Psa.33.7.kjv: He gathereth the waters of the sea together as an heap: he layeth up the depth in storehouses.

Psa.65.6.bsb: You formed the mountains by Your power, having girded Yourself with might.
Psa.65.6.kjv: Which by his strength setteth fast the mountains; being girded with power:

Psa.74.16.bsb: The day is Yours, and also the night; You established the moon and the sun.
Psa.74.16.kjv: The day is thine, the night also is thine: thou hast prepared the light and the sun.

Psa.74.17.bsb: You set all the boundaries of the earth; You made the summer and winter.
Psa.74.17.kjv: Thou hast set all the borders of the earth: thou hast made summer and winter.

Psa.89.47.bsb: Remember the briefness of my lifespan! For what futility You have created all men!
Psa.89.47.kjv: Remember how short my time is: wherefore hast thou made all men in vain?

Psa.90.2.bsb: Before the mountains were born or You brought forth the earth and the world, from everlasting to everlasting You are God.
Psa.90.2.kjv: Before the mountains were brought forth, or ever thou hadst formed the earth and the world, even from everlasting to everlasting, thou art God.

Psa.95.4.bsb: In His hand are the depths of the earth, and the mountain peaks belong to Him.
Psa.95.4.kjv: In his hand are the deep places of the earth: the strength of the hills is his also.

Psa.95.5.bsb: The sea is His, for He made it, and His hands formed the dry land.
Psa.95.5.kjv: The sea is his, and he made it: and his hands formed the dry land.

Psa.102.25.bsb: In the beginning You laid the foundations of the earth, and the heavens are the work of Your hands.
Psa.102.25.kjv: Of old hast thou laid the foundation of the earth: and the heavens are the work of thy hands.

Psa.103.22.bsb: Bless the LORD, all His works in all places of His dominion. Bless the LORD, O my soul!
Psa.103.22.kjv: Bless the Lord, all his works in all places of his dominion: bless the Lord, O my soul.

Psa.136.6.bsb: He spread out the earth upon the waters. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.6.kjv: To him that stretched out the earth above the waters: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.136.7.bsb: He made the great lights—His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.7.kjv: To him that made great lights: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.8.bsb: the sun to rule the day, His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.8.kjv: The sun to rule by day: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.9.bsb: the moon and stars to govern the night. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.9.kjv: The moon and stars to rule by night: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.33.15.bsb: He shapes the hearts of each; He considers all their works.
Psa.33.15.kjv: He fashioneth their hearts alike; he considereth all their works.

Psa.100.3.bsb: Know that the LORD is God. It is He who made us, and we are His; we are His people, and the sheep of His pasture.
Psa.100.3.kjv: Know ye that the Lord he is God: it is he that hath made us, and not we ourselves; we are his people, and the sheep of his pasture.

Psa.119.73.bsb: Your hands have made me and fashioned me; give me understanding to learn Your commandments.
Psa.119.73.kjv: י JOD. Thy hands have made me and fashioned me: give me understanding, that I may learn thy commandments.

Psa.139.13.bsb: For You formed my inmost being; You knit me together in my mother’s womb.
Psa.139.13.kjv: For thou hast possessed my reins: thou hast covered me in my mother’s womb.

Psa.9.7.bsb: But the LORD abides forever; He has established His throne for judgment.
Psa.9.7.kjv: But the Lord shall endure for ever: he hath prepared his throne for judgment.

Psa.33.11.bsb: The counsel of the LORD stands forever, the purposes of His heart to all generations.
Psa.33.11.kjv: The counsel of the Lord standeth for ever, the thoughts of his heart to all generations.

Psa.41.13.bsb: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Amen and Amen.
Psa.41.13.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting, and to everlasting. Amen, and Amen.

Psa.55.19.bsb: God will hear and humiliate them—the One enthroned for the ages—Selah because they do not change and they have no fear of God.
Psa.55.19.kjv: God shall hear, and afflict them, even he that abideth of old. Selah. Because they have no changes, therefore they fear not God.

Psa.68.33.bsb: to Him who rides upon the highest heavens of old; behold, His mighty voice resounds.
Psa.68.33.kjv: To him that rideth upon the heavens of heavens, which were of old; lo, he doth send out his voice, and that a mighty voice.

Psa.90.4.bsb: For in Your sight a thousand years are but a day that passes, or a watch of the night.
Psa.90.4.kjv: For a thousand years in thy sight are but as yesterday when it is past, and as a watch in the night.

Psa.92.8.bsb: But You, O LORD, are exalted forever!
Psa.92.8.kjv: But thou, Lord, art most high for evermore.

Psa.93.2.bsb: Your throne was established long ago; You are from all eternity.
Psa.93.2.kjv: Thy throne is established of old: thou art from everlasting.

Psa.102.12.bsb: But You, O LORD, sit enthroned forever; Your renown endures to all generations.
Psa.102.12.kjv: But thou, O Lord, shalt endure for ever; and thy remembrance unto all generations.

Psa.102.24.bsb: I say: “O my God, do not take me in the midst of my days! Your years go on through all generations.
Psa.102.24.kjv: I said, O my God, take me not away in the midst of my days: thy years are throughout all generations.

Psa.102.26.bsb: They will perish, but You remain; they will all wear out like a garment. Like clothing You will change them, and they will be passed on.
Psa.102.26.kjv: They shall perish, but thou shalt endure: yea, all of them shall wax old like a garment; as a vesture shalt thou change them, and they shall be changed:

Psa.102.27.bsb: But You remain the same, and Your years will never end.
Psa.102.27.kjv: But thou art the same, and thy years shall have no end.

Psa.135.13.bsb: Your name, O LORD, endures forever, Your renown, O LORD, through all generations.
Psa.135.13.kjv: Thy name, O Lord, endureth for ever; and thy memorial, O Lord, throughout all generations.

Psa.146.10.bsb: The LORD reigns forever, your God, O Zion, for all generations. Hallelujah!
Psa.146.10.kjv: The Lord shall reign for ever, even thy God, O Zion, unto all generations. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.19.9.bsb: The fear of the LORD is pure, enduring forever; the judgments of the LORD are true, being altogether righteous.
Psa.19.9.kjv: The fear of the Lord is clean, enduring for ever: the judgments of the Lord are true and righteous altogether.

Psa.25.10.bsb: All the LORD’s ways are loving and faithful to those who keep His covenant and His decrees.
Psa.25.10.kjv: All the paths of the Lord are mercy and truth unto such as keep his covenant and his testimonies.

Psa.33.4.bsb: For the word of the LORD is upright, and all His work is trustworthy.
Psa.33.4.kjv: For the word of the Lord is right; and all his works are done in truth.

Psa.36.5.bsb: Your loving devotion, O LORD, reaches to the heavens, Your faithfulness to the clouds.
Psa.36.5.kjv: Thy mercy, O Lord, is in the heavens; and thy faithfulness reacheth unto the clouds.

Psa.40.10.bsb: I have not covered up Your righteousness in my heart; I have declared Your faithfulness and salvation; I have not concealed Your loving devotion and faithfulness from the great assembly.
Psa.40.10.kjv: I have not hid thy righteousness within my heart; I have declared thy faithfulness and thy salvation: I have not concealed thy lovingkindness and thy truth from the great congregation.

Psa.92.1.bsb: A Psalm. A song for the Sabbath day. It is good to praise the LORD, and to sing praises to Your name, O Most High,
Psa.92.1.kjv: A Psalm or Song for the sabbath day. It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord, and to sing praises unto thy name, O most High:

Psa.92.2.bsb: to proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning and Your faithfulness at night
Psa.92.2.kjv: To shew forth thy lovingkindness in the morning, and thy faithfulness every night,

Psa.92.14.bsb: In old age they will still bear fruit; healthy and green they will remain,
Psa.92.14.kjv: They shall still bring forth fruit in old age; they shall be fat and flourishing;

Psa.98.3.bsb: He has remembered His love and faithfulness to the house of Israel; all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.
Psa.98.3.kjv: He hath remembered his mercy and his truth toward the house of Israel: all the ends of the earth have seen the salvation of our God.

Psa.100.5.bsb: For the LORD is good, and His loving devotion endures forever; His faithfulness continues to all generations.
Psa.100.5.kjv: For the Lord is good; his mercy is everlasting; and his truth endureth to all generations.

Psa.105.42.bsb: For He remembered His holy promise to Abraham His servant.
Psa.105.42.kjv: For he remembered his holy promise, and Abraham his servant.

Psa.111.7.bsb: The works of His hands are truth and justice; all His precepts are trustworthy.
Psa.111.7.kjv: The works of his hands are verity and judgment; all his commandments are sure.

Psa.111.8.bsb: They are upheld forever and ever, enacted in truth and uprightness.
Psa.111.8.kjv: They stand fast for ever and ever, and are done in truth and uprightness.

Psa.117.2.bsb: For great is His loving devotion toward us, and the faithfulness of the LORD endures forever. Hallelujah!
Psa.117.2.kjv: For his merciful kindness is great toward us: and the truth of the Lord endureth for ever. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.119.65.bsb: You are good to Your servant, O LORD, according to Your word.
Psa.119.65.kjv: ט TETH. Thou hast dealt well with thy servant, O Lord, according unto thy word.

Psa.119.89.bsb: Your word, O LORD, is everlasting; it is firmly fixed in the heavens.
Psa.119.89.kjv: ל LAMED. For ever, O Lord, thy word is settled in heaven.

Psa.121.3.bsb: He will not allow your foot to slip; your Protector will not slumber.
Psa.121.3.kjv: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: he that keepeth thee will not slumber.

Psa.8.9.bsb: O LORD, our Lord, how majestic is Your name in all the earth!
Psa.8.9.kjv: O Lord our Lord, how excellent is thy name in all the earth!

Psa.18.7.bsb: Then the earth shook and quaked, and the foundations of the mountains trembled; they were shaken because He burned with anger.
Psa.18.7.kjv: Then the earth shook and trembled; the foundations also of the hills moved and were shaken, because he was wroth.

Psa.18.8.bsb: Smoke rose from His nostrils, and consuming fire came from His mouth; glowing coals blazed forth.
Psa.18.8.kjv: There went up a smoke out of his nostrils, and fire out of his mouth devoured: coals were kindled by it.

Psa.18.9.bsb: He parted the heavens and came down with dark clouds beneath His feet.
Psa.18.9.kjv: He bowed the heavens also, and came down: and darkness was under his feet.

Psa.18.10.bsb: He mounted a cherub and flew; He soared on the wings of the wind.
Psa.18.10.kjv: And he rode upon a cherub, and did fly: yea, he did fly upon the wings of the wind.

Psa.18.11.bsb: He made darkness His hiding place, and storm clouds a canopy around Him.
Psa.18.11.kjv: He made darkness his secret place; his pavilion round about him were dark waters and thick clouds of the skies.

Psa.18.12.bsb: From the brightness of His presence His clouds advanced—hailstones and coals of fire.
Psa.18.12.kjv: At the brightness that was before him his thick clouds passed, hail stones and coals of fire.

Psa.18.13.bsb: The LORD thundered from heaven; the voice of the Most High resounded—hailstones and coals of fire.
Psa.18.13.kjv: The Lord also thundered in the heavens, and the Highest gave his voice; hail stones and coals of fire.

Psa.18.14.bsb: He shot His arrows and scattered the foes; He hurled lightning and routed them.
Psa.18.14.kjv: Yea, he sent out his arrows, and scattered them; and he shot out lightnings, and discomfited them.

Psa.18.15.bsb: The channels of the sea appeared, and the foundations of the world were exposed, at Your rebuke, O LORD, at the blast of the breath of Your nostrils.
Psa.18.15.kjv: Then the channels of waters were seen, and the foundations of the world were discovered at thy rebuke, O Lord, at the blast of the breath of thy nostrils.

Psa.19.2.bsb: Day after day they pour forth speech; night after night they reveal knowledge.
Psa.19.2.kjv: Day unto day uttereth speech, and night unto night sheweth knowledge.

Psa.19.3.bsb: Without speech or language, without a sound to be heard,
Psa.19.3.kjv: There is no speech nor language, where their voice is not heard.

Psa.24.8.bsb: Who is this King of Glory? The LORD strong and mighty, the LORD mighty in battle.
Psa.24.8.kjv: Who is this King of glory? The Lord strong and mighty, the Lord mighty in battle.

Psa.24.9.bsb: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
Psa.24.9.kjv: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; even lift them up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

Psa.24.10.bsb: Who is He, this King of Glory? The LORD of Hosts—He is the King of Glory. Selah
Psa.24.10.kjv: Who is this King of glory? The Lord of hosts, he is the King of glory. Selah.

Psa.29.2.bsb: Ascribe to the LORD the glory due His name; worship the LORD in the splendor of His holiness.
Psa.29.2.kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name; worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.

Psa.29.3.bsb: The voice of the LORD is over the waters; the God of glory thunders; the LORD is heard over many waters.
Psa.29.3.kjv: The voice of the Lord is upon the waters: the God of glory thundereth: the Lord is upon many waters.

Psa.29.4.bsb: The voice of the LORD is powerful; the voice of the LORD is majestic.
Psa.29.4.kjv: The voice of the Lord is powerful; the voice of the Lord is full of majesty.

Psa.57.11.bsb: Be exalted, O God, above the heavens; may Your glory cover all the earth.
Psa.57.11.kjv: Be thou exalted, O God, above the heavens: let thy glory be above all the earth.

Psa.76.4.bsb: You are resplendent with light, more majestic than mountains filled with game.
Psa.76.4.kjv: Thou art more glorious and excellent than the mountains of prey.

Psa.97.2.bsb: Clouds and darkness surround Him; righteousness and justice are His throne’s foundation.
Psa.97.2.kjv: Clouds and darkness are round about him: righteousness and judgment are the habitation of his throne.

Psa.97.3.bsb: Fire goes before Him and consumes His foes on every side.
Psa.97.3.kjv: A fire goeth before him, and burneth up his enemies round about.

Psa.97.4.bsb: His lightning illuminates the world; the earth sees and trembles.
Psa.97.4.kjv: His lightnings enlightened the world: the earth saw, and trembled.

Psa.97.5.bsb: The mountains melt like wax at the presence of the LORD, before the Lord of all the earth.
Psa.97.5.kjv: The hills melted like wax at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the Lord of the whole earth.

Psa.97.9.bsb: For You, O LORD, are Most High over all the earth; You are exalted far above all gods.
Psa.97.9.kjv: For thou, Lord, art high above all the earth: thou art exalted far above all gods.

Psa.106.8.bsb: Yet He saved them for the sake of His name, to make His power known.
Psa.106.8.kjv: Nevertheless he saved them for his name’s sake, that he might make his mighty power to be known.

Psa.17.7.bsb: Show the wonders of Your loving devotion, You who save by Your right hand those who seek refuge from their foes.
Psa.17.7.kjv: Shew thy marvellous lovingkindness, O thou that savest by thy right hand them which put their trust in thee from those that rise up against them.

Psa.25.8.bsb: Good and upright is the LORD; therefore He shows sinners the way.
Psa.25.8.kjv: Good and upright is the Lord: therefore will he teach sinners in the way.

Psa.25.9.bsb: He guides the humble in what is right and teaches them His way.
Psa.25.9.kjv: The meek will he guide in judgment: and the meek will he teach his way.

Psa.52.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of David. After Doeg the Edomite went to Saul and told him, “David has gone to the house of Ahimelech.” Why do you boast of evil, O mighty man? The loving devotion of God endures all day long.
Psa.52.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, Maschil, A Psalm of David, when Doeg the Edomite came and told Saul, and said unto him, David is come to the house of Ahimelech. Why boastest thou thyself in mischief, O mighty man? the goodness of God endureth continually.

Psa.52.9.bsb: I will praise You forever, because You have done it. I will wait on Your name—for it is good—in the presence of Your saints.
Psa.52.9.kjv: I will praise thee for ever, because thou hast done it: and I will wait on thy name; for it is good before thy saints.

Psa.68.19.bsb: Blessed be the Lord, who daily bears our burden, the God of our salvation. Selah
Psa.68.19.kjv: Blessed be the Lord, who daily loadeth us with benefits, even the God of our salvation. Selah.

Psa.69.16.bsb: Answer me, O LORD, for Your loving devotion is good; turn to me in keeping with Your great compassion.
Psa.69.16.kjv: Hear me, O Lord; for thy lovingkindness is good: turn unto me according to the multitude of thy tender mercies.

Psa.73.1.bsb: A Psalm of Asaph. Surely God is good to Israel, to those who are pure in heart.
Psa.73.1.kjv: A Psalm of Asaph. Truly God is good to Israel, even to such as are of a clean heart.

Psa.86.5.bsb: For You, O Lord, are kind and forgiving, rich in loving devotion to all who call on You.
Psa.86.5.kjv: For thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

Psa.106.1.bsb: Hallelujah! Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.106.1.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.107.8.bsb: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
Psa.107.8.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

Psa.107.9.bsb: For He satisfies the thirsty and fills the hungry with good things.
Psa.107.9.kjv: For he satisfieth the longing soul, and filleth the hungry soul with goodness.

Psa.107.43.bsb: Let him who is wise pay heed to these things and consider the loving devotion of the LORD.
Psa.107.43.kjv: Whoso is wise, and will observe these things, even they shall understand the lovingkindness of the Lord.

Psa.118.29.bsb: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.118.29.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.119.64.bsb: The earth is filled with Your loving devotion, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
Psa.119.64.kjv: The earth, O Lord, is full of thy mercy: teach me thy statutes.

Psa.119.68.bsb: You are good, and You do what is good; teach me Your statutes.
Psa.119.68.kjv: Thou art good, and doest good; teach me thy statutes.

Psa.135.3.bsb: Hallelujah, for the LORD is good; sing praises to His name, for it is lovely.
Psa.135.3.kjv: Praise the Lord; for the Lord is good: sing praises unto his name; for it is pleasant.

Psa.136.1.bsb: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.1.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.139.17.bsb: How precious to me are Your thoughts, O God, how vast is their sum!
Psa.139.17.kjv: How precious also are thy thoughts unto me, O God! how great is the sum of them!

Psa.139.18.bsb: If I were to count them, they would outnumber the grains of sand; and when I awake, I am still with You.
Psa.139.18.kjv: If I should count them, they are more in number than the sand: when I awake, I am still with thee.

Psa.144.3.bsb: O LORD, what is man, that You regard him, the son of man that You think of him?
Psa.144.3.kjv: Lord, what is man, that thou takest knowledge of him! or the son of man, that thou makest account of him!

Psa.145.7.bsb: They will extol the fame of Your abundant goodness and sing joyfully of Your righteousness.
Psa.145.7.kjv: They shall abundantly utter the memory of thy great goodness, and shall sing of thy righteousness.

Psa.145.9.bsb: The LORD is good to all; His compassion rests on all He has made.
Psa.145.9.kjv: The Lord is good to all: and his tender mercies are over all his works.

Psa.3.8.bsb: Salvation belongs to the LORD; may Your blessing be on Your people. Selah
Psa.3.8.kjv: Salvation belongeth unto the Lord: thy blessing is upon thy people. Selah.

Psa.5.12.bsb: For surely You, O LORD, bless the righteous; You surround them with the shield of Your favor.
Psa.5.12.kjv: For thou, Lord, wilt bless the righteous; with favour wilt thou compass him as with a shield.

Psa.11.7.bsb: For the LORD is righteous; He loves justice. The upright will see His face.
Psa.11.7.kjv: For the righteous Lord loveth righteousness; his countenance doth behold the upright.

Psa.18.19.bsb: He brought me out into the open; He rescued me because He delighted in me.
Psa.18.19.kjv: He brought me forth also into a large place; he delivered me, because he delighted in me.

Psa.18.25.bsb: To the faithful You show Yourself faithful, to the blameless You show Yourself blameless;
Psa.18.25.kjv: With the merciful thou wilt shew thyself merciful; with an upright man thou wilt shew thyself upright;

Psa.18.26.bsb: to the pure You show Yourself pure, but to the crooked You show Yourself shrewd.
Psa.18.26.kjv: With the pure thou wilt shew thyself pure; and with the froward thou wilt shew thyself froward.

Psa.24.5.bsb: He will receive blessing from the LORD and vindication from the God of his salvation.
Psa.24.5.kjv: He shall receive the blessing from the Lord, and righteousness from the God of his salvation.

Psa.25.14.bsb: The LORD confides in those who fear Him, and reveals His covenant to them.
Psa.25.14.kjv: The secret of the Lord is with them that fear him; and he will shew them his covenant.

Psa.30.7.bsb: O LORD, You favored me; You made my mountain stand strong. When You hid Your face, I was dismayed.
Psa.30.7.kjv: Lord, by thy favour thou hast made my mountain to stand strong: thou didst hide thy face, and I was troubled.

Psa.36.9.bsb: For with You is the fountain of life; in Your light we see light.
Psa.36.9.kjv: For with thee is the fountain of life: in thy light shall we see light.

Psa.37.18.bsb: The LORD knows the days of the blameless, and their inheritance will last forever.
Psa.37.18.kjv: The Lord knoweth the days of the upright: and their inheritance shall be for ever.

Psa.37.23.bsb: The steps of a man are ordered by the LORD who takes delight in his journey.
Psa.37.23.kjv: The steps of a good man are ordered by the Lord: and he delighteth in his way.

Psa.41.11.bsb: By this I know that You delight in me, for my enemy does not triumph over me.
Psa.41.11.kjv: By this I know that thou favourest me, because mine enemy doth not triumph over me.

Psa.44.3.bsb: For it was not by their sword that they took the land; their arm did not bring them victory. It was by Your right hand, Your arm, and the light of Your face, because You favored them.
Psa.44.3.kjv: For they got not the land in possession by their own sword, neither did their own arm save them: but thy right hand, and thine arm, and the light of thy countenance, because thou hadst a favour unto them.

Psa.58.11.bsb: Then men will say, “There is surely a reward for the righteous! There is surely a God who judges the earth!”
Psa.58.11.kjv: So that a man shall say, Verily there is a reward for the righteous: verily he is a God that judgeth in the earth.

Psa.68.16.bsb: Why do you gaze in envy, O mountains of many peaks? This is the mountain God chose for His dwelling, where the LORD will surely dwell forever.
Psa.68.16.kjv: Why leap ye, ye high hills? this is the hill which God desireth to dwell in; yea, the Lord will dwell in it for ever.

Psa.75.10.bsb: “All the horns of the wicked I will cut off, but the horns of the righteous will be exalted.”
Psa.75.10.kjv: All the horns of the wicked also will I cut off; but the horns of the righteous shall be exalted.

Psa.94.19.bsb: When anxiety overwhelms me, Your consolation delights my soul.
Psa.94.19.kjv: In the multitude of my thoughts within me thy comforts delight my soul.

Psa.115.15.bsb: May you be blessed by the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth.
Psa.115.15.kjv: Ye are blessed of the Lord which made heaven and earth.

Psa.149.4.bsb: For the LORD takes pleasure in His people; He adorns the afflicted with salvation.
Psa.149.4.kjv: For the Lord taketh pleasure in his people: he will beautify the meek with salvation.

Psa.5.8.bsb: Lead me, O LORD, in Your righteousness because of my enemies; make straight Your way before me.
Psa.5.8.kjv: Lead me, O Lord, in thy righteousness because of mine enemies; make thy way straight before my face.

Psa.32.8.bsb: I will instruct you and teach you the way you should go; I will give you counsel and watch over you.
Psa.32.8.kjv: I will instruct thee and teach thee in the way which thou shalt go: I will guide thee with mine eye.

Psa.78.52.bsb: He led out His people like sheep and guided them like a flock in the wilderness.
Psa.78.52.kjv: But made his own people to go forth like sheep, and guided them in the wilderness like a flock.

Psa.107.7.bsb: He led them on a straight path to reach a city where they could live.
Psa.107.7.kjv: And he led them forth by the right way, that they might go to a city of habitation.

Psa.139.9.bsb: If I rise on the wings of the dawn, if I settle by the farthest sea,
Psa.139.9.kjv: If I take the wings of the morning, and dwell in the uttermost parts of the sea;

Psa.139.10.bsb: even there Your hand will guide me; Your right hand will hold me fast.
Psa.139.10.kjv: Even there shall thy hand lead me, and thy right hand shall hold me.

Psa.139.24.bsb: See if there is any offensive way in me; lead me in the way everlasting.
Psa.139.24.kjv: And see if there be any wicked way in me, and lead me in the way everlasting.

Psa.22.3.bsb: Yet You are holy, enthroned on the praises of Israel.
Psa.22.3.kjv: But thou art holy, O thou that inhabitest the praises of Israel.

Psa.30.4.bsb: Sing to the LORD, O you His saints, and praise His holy name.
Psa.30.4.kjv: Sing unto the Lord, O ye saints of his, and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

Psa.47.8.bsb: God reigns over the nations; God is seated on His holy throne.
Psa.47.8.kjv: God reigneth over the heathen: God sitteth upon the throne of his holiness.

Psa.48.10.bsb: Your name, O God, like Your praise, reaches to the ends of the earth; Your right hand is full of righteousness.
Psa.48.10.kjv: According to thy name, O God, so is thy praise unto the ends of the earth: thy right hand is full of righteousness.

Psa.60.6.bsb: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
Psa.60.6.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

Psa.98.1.bsb: A Psalm. Sing to the LORD a new song, for He has done wonders; His right hand and holy arm have gained Him the victory.
Psa.98.1.kjv: A Psalm. O sing unto the Lord a new song; for he hath done marvellous things: his right hand, and his holy arm, hath gotten him the victory.

Psa.99.3.bsb: Let them praise Your great and awesome name—He is holy!
Psa.99.3.kjv: Let them praise thy great and terrible name; for it is holy.

Psa.99.5.bsb: Exalt the LORD our God, and worship at His footstool; He is holy!
Psa.99.5.kjv: Exalt ye the Lord our God, and worship at his footstool; for he is holy.

Psa.99.9.bsb: Exalt the LORD our God and worship at His holy mountain, for the LORD our God is holy.
Psa.99.9.kjv: Exalt the Lord our God, and worship at his holy hill; for the Lord our God is holy.

Psa.105.3.bsb: Glory in His holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD rejoice.
Psa.105.3.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.

Psa.108.7.bsb: God has spoken from His sanctuary: “I will triumph! I will parcel out Shechem and apportion the Valley of Succoth.
Psa.108.7.kjv: God hath spoken in his holiness; I will rejoice, I will divide Shechem, and mete out the valley of Succoth.

Psa.119.142.bsb: Your righteousness is everlasting and Your law is true.
Psa.119.142.kjv: Thy righteousness is an everlasting righteousness, and thy law is the truth.

Psa.145.17.bsb: The LORD is righteous in all His ways and kind in all His deeds.
Psa.145.17.kjv: The Lord is righteous in all his ways, and holy in all his works.

Psa.7.8.bsb: The LORD judges the peoples; vindicate me, O LORD, according to my righteousness and integrity.
Psa.7.8.kjv: The Lord shall judge the people: judge me, O Lord, according to my righteousness, and according to mine integrity that is in me.

Psa.7.9.bsb: Put an end to the evil of the wicked, but establish the righteous, O righteous God who searches hearts and minds.
Psa.7.9.kjv: Oh let the wickedness of the wicked come to an end; but establish the just: for the righteous God trieth the hearts and reins.

Psa.9.8.bsb: He judges the world with justice; He governs the people with equity.
Psa.9.8.kjv: And he shall judge the world in righteousness, he shall minister judgment to the people in uprightness.

Psa.11.5.bsb: The LORD tests the righteous and the wicked; His soul hates the lover of violence.
Psa.11.5.kjv: The Lord trieth the righteous: but the wicked and him that loveth violence his soul hateth.

Psa.26.2.bsb: Test me, O LORD, and try me; examine my heart and mind.
Psa.26.2.kjv: Examine me, O Lord, and prove me; try my reins and my heart.

Psa.35.24.bsb: Vindicate me by Your righteousness, O LORD my God, and do not let them gloat over me.
Psa.35.24.kjv: Judge me, O Lord my God, according to thy righteousness; and let them not rejoice over me.

Psa.43.1.bsb: Vindicate me, O God, and plead my case against an ungodly nation; deliver me from deceitful and unjust men.
Psa.43.1.kjv: Judge me, O God, and plead my cause against an ungodly nation: O deliver me from the deceitful and unjust man.

Psa.50.4.bsb: He summons the heavens above, and the earth, that He may judge His people:
Psa.50.4.kjv: He shall call to the heavens from above, and to the earth, that he may judge his people.

Psa.50.6.bsb: And the heavens proclaim His righteousness, for God Himself is Judge. Selah
Psa.50.6.kjv: And the heavens shall declare his righteousness: for God is judge himself. Selah.

Psa.51.4.bsb: Against You, You only, have I sinned and done what is evil in Your sight, so that You may be proved right when You speak and blameless when You judge.
Psa.51.4.kjv: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight: that thou mightest be justified when thou speakest, and be clear when thou judgest.

Psa.67.4.bsb: Let the nations be glad and sing for joy, for You judge the peoples justly and lead the nations of the earth. Selah
Psa.67.4.kjv: O let the nations be glad and sing for joy: for thou shalt judge the people righteously, and govern the nations upon earth. Selah.

Psa.71.19.bsb: Your righteousness reaches to the heavens, O God, You who have done great things. Who, O God, is like You?
Psa.71.19.kjv: Thy righteousness also, O God, is very high, who hast done great things: O God, who is like unto thee!

Psa.75.7.bsb: but it is God who judges; He brings down one and exalts another.
Psa.75.7.kjv: But God is the judge: he putteth down one, and setteth up another.

Psa.76.8.bsb: From heaven You pronounced judgment, and the earth feared and was still
Psa.76.8.kjv: Thou didst cause judgment to be heard from heaven; the earth feared, and was still,

Psa.76.9.bsb: when God rose up to judge, to save all the lowly of the earth. Selah
Psa.76.9.kjv: When God arose to judgment, to save all the meek of the earth. Selah.

Psa.82.8.bsb: Arise, O God, judge the earth, for all the nations are Your inheritance.
Psa.82.8.kjv: Arise, O God, judge the earth: for thou shalt inherit all nations.

Psa.90.8.bsb: You have set our iniquities before You, our secret sins in the light of Your presence.
Psa.90.8.kjv: Thou hast set our iniquities before thee, our secret sins in the light of thy countenance.

Psa.94.1.bsb: O LORD, God of vengeance, O God of vengeance, shine forth.
Psa.94.1.kjv: O Lord God, to whom vengeance belongeth; O God, to whom vengeance belongeth, shew thyself.

Psa.94.2.bsb: Rise up, O Judge of the earth; render a reward to the proud.
Psa.94.2.kjv: Lift up thyself, thou judge of the earth: render a reward to the proud.

Psa.98.2.bsb: The LORD has proclaimed His salvation and revealed His righteousness to the nations.
Psa.98.2.kjv: The Lord hath made known his salvation: his righteousness hath he openly shewed in the sight of the heathen.

Psa.98.9.bsb: before the LORD, for He comes to judge the earth. He will judge the world with righteousness and the peoples with equity.
Psa.98.9.kjv: Before the Lord; for he cometh to judge the earth: with righteousness shall he judge the world, and the people with equity.

Psa.99.4.bsb: The mighty King loves justice. You have established equity; You have exercised justice and righteousness in Jacob.
Psa.99.4.kjv: The king’s strength also loveth judgment; thou dost establish equity, thou executest judgment and righteousness in Jacob.

Psa.99.8.bsb: O LORD our God, You answered them. You were a forgiving God to them, yet an avenger of their misdeeds.
Psa.99.8.kjv: Thou answeredst them, O Lord our God: thou wast a God that forgavest them, though thou tookest vengeance of their inventions.

Psa.103.6.bsb: The LORD executes righteousness and justice for all the oppressed.
Psa.103.6.kjv: The Lord executeth righteousness and judgment for all that are oppressed.

Psa.119.137.bsb: Righteous are You, O LORD, and upright are Your judgments.
Psa.119.137.kjv: צ TZADDI. Righteous art thou, O Lord, and upright are thy judgments.

Psa.129.4.bsb: The LORD is righteous; He has cut me from the cords of the wicked.
Psa.129.4.kjv: The Lord is righteous: he hath cut asunder the cords of the wicked.

Psa.135.14.bsb: For the LORD will vindicate His people and will have compassion on His servants.
Psa.135.14.kjv: For the Lord will judge his people, and he will repent himself concerning his servants.

Psa.1.6.bsb: For the LORD guards the path of the righteous, but the way of the wicked will perish.
Psa.1.6.kjv: For the Lord knoweth the way of the righteous: but the way of the ungodly shall perish.

Psa.33.13.bsb: The LORD looks down from heaven; He sees all the sons of men.
Psa.33.13.kjv: The Lord looketh from heaven; he beholdeth all the sons of men.

Psa.33.14.bsb: From His dwelling place He gazes on all who inhabit the earth.
Psa.33.14.kjv: From the place of his habitation he looketh upon all the inhabitants of the earth.

Psa.66.7.bsb: He rules forever by His power; His eyes watch the nations. Do not let the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah
Psa.66.7.kjv: He ruleth by his power for ever; his eyes behold the nations: let not the rebellious exalt themselves. Selah.

Psa.92.5.bsb: How great are Your works, O LORD, how deep are Your thoughts!
Psa.92.5.kjv: O Lord, how great are thy works! and thy thoughts are very deep.

Psa.119.168.bsb: I obey Your precepts and Your testimonies, for all my ways are before You.
Psa.119.168.kjv: I have kept thy precepts and thy testimonies: for all my ways are before thee.

Psa.139.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, You have searched me and known me.
Psa.139.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. O Lord, thou hast searched me, and known me.

Psa.139.2.bsb: You know when I sit and when I rise; You understand my thoughts from afar.
Psa.139.2.kjv: Thou knowest my downsitting and mine uprising, thou understandest my thought afar off.

Psa.139.3.bsb: You search out my path and my lying down; You are aware of all my ways.
Psa.139.3.kjv: Thou compassest my path and my lying down, and art acquainted with all my ways.

Psa.139.4.bsb: Even before a word is on my tongue, You know all about it, O LORD.
Psa.139.4.kjv: For there is not a word in my tongue, but, lo, O Lord, thou knowest it altogether.

Psa.139.5.bsb: You hem me in behind and before; You have laid Your hand upon me.
Psa.139.5.kjv: Thou hast beset me behind and before, and laid thine hand upon me.

Psa.139.6.bsb: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me, too lofty for me to attain.
Psa.139.6.kjv: Such knowledge is too wonderful for me; it is high, I cannot attain unto it.

Psa.139.7.bsb: Where can I go to escape Your Spirit? Where can I flee from Your presence?
Psa.139.7.kjv: Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

Psa.139.8.bsb: If I ascend to the heavens, You are there; if I make my bed in Sheol, You are there.
Psa.139.8.kjv: If I ascend up into heaven, thou art there: if I make my bed in hell, behold, thou art there.

Psa.139.11.bsb: If I say, “Surely the darkness will hide me, and the light become night around me”—
Psa.139.11.kjv: If I say, Surely the darkness shall cover me; even the night shall be light about me.

Psa.139.12.bsb: even the darkness is not dark to You, but the night shines like the day, for darkness is as light to You.
Psa.139.12.kjv: Yea, the darkness hideth not from thee; but the night shineth as the day: the darkness and the light are both alike to thee.

Psa.139.15.bsb: My frame was not hidden from You when I was made in secret, when I was woven together in the depths of the earth.
Psa.139.15.kjv: My substance was not hid from thee, when I was made in secret, and curiously wrought in the lowest parts of the earth.

Psa.139.16.bsb: Your eyes saw my unformed body; all my days were written in Your book and ordained for me before one of them came to be.
Psa.139.16.kjv: Thine eyes did see my substance, yet being unperfect; and in thy book all my members were written, which in continuance were fashioned, when as yet there was none of them.

Psa.139.19.bsb: O God, that You would slay the wicked—away from me, you bloodthirsty men—
Psa.139.19.kjv: Surely thou wilt slay the wicked, O God: depart from me therefore, ye bloody men.

Psa.139.21.bsb: Do I not hate those who hate You, O LORD, and detest those who rise against You?
Psa.139.21.kjv: Do not I hate them, O Lord, that hate thee? and am not I grieved with those that rise up against thee?

Psa.139.22.bsb: I hate them with perfect hatred; I count them as my enemies.
Psa.139.22.kjv: I hate them with perfect hatred: I count them mine enemies.

Psa.139.23.bsb: Search me, O God, and know my heart; test me and know my concerns.
Psa.139.23.kjv: Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts:

Psa.147.4.bsb: He determines the number of the stars; He calls them each by name.
Psa.147.4.kjv: He telleth the number of the stars; he calleth them all by their names.

Psa.86.15.bsb: But You, O Lord, are a compassionate and gracious God, slow to anger, abounding in loving devotion and faithfulness.
Psa.86.15.kjv: But thou, O Lord, art a God full of compassion, and gracious, longsuffering, and plenteous in mercy and truth.

Psa.103.9.bsb: He will not always accuse us, nor harbor His anger forever.
Psa.103.9.kjv: He will not always chide: neither will he keep his anger for ever.

Psa.103.10.bsb: He has not dealt with us according to our sins or repaid us according to our iniquities.
Psa.103.10.kjv: He hath not dealt with us after our sins; nor rewarded us according to our iniquities.

Psa.63.3.bsb: Because Your loving devotion is better than life, my lips will glorify You.
Psa.63.3.kjv: Because thy lovingkindness is better than life, my lips shall praise thee.

Psa.78.65.bsb: Then the Lord awoke as from sleep, like a mighty warrior overcome by wine.
Psa.78.65.kjv: Then the Lord awaked as one out of sleep, and like a mighty man that shouteth by reason of wine.

Psa.78.68.bsb: But He chose the tribe of Judah, Mount Zion, which He loved.
Psa.78.68.kjv: But chose the tribe of Judah, the mount Zion which he loved.

Psa.103.13.bsb: As a father has compassion on his children, so the LORD has compassion on those who fear Him.
Psa.103.13.kjv: Like as a father pitieth his children, so the Lord pitieth them that fear him.

Psa.146.8.bsb: the LORD opens the eyes of the blind, the LORD lifts those who are weighed down, the LORD loves the righteous.
Psa.146.8.kjv: The Lord openeth the eyes of the blind: the Lord raiseth them that are bowed down: the Lord loveth the righteous:

Psa.31.21.bsb: Blessed be the LORD, for He has shown me His loving devotion in a city under siege.
Psa.31.21.kjv: Blessed be the Lord: for he hath shewed me his marvellous kindness in a strong city.

Psa.50.5.bsb: “Gather to Me My saints, who made a covenant with Me by sacrifice.”
Psa.50.5.kjv: Gather my saints together unto me; those that have made a covenant with me by sacrifice.

Psa.50.7.bsb: “Hear, O My people, and I will speak, O Israel, and I will testify against you: I am God, your God.
Psa.50.7.kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will speak; O Israel, and I will testify against thee: I am God, even thy God.

Psa.79.13.bsb: Then we Your people, the sheep of Your pasture, will thank You forever; from generation to generation we will declare Your praise.
Psa.79.13.kjv: So we thy people and sheep of thy pasture will give thee thanks for ever: we will shew forth thy praise to all generations.

Psa.95.7.bsb: For He is our God, and we are the people of His pasture, the sheep under His care. Today, if you hear His voice,
Psa.95.7.kjv: For he is our God; and we are the people of his pasture, and the sheep of his hand. To day if ye will hear his voice,

Psa.103.4.bsb: who redeems your life from the Pit and crowns you with loving devotion and compassion,
Psa.103.4.kjv: Who redeemeth thy life from destruction; who crowneth thee with lovingkindness and tender mercies;

Psa.105.6.bsb: O offspring of His servant Abraham, O sons of Jacob, His chosen ones.
Psa.105.6.kjv: O ye seed of Abraham his servant, ye children of Jacob his chosen.

Psa.135.4.bsb: For the LORD has chosen Jacob as His own, Israel as His treasured possession.
Psa.135.4.kjv: For the Lord hath chosen Jacob unto himself, and Israel for his peculiar treasure.

Psa.148.14.bsb: He has raised up a horn for His people, the praise of all His saints, of Israel, a people near to Him. Hallelujah!
Psa.148.14.kjv: He also exalteth the horn of his people, the praise of all his saints; even of the children of Israel, a people near unto him. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.18.50.bsb: Great salvation He brings to His king. He shows loving devotion to His anointed, to David and his descendants forever.
Psa.18.50.kjv: Great deliverance giveth he to his king; and sheweth mercy to his anointed, to David, and to his seed for evermore.

Psa.25.6.bsb: Remember, O LORD, Your compassion and loving devotion, for they are from age to age.
Psa.25.6.kjv: Remember, O Lord, thy tender mercies and thy lovingkindnesses; for they have been ever of old.

Psa.30.5.bsb: For His anger is fleeting, but His favor lasts a lifetime. Weeping may stay the night, but joy comes in the morning.
Psa.30.5.kjv: For his anger endureth but a moment; in his favour is life: weeping may endure for a night, but joy cometh in the morning.

Psa.31.7.bsb: I will be glad and rejoice in Your loving devotion, for You have seen my affliction; You have known the anguish of my soul.
Psa.31.7.kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thy mercy: for thou hast considered my trouble; thou hast known my soul in adversities;

Psa.32.1.bsb: Of David. A Maskil. Blessed is he whose transgressions are forgiven, whose sins are covered.
Psa.32.1.kjv: A Psalm of David, Maschil. Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered.

Psa.32.2.bsb: Blessed is the man whose iniquity the LORD does not count against him, in whose spirit there is no deceit.
Psa.32.2.kjv: Blessed is the man unto whom the Lord imputeth not iniquity, and in whose spirit there is no guile.

Psa.32.5.bsb: Then I acknowledged my sin to You and did not hide my iniquity. I said, “I will confess my transgressions to the LORD,” and You forgave the guilt of my sin. Selah
Psa.32.5.kjv: I acknowledged my sin unto thee, and mine iniquity have I not hid. I said, I will confess my transgressions unto the Lord; and thou forgavest the iniquity of my sin. Selah.

Psa.57.10.bsb: For Your loving devotion reaches to the heavens, and Your faithfulness to the clouds.
Psa.57.10.kjv: For thy mercy is great unto the heavens, and thy truth unto the clouds.

Psa.65.3.bsb: When iniquities prevail against me, You atone for our transgressions.
Psa.65.3.kjv: Iniquities prevail against me: as for our transgressions, thou shalt purge them away.

Psa.78.9.bsb: The archers of Ephraim turned back on the day of battle.
Psa.78.9.kjv: The children of Ephraim, being armed, and carrying bows, turned back in the day of battle.

Psa.78.12.bsb: He worked wonders before their fathers in the land of Egypt, in the region of Zoan.
Psa.78.12.kjv: Marvellous things did he in the sight of their fathers, in the land of Egypt, in the field of Zoan.

Psa.78.13.bsb: He split the sea and brought them through; He set the waters upright like a wall.
Psa.78.13.kjv: He divided the sea, and caused them to pass through; and he made the waters to stand as an heap.

Psa.78.14.bsb: He led them with a cloud by day and with a light of fire all night.
Psa.78.14.kjv: In the daytime also he led them with a cloud, and all the night with a light of fire.

Psa.78.15.bsb: He split the rocks in the wilderness and gave them drink as abundant as the seas.
Psa.78.15.kjv: He clave the rocks in the wilderness, and gave them drink as out of the great depths.

Psa.78.16.bsb: He brought streams from the stone and made water flow down like rivers.
Psa.78.16.kjv: He brought streams also out of the rock, and caused waters to run down like rivers.

Psa.78.17.bsb: But they continued to sin against Him, rebelling in the desert against the Most High.
Psa.78.17.kjv: And they sinned yet more against him by provoking the most High in the wilderness.

Psa.78.18.bsb: They willfully tested God by demanding the food they craved.
Psa.78.18.kjv: And they tempted God in their heart by asking meat for their lust.

Psa.78.22.bsb: because they did not believe God or rely on His salvation.
Psa.78.22.kjv: Because they believed not in God, and trusted not in his salvation:

Psa.78.23.bsb: Yet He commanded the clouds above and opened the doors of the heavens.
Psa.78.23.kjv: Though he had commanded the clouds from above, and opened the doors of heaven,

Psa.78.24.bsb: He rained down manna for them to eat; He gave them grain from heaven.
Psa.78.24.kjv: And had rained down manna upon them to eat, and had given them of the corn of heaven.

Psa.78.25.bsb: Man ate the bread of angels; He sent them food in abundance.
Psa.78.25.kjv: Man did eat angels’ food: he sent them meat to the full.

Psa.78.26.bsb: He stirred the east wind from the heavens and drove the south wind by His might.
Psa.78.26.kjv: He caused an east wind to blow in the heaven: and by his power he brought in the south wind.

Psa.78.27.bsb: He rained meat on them like dust, and winged birds like the sand of the sea.
Psa.78.27.kjv: He rained flesh also upon them as dust, and feathered fowls like as the sand of the sea:

Psa.78.28.bsb: He felled them in the midst of their camp, all around their dwellings.
Psa.78.28.kjv: And he let it fall in the midst of their camp, round about their habitations.

Psa.78.29.bsb: So they ate and were well filled, for He gave them what they craved.
Psa.78.29.kjv: So they did eat, and were well filled: for he gave them their own desire;

Psa.78.30.bsb: Yet before they had filled their desire, with the food still in their mouths,
Psa.78.30.kjv: They were not estranged from their lust. But while their meat was yet in their mouths,

Psa.78.31.bsb: God’s anger flared against them, and He put to death their strongest and subdued the young men of Israel.
Psa.78.31.kjv: The wrath of God came upon them, and slew the fattest of them, and smote down the chosen men of Israel.

Psa.78.32.bsb: In spite of all this, they kept on sinning; despite His wonderful works, they did not believe.
Psa.78.32.kjv: For all this they sinned still, and believed not for his wondrous works.

Psa.78.33.bsb: So He ended their days in futility, and their years in sudden terror.
Psa.78.33.kjv: Therefore their days did he consume in vanity, and their years in trouble.

Psa.78.34.bsb: When He slew them, they would seek Him; they repented and searched for God.
Psa.78.34.kjv: When he slew them, then they sought him: and they returned and enquired early after God.

Psa.78.35.bsb: And they remembered that God was their Rock, that God Most High was their Redeemer.
Psa.78.35.kjv: And they remembered that God was their rock, and the high God their redeemer.

Psa.78.36.bsb: But they deceived Him with their mouths, and lied to Him with their tongues.
Psa.78.36.kjv: Nevertheless they did flatter him with their mouth, and they lied unto him with their tongues.

Psa.78.37.bsb: Their hearts were disloyal to Him, and they were unfaithful to His covenant.
Psa.78.37.kjv: For their heart was not right with him, neither were they stedfast in his covenant.

Psa.78.39.bsb: He remembered that they were but flesh, a passing breeze that does not return.
Psa.78.39.kjv: For he remembered that they were but flesh; a wind that passeth away, and cometh not again.

Psa.78.44.bsb: He turned their rivers to blood, and from their streams they could not drink.
Psa.78.44.kjv: And had turned their rivers into blood; and their floods, that they could not drink.

Psa.78.45.bsb: He sent swarms of flies that devoured them, and frogs that devastated them.
Psa.78.45.kjv: He sent divers sorts of flies among them, which devoured them; and frogs, which destroyed them.

Psa.78.46.bsb: He gave their crops to the grasshopper, the fruit of their labor to the locust.
Psa.78.46.kjv: He gave also their increase unto the caterpiller, and their labour unto the locust.
