Psa.78.47.bsb: He killed their vines with hailstones and their sycamore-figs with sleet.
Psa.78.47.kjv: He destroyed their vines with hail, and their sycomore trees with frost.

Psa.78.48.bsb: He abandoned their cattle to the hail and their livestock to bolts of lightning.
Psa.78.48.kjv: He gave up their cattle also to the hail, and their flocks to hot thunderbolts.

Psa.78.51.bsb: He struck all the firstborn of Egypt, the virility in the tents of Ham.
Psa.78.51.kjv: And smote all the firstborn in Egypt; the chief of their strength in the tabernacles of Ham:

Psa.78.53.bsb: He led them safely, so they did not fear, but the sea engulfed their enemies.
Psa.78.53.kjv: And he led them on safely, so that they feared not: but the sea overwhelmed their enemies.

Psa.78.54.bsb: He brought them to His holy land, to the mountain His right hand had acquired.
Psa.78.54.kjv: And he brought them to the border of his sanctuary, even to this mountain, which his right hand had purchased.

Psa.78.55.bsb: He drove out nations before them and apportioned their inheritance; He settled the tribes of Israel in their tents.
Psa.78.55.kjv: He cast out the heathen also before them, and divided them an inheritance by line, and made the tribes of Israel to dwell in their tents.

Psa.78.66.bsb: He beat back His foes; He put them to everlasting shame.
Psa.78.66.kjv: And he smote his enemies in the hinder parts: he put them to a perpetual reproach.

Psa.78.67.bsb: He rejected the tent of Joseph and refused the tribe of Ephraim.
Psa.78.67.kjv: Moreover he refused the tabernacle of Joseph, and chose not the tribe of Ephraim:

Psa.78.70.bsb: He chose David His servant and took him from the sheepfolds;
Psa.78.70.kjv: He chose David also his servant, and took him from the sheepfolds:

Psa.78.71.bsb: from tending the ewes He brought him to be shepherd of His people Jacob, of Israel His inheritance.
Psa.78.71.kjv: From following the ewes great with young he brought him to feed Jacob his people, and Israel his inheritance.

Psa.78.72.bsb: So David shepherded them with integrity of heart and guided them with skillful hands.
Psa.78.72.kjv: So he fed them according to the integrity of his heart; and guided them by the skilfulness of his hands.

Psa.85.2.bsb: You forgave the iniquity of Your people; You covered all their sin. Selah
Psa.85.2.kjv: Thou hast forgiven the iniquity of thy people, thou hast covered all their sin. Selah.

Psa.86.13.bsb: For great is Your loving devotion to me; You have delivered me from the depths of Sheol.
Psa.86.13.kjv: For great is thy mercy toward me: and thou hast delivered my soul from the lowest hell.

Psa.103.3.bsb: He who forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases,
Psa.103.3.kjv: Who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases;

Psa.103.11.bsb: For as high as the heavens are above the earth, so great is His loving devotion for those who fear Him.
Psa.103.11.kjv: For as the heaven is high above the earth, so great is his mercy toward them that fear him.

Psa.103.12.bsb: As far as the east is from the west, so far has He removed our transgressions from us.
Psa.103.12.kjv: As far as the east is from the west, so far hath he removed our transgressions from us.

Psa.106.43.bsb: Many times He rescued them, but they were bent on rebellion and sank down in their iniquity.
Psa.106.43.kjv: Many times did he deliver them; but they provoked him with their counsel, and were brought low for their iniquity.

Psa.107.1.bsb: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.107.1.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord, for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.108.4.bsb: For Your loving devotion extends beyond the heavens, and Your faithfulness reaches to the clouds.
Psa.108.4.kjv: For thy mercy is great above the heavens: and thy truth reacheth unto the clouds.

Psa.111.4.bsb: He has caused His wonders to be remembered; the LORD is gracious and compassionate.
Psa.111.4.kjv: He hath made his wonderful works to be remembered: the Lord is gracious and full of compassion.

Psa.116.5.bsb: The LORD is gracious and righteous; our God is full of compassion.
Psa.116.5.kjv: Gracious is the Lord, and righteous; yea, our God is merciful.

Psa.118.1.bsb: Give thanks to the LORD, for He is good; His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.118.1.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: because his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.118.2.bsb: Let Israel say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
Psa.118.2.kjv: Let Israel now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.118.3.bsb: Let the house of Aaron say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
Psa.118.3.kjv: Let the house of Aaron now say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.118.4.bsb: Let those who fear the LORD say, “His loving devotion endures forever.”
Psa.118.4.kjv: Let them now that fear the Lord say, that his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.119.156.bsb: Great are Your mercies, O LORD; revive me according to Your ordinances.
Psa.119.156.kjv: Great are thy tender mercies, O Lord: quicken me according to thy judgments.

Psa.130.4.bsb: But with You there is forgiveness, so that You may be feared.
Psa.130.4.kjv: But there is forgiveness with thee, that thou mayest be feared.

Psa.130.8.bsb: And He will redeem Israel from all iniquity.
Psa.130.8.kjv: And he shall redeem Israel from all his iniquities.

Psa.136.3.bsb: Give thanks to the Lord of lords. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.3.kjv: O give thanks to the Lord of lords: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.136.4.bsb: He alone does great wonders. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.4.kjv: To him who alone doeth great wonders: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.136.10.bsb: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.10.kjv: To him that smote Egypt in their firstborn: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.11.bsb: and brought Israel out from among them His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.11.kjv: And brought out Israel from among them: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.12.bsb: with a mighty hand and an outstretched arm. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.12.kjv: With a strong hand, and with a stretched out arm: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.136.13.bsb: He divided the Red Sea in two His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.13.kjv: To him which divided the Red sea into parts: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.14.bsb: and led Israel through the midst, His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.14.kjv: And made Israel to pass through the midst of it: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.15.bsb: but swept Pharaoh and his army into the Red Sea. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.15.kjv: But overthrew Pharaoh and his host in the Red sea: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.136.16.bsb: He led His people through the wilderness. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.16.kjv: To him which led his people through the wilderness: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.136.17.bsb: He struck down great kings His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.17.kjv: To him which smote great kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.18.bsb: and slaughtered mighty kings—His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.18.kjv: And slew famous kings: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.19.bsb: Sihon king of the Amorites His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.19.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.20.bsb: and Og king of Bashan—His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.20.kjv: And Og the king of Bashan: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.21.bsb: and He gave their land as an inheritance, His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.21.kjv: And gave their land for an heritage: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.22.bsb: a heritage to His servant Israel. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.22.kjv: Even an heritage unto Israel his servant: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.136.23.bsb: He remembered us in our low estate His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.23.kjv: Who remembered us in our low estate: for his mercy endureth for ever:

Psa.136.24.bsb: and freed us from our enemies. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.24.kjv: And hath redeemed us from our enemies: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.136.25.bsb: He gives food to every creature. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.25.kjv: Who giveth food to all flesh: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.136.26.bsb: Give thanks to the God of heaven! His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.26.kjv: O give thanks unto the God of heaven: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.145.8.bsb: The LORD is gracious and compassionate, slow to anger and abounding in loving devotion.
Psa.145.8.kjv: The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

Psa.146.7.bsb: He executes justice for the oppressed and gives food to the hungry. The LORD sets the prisoners free,
Psa.146.7.kjv: Which executeth judgment for the oppressed: which giveth food to the hungry. The Lord looseth the prisoners:

Psa.18.31.bsb: For who is God besides the LORD? And who is the Rock except our God?
Psa.18.31.kjv: For who is God save the Lord? or who is a rock save our God?

Psa.86.10.bsb: For You are great and perform wonders; You alone are God.
Psa.86.10.kjv: For thou art great, and doest wondrous things: thou art God alone.

Psa.2.5.bsb: Then He rebukes them in His anger, and terrifies them in His fury:
Psa.2.5.kjv: Then shall he speak unto them in his wrath, and vex them in his sore displeasure.

Psa.21.13.bsb: Be exalted, O LORD, in Your strength; we will sing and praise Your power.
Psa.21.13.kjv: Be thou exalted, Lord, in thine own strength: so will we sing and praise thy power.

Psa.29.5.bsb: The voice of the LORD breaks the cedars; the LORD shatters the cedars of Lebanon.
Psa.29.5.kjv: The voice of the Lord breaketh the cedars; yea, the Lord breaketh the cedars of Lebanon.

Psa.29.6.bsb: He makes Lebanon skip like a calf, and Sirion like a young wild ox.
Psa.29.6.kjv: He maketh them also to skip like a calf; Lebanon and Sirion like a young unicorn.

Psa.29.7.bsb: The voice of the LORD strikes with flames of fire.
Psa.29.7.kjv: The voice of the Lord divideth the flames of fire.

Psa.29.8.bsb: The voice of the LORD shakes the wilderness; the LORD shakes the Wilderness of Kadesh.
Psa.29.8.kjv: The voice of the Lord shaketh the wilderness; the Lord shaketh the wilderness of Kadesh.

Psa.46.6.bsb: Nations rage, kingdoms crumble; the earth melts when He lifts His voice.
Psa.46.6.kjv: The heathen raged, the kingdoms were moved: he uttered his voice, the earth melted.

Psa.62.11.bsb: God has spoken once; I have heard this twice: that power belongs to God,
Psa.62.11.kjv: God hath spoken once; twice have I heard this; that power belongeth unto God.

Psa.65.7.bsb: You stilled the roaring of the seas, the pounding of their waves, and the tumult of the nations.
Psa.65.7.kjv: Which stilleth the noise of the seas, the noise of their waves, and the tumult of the people.

Psa.66.3.bsb: Say to God, “How awesome are Your deeds! So great is Your power that Your enemies cower before You.
Psa.66.3.kjv: Say unto God, How terrible art thou in thy works! through the greatness of thy power shall thine enemies submit themselves unto thee.

Psa.68.34.bsb: Ascribe the power to God, whose majesty is over Israel, whose strength is in the skies.
Psa.68.34.kjv: Ascribe ye strength unto God: his excellency is over Israel, and his strength is in the clouds.

Psa.68.35.bsb: O God, You are awesome in Your sanctuary; the God of Israel Himself gives strength and power to His people. Blessed be God!
Psa.68.35.kjv: O God, thou art terrible out of thy holy places: the God of Israel is he that giveth strength and power unto his people. Blessed be God.

Psa.74.13.bsb: You divided the sea by Your strength; You smashed the heads of the dragons of the sea;
Psa.74.13.kjv: Thou didst divide the sea by thy strength: thou brakest the heads of the dragons in the waters.

Psa.74.15.bsb: You broke open the fountain and the flood; You dried up the ever-flowing rivers.
Psa.74.15.kjv: Thou didst cleave the fountain and the flood: thou driedst up mighty rivers.

Psa.76.6.bsb: At Your rebuke, O God of Jacob, both horse and rider lie stunned.
Psa.76.6.kjv: At thy rebuke, O God of Jacob, both the chariot and horse are cast into a dead sleep.

Psa.77.14.bsb: You are the God who works wonders; You display Your strength among the peoples.
Psa.77.14.kjv: Thou art the God that doest wonders: thou hast declared thy strength among the people.

Psa.77.16.bsb: The waters saw You, O God; the waters saw You and swirled; even the depths were shaken.
Psa.77.16.kjv: The waters saw thee, O God, the waters saw thee; they were afraid: the depths also were troubled.

Psa.77.18.bsb: Your thunder resounded in the whirlwind; the lightning lit up the world; the earth trembled and quaked.
Psa.77.18.kjv: The voice of thy thunder was in the heaven: the lightnings lightened the world: the earth trembled and shook.

Psa.79.11.bsb: May the groans of the captives reach You; by the strength of Your arm preserve those condemned to death.
Psa.79.11.kjv: Let the sighing of the prisoner come before thee; according to the greatness of thy power preserve thou those that are appointed to die;

Psa.93.4.bsb: Above the roar of many waters—the mighty breakers of the sea—the LORD on high is majestic.
Psa.93.4.kjv: The Lord on high is mightier than the noise of many waters, yea, than the mighty waves of the sea.

Psa.107.29.bsb: He calmed the storm to a whisper, and the waves of the sea were hushed.
Psa.107.29.kjv: He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.

Psa.111.6.bsb: He has shown His people the power of His works by giving them the inheritance of the nations.
Psa.111.6.kjv: He hath shewed his people the power of his works, that he may give them the heritage of the heathen.

Psa.114.3.bsb: The sea observed and fled; the Jordan turned back;
Psa.114.3.kjv: The sea saw it, and fled: Jordan was driven back.

Psa.114.4.bsb: the mountains skipped like rams, the hills like lambs.
Psa.114.4.kjv: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.

Psa.114.5.bsb: Why was it, O sea, that you fled, O Jordan, that you turned back,
Psa.114.5.kjv: What ailed thee, O thou sea, that thou fleddest? thou Jordan, that thou wast driven back?

Psa.114.6.bsb: O mountains, that you skipped like rams, O hills, like lambs?
Psa.114.6.kjv: Ye mountains, that ye skipped like rams; and ye little hills, like lambs?

Psa.114.7.bsb: Tremble, O earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob,
Psa.114.7.kjv: Tremble, thou earth, at the presence of the Lord, at the presence of the God of Jacob;

Psa.114.8.bsb: who turned the rock into a pool, the flint into a fountain of water!
Psa.114.8.kjv: Which turned the rock into a standing water, the flint into a fountain of waters.

Psa.115.3.bsb: Our God is in heaven; He does as He pleases.
Psa.115.3.kjv: But our God is in the heavens: he hath done whatsoever he hath pleased.

Psa.118.16.bsb: The right hand of the LORD is exalted! The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!”
Psa.118.16.kjv: The right hand of the Lord is exalted: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

Psa.135.8.bsb: He struck down the firstborn of Egypt, of both man and beast.
Psa.135.8.kjv: Who smote the firstborn of Egypt, both of man and beast.

Psa.135.9.bsb: He sent signs and wonders into your midst, O Egypt, against Pharaoh and all his servants.
Psa.135.9.kjv: Who sent tokens and wonders into the midst of thee, O Egypt, upon Pharaoh, and upon all his servants.

Psa.135.10.bsb: He struck down many nations and slaughtered mighty kings:
Psa.135.10.kjv: Who smote great nations, and slew mighty kings;

Psa.135.11.bsb: Sihon king of the Amorites, Og king of Bashan, and all the kings of Canaan.
Psa.135.11.kjv: Sihon king of the Amorites, and Og king of Bashan, and all the kingdoms of Canaan:

Psa.135.12.bsb: He gave their land as an inheritance, as a heritage to His people Israel.
Psa.135.12.kjv: And gave their land for an heritage, an heritage unto Israel his people.

Psa.144.5.bsb: Part Your heavens, O LORD, and come down; touch the mountains, that they may smoke.
Psa.144.5.kjv: Bow thy heavens, O Lord, and come down: touch the mountains, and they shall smoke.

Psa.145.6.bsb: They will proclaim the power of Your awesome deeds, and I will declare Your greatness.
Psa.145.6.kjv: And men shall speak of the might of thy terrible acts: and I will declare thy greatness.

Psa.148.8.bsb: lightning and hail, snow and clouds, powerful wind fulfilling His word,
Psa.148.8.kjv: Fire, and hail; snow, and vapour; stormy wind fulfilling his word:

Psa.12.7.bsb: You, O LORD, will keep us; You will forever guard us from this generation.
Psa.12.7.kjv: Thou shalt keep them, O Lord, thou shalt preserve them from this generation for ever.

Psa.14.5.bsb: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, for God is in the company of the righteous.
Psa.14.5.kjv: There were they in great fear: for God is in the generation of the righteous.

Psa.14.6.bsb: You sinners frustrate the plans of the oppressed, yet the LORD is their shelter.
Psa.14.6.kjv: Ye have shamed the counsel of the poor, because the Lord is his refuge.

Psa.18.17.bsb: He rescued me from my powerful enemy, from foes too mighty for me.
Psa.18.17.kjv: He delivered me from my strong enemy, and from them which hated me: for they were too strong for me.

Psa.18.27.bsb: For You save an afflicted people, but You humble those with haughty eyes.
Psa.18.27.kjv: For thou wilt save the afflicted people; but wilt bring down high looks.

Psa.19.14.bsb: May the words of my mouth and the meditation of my heart be pleasing in Your sight, O LORD, my Rock and my Redeemer.
Psa.19.14.kjv: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O Lord, my strength, and my redeemer.

Psa.25.12.bsb: Who is the man who fears the LORD? He will instruct him in the path chosen for him.
Psa.25.12.kjv: What man is he that feareth the Lord? him shall he teach in the way that he shall choose.

Psa.31.20.bsb: You hide them in the secret place of Your presence from the schemes of men. You conceal them in Your shelter from accusing tongues.
Psa.31.20.kjv: Thou shalt hide them in the secret of thy presence from the pride of man: thou shalt keep them secretly in a pavilion from the strife of tongues.

Psa.32.6.bsb: Therefore let all the godly pray to You while You may be found. Surely when great waters rise, they will not come near.
Psa.32.6.kjv: For this shall every one that is godly pray unto thee in a time when thou mayest be found: surely in the floods of great waters they shall not come nigh unto him.

Psa.34.14.bsb: Turn away from evil and do good; seek peace and pursue it.
Psa.34.14.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; seek peace, and pursue it.

Psa.34.17.bsb: The righteous cry out, and the LORD hears; He delivers them from all their troubles.
Psa.34.17.kjv: The righteous cry, and the Lord heareth, and delivereth them out of all their troubles.

Psa.34.19.bsb: Many are the afflictions of the righteous, but the LORD delivers him from them all.
Psa.34.19.kjv: Many are the afflictions of the righteous: but the Lord delivereth him out of them all.

Psa.34.21.bsb: Evil will slay the wicked, and the haters of the righteous will be condemned.
Psa.34.21.kjv: Evil shall slay the wicked: and they that hate the righteous shall be desolate.

Psa.37.17.bsb: For the arms of the wicked will be broken, but the LORD upholds the righteous.
Psa.37.17.kjv: For the arms of the wicked shall be broken: but the Lord upholdeth the righteous.

Psa.37.24.bsb: Though he falls, he will not be overwhelmed, for the LORD is holding his hand.
Psa.37.24.kjv: Though he fall, he shall not be utterly cast down: for the Lord upholdeth him with his hand.

Psa.37.32.bsb: Though the wicked lie in wait for the righteous, and seek to slay them,
Psa.37.32.kjv: The wicked watcheth the righteous, and seeketh to slay him.

Psa.37.33.bsb: the LORD will not leave them in their power or let them be condemned under judgment.
Psa.37.33.kjv: The Lord will not leave him in his hand, nor condemn him when he is judged.

Psa.41.2.bsb: The LORD will protect and preserve him; He will bless him in the land and refuse to give him over to the will of his foes.
Psa.41.2.kjv: The Lord will preserve him, and keep him alive; and he shall be blessed upon the earth: and thou wilt not deliver him unto the will of his enemies.

Psa.41.3.bsb: The LORD will sustain him on his bed of illness and restore him from his bed of sickness.
Psa.41.3.kjv: The Lord will strengthen him upon the bed of languishing: thou wilt make all his bed in his sickness.

Psa.48.3.bsb: God is in her citadels; He has shown Himself to be a fortress.
Psa.48.3.kjv: God is known in her palaces for a refuge.

Psa.61.3.bsb: For You have been my refuge, a tower of strength against the enemy.
Psa.61.3.kjv: For thou hast been a shelter for me, and a strong tower from the enemy.

Psa.68.6.bsb: God settles the lonely in families; He leads the prisoners out to prosperity, but the rebellious dwell in a sun-scorched land.
Psa.68.6.kjv: God setteth the solitary in families: he bringeth out those which are bound with chains: but the rebellious dwell in a dry land.

Psa.68.22.bsb: The Lord said, “I will retrieve them from Bashan, I will bring them up from the depths of the sea,
Psa.68.22.kjv: The Lord said, I will bring again from Bashan, I will bring my people again from the depths of the sea:

Psa.91.3.bsb: Surely He will deliver you from the snare of the fowler, and from the deadly plague.
Psa.91.3.kjv: Surely he shall deliver thee from the snare of the fowler, and from the noisome pestilence.

Psa.91.4.bsb: He will cover you with His feathers; under His wings you will find refuge; His faithfulness is a shield and rampart.
Psa.91.4.kjv: He shall cover thee with his feathers, and under his wings shalt thou trust: his truth shall be thy shield and buckler.

Psa.91.5.bsb: You will not fear the terror of the night, nor the arrow that flies by day,
Psa.91.5.kjv: Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day;

Psa.91.6.bsb: nor the pestilence that stalks in the darkness, nor the calamity that destroys at noon.
Psa.91.6.kjv: Nor for the pestilence that walketh in darkness; nor for the destruction that wasteth at noonday.

Psa.91.7.bsb: Though a thousand may fall at your side, and ten thousand at your right hand, no harm will come near you.
Psa.91.7.kjv: A thousand shall fall at thy side, and ten thousand at thy right hand; but it shall not come nigh thee.

Psa.91.8.bsb: You will only see it with your eyes and witness the punishment of the wicked.
Psa.91.8.kjv: Only with thine eyes shalt thou behold and see the reward of the wicked.

Psa.91.13.bsb: You will tread on the lion and cobra; you will trample the young lion and serpent.
Psa.91.13.kjv: Thou shalt tread upon the lion and adder: the young lion and the dragon shalt thou trample under feet.

Psa.91.16.bsb: With long life I will satisfy him and show him My salvation.”
Psa.91.16.kjv: With long life will I satisfy him, and shew him my salvation.

Psa.94.13.bsb: to grant him relief from days of trouble, until a pit is dug for the wicked.
Psa.94.13.kjv: That thou mayest give him rest from the days of adversity, until the pit be digged for the wicked.

Psa.97.10.bsb: Hate evil, O you who love the LORD! He preserves the souls of His saints; He delivers them from the hand of the wicked.
Psa.97.10.kjv: Ye that love the Lord, hate evil: he preserveth the souls of his saints; he delivereth them out of the hand of the wicked.

Psa.103.2.bsb: Bless the LORD, O my soul, and do not forget all His kind deeds—
Psa.103.2.kjv: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits:

Psa.103.5.bsb: who satisfies you with good things, so that your youth is renewed like the eagle’s.
Psa.103.5.kjv: Who satisfieth thy mouth with good things; so that thy youth is renewed like the eagle’s.

Psa.107.10.bsb: Some sat in darkness and in the shadow of death, prisoners in affliction and chains,
Psa.107.10.kjv: Such as sit in darkness and in the shadow of death, being bound in affliction and iron;

Psa.112.4.bsb: Light dawns in the darkness for the upright—for the gracious, compassionate, and righteous.
Psa.112.4.kjv: Unto the upright there ariseth light in the darkness: he is gracious, and full of compassion, and righteous.

Psa.115.10.bsb: O house of Aaron, trust in the LORD! He is their help and shield.
Psa.115.10.kjv: O house of Aaron, trust in the Lord: he is their help and their shield.

Psa.116.6.bsb: The LORD preserves the simplehearted; I was helpless, and He saved me.
Psa.116.6.kjv: The Lord preserveth the simple: I was brought low, and he helped me.

Psa.118.13.bsb: I was pushed so hard I was falling, but the LORD helped me.
Psa.118.13.kjv: Thou hast thrust sore at me that I might fall: but the Lord helped me.

Psa.121.5.bsb: The LORD is your keeper; the LORD is the shade on your right hand.
Psa.121.5.kjv: The Lord is thy keeper: the Lord is thy shade upon thy right hand.

Psa.121.6.bsb: The sun will not strike you by day, nor the moon by night.
Psa.121.6.kjv: The sun shall not smite thee by day, nor the moon by night.

Psa.121.7.bsb: The LORD will guard you from all evil; He will preserve your soul.
Psa.121.7.kjv: The Lord shall preserve thee from all evil: he shall preserve thy soul.

Psa.121.8.bsb: The LORD will watch over your coming and going, both now and forevermore.
Psa.121.8.kjv: The Lord shall preserve thy going out and thy coming in from this time forth, and even for evermore.

Psa.124.1.bsb: A song of ascents. Of David. If the LORD had not been on our side—let Israel now declare—
Psa.124.1.kjv: A Song of degrees of David. If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, now may Israel say;

Psa.124.2.bsb: if the LORD had not been on our side when men attacked us,
Psa.124.2.kjv: If it had not been the Lord who was on our side, when men rose up against us:

Psa.124.3.bsb: when their anger flared against us, then they would have swallowed us alive,
Psa.124.3.kjv: Then they had swallowed us up quick, when their wrath was kindled against us:

Psa.124.4.bsb: then the floods would have engulfed us, then the torrent would have overwhelmed us,
Psa.124.4.kjv: Then the waters had overwhelmed us, the stream had gone over our soul:

Psa.124.5.bsb: then the raging waters would have swept us away.
Psa.124.5.kjv: Then the proud waters had gone over our soul.

Psa.124.6.bsb: Blessed be the LORD, who has not given us as prey to their teeth.
Psa.124.6.kjv: Blessed be the Lord, who hath not given us as a prey to their teeth.

Psa.124.7.bsb: We have escaped like a bird from the snare of the fowler; the net is torn, and we have slipped away.
Psa.124.7.kjv: Our soul is escaped as a bird out of the snare of the fowlers: the snare is broken, and we are escaped.

Psa.125.2.bsb: As the mountains surround Jerusalem, so the LORD surrounds His people, both now and forevermore.
Psa.125.2.kjv: As the mountains are round about Jerusalem, so the Lord is round about his people from henceforth even for ever.

Psa.125.3.bsb: For the scepter of the wicked will not rest upon the land allotted to the righteous, so that the righteous will not put forth their hands to injustice.
Psa.125.3.kjv: For the rod of the wicked shall not rest upon the lot of the righteous; lest the righteous put forth their hands unto iniquity.

Psa.127.1.bsb: A song of ascents. Of Solomon. Unless the LORD builds the house, its builders labor in vain; unless the LORD protects the city, its watchmen stand guard in vain.
Psa.127.1.kjv: A Song of degrees for Solomon. Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it: except the Lord keep the city, the watchman waketh but in vain.

Psa.145.14.bsb: The LORD upholds all who fall and lifts up all who are bowed down.
Psa.145.14.kjv: The Lord upholdeth all that fall, and raiseth up all those that be bowed down.

Psa.145.20.bsb: The LORD preserves all who love Him, but all the wicked He will destroy.
Psa.145.20.kjv: The Lord preserveth all them that love him: but all the wicked will he destroy.

Psa.147.2.bsb: The LORD builds up Jerusalem; He gathers the exiles of Israel.
Psa.147.2.kjv: The Lord doth build up Jerusalem: he gathereth together the outcasts of Israel.

Psa.147.3.bsb: He heals the brokenhearted and binds up their wounds.
Psa.147.3.kjv: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

Psa.21.4.bsb: He asked You for life, and You granted it—length of days, forever and ever.
Psa.21.4.kjv: He asked life of thee, and thou gavest it him, even length of days for ever and ever.

Psa.21.5.bsb: Great is his glory in Your salvation; You bestow on him splendor and majesty.
Psa.21.5.kjv: His glory is great in thy salvation: honour and majesty hast thou laid upon him.

Psa.33.12.bsb: Blessed is the nation whose God is the LORD, the people He has chosen as His inheritance!
Psa.33.12.kjv: Blessed is the nation whose God is the Lord; and the people whom he hath chosen for his own inheritance.

Psa.34.9.bsb: Fear the LORD, you His saints, for those who fear Him lack nothing.
Psa.34.9.kjv: O fear the Lord, ye his saints: for there is no want to them that fear him.

Psa.34.10.bsb: Young lions go lacking and hungry, but those who seek the LORD lack no good thing.
Psa.34.10.kjv: The young lions do lack, and suffer hunger: but they that seek the Lord shall not want any good thing.

Psa.37.19.bsb: In the time of evil they will not be ashamed, and in the days of famine they will be satisfied.
Psa.37.19.kjv: They shall not be ashamed in the evil time: and in the days of famine they shall be satisfied.

Psa.37.22.bsb: Surely those He blesses will inherit the land, but the cursed will be destroyed.
Psa.37.22.kjv: For such as be blessed of him shall inherit the earth; and they that be cursed of him shall be cut off.

Psa.37.25.bsb: I once was young and now am old, yet never have I seen the righteous abandoned or their children begging for bread.
Psa.37.25.kjv: I have been young, and now am old; yet have I not seen the righteous forsaken, nor his seed begging bread.

Psa.37.34.bsb: Wait for the LORD and keep His way, and He will raise you up to inherit the land. When the wicked are cut off, you will see it.
Psa.37.34.kjv: Wait on the Lord, and keep his way, and he shall exalt thee to inherit the land: when the wicked are cut off, thou shalt see it.

Psa.40.5.bsb: Many, O LORD my God, are the wonders You have done, and the plans You have for us—none can compare to You—if I proclaim and declare them, they are more than I can count.
Psa.40.5.kjv: Many, O Lord my God, are thy wonderful works which thou hast done, and thy thoughts which are to us-ward: they cannot be reckoned up in order unto thee: if I would declare and speak of them, they are more than can be numbered.

Psa.44.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. We have heard with our ears, O God; our fathers have told us the work You did in their days, in the days of old.
Psa.44.1.kjv: To the chief Musician for the sons of Korah, Maschil. We have heard with our ears, O God, our fathers have told us, what work thou didst in their days, in the times of old.

Psa.44.2.bsb: With Your hand You drove out the nations and planted our fathers there; You crushed the peoples and cast them out.
Psa.44.2.kjv: How thou didst drive out the heathen with thy hand, and plantedst them; how thou didst afflict the people, and cast them out.

Psa.65.9.bsb: You attend to the earth and water it; with abundance You enrich it. The streams of God are full of water, for You prepare our grain by providing for the earth.
Psa.65.9.kjv: Thou visitest the earth, and waterest it: thou greatly enrichest it with the river of God, which is full of water: thou preparest them corn, when thou hast so provided for it.

Psa.65.10.bsb: You soak its furrows and level its ridges; You soften it with showers and bless its growth.
Psa.65.10.kjv: Thou waterest the ridges thereof abundantly: thou settlest the furrows thereof: thou makest it soft with showers: thou blessest the springing thereof.

Psa.65.11.bsb: You crown the year with Your bounty, and Your paths overflow with plenty.
Psa.65.11.kjv: Thou crownest the year with thy goodness; and thy paths drop fatness.

Psa.65.12.bsb: The pastures of the wilderness overflow; the hills are robed with joy.
Psa.65.12.kjv: They drop upon the pastures of the wilderness: and the little hills rejoice on every side.

Psa.65.13.bsb: The pastures are clothed with flocks, and the valleys are decked with grain. They shout in triumph; indeed, they sing.
Psa.65.13.kjv: The pastures are clothed with flocks; the valleys also are covered over with corn; they shout for joy, they also sing.

Psa.68.9.bsb: You sent abundant rain, O God; You refreshed Your weary inheritance.
Psa.68.9.kjv: Thou, O God, didst send a plentiful rain, whereby thou didst confirm thine inheritance, when it was weary.

Psa.68.10.bsb: Your flock settled therein; O God, from Your bounty You provided for the poor.
Psa.68.10.kjv: Thy congregation hath dwelt therein: thou, O God, hast prepared of thy goodness for the poor.

Psa.71.15.bsb: My mouth will declare Your righteousness and Your salvation all day long, though I cannot know their full measure.
Psa.71.15.kjv: My mouth shall shew forth thy righteousness and thy salvation all the day; for I know not the numbers thereof.

Psa.81.15.bsb: Those who hate the LORD would feign obedience, and their doom would last forever.
Psa.81.15.kjv: The haters of the Lord should have submitted themselves unto him: but their time should have endured for ever.

Psa.81.16.bsb: But I would feed you the finest wheat; with honey from the rock I would satisfy you.”
Psa.81.16.kjv: He should have fed them also with the finest of the wheat: and with honey out of the rock should I have satisfied thee.

Psa.105.14.bsb: He let no man oppress them; He rebuked kings on their behalf:
Psa.105.14.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes;

Psa.105.15.bsb: “Do not touch My anointed ones! Do no harm to My prophets!”
Psa.105.15.kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.

Psa.105.16.bsb: He called down famine on the land and cut off all their supplies of food.
Psa.105.16.kjv: Moreover he called for a famine upon the land: he brake the whole staff of bread.

Psa.105.17.bsb: He sent a man before them—Joseph, sold as a slave.
Psa.105.17.kjv: He sent a man before them, even Joseph, who was sold for a servant:

Psa.105.18.bsb: They bruised his feet with shackles and placed his neck in irons,
Psa.105.18.kjv: Whose feet they hurt with fetters: he was laid in iron:

Psa.105.19.bsb: until his prediction came true and the word of the LORD proved him right.
Psa.105.19.kjv: Until the time that his word came: the word of the Lord tried him.

Psa.105.20.bsb: The king sent and released him; the ruler of peoples set him free.
Psa.105.20.kjv: The king sent and loosed him; even the ruler of the people, and let him go free.

Psa.105.21.bsb: He made him master of his household, ruler over all his substance,
Psa.105.21.kjv: He made him lord of his house, and ruler of all his substance:

Psa.105.22.bsb: to instruct his princes as he pleased and teach his elders wisdom.
Psa.105.22.kjv: To bind his princes at his pleasure; and teach his senators wisdom.

Psa.105.23.bsb: Then Israel entered Egypt; Jacob dwelt in the land of Ham.
Psa.105.23.kjv: Israel also came into Egypt; and Jacob sojourned in the land of Ham.

Psa.105.24.bsb: And the LORD made His people very fruitful, more numerous than their foes,
Psa.105.24.kjv: And he increased his people greatly; and made them stronger than their enemies.

Psa.105.25.bsb: whose hearts He turned to hate His people, to conspire against His servants.
Psa.105.25.kjv: He turned their heart to hate his people, to deal subtilly with his servants.

Psa.105.26.bsb: He sent Moses His servant, and Aaron, whom He had chosen.
Psa.105.26.kjv: He sent Moses his servant; and Aaron whom he had chosen.

Psa.105.27.bsb: They performed His miraculous signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.
Psa.105.27.kjv: They shewed his signs among them, and wonders in the land of Ham.

Psa.105.28.bsb: He sent darkness, and it became dark—yet they defied His words.
Psa.105.28.kjv: He sent darkness, and made it dark; and they rebelled not against his word.

Psa.105.29.bsb: He turned their waters to blood and caused their fish to die.
Psa.105.29.kjv: He turned their waters into blood, and slew their fish.

Psa.105.30.bsb: Their land teemed with frogs, even in their royal chambers.
Psa.105.30.kjv: Their land brought forth frogs in abundance, in the chambers of their kings.

Psa.105.31.bsb: He spoke, and insects swarmed—gnats throughout their country.
Psa.105.31.kjv: He spake, and there came divers sorts of flies, and lice in all their coasts.

Psa.105.32.bsb: He gave them hail for rain, with lightning throughout their land.
Psa.105.32.kjv: He gave them hail for rain, and flaming fire in their land.

Psa.105.33.bsb: He struck their vines and fig trees and shattered the trees of their country.
Psa.105.33.kjv: He smote their vines also and their fig trees; and brake the trees of their coasts.

Psa.105.34.bsb: He spoke, and the locusts came—young locusts without number.
Psa.105.34.kjv: He spake, and the locusts came, and caterpillers, and that without number,

Psa.105.35.bsb: They devoured every plant in their land and consumed the produce of their soil.
Psa.105.35.kjv: And did eat up all the herbs in their land, and devoured the fruit of their ground.

Psa.105.36.bsb: Then He struck all the firstborn in their land, the firstfruits of all their vigor.
Psa.105.36.kjv: He smote also all the firstborn in their land, the chief of all their strength.

Psa.105.37.bsb: He brought Israel out with silver and gold, and none among His tribes stumbled.
Psa.105.37.kjv: He brought them forth also with silver and gold: and there was not one feeble person among their tribes.

Psa.105.38.bsb: Egypt was glad when they departed, for the dread of Israel had fallen on them.
Psa.105.38.kjv: Egypt was glad when they departed: for the fear of them fell upon them.

Psa.105.40.bsb: They asked, and He brought quail and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.
Psa.105.40.kjv: The people asked, and he brought quails, and satisfied them with the bread of heaven.

Psa.105.41.bsb: He opened a rock, and water gushed out; it flowed like a river in the desert.
Psa.105.41.kjv: He opened the rock, and the waters gushed out; they ran in the dry places like a river.

Psa.105.43.bsb: He brought forth His people with rejoicing, His chosen with shouts of joy.
Psa.105.43.kjv: And he brought forth his people with joy, and his chosen with gladness:

Psa.105.44.bsb: He gave them the lands of the nations, that they might inherit the fruit of others’ labor,
Psa.105.44.kjv: And gave them the lands of the heathen: and they inherited the labour of the people;

Psa.105.45.bsb: that they might keep His statutes and obey His laws. Hallelujah!
Psa.105.45.kjv: That they might observe his statutes, and keep his laws. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.107.2.bsb: Let the redeemed of the LORD say so, whom He has redeemed from the hand of the enemy
Psa.107.2.kjv: Let the redeemed of the Lord say so, whom he hath redeemed from the hand of the enemy;

Psa.107.3.bsb: and gathered from the lands, from east and west, from north and south.
Psa.107.3.kjv: And gathered them out of the lands, from the east, and from the west, from the north, and from the south.

Psa.107.4.bsb: Some wandered in desert wastelands, finding no path to a city in which to dwell.
Psa.107.4.kjv: They wandered in the wilderness in a solitary way; they found no city to dwell in.

Psa.107.5.bsb: They were hungry and thirsty; their soul fainted within them.
Psa.107.5.kjv: Hungry and thirsty, their soul fainted in them.

Psa.107.6.bsb: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He delivered them from their distress.
Psa.107.6.kjv: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he delivered them out of their distresses.

Psa.107.11.bsb: because they rebelled against the words of God and despised the counsel of the Most High.
Psa.107.11.kjv: Because they rebelled against the words of God, and contemned the counsel of the most High:

Psa.107.12.bsb: He humbled their hearts with hard labor; they stumbled, and there was no one to help.
Psa.107.12.kjv: Therefore he brought down their heart with labour; they fell down, and there was none to help.

Psa.107.13.bsb: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
Psa.107.13.kjv: Then they cried unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saved them out of their distresses.

Psa.107.14.bsb: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death and broke away their chains.
Psa.107.14.kjv: He brought them out of darkness and the shadow of death, and brake their bands in sunder.

Psa.107.15.bsb: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
Psa.107.15.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

Psa.107.16.bsb: For He has broken down the gates of bronze and cut through the bars of iron.
Psa.107.16.kjv: For he hath broken the gates of brass, and cut the bars of iron in sunder.

Psa.107.17.bsb: Fools, in their rebellious ways, and through their iniquities, suffered affliction.
Psa.107.17.kjv: Fools because of their transgression, and because of their iniquities, are afflicted.

Psa.107.18.bsb: They loathed all food and drew near to the gates of death.
Psa.107.18.kjv: Their soul abhorreth all manner of meat; and they draw near unto the gates of death.

Psa.107.19.bsb: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He saved them from their distress.
Psa.107.19.kjv: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he saveth them out of their distresses.

Psa.107.20.bsb: He sent forth His word and healed them; He rescued them from the Pit.
Psa.107.20.kjv: He sent his word, and healed them, and delivered them from their destructions.

Psa.107.21.bsb: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
Psa.107.21.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

Psa.107.22.bsb: Let them offer sacrifices of thanksgiving and declare His works with rejoicing.
Psa.107.22.kjv: And let them sacrifice the sacrifices of thanksgiving, and declare his works with rejoicing.

Psa.107.27.bsb: They reeled and staggered like drunkards, and all their skill was useless.
Psa.107.27.kjv: They reel to and fro, and stagger like a drunken man, and are at their wits’ end.

Psa.107.28.bsb: Then they cried out to the LORD in their trouble, and He brought them out of their distress.
Psa.107.28.kjv: Then they cry unto the Lord in their trouble, and he bringeth them out of their distresses.

Psa.107.30.bsb: They rejoiced in the silence, and He guided them to the harbor they desired.
Psa.107.30.kjv: Then are they glad because they be quiet; so he bringeth them unto their desired haven.

Psa.107.31.bsb: Let them give thanks to the LORD for His loving devotion and His wonders to the sons of men.
Psa.107.31.kjv: Oh that men would praise the Lord for his goodness, and for his wonderful works to the children of men!

Psa.107.32.bsb: Let them exalt Him in the assembly of the people and praise Him in the council of the elders.
Psa.107.32.kjv: Let them exalt him also in the congregation of the people, and praise him in the assembly of the elders.

Psa.107.33.bsb: He turns rivers into deserts, springs of water into thirsty ground,
Psa.107.33.kjv: He turneth rivers into a wilderness, and the watersprings into dry ground;

Psa.107.34.bsb: and fruitful land into fields of salt, because of the wickedness of its dwellers.
Psa.107.34.kjv: A fruitful land into barrenness, for the wickedness of them that dwell therein.

Psa.107.35.bsb: He turns a desert into pools of water and a dry land into flowing springs.
Psa.107.35.kjv: He turneth the wilderness into a standing water, and dry ground into watersprings.

Psa.107.36.bsb: He causes the hungry to settle there, that they may establish a city in which to dwell.
Psa.107.36.kjv: And there he maketh the hungry to dwell, that they may prepare a city for habitation;

Psa.107.37.bsb: They sow fields and plant vineyards that yield a fruitful harvest.
Psa.107.37.kjv: And sow the fields, and plant vineyards, which may yield fruits of increase.

Psa.107.39.bsb: When they are decreased and humbled by oppression, evil, and sorrow,
Psa.107.39.kjv: Again, they are minished and brought low through oppression, affliction, and sorrow.

Psa.107.40.bsb: He pours out contempt on the nobles and makes them wander in a trackless wasteland.
Psa.107.40.kjv: He poureth contempt upon princes, and causeth them to wander in the wilderness, where there is no way.

Psa.107.42.bsb: The upright see and rejoice, and all iniquity shuts its mouth.
Psa.107.42.kjv: The righteous shall see it, and rejoice: and all iniquity shall stop her mouth.

Psa.113.6.bsb: He humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth.
Psa.113.6.kjv: Who humbleth himself to behold the things that are in heaven, and in the earth!

Psa.113.7.bsb: He raises the poor from the dust and lifts the needy from the dump
Psa.113.7.kjv: He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth the needy out of the dunghill;

Psa.113.8.bsb: to seat them with nobles, with the princes of His people.
Psa.113.8.kjv: That he may set him with princes, even with the princes of his people.

Psa.115.16.bsb: The highest heavens belong to the LORD, but the earth He has given to mankind.
Psa.115.16.kjv: The heaven, even the heavens, are the Lord’s: but the earth hath he given to the children of men.

Psa.116.3.bsb: The ropes of death entangled me; the anguish of Sheol overcame me; I was confronted by trouble and sorrow.
Psa.116.3.kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the pains of hell gat hold upon me: I found trouble and sorrow.

Psa.116.8.bsb: For You have delivered my soul from death, my eyes from tears, my feet from stumbling.
Psa.116.8.kjv: For thou hast delivered my soul from death, mine eyes from tears, and my feet from falling.

Psa.116.9.bsb: I will walk before the LORD in the land of the living.
Psa.116.9.kjv: I will walk before the Lord in the land of the living.

Psa.116.10.bsb: I believed, therefore I said, “I am greatly afflicted.”
Psa.116.10.kjv: I believed, therefore have I spoken: I was greatly afflicted:

Psa.116.11.bsb: In my alarm I said, “All men are liars!”
Psa.116.11.kjv: I said in my haste, All men are liars.

Psa.116.12.bsb: How can I repay the LORD for all His goodness to me?
Psa.116.12.kjv: What shall I render unto the Lord for all his benefits toward me?

Psa.116.13.bsb: I will lift the cup of salvation and call on the name of the LORD.
Psa.116.13.kjv: I will take the cup of salvation, and call upon the name of the Lord.

Psa.116.14.bsb: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people.
Psa.116.14.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people.

Psa.127.2.bsb: In vain you rise early and stay up late, toiling for bread to eat—for He gives sleep to His beloved.
Psa.127.2.kjv: It is vain for you to rise up early, to sit up late, to eat the bread of sorrows: for so he giveth his beloved sleep.

Psa.144.12.bsb: Then our sons will be like plants nurtured in their youth, our daughters like corner pillars carved to adorn a palace.
Psa.144.12.kjv: That our sons may be as plants grown up in their youth; that our daughters may be as corner stones, polished after the similitude of a palace:

Psa.144.13.bsb: Our storehouses will be full, supplying all manner of produce; our flocks will bring forth thousands, tens of thousands in our fields.
Psa.144.13.kjv: That our garners may be full, affording all manner of store: that our sheep may bring forth thousands and ten thousands in our streets:

Psa.144.14.bsb: Our oxen will bear great loads. There will be no breach in the walls, no going into captivity, and no cry of lament in our streets.
Psa.144.14.kjv: That our oxen may be strong to labour; that there be no breaking in, nor going out; that there be no complaining in our streets.

Psa.144.15.bsb: Blessed are the people of whom this is so; blessed are the people whose God is the LORD.
Psa.144.15.kjv: Happy is that people, that is in such a case: yea, happy is that people, whose God is the Lord.

Psa.147.8.bsb: who covers the sky with clouds, who prepares rain for the earth, who makes grass to grow on the hills.
Psa.147.8.kjv: Who covereth the heaven with clouds, who prepareth rain for the earth, who maketh grass to grow upon the mountains.

Psa.147.9.bsb: He provides food for the animals, and for the young ravens when they call.
Psa.147.9.kjv: He giveth to the beast his food, and to the young ravens which cry.

Psa.147.13.bsb: For He strengthens the bars of your gates and blesses the children within you.
Psa.147.13.kjv: For he hath strengthened the bars of thy gates; he hath blessed thy children within thee.

Psa.147.14.bsb: He makes peace at your borders; He fills you with the finest wheat.
Psa.147.14.kjv: He maketh peace in thy borders, and filleth thee with the finest of the wheat.

Psa.17.13.bsb: Arise, O LORD, confront them! Bring them to their knees; deliver me from the wicked by Your sword,
Psa.17.13.kjv: Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword:

Psa.17.14.bsb: from such men, O LORD, by Your hand—from men of the world whose portion is in this life. May You fill the bellies of Your treasured ones and satisfy their sons, so they leave their abundance to their children.
Psa.17.14.kjv: From men which are thy hand, O Lord, from men of the world, which have their portion in this life, and whose belly thou fillest with thy hid treasure: they are full of children, and leave the rest of their substance to their babes.

Psa.33.10.bsb: The LORD frustrates the plans of the nations; He thwarts the devices of the peoples.
Psa.33.10.kjv: The Lord bringeth the counsel of the heathen to nought: he maketh the devices of the people of none effect.

Psa.119.40.bsb: How I long for Your precepts! Revive me in Your righteousness.
Psa.119.40.kjv: Behold, I have longed after thy precepts: quicken me in thy righteousness.

Psa.119.144.bsb: Your testimonies are righteous forever. Give me understanding, that I may live.
Psa.119.144.kjv: The righteousness of thy testimonies is everlasting: give me understanding, and I shall live.

Psa.119.172.bsb: My tongue sings of Your word, for all Your commandments are righteous.
Psa.119.172.kjv: My tongue shall speak of thy word: for all thy commandments are righteousness.

Psa.28.8.bsb: The LORD is the strength of His people, a stronghold of salvation for His anointed.
Psa.28.8.kjv: The Lord is their strength, and he is the saving strength of his anointed.

Psa.50.23.bsb: He who sacrifices a thank offering honors Me, and to him who rightly orders his way, I will show the salvation of God.”
Psa.50.23.kjv: Whoso offereth praise glorifieth me: and to him that ordereth his conversation aright will I shew the salvation of God.

Psa.62.2.bsb: He alone is my rock and my salvation. He is my fortress; I will never be shaken.
Psa.62.2.kjv: He only is my rock and my salvation; he is my defence; I shall not be greatly moved.

Psa.65.5.bsb: With awesome deeds of righteousness You answer us, O God of our salvation, the hope of all the ends of the earth and of the farthest seas.
Psa.65.5.kjv: By terrible things in righteousness wilt thou answer us, O God of our salvation; who art the confidence of all the ends of the earth, and of them that are afar off upon the sea:

Psa.85.9.bsb: Surely His salvation is near to those who fear Him, that His glory may dwell in our land.
Psa.85.9.kjv: Surely his salvation is nigh them that fear him; that glory may dwell in our land.

Psa.118.27.bsb: The LORD is God; He has made His light to shine upon us. Bind the festal sacrifice with cords to the horns of the altar.
Psa.118.27.kjv: God is the Lord, which hath shewed us light: bind the sacrifice with cords, even unto the horns of the altar.

Psa.10.16.bsb: The LORD is King forever and ever; the nations perish from His land.
Psa.10.16.kjv: The Lord is King for ever and ever: the heathen are perished out of his land.

Psa.29.10.bsb: The LORD sits enthroned over the flood; the LORD is enthroned as King forever.
Psa.29.10.kjv: The Lord sitteth upon the flood; yea, the Lord sitteth King for ever.

Psa.44.4.bsb: You are my King, O God, who ordains victories for Jacob.
Psa.44.4.kjv: Thou art my King, O God: command deliverances for Jacob.

Psa.47.2.bsb: How awesome is the LORD Most High, the great King over all the earth!
Psa.47.2.kjv: For the Lord most high is terrible; he is a great King over all the earth.

Psa.47.7.bsb: For God is King of all the earth; sing to Him a psalm of praise.
Psa.47.7.kjv: For God is the King of all the earth: sing ye praises with understanding.

Psa.50.10.bsb: for every beast of the forest is Mine—the cattle on a thousand hills.
Psa.50.10.kjv: For every beast of the forest is mine, and the cattle upon a thousand hills.

Psa.50.11.bsb: I know every bird in the mountains, and the creatures of the field are Mine.
Psa.50.11.kjv: I know all the fowls of the mountains: and the wild beasts of the field are mine.

Psa.50.12.bsb: If I were hungry, I would not tell you, for the world is Mine, and the fullness thereof.
Psa.50.12.kjv: If I were hungry, I would not tell thee: for the world is mine, and the fulness thereof.

Psa.59.13.bsb: Consume them in wrath; consume them till they are no more, so it may be known to the ends of the earth that God rules over Jacob. Selah
Psa.59.13.kjv: Consume them in wrath, consume them, that they may not be: and let them know that God ruleth in Jacob unto the ends of the earth. Selah.

Psa.75.6.bsb: For exaltation comes neither from east nor west, nor out of the desert,
Psa.75.6.kjv: For promotion cometh neither from the east, nor from the west, nor from the south.

Psa.76.12.bsb: He breaks the spirits of princes; He is feared by the kings of the earth.
Psa.76.12.kjv: He shall cut off the spirit of princes: he is terrible to the kings of the earth.

Psa.82.1.bsb: A Psalm of Asaph. God presides in the divine assembly; He renders judgment among the gods:
Psa.82.1.kjv: A Psalm of Asaph. God standeth in the congregation of the mighty; he judgeth among the gods.

Psa.95.3.bsb: For the LORD is a great God, a great King above all gods.
Psa.95.3.kjv: For the Lord is a great God, and a great King above all gods.

Psa.97.1.bsb: The LORD reigns, let the earth rejoice; let the distant shores be glad.
Psa.97.1.kjv: The Lord reigneth; let the earth rejoice; let the multitude of isles be glad thereof.

Psa.98.6.bsb: With trumpets and the blast of the ram’s horn shout for joy before the LORD, the King.
Psa.98.6.kjv: With trumpets and sound of cornet make a joyful noise before the Lord, the King.

Psa.99.1.bsb: The LORD reigns; let the nations tremble! He is enthroned above the cherubim; let the earth quake!
Psa.99.1.kjv: The Lord reigneth; let the people tremble: he sitteth between the cherubims; let the earth be moved.

Psa.105.7.bsb: He is the LORD our God; His judgments carry throughout the earth.
Psa.105.7.kjv: He is the Lord our God: his judgments are in all the earth.

Psa.135.5.bsb: For I know that the LORD is great; our Lord is above all gods.
Psa.135.5.kjv: For I know that the Lord is great, and that our Lord is above all gods.

Psa.136.2.bsb: Give thanks to the God of gods. His loving devotion endures forever.
Psa.136.2.kjv: O give thanks unto the God of gods: for his mercy endureth for ever.

Psa.43.3.bsb: Send out Your light and Your truth; let them lead me. Let them bring me to Your holy mountain and to the place where You dwell.
Psa.43.3.kjv: O send out thy light and thy truth: let them lead me; let them bring me unto thy holy hill, and to thy tabernacles.

Psa.71.22.bsb: So I will praise You with the harp for Your faithfulness, O my God; I will sing praise to You with the lyre, O Holy One of Israel.
Psa.71.22.kjv: I will also praise thee with the psaltery, even thy truth, O my God: unto thee will I sing with the harp, O thou Holy One of Israel.

Psa.86.11.bsb: Teach me Your way, O LORD, that I may walk in Your truth. Give me an undivided heart, that I may fear Your name.
Psa.86.11.kjv: Teach me thy way, O Lord; I will walk in thy truth: unite my heart to fear thy name.

Psa.77.19.bsb: Your path led through the sea, Your way through the mighty waters, but Your footprints were not to be found.
Psa.77.19.kjv: Thy way is in the sea, and thy path in the great waters, and thy footsteps are not known.

Psa.145.3.bsb: Great is the LORD and greatly to be praised; His greatness is unsearchable.
Psa.145.3.kjv: Great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised; and his greatness is unsearchable.

Psa.26.7.bsb: to raise my voice in thanksgiving and declare all Your wonderful works.
Psa.26.7.kjv: That I may publish with the voice of thanksgiving, and tell of all thy wondrous works.

Psa.75.1.bsb: For the choirmaster: To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Psalm of Asaph. A song. We give thanks to You, O God; we give thanks, for Your Name is near. The people declare Your wondrous works.
Psa.75.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, Al–taschith, A Psalm or Song of Asaph. Unto thee, O God, do we give thanks, unto thee do we give thanks: for that thy name is near thy wondrous works declare.

Psa.86.8.bsb: O Lord, there is none like You among the gods, nor any works like Yours.
Psa.86.8.kjv: Among the gods there is none like unto thee, O Lord; neither are there any works like unto thy works.

Psa.92.4.bsb: For You, O LORD, have made me glad by Your deeds; I sing for joy at the works of Your hands.
Psa.92.4.kjv: For thou, Lord, hast made me glad through thy work: I will triumph in the works of thy hands.

Psa.111.2.bsb: Great are the works of the LORD; they are pondered by all who delight in them.
Psa.111.2.kjv: The works of the Lord are great, sought out of all them that have pleasure therein.

Psa.106.37.bsb: They sacrificed their sons and their daughters to demons.
Psa.106.37.kjv: Yea, they sacrificed their sons and their daughters unto devils,

Psa.106.38.bsb: They shed innocent blood—the blood of their sons and daughters, whom they sacrificed to the idols of Canaan, and the land was polluted with blood.
Psa.106.38.kjv: And shed innocent blood, even the blood of their sons and of their daughters, whom they sacrificed unto the idols of Canaan: and the land was polluted with blood.

Psa.16.4.bsb: Sorrows will multiply to those who chase other gods. I will not pour out their libations of blood, or speak their names with my lips.
Psa.16.4.kjv: Their sorrows shall be multiplied that hasten after another god: their drink offerings of blood will I not offer, nor take up their names into my lips.

Psa.81.9.bsb: There must be no strange god among you, nor shall you bow to a foreign god.
Psa.81.9.kjv: There shall no strange god be in thee; neither shalt thou worship any strange god.

Psa.97.7.bsb: All worshipers of images are put to shame—those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
Psa.97.7.kjv: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.

Psa.106.34.bsb: They did not destroy the peoples as the LORD had commanded them,
Psa.106.34.kjv: They did not destroy the nations, concerning whom the Lord commanded them:

Psa.106.35.bsb: but they mingled with the nations and adopted their customs.
Psa.106.35.kjv: But were mingled among the heathen, and learned their works.

Psa.106.36.bsb: They worshiped their idols, which became a snare to them.
Psa.106.36.kjv: And they served their idols: which were a snare unto them.

Psa.106.39.bsb: They defiled themselves by their actions and prostituted themselves by their deeds.
Psa.106.39.kjv: Thus were they defiled with their own works, and went a whoring with their own inventions.

Psa.106.40.bsb: So the anger of the LORD burned against His people, and He abhorred His own inheritance.
Psa.106.40.kjv: Therefore was the wrath of the Lord kindled against his people, insomuch that he abhorred his own inheritance.

Psa.106.41.bsb: He delivered them into the hand of the nations, and those who hated them ruled over them.
Psa.106.41.kjv: And he gave them into the hand of the heathen; and they that hated them ruled over them.

Psa.106.42.bsb: Their enemies oppressed them and subdued them under their hand.
Psa.106.42.kjv: Their enemies also oppressed them, and they were brought into subjection under their hand.

Psa.106.20.bsb: They exchanged their Glory for the image of a grass-eating ox.
Psa.106.20.kjv: Thus they changed their glory into the similitude of an ox that eateth grass.

Psa.115.4.bsb: Their idols are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
Psa.115.4.kjv: Their idols are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

Psa.115.5.bsb: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
Psa.115.5.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not: eyes have they, but they see not:

Psa.115.8.bsb: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
Psa.115.8.kjv: They that make them are like unto them; so is every one that trusteth in them.

Psa.135.15.bsb: The idols of the nations are silver and gold, made by the hands of men.
Psa.135.15.kjv: The idols of the heathen are silver and gold, the work of men’s hands.

Psa.135.16.bsb: They have mouths, but cannot speak; they have eyes, but cannot see;
Psa.135.16.kjv: They have mouths, but they speak not; eyes have they, but they see not;

Psa.135.17.bsb: they have ears, but cannot hear; nor is there breath in their mouths.
Psa.135.17.kjv: They have ears, but they hear not; neither is there any breath in their mouths.

Psa.135.18.bsb: Those who make them become like them, as do all who trust in them.
Psa.135.18.kjv: They that make them are like unto them: so is every one that trusteth in them.

Psa.17.15.bsb: As for me, I will behold Your face in righteousness; when I awake, I will be satisfied in Your presence.
Psa.17.15.kjv: As for me, I will behold thy face in righteousness: I shall be satisfied, when I awake, with thy likeness.

Psa.22.26.bsb: The poor will eat and be satisfied; those who seek the LORD will praise Him. May your hearts live forever!
Psa.22.26.kjv: The meek shall eat and be satisfied: they shall praise the Lord that seek him: your heart shall live for ever.

Psa.37.27.bsb: Turn away from evil and do good, so that you will abide forever.
Psa.37.27.kjv: Depart from evil, and do good; and dwell for evermore.

Psa.49.8.bsb: For the redemption of his soul is costly, and never can payment suffice,
Psa.49.8.kjv: (For the redemption of their soul is precious, and it ceaseth for ever:)

Psa.86.12.bsb: I will praise You, O Lord my God, with all my heart; I will glorify Your name forever.
Psa.86.12.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord my God, with all my heart: and I will glorify thy name for evermore.

Psa.102.4.bsb: My heart is afflicted, and withered like grass; I even forget to eat my bread.
Psa.102.4.kjv: My heart is smitten, and withered like grass; so that I forget to eat my bread.

Psa.145.1.bsb: A Psalm of praise. Of David. I will exalt You, my God and King; I will bless Your name forever and ever.
Psa.145.1.kjv: David’s Psalm of praise. I will extol thee, my God, O king; and I will bless thy name for ever and ever.

Psa.145.2.bsb: Every day I will bless You, and I will praise Your name forever and ever.
Psa.145.2.kjv: Every day will I bless thee; and I will praise thy name for ever and ever.

Psa.79.5.bsb: How long, O LORD? Will You be angry forever? Will Your jealousy burn like fire?
Psa.79.5.kjv: How long, Lord? wilt thou be angry for ever? shall thy jealousy burn like fire?

Psa.50.3.bsb: Our God approaches and will not be silent! Consuming fire precedes Him, and a tempest rages around Him.
Psa.50.3.kjv: Our God shall come, and shall not keep silence: a fire shall devour before him, and it shall be very tempestuous round about him.

Psa.9.16.bsb: The LORD is known by the justice He brings; the wicked are ensnared by the work of their hands. Higgaion Selah
Psa.9.16.kjv: The Lord is known by the judgment which he executeth: the wicked is snared in the work of his own hands. Higgaion. Selah.

Psa.9.20.bsb: Lay terror upon them, O LORD; let the nations know they are but men. Selah
Psa.9.20.kjv: Put them in fear, O Lord: that the nations may know themselves to be but men. Selah.

Psa.83.16.bsb: Cover their faces with shame, that they may seek Your name, O LORD.
Psa.83.16.kjv: Fill their faces with shame; that they may seek thy name, O Lord.

Psa.83.17.bsb: May they be ever ashamed and terrified; may they perish in disgrace.
Psa.83.17.kjv: Let them be confounded and troubled for ever; yea, let them be put to shame, and perish:

Psa.132.1.bsb: A song of ascents. O LORD, remember on behalf of David all the hardships he endured,
Psa.132.1.kjv: A Song of degrees. Lord, remember David, and all his afflictions:

Psa.4.2.bsb: How long, O men, will my honor be maligned? How long will you love vanity and seek after lies? Selah
Psa.4.2.kjv: O ye sons of men, how long will ye turn my glory into shame? how long will ye love vanity, and seek after leasing? Selah.

Psa.7.14.bsb: Behold, the wicked man travails with evil; he conceives trouble and births falsehood.
Psa.7.14.kjv: Behold, he travaileth with iniquity, and hath conceived mischief, and brought forth falsehood.

Psa.7.15.bsb: He has dug a hole and hollowed it out; he has fallen into a pit of his own making.
Psa.7.15.kjv: He made a pit, and digged it, and is fallen into the ditch which he made.

Psa.7.16.bsb: His trouble recoils on himself, and his violence falls on his own head.
Psa.7.16.kjv: His mischief shall return upon his own head, and his violent dealing shall come down upon his own pate.

Psa.10.7.bsb: His mouth is full of cursing, deceit, and violence; trouble and malice are under his tongue.
Psa.10.7.kjv: His mouth is full of cursing and deceit and fraud: under his tongue is mischief and vanity.

Psa.10.8.bsb: He lies in wait near the villages; in ambush he slays the innocent; his eyes watch in stealth for the helpless.
Psa.10.8.kjv: He sitteth in the lurking places of the villages: in the secret places doth he murder the innocent: his eyes are privily set against the poor.

Psa.10.9.bsb: He lies in wait like a lion in a thicket; he lurks to seize the oppressed; he catches the lowly in his net.
Psa.10.9.kjv: He lieth in wait secretly as a lion in his den: he lieth in wait to catch the poor: he doth catch the poor, when he draweth him into his net.

Psa.10.10.bsb: They are crushed and beaten down; the helpless fall prey to his strength.
Psa.10.10.kjv: He croucheth, and humbleth himself, that the poor may fall by his strong ones.

Psa.21.11.bsb: Though they intend You harm, the schemes they devise will not prevail.
Psa.21.11.kjv: For they intended evil against thee: they imagined a mischievous device, which they are not able to perform.

Psa.35.15.bsb: But when I stumbled, they assembled in glee; they gathered together against me. Assailants I did not know slandered me without ceasing.
Psa.35.15.kjv: But in mine adversity they rejoiced, and gathered themselves together: yea, the abjects gathered themselves together against me, and I knew it not; they did tear me, and ceased not:

Psa.35.16.bsb: Like godless jesters at a feast, they gnashed their teeth at me.
Psa.35.16.kjv: With hypocritical mockers in feasts, they gnashed upon me with their teeth.

Psa.35.19.bsb: Let not my enemies gloat over me without cause, nor those who hate me without reason wink in malice.
Psa.35.19.kjv: Let not them that are mine enemies wrongfully rejoice over me: neither let them wink with the eye that hate me without a cause.

Psa.35.20.bsb: For they do not speak peace, but they devise deceitful schemes against those who live quietly in the land.
Psa.35.20.kjv: For they speak not peace: but they devise deceitful matters against them that are quiet in the land.

Psa.35.21.bsb: They gape at me and say, “Aha, aha! Our eyes have seen!”
Psa.35.21.kjv: Yea, they opened their mouth wide against me, and said, Aha, aha, our eye hath seen it.

Psa.38.16.bsb: For I said, “Let them not gloat over me—those who taunt me when my foot slips.”
Psa.38.16.kjv: For I said, Hear me, lest otherwise they should rejoice over me: when my foot slippeth, they magnify themselves against me.

Psa.38.19.bsb: Many are my enemies without cause, and many hate me without reason.
Psa.38.19.kjv: But mine enemies are lively, and they are strong: and they that hate me wrongfully are multiplied.

Psa.41.5.bsb: My enemies say with malice: “When will he die and be forgotten?”
Psa.41.5.kjv: Mine enemies speak evil of me, When shall he die, and his name perish?

Psa.41.6.bsb: My visitor speaks falsehood; he gathers slander in his heart; he goes out and spreads it abroad.
Psa.41.6.kjv: And if he come to see me, he speaketh vanity: his heart gathereth iniquity to itself; when he goeth abroad, he telleth it.

Psa.41.7.bsb: All who hate me whisper against me; they imagine the worst for me:
Psa.41.7.kjv: All that hate me whisper together against me: against me do they devise my hurt.

Psa.41.8.bsb: “A vile disease has been poured into him; he will never get up from where he lies!”
Psa.41.8.kjv: An evil disease, say they, cleaveth fast unto him: and now that he lieth he shall rise up no more.

Psa.55.10.bsb: Day and night they encircle the walls, while malice and trouble lie within.
Psa.55.10.kjv: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: mischief also and sorrow are in the midst of it.

Psa.55.11.bsb: Destruction is within; oppression and deceit never leave the streets.
Psa.55.11.kjv: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: deceit and guile depart not from her streets.

Psa.56.5.bsb: All day long they twist my words; all their thoughts are on my demise.
Psa.56.5.kjv: Every day they wrest my words: all their thoughts are against me for evil.

Psa.56.6.bsb: They conspire, they lurk, they watch my steps while they wait to take my life.
Psa.56.6.kjv: They gather themselves together, they hide themselves, they mark my steps, when they wait for my soul.

Psa.57.4.bsb: My soul is among the lions; I lie down with ravenous beasts—with men whose teeth are spears and arrows, whose tongues are sharp swords.
Psa.57.4.kjv: My soul is among lions: and I lie even among them that are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows, and their tongue a sharp sword.

Psa.57.6.bsb: They spread a net for my feet; my soul was despondent. They dug a pit before me, but they themselves have fallen into it! Selah
Psa.57.6.kjv: They have prepared a net for my steps; my soul is bowed down: they have digged a pit before me, into the midst whereof they are fallen themselves. Selah.

Psa.59.3.bsb: See how they lie in wait for me. Fierce men conspire against me for no transgression or sin of my own, O LORD.
Psa.59.3.kjv: For, lo, they lie in wait for my soul: the mighty are gathered against me; not for my transgression, nor for my sin, O Lord.

Psa.59.4.bsb: For no fault of my own, they move swiftly to attack me. Arise to help me, and take notice.
Psa.59.4.kjv: They run and prepare themselves without my fault: awake to help me, and behold.

Psa.59.6.bsb: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
Psa.59.6.kjv: They return at evening: they make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

Psa.59.7.bsb: See what they spew from their mouths—sharp words from their lips: “For who can hear us?”
Psa.59.7.kjv: Behold, they belch out with their mouth: swords are in their lips: for who, say they, doth hear?

Psa.62.3.bsb: How long will you threaten a man? Will all of you throw him down like a leaning wall or a tottering fence?
Psa.62.3.kjv: How long will ye imagine mischief against a man? ye shall be slain all of you: as a bowing wall shall ye be, and as a tottering fence.

Psa.62.4.bsb: They fully intend to cast him down from his lofty perch; they delight in lies; with their mouths they bless, but inwardly they curse. Selah
Psa.62.4.kjv: They only consult to cast him down from his excellency: they delight in lies: they bless with their mouth, but they curse inwardly. Selah.

Psa.64.2.bsb: Hide me from the scheming of the wicked, from the mob of workers of iniquity,
Psa.64.2.kjv: Hide me from the secret counsel of the wicked; from the insurrection of the workers of iniquity:

Psa.64.3.bsb: who sharpen their tongues like swords and aim their bitter words like arrows,
Psa.64.3.kjv: Who whet their tongue like a sword, and bend their bows to shoot their arrows, even bitter words:

Psa.64.4.bsb: ambushing the innocent in seclusion, shooting suddenly, without fear.
Psa.64.4.kjv: That they may shoot in secret at the perfect: suddenly do they shoot at him, and fear not.

Psa.64.5.bsb: They hold fast to their evil purpose; they speak of hiding their snares. “Who will see them?” they say.
Psa.64.5.kjv: They encourage themselves in an evil matter: they commune of laying snares privily; they say, Who shall see them?

Psa.64.6.bsb: They devise injustice and say, “We have perfected a secret plan.” For the inner man and the heart are mysterious.
Psa.64.6.kjv: They search out iniquities; they accomplish a diligent search: both the inward thought of every one of them, and the heart, is deep.

Psa.69.10.bsb: I wept and fasted, but it brought me reproach.
Psa.69.10.kjv: When I wept, and chastened my soul with fasting, that was to my reproach.

Psa.69.11.bsb: I made sackcloth my clothing, and I was sport to them.
Psa.69.11.kjv: I made sackcloth also my garment; and I became a proverb to them.

Psa.69.12.bsb: Those who sit at the gate mock me, and I am the song of drunkards.
Psa.69.12.kjv: They that sit in the gate speak against me; and I was the song of the drunkards.

Psa.69.26.bsb: For they persecute the one You struck and recount the pain of those You wounded.
Psa.69.26.kjv: For they persecute him whom thou hast smitten; and they talk to the grief of those whom thou hast wounded.

Psa.70.2.bsb: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
Psa.70.2.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded that seek after my soul: let them be turned backward, and put to confusion, that desire my hurt.

Psa.70.3.bsb: May those who say, “Aha, aha!” retreat because of their shame.
Psa.70.3.kjv: Let them be turned back for a reward of their shame that say, Aha, aha.

Psa.71.10.bsb: For my enemies speak against me, and those who lie in wait for my life conspire,
Psa.71.10.kjv: For mine enemies speak against me; and they that lay wait for my soul take counsel together,

Psa.71.11.bsb: saying, “God has forsaken him; pursue him and seize him, for there is no one to rescue him.”
Psa.71.11.kjv: Saying, God hath forsaken him: persecute and take him; for there is none to deliver him.

Psa.71.13.bsb: May the accusers of my soul be ashamed and consumed; may those who seek my harm be covered with scorn and disgrace.
Psa.71.13.kjv: Let them be confounded and consumed that are adversaries to my soul; let them be covered with reproach and dishonour that seek my hurt.

Psa.71.24.bsb: My tongue will indeed proclaim Your righteousness all day long, for those who seek my harm are disgraced and confounded.
Psa.71.24.kjv: My tongue also shall talk of thy righteousness all the day long: for they are confounded, for they are brought unto shame, that seek my hurt.

Psa.74.20.bsb: Consider Your covenant, for haunts of violence fill the dark places of the land.
Psa.74.20.kjv: Have respect unto the covenant: for the dark places of the earth are full of the habitations of cruelty.

Psa.86.14.bsb: The arrogant rise against me, O God; a band of ruthless men seeks my life; they have no regard for You.
Psa.86.14.kjv: O God, the proud are risen against me, and the assemblies of violent men have sought after my soul; and have not set thee before them.

Psa.102.8.bsb: All day long my enemies taunt me; they ridicule me and curse me.
Psa.102.8.kjv: Mine enemies reproach me all the day; and they that are mad against me are sworn against me.

Psa.109.2.bsb: For wicked and deceitful mouths open against me; they speak against me with lying tongues.
Psa.109.2.kjv: For the mouth of the wicked and the mouth of the deceitful are opened against me: they have spoken against me with a lying tongue.

Psa.109.3.bsb: They surround me with hateful words and attack me without cause.
Psa.109.3.kjv: They compassed me about also with words of hatred; and fought against me without a cause.

Psa.109.4.bsb: In return for my love they accuse me, but I am a man of prayer.
Psa.109.4.kjv: For my love they are my adversaries: but I give myself unto prayer.

Psa.109.5.bsb: They repay me evil for good, and hatred for my love.
Psa.109.5.kjv: And they have rewarded me evil for good, and hatred for my love.

Psa.109.16.bsb: For he never thought to show kindness, but pursued the poor and needy and brokenhearted, even to their death.
Psa.109.16.kjv: Because that he remembered not to shew mercy, but persecuted the poor and needy man, that he might even slay the broken in heart.

Psa.109.17.bsb: The cursing that he loved, may it fall on him; the blessing in which he refused to delight, may it be far from him.
Psa.109.17.kjv: As he loved cursing, so let it come unto him: as he delighted not in blessing, so let it be far from him.

Psa.109.18.bsb: The cursing that he wore like a coat, may it soak into his body like water, and into his bones like oil.
Psa.109.18.kjv: As he clothed himself with cursing like as with his garment, so let it come into his bowels like water, and like oil into his bones.

Psa.119.78.bsb: May the arrogant be put to shame for subverting me with a lie; I will meditate on Your precepts.
Psa.119.78.kjv: Let the proud be ashamed; for they dealt perversely with me without a cause: but I will meditate in thy precepts.

Psa.119.150.bsb: Those who follow after wickedness draw near; they are far from Your law.
Psa.119.150.kjv: They draw nigh that follow after mischief: they are far from thy law.

Psa.140.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Rescue me, O LORD, from evil men. Protect me from men of violence,
Psa.140.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Deliver me, O Lord, from the evil man: preserve me from the violent man;

Psa.140.2.bsb: who devise evil in their hearts and stir up war all day long.
Psa.140.2.kjv: Which imagine mischiefs in their heart; continually are they gathered together for war.

Psa.140.3.bsb: They sharpen their tongues like snakes; the venom of vipers is on their lips. Selah
Psa.140.3.kjv: They have sharpened their tongues like a serpent; adders’ poison is under their lips. Selah.

Psa.140.4.bsb: Guard me, O LORD, from the hands of the wicked. Keep me safe from men of violence who scheme to make me stumble.
Psa.140.4.kjv: Keep me, O Lord, from the hands of the wicked; preserve me from the violent man; who have purposed to overthrow my goings.
