Psa.150.4.bsb: Praise Him with tambourine and dancing; praise Him with strings and flute.
Psa.150.4.kjv: Praise him with the timbrel and dance: praise him with stringed instruments and organs.

Psa.59.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Do Not Destroy.” A Miktam of David, when Saul sent men to watch David’s house in order to kill him. Deliver me from my enemies, O my God; protect me from those who rise against me.
Psa.59.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, Al–taschith, Michtam of David; when Saul sent, and they watched the house to kill him. Deliver me from mine enemies, O my God: defend me from them that rise up against me.

Psa.92.3.bsb: with the ten-stringed harp and the melody of the lyre.
Psa.92.3.kjv: Upon an instrument of ten strings, and upon the psaltery; upon the harp with a solemn sound.

Psa.42.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Maskil of the sons of Korah. As the deer pants for streams of water, so my soul longs after You, O God.
Psa.42.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, Maschil, for the sons of Korah. As the hart panteth after the water brooks, so panteth my soul after thee, O God.

Psa.45.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lilies.” A Maskil of the sons of Korah. A love song. My heart is stirred by a noble theme as I recite my verses to the king; my tongue is the pen of a skillful writer.
Psa.45.1.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, for the sons of Korah, Maschil, A Song of loves. My heart is inditing a good matter: I speak of the things which I have made touching the king: my tongue is the pen of a ready writer.

Psa.54.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Maskil of David. When the Ziphites went to Saul and said, “Is David not hiding among us?” Save me, O God, by Your name, and vindicate me by Your might!
Psa.54.1.kjv: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, Maschil, A Psalm of David, when the Ziphims came and said to Saul, Doth not David hide himself with us? Save me, O God, by thy name, and judge me by thy strength.

Psa.142.1.bsb: A Maskil of David, when he was in the cave. A prayer. I cry aloud to the LORD; I lift my voice to the LORD for mercy.
Psa.142.1.kjv: Maschil of David; A Prayer when he was in the cave. I cried unto the Lord with my voice; with my voice unto the Lord did I make my supplication.

Psa.56.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “A Dove on Distant Oaks.” A Miktam of David, when the Philistines seized him in Gath. Be merciful to me, O God, for men are hounding me; all day they press their attack.
Psa.56.1.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Jonath–elem–rechokim, Michtam of David, when the Philistines took him in Gath. Be merciful unto me, O God: for man would swallow me up; he fighting daily oppresseth me.

Psa.60.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Lily of the Covenant.” A Miktam of David for instruction. When he fought Aram-naharaim and Aram-zobah, and Joab returned and struck down 12,000 Edomites in the Valley of Salt. You have rejected us, O God; You have broken us; You have been angry; restore us!
Psa.60.1.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Shushan–eduth, Michtam of David, to teach; when he strove with Aram–naharaim and with Aram–zobah, when Joab returned, and smote of Edom in the valley of salt twelve thousand. O God, thou hast cast us off, thou hast scattered us, thou hast been displeased; O turn thyself to us again.

Psa.9.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “The Death of the Son.” A Psalm of David. I will give thanks to the LORD with all my heart; I will recount all Your wonders.
Psa.9.1.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Muth–labben, A Psalm of David. I will praise thee, O Lord, with my whole heart; I will shew forth all thy marvellous works.

Psa.67.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments. A Psalm. A song. May God be gracious to us and bless us, and cause His face to shine upon us, Selah
Psa.67.1.kjv: To the chief Musician on Neginoth, A Psalm or Song. God be merciful unto us, and bless us; and cause his face to shine upon us; Selah.

Psa.6.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. With stringed instruments, according to Sheminith. A Psalm of David. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
Psa.6.1.kjv: To the chief Musician on Neginoth upon Sheminith, A Psalm of David. O Lord, rebuke me not in thine anger, neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

Psa.69.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. To the tune of “Lilies.” Of David. Save me, O God, for the waters are up to my neck.
Psa.69.1.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Shoshannim, A Psalm of David. Save me, O God; for the waters are come in unto my soul.

Psa.33.1.bsb: Rejoice in the LORD, O righteous ones; it is fitting for the upright to praise Him.
Psa.33.1.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord, O ye righteous: for praise is comely for the upright.

Psa.33.2.bsb: Praise the LORD with the harp; make music to Him with ten strings.
Psa.33.2.kjv: Praise the Lord with harp: sing unto him with the psaltery and an instrument of ten strings.

Psa.33.3.bsb: Sing to Him a new song; play skillfully with a shout of joy.
Psa.33.3.kjv: Sing unto him a new song; play skilfully with a loud noise.

Psa.68.4.bsb: Sing to God! Sing praises to His name. Exalt Him who rides on the clouds—His name is the LORD—and rejoice before Him.
Psa.68.4.kjv: Sing unto God, sing praises to his name: extol him that rideth upon the heavens by his name Jah, and rejoice before him.

Psa.68.25.bsb: The singers lead the way, the musicians follow after, among the maidens playing tambourines.
Psa.68.25.kjv: The singers went before, the players on instruments followed after; among them were the damsels playing with timbrels.

Psa.68.26.bsb: Bless God in the great congregation; bless the LORD from the fountain of Israel.
Psa.68.26.kjv: Bless ye God in the congregations, even the Lord, from the fountain of Israel.

Psa.81.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. According to Gittith. Of Asaph. Sing for joy to God our strength; make a joyful noise to the God of Jacob.
Psa.81.1.kjv: To the chief Musician upon Gittith, A Psalm of Asaph. Sing aloud unto God our strength: make a joyful noise unto the God of Jacob.

Psa.81.2.bsb: Lift up a song, strike the tambourine, play the sweet-sounding harp and lyre.
Psa.81.2.kjv: Take a psalm, and bring hither the timbrel, the pleasant harp with the psaltery.

Psa.81.3.bsb: Sound the ram’s horn at the New Moon, and at the full moon on the day of our Feast.
Psa.81.3.kjv: Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day.

Psa.95.1.bsb: Come, let us sing for joy to the LORD; let us shout to the Rock of our salvation!
Psa.95.1.kjv: O come, let us sing unto the Lord: let us make a joyful noise to the rock of our salvation.

Psa.95.2.bsb: Let us enter His presence with thanksgiving; let us make a joyful noise to Him in song.
Psa.95.2.kjv: Let us come before his presence with thanksgiving, and make a joyful noise unto him with psalms.

Psa.98.4.bsb: Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth; break forth—let your cry ring out, and sing praises!
Psa.98.4.kjv: Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all the earth: make a loud noise, and rejoice, and sing praise.

Psa.98.5.bsb: Sing praises to the LORD with the lyre, in melodious song with the harp.
Psa.98.5.kjv: Sing unto the Lord with the harp; with the harp, and the voice of a psalm.

Psa.98.7.bsb: Let the sea resound, and all that fills it, the world, and all who dwell in it.
Psa.98.7.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof; the world, and they that dwell therein.

Psa.98.8.bsb: Let the rivers clap their hands, let the mountains sing together for joy
Psa.98.8.kjv: Let the floods clap their hands: let the hills be joyful together

Psa.104.33.bsb: I will sing to the LORD all my life; I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.
Psa.104.33.kjv: I will sing unto the Lord as long as I live: I will sing praise to my God while I have my being.

Psa.105.2.bsb: Sing to Him, sing praises to Him; tell of all His wonders.
Psa.105.2.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him: talk ye of all his wondrous works.

Psa.135.1.bsb: Hallelujah! Praise the name of the LORD. Give praise, O servants of the LORD,
Psa.135.1.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the name of the Lord; praise him, O ye servants of the Lord.

Psa.135.2.bsb: who stand in the house of the LORD, in the courts of the house of our God.
Psa.135.2.kjv: Ye that stand in the house of the Lord, in the courts of the house of our God,

Psa.144.9.bsb: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You—
Psa.144.9.kjv: I will sing a new song unto thee, O God: upon a psaltery and an instrument of ten strings will I sing praises unto thee.

Psa.149.3.bsb: Let them praise His name with dancing, and make music to Him with tambourine and harp.
Psa.149.3.kjv: Let them praise his name in the dance: let them sing praises unto him with the timbrel and harp.

Psa.149.6.bsb: May the high praises of God be in their mouths, and a double-edged sword in their hands,
Psa.149.6.kjv: Let the high praises of God be in their mouth, and a twoedged sword in their hand;

Psa.150.2.bsb: Praise Him for His mighty acts; praise Him for His excellent greatness.
Psa.150.2.kjv: Praise him for his mighty acts: praise him according to his excellent greatness.

Psa.150.3.bsb: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
Psa.150.3.kjv: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.

Psa.150.5.bsb: Praise Him with clashing cymbals; praise Him with resounding cymbals.
Psa.150.5.kjv: Praise him upon the loud cymbals: praise him upon the high sounding cymbals.

Psa.150.6.bsb: Let everything that has breath praise the LORD! Hallelujah!
Psa.150.6.kjv: Let every thing that hath breath praise the Lord. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.15.2.bsb: He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,
Psa.15.2.kjv: He that walketh uprightly, and worketh righteousness, and speaketh the truth in his heart.

Psa.15.3.bsb: who has no slander on his tongue, who does no harm to his neighbor, who casts no scorn on his friend,
Psa.15.3.kjv: He that backbiteth not with his tongue, nor doeth evil to his neighbour, nor taketh up a reproach against his neighbour.

Psa.82.3.bsb: Defend the cause of the weak and fatherless; uphold the rights of the afflicted and oppressed.
Psa.82.3.kjv: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy.

Psa.94.6.bsb: They kill the widow and the foreigner; they murder the fatherless.
Psa.94.6.kjv: They slay the widow and the stranger, and murder the fatherless.

Psa.35.11.bsb: Hostile witnesses come forward; they make charges I know nothing about.
Psa.35.11.kjv: False witnesses did rise up; they laid to my charge things that I knew not.

Psa.37.16.bsb: Better is the little of the righteous than the abundance of many who are wicked.
Psa.37.16.kjv: A little that a righteous man hath is better than the riches of many wicked.

Psa.82.4.bsb: Rescue the weak and needy; save them from the hand of the wicked.
Psa.82.4.kjv: Deliver the poor and needy: rid them out of the hand of the wicked.

Psa.37.21.bsb: The wicked borrow and do not repay, but the righteous are gracious and giving.
Psa.37.21.kjv: The wicked borroweth, and payeth not again: but the righteous sheweth mercy, and giveth.

Psa.10.2.bsb: In pride the wicked pursue the needy; let them be caught in the schemes they devise.
Psa.10.2.kjv: The wicked in his pride doth persecute the poor: let them be taken in the devices that they have imagined.

Psa.37.14.bsb: The wicked have drawn the sword and bent the bow to bring down the poor and needy, to slay those whose ways are upright.
Psa.37.14.kjv: The wicked have drawn out the sword, and have bent their bow, to cast down the poor and needy, and to slay such as be of upright conversation.

Psa.7.17.bsb: I will thank the LORD for His righteousness and sing praise to the name of the LORD Most High.
Psa.7.17.kjv: I will praise the Lord according to his righteousness: and will sing praise to the name of the Lord most high.

Psa.22.22.bsb: I will proclaim Your name to my brothers; I will praise You in the assembly.
Psa.22.22.kjv: I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee.

Psa.22.23.bsb: You who fear the LORD, praise Him! All descendants of Jacob, honor Him! All offspring of Israel, revere Him!
Psa.22.23.kjv: Ye that fear the Lord, praise him; all ye the seed of Jacob, glorify him; and fear him, all ye the seed of Israel.

Psa.22.25.bsb: My praise for You resounds in the great assembly; I will fulfill my vows before those who fear You.
Psa.22.25.kjv: My praise shall be of thee in the great congregation: I will pay my vows before them that fear him.

Psa.24.7.bsb: Lift up your heads, O gates! Be lifted up, O ancient doors, that the King of Glory may enter!
Psa.24.7.kjv: Lift up your heads, O ye gates; and be ye lift up, ye everlasting doors; and the King of glory shall come in.

Psa.28.6.bsb: Blessed be the LORD, for He has heard my cry for mercy.
Psa.28.6.kjv: Blessed be the Lord, because he hath heard the voice of my supplications.

Psa.32.11.bsb: Be glad in the LORD and rejoice, O righteous ones; shout for joy, all you upright in heart.
Psa.32.11.kjv: Be glad in the Lord, and rejoice, ye righteous: and shout for joy, all ye that are upright in heart.

Psa.35.18.bsb: Then I will give You thanks in the great assembly; I will praise You among many people.
Psa.35.18.kjv: I will give thee thanks in the great congregation: I will praise thee among much people.

Psa.35.28.bsb: Then my tongue will proclaim Your righteousness and Your praises all day long.
Psa.35.28.kjv: And my tongue shall speak of thy righteousness and of thy praise all the day long.

Psa.43.4.bsb: Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my greatest joy. I will praise You with the harp, O God, my God.
Psa.43.4.kjv: Then will I go unto the altar of God, unto God my exceeding joy: yea, upon the harp will I praise thee, O God my God.

Psa.47.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Clap your hands, all you peoples; shout unto God with a voice of triumph.
Psa.47.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. O clap your hands, all ye people; shout unto God with the voice of triumph.

Psa.47.6.bsb: Sing praises to God, sing praises; sing praises to our King, sing praises!
Psa.47.6.kjv: Sing praises to God, sing praises: sing praises unto our King, sing praises.

Psa.51.15.bsb: O Lord, open my lips, and my mouth will declare Your praise.
Psa.51.15.kjv: O Lord, open thou my lips; and my mouth shall shew forth thy praise.

Psa.56.10.bsb: In God, whose word I praise, in the LORD, whose word I praise,
Psa.56.10.kjv: In God will I praise his word: in the Lord will I praise his word.

Psa.56.12.bsb: Your vows are upon me, O God; I will render thank offerings to You.
Psa.56.12.kjv: Thy vows are upon me, O God: I will render praises unto thee.

Psa.57.7.bsb: My heart is steadfast, O God, my heart is steadfast. I will sing and make music.
Psa.57.7.kjv: My heart is fixed, O God, my heart is fixed: I will sing and give praise.

Psa.57.8.bsb: Awake, my glory! Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
Psa.57.8.kjv: Awake up, my glory; awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

Psa.57.9.bsb: I will praise You, O Lord, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
Psa.57.9.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: I will sing unto thee among the nations.

Psa.61.8.bsb: Then I will ever sing praise to Your name and fulfill my vows day by day.
Psa.61.8.kjv: So will I sing praise unto thy name for ever, that I may daily perform my vows.

Psa.63.4.bsb: So I will bless You as long as I live; in Your name I will lift my hands.
Psa.63.4.kjv: Thus will I bless thee while I live: I will lift up my hands in thy name.

Psa.63.5.bsb: My soul is satisfied as with the richest of foods; with joyful lips my mouth will praise You.
Psa.63.5.kjv: My soul shall be satisfied as with marrow and fatness; and my mouth shall praise thee with joyful lips:

Psa.66.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A song. A Psalm. Make a joyful noise to God, all the earth!
Psa.66.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Song or Psalm. Make a joyful noise unto God, all ye lands:

Psa.66.2.bsb: Sing the glory of His name; make His praise glorious.
Psa.66.2.kjv: Sing forth the honour of his name: make his praise glorious.

Psa.66.8.bsb: Bless our God, O peoples; let the sound of His praise be heard.
Psa.66.8.kjv: O bless our God, ye people, and make the voice of his praise to be heard:

Psa.67.3.bsb: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
Psa.67.3.kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

Psa.69.30.bsb: I will praise God’s name in song and exalt Him with thanksgiving.
Psa.69.30.kjv: I will praise the name of God with a song, and will magnify him with thanksgiving.

Psa.69.34.bsb: Let heaven and earth praise Him, the seas and everything that moves in them.
Psa.69.34.kjv: Let the heaven and earth praise him, the seas, and every thing that moveth therein.

Psa.70.4.bsb: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “Let God be magnified!”
Psa.70.4.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: and let such as love thy salvation say continually, Let God be magnified.

Psa.71.8.bsb: My mouth is filled with Your praise and with Your splendor all day long.
Psa.71.8.kjv: Let my mouth be filled with thy praise and with thy honour all the day.

Psa.89.52.bsb: Blessed be the LORD forever! Amen and amen.
Psa.89.52.kjv: Blessed be the Lord for evermore. Amen, and Amen.

Psa.97.12.bsb: Rejoice in the LORD, you righteous ones, and praise His holy name.
Psa.97.12.kjv: Rejoice in the Lord, ye righteous; and give thanks at the remembrance of his holiness.

Psa.100.1.bsb: A Psalm of thanksgiving. Make a joyful noise to the LORD, all the earth.
Psa.100.1.kjv: A Psalm of praise. Make a joyful noise unto the Lord, all ye lands.

Psa.100.2.bsb: Serve the LORD with gladness; come into His presence with joyful songs.
Psa.100.2.kjv: Serve the Lord with gladness: come before his presence with singing.

Psa.101.1.bsb: A Psalm of David. I will sing of Your loving devotion and justice; to You, O LORD, I will sing praises.
Psa.101.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. I will sing of mercy and judgment: unto thee, O Lord, will I sing.

Psa.104.34.bsb: May my meditation be pleasing to Him, for I rejoice in the LORD.
Psa.104.34.kjv: My meditation of him shall be sweet: I will be glad in the Lord.

Psa.105.1.bsb: Give thanks to the LORD, call upon His name; make known His deeds among the nations.
Psa.105.1.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; call upon his name: make known his deeds among the people.

Psa.105.4.bsb: Seek out the LORD and His strength; seek His face always.
Psa.105.4.kjv: Seek the Lord, and his strength: seek his face evermore.

Psa.105.5.bsb: Remember the wonders He has done, His marvels, and the judgments He has pronounced,
Psa.105.5.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done; his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;

Psa.106.48.bsb: Blessed be the LORD, the God of Israel, from everlasting to everlasting. Let all the people say, “Amen!” Hallelujah!
Psa.106.48.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel from everlasting to everlasting: and let all the people say, Amen. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.108.1.bsb: A song. A Psalm of David. My heart is steadfast, O God; I will sing and make music with all my being.
Psa.108.1.kjv: A Song or Psalm of David. O God, my heart is fixed; I will sing and give praise, even with my glory.

Psa.108.2.bsb: Awake, O harp and lyre! I will awaken the dawn.
Psa.108.2.kjv: Awake, psaltery and harp: I myself will awake early.

Psa.108.3.bsb: I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing Your praises among the peoples.
Psa.108.3.kjv: I will praise thee, O Lord, among the people: and I will sing praises unto thee among the nations.

Psa.109.30.bsb: With my mouth I will thank the LORD profusely; I will praise Him in the presence of many.
Psa.109.30.kjv: I will greatly praise the Lord with my mouth; yea, I will praise him among the multitude.

Psa.111.10.bsb: The fear of the LORD is the beginning of wisdom; all who follow His precepts gain rich understanding. His praise endures forever!
Psa.111.10.kjv: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of wisdom: a good understanding have all they that do his commandments: his praise endureth for ever.

Psa.113.1.bsb: Hallelujah! Give praise, O servants of the LORD; praise the name of the LORD.
Psa.113.1.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise, O ye servants of the Lord, praise the name of the Lord.

Psa.113.2.bsb: Blessed be the name of the LORD both now and forevermore.
Psa.113.2.kjv: Blessed be the name of the Lord from this time forth and for evermore.

Psa.115.18.bsb: But it is we who will bless the LORD, both now and forevermore. Hallelujah!
Psa.115.18.kjv: But we will bless the Lord from this time forth and for evermore. Praise the Lord.

Psa.116.18.bsb: I will fulfill my vows to the LORD in the presence of all His people,
Psa.116.18.kjv: I will pay my vows unto the Lord now in the presence of all his people,

Psa.117.1.bsb: Praise the LORD, all you nations! Extol Him, all you peoples!
Psa.117.1.kjv: O praise the Lord, all ye nations: praise him, all ye people.

Psa.118.15.bsb: Shouts of joy and salvation resound in the tents of the righteous: “The right hand of the LORD performs with valor!
Psa.118.15.kjv: The voice of rejoicing and salvation is in the tabernacles of the righteous: the right hand of the Lord doeth valiantly.

Psa.118.28.bsb: You are my God, and I will give You thanks. You are my God, and I will exalt You.
Psa.118.28.kjv: Thou art my God, and I will praise thee: thou art my God, I will exalt thee.

Psa.119.7.bsb: I will praise You with an upright heart when I learn Your righteous judgments.
Psa.119.7.kjv: I will praise thee with uprightness of heart, when I shall have learned thy righteous judgments.

Psa.119.62.bsb: At midnight I rise to give You thanks for Your righteous judgments.
Psa.119.62.kjv: At midnight I will rise to give thanks unto thee because of thy righteous judgments.

Psa.119.108.bsb: Accept the freewill offerings of my mouth, O LORD, and teach me Your judgments.
Psa.119.108.kjv: Accept, I beseech thee, the freewill offerings of my mouth, O Lord, and teach me thy judgments.

Psa.119.164.bsb: Seven times a day I praise You for Your righteous judgments.
Psa.119.164.kjv: Seven times a day do I praise thee because of thy righteous judgments.

Psa.119.171.bsb: My lips pour forth praise, for You teach me Your statutes.
Psa.119.171.kjv: My lips shall utter praise, when thou hast taught me thy statutes.

Psa.119.175.bsb: Let me live to praise You; may Your judgments sustain me.
Psa.119.175.kjv: Let my soul live, and it shall praise thee; and let thy judgments help me.

Psa.135.19.bsb: O house of Israel, bless the LORD; O house of Aaron, bless the LORD;
Psa.135.19.kjv: Bless the Lord, O house of Israel: bless the Lord, O house of Aaron:

Psa.135.21.bsb: Blessed be the LORD from Zion—He who dwells in Jerusalem. Hallelujah!
Psa.135.21.kjv: Blessed be the Lord out of Zion, which dwelleth at Jerusalem. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.138.1.bsb: Of David. I give You thanks with all my heart; before the gods I sing Your praises.
Psa.138.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. I will praise thee with my whole heart: before the gods will I sing praise unto thee.

Psa.140.13.bsb: Surely the righteous will praise Your name; the upright will dwell in Your presence.
Psa.140.13.kjv: Surely the righteous shall give thanks unto thy name: the upright shall dwell in thy presence.

Psa.144.1.bsb: Of David. Blessed be the LORD, my Rock, who trains my hands for war, my fingers for battle.
Psa.144.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. Blessed be the Lord my strength, which teacheth my hands to war, and my fingers to fight:

Psa.145.4.bsb: One generation will commend Your works to the next, and will proclaim Your mighty acts—
Psa.145.4.kjv: One generation shall praise thy works to another, and shall declare thy mighty acts.

Psa.145.21.bsb: My mouth will declare the praise of the LORD; let every creature bless His holy name forever and ever.
Psa.145.21.kjv: My mouth shall speak the praise of the Lord: and let all flesh bless his holy name for ever and ever.

Psa.146.1.bsb: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD, O my soul.
Psa.146.1.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise the Lord, O my soul.

Psa.146.2.bsb: I will praise the LORD all my life; I will sing praises to my God while I have my being.
Psa.146.2.kjv: While I live will I praise the Lord: I will sing praises unto my God while I have any being.

Psa.146.3.bsb: Put not your trust in princes, in mortal man, who cannot save.
Psa.146.3.kjv: Put not your trust in princes, nor in the son of man, in whom there is no help.

Psa.147.1.bsb: Hallelujah! How good it is to sing praises to our God, how pleasant and lovely to praise Him!
Psa.147.1.kjv: Praise ye the Lord: for it is good to sing praises unto our God; for it is pleasant; and praise is comely.

Psa.147.6.bsb: The LORD sustains the humble, but casts the wicked to the ground.
Psa.147.6.kjv: The Lord lifteth up the meek: he casteth the wicked down to the ground.

Psa.147.7.bsb: Sing to the LORD with thanksgiving; make music on the harp to our God,
Psa.147.7.kjv: Sing unto the Lord with thanksgiving; sing praise upon the harp unto our God:

Psa.147.10.bsb: He does not delight in the strength of the horse; He takes no pleasure in the legs of a man.
Psa.147.10.kjv: He delighteth not in the strength of the horse: he taketh not pleasure in the legs of a man.

Psa.147.12.bsb: Exalt the LORD, O Jerusalem; praise your God, O Zion!
Psa.147.12.kjv: Praise the Lord, O Jerusalem; praise thy God, O Zion.

Psa.147.19.bsb: He declares His word to Jacob, His statutes and judgments to Israel.
Psa.147.19.kjv: He sheweth his word unto Jacob, his statutes and his judgments unto Israel.

Psa.147.20.bsb: He has done this for no other nation; they do not know His judgments. Hallelujah!
Psa.147.20.kjv: He hath not dealt so with any nation: and as for his judgments, they have not known them. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.148.1.bsb: Hallelujah! Praise the LORD from the heavens; praise Him in the highest places.
Psa.148.1.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Praise ye the Lord from the heavens: praise him in the heights.

Psa.148.7.bsb: Praise the LORD from the earth, all great sea creatures and ocean depths,
Psa.148.7.kjv: Praise the Lord from the earth, ye dragons, and all deeps:

Psa.148.9.bsb: mountains and all hills, fruit trees and all cedars,
Psa.148.9.kjv: Mountains, and all hills; fruitful trees, and all cedars:

Psa.148.10.bsb: wild animals and all cattle, crawling creatures and flying birds,
Psa.148.10.kjv: Beasts, and all cattle; creeping things, and flying fowl:

Psa.148.11.bsb: kings of the earth and all peoples, princes and all rulers of the earth,
Psa.148.11.kjv: Kings of the earth, and all people; princes, and all judges of the earth:

Psa.149.5.bsb: Let the saints exult in glory; let them shout for joy upon their beds.
Psa.149.5.kjv: Let the saints be joyful in glory: let them sing aloud upon their beds.

Psa.149.7.bsb: to inflict vengeance on the nations and punishment on the peoples,
Psa.149.7.kjv: To execute vengeance upon the heathen, and punishments upon the people;

Psa.149.8.bsb: to bind their kings with chains and their nobles with shackles of iron,
Psa.149.8.kjv: To bind their kings with chains, and their nobles with fetters of iron;

Psa.149.9.bsb: to execute the judgment written against them. This honor is for all His saints. Hallelujah!
Psa.149.9.kjv: To execute upon them the judgment written: this honour have all his saints. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.22.2.bsb: I cry out by day, O my God, but You do not answer, and by night, but I have no rest.
Psa.22.2.kjv: O my God, I cry in the daytime, but thou hearest not; and in the night season, and am not silent.

Psa.106.15.bsb: So He granted their request, but sent a wasting disease upon them.
Psa.106.15.kjv: And he gave them their request; but sent leanness into their soul.

Psa.51.2.bsb: Wash me clean of my iniquity and cleanse me from my sin.
Psa.51.2.kjv: Wash me throughly from mine iniquity, and cleanse me from my sin.

Psa.51.3.bsb: For I know my transgressions, and my sin is always before me.
Psa.51.3.kjv: For I acknowledge my transgressions: and my sin is ever before me.

Psa.51.6.bsb: Surely You desire truth in the inmost being; You teach me wisdom in the inmost place.
Psa.51.6.kjv: Behold, thou desirest truth in the inward parts: and in the hidden part thou shalt make me to know wisdom.

Psa.51.7.bsb: Purify me with hyssop, and I will be clean; wash me, and I will be whiter than snow.
Psa.51.7.kjv: Purge me with hyssop, and I shall be clean: wash me, and I shall be whiter than snow.

Psa.51.9.bsb: Hide Your face from my sins and blot out all my iniquities.
Psa.51.9.kjv: Hide thy face from my sins, and blot out all mine iniquities.

Psa.51.13.bsb: Then I will teach transgressors Your ways, and sinners will return to You.
Psa.51.13.kjv: Then will I teach transgressors thy ways; and sinners shall be converted unto thee.

Psa.51.14.bsb: Deliver me from bloodguilt, O God, the God of my salvation, and my tongue will sing of Your righteousness.
Psa.51.14.kjv: Deliver me from bloodguiltiness, O God, thou God of my salvation: and my tongue shall sing aloud of thy righteousness.

Psa.51.16.bsb: For You do not delight in sacrifice, or I would bring it; You take no pleasure in burnt offerings.
Psa.51.16.kjv: For thou desirest not sacrifice; else would I give it: thou delightest not in burnt offering.

Psa.5.10.bsb: Declare them guilty, O God; let them fall by their own devices. Drive them out for their many transgressions, for they have rebelled against You.
Psa.5.10.kjv: Destroy thou them, O God; let them fall by their own counsels; cast them out in the multitude of their transgressions; for they have rebelled against thee.

Psa.6.10.bsb: All my enemies will be ashamed and dismayed; they will turn back in sudden disgrace.
Psa.6.10.kjv: Let all mine enemies be ashamed and sore vexed: let them return and be ashamed suddenly.

Psa.10.15.bsb: Break the arm of the wicked and evildoer; call him to account for his wickedness until none is left to be found.
Psa.10.15.kjv: Break thou the arm of the wicked and the evil man: seek out his wickedness till thou find none.

Psa.25.3.bsb: Surely none who wait for You will be put to shame; but those who engage in treachery without cause will be disgraced.
Psa.25.3.kjv: Yea, let none that wait on thee be ashamed: let them be ashamed which transgress without cause.

Psa.28.4.bsb: Repay them according to their deeds and for their works of evil. Repay them for what their hands have done; bring back on them what they deserve.
Psa.28.4.kjv: Give them according to their deeds, and according to the wickedness of their endeavours: give them after the work of their hands; render to them their desert.

Psa.31.17.bsb: O LORD, let me not be ashamed, for I have called on You. Let the wicked be put to shame; let them lie silent in Sheol.
Psa.31.17.kjv: Let me not be ashamed, O Lord; for I have called upon thee: let the wicked be ashamed, and let them be silent in the grave.

Psa.31.18.bsb: May lying lips be silenced—lips that speak with arrogance against the righteous, full of pride and contempt.
Psa.31.18.kjv: Let the lying lips be put to silence; which speak grievous things proudly and contemptuously against the righteous.

Psa.35.4.bsb: May those who seek my life be disgraced and put to shame; may those who plan to harm me be driven back and confounded.
Psa.35.4.kjv: Let them be confounded and put to shame that seek after my soul: let them be turned back and brought to confusion that devise my hurt.

Psa.35.8.bsb: May ruin befall them by surprise; may the net they hid ensnare them; may they fall into the hazard they created.
Psa.35.8.kjv: Let destruction come upon him at unawares; and let his net that he hath hid catch himself: into that very destruction let him fall.

Psa.35.26.bsb: May those who gloat in my distress be ashamed and confounded; may those who exalt themselves over me be clothed in shame and reproach.
Psa.35.26.kjv: Let them be ashamed and brought to confusion together that rejoice at mine hurt: let them be clothed with shame and dishonour that magnify themselves against me.

Psa.40.14.bsb: May those who seek my life be ashamed and confounded; may those who wish me harm be repelled and humiliated.
Psa.40.14.kjv: Let them be ashamed and confounded together that seek after my soul to destroy it; let them be driven backward and put to shame that wish me evil.

Psa.40.15.bsb: May those who say to me, “Aha, aha!” be appalled at their own shame.
Psa.40.15.kjv: Let them be desolate for a reward of their shame that say unto me, Aha, aha.

Psa.54.5.bsb: He will reward my enemies with evil. In Your faithfulness, destroy them.
Psa.54.5.kjv: He shall reward evil unto mine enemies: cut them off in thy truth.

Psa.55.9.bsb: O Lord, confuse and confound their speech, for I see violence and strife in the city.
Psa.55.9.kjv: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongues: for I have seen violence and strife in the city.

Psa.55.15.bsb: Let death seize them by surprise; let them go down to Sheol alive, for evil is with them in their homes.
Psa.55.15.kjv: Let death seize upon them, and let them go down quick into hell: for wickedness is in their dwellings, and among them.

Psa.56.7.bsb: In spite of such sin, will they escape? In Your anger, O God, cast down the nations.
Psa.56.7.kjv: Shall they escape by iniquity? in thine anger cast down the people, O God.

Psa.58.7.bsb: May they vanish like water that runs off; when they draw the bow, may their arrows be blunted.
Psa.58.7.kjv: Let them melt away as waters which run continually: when he bendeth his bow to shoot his arrows, let them be as cut in pieces.

Psa.59.5.bsb: O LORD God of Hosts, the God of Israel, rouse Yourself to punish all the nations; show no mercy to the wicked traitors. Selah
Psa.59.5.kjv: Thou therefore, O Lord God of hosts, the God of Israel, awake to visit all the heathen: be not merciful to any wicked transgressors. Selah.

Psa.59.11.bsb: Do not kill them, or my people will forget. Scatter them by Your power, and bring them down, O Lord, our shield.
Psa.59.11.kjv: Slay them not, lest my people forget: scatter them by thy power; and bring them down, O Lord our shield.

Psa.59.15.bsb: They scavenge for food, and growl if they are not satisfied.
Psa.59.15.kjv: Let them wander up and down for meat, and grudge if they be not satisfied.

Psa.68.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. A song. God arises. His enemies are scattered, and those who hate Him flee His presence.
Psa.68.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm or Song of David. Let God arise, let his enemies be scattered: let them also that hate him flee before him.

Psa.68.2.bsb: As smoke is blown away, You will drive them out; as wax melts before the fire, the wicked will perish in the presence of God.
Psa.68.2.kjv: As smoke is driven away, so drive them away: as wax melteth before the fire, so let the wicked perish at the presence of God.

Psa.69.23.bsb: May their eyes be darkened so they cannot see, and their backs be bent forever.
Psa.69.23.kjv: Let their eyes be darkened, that they see not; and make their loins continually to shake.

Psa.69.27.bsb: Add iniquity to their iniquity; let them not share in Your righteousness.
Psa.69.27.kjv: Add iniquity unto their iniquity: and let them not come into thy righteousness.

Psa.69.28.bsb: May they be blotted out of the Book of Life and not listed with the righteous.
Psa.69.28.kjv: Let them be blotted out of the book of the living, and not be written with the righteous.

Psa.79.10.bsb: Why should the nations ask, “Where is their God?” Before our eyes, make known among the nations Your vengeance for the bloodshed of Your servants.
Psa.79.10.kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is their God? let him be known among the heathen in our sight by the revenging of the blood of thy servants which is shed.

Psa.79.12.bsb: Pay back into the laps of our neighbors sevenfold the reproach they hurled at You, O Lord.
Psa.79.12.kjv: And render unto our neighbours sevenfold into their bosom their reproach, wherewith they have reproached thee, O Lord.

Psa.83.13.bsb: Make them like tumbleweed, O my God, like chaff before the wind.
Psa.83.13.kjv: O my God, make them like a wheel; as the stubble before the wind.

Psa.83.14.bsb: As fire consumes a forest, as a flame sets the mountains ablaze,
Psa.83.14.kjv: As the fire burneth a wood, and as the flame setteth the mountains on fire;

Psa.83.15.bsb: so pursue them with Your tempest, and terrify them with Your storm.
Psa.83.15.kjv: So persecute them with thy tempest, and make them afraid with thy storm.

Psa.109.7.bsb: When he is tried, let him be found guilty, and may his prayer be regarded as sin.
Psa.109.7.kjv: When he shall be judged, let him be condemned: and let his prayer become sin.

Psa.109.9.bsb: May his children be fatherless and his wife a widow.
Psa.109.9.kjv: Let his children be fatherless, and his wife a widow.

Psa.109.10.bsb: May his children wander as beggars, seeking sustenance far from their ruined homes.
Psa.109.10.kjv: Let his children be continually vagabonds, and beg: let them seek their bread also out of their desolate places.

Psa.109.11.bsb: May the creditor seize all he owns, and strangers plunder the fruits of his labor.
Psa.109.11.kjv: Let the extortioner catch all that he hath; and let the strangers spoil his labour.

Psa.109.12.bsb: May there be no one to extend kindness to him, and no one to favor his fatherless children.
Psa.109.12.kjv: Let there be none to extend mercy unto him: neither let there be any to favour his fatherless children.

Psa.109.13.bsb: May his descendants be cut off; may their name be blotted out from the next generation.
Psa.109.13.kjv: Let his posterity be cut off; and in the generation following let their name be blotted out.

Psa.109.14.bsb: May the iniquity of his fathers be remembered before the LORD, and the sin of his mother never be blotted out.
Psa.109.14.kjv: Let the iniquity of his fathers be remembered with the Lord; and let not the sin of his mother be blotted out.

Psa.109.15.bsb: May their sins always remain before the LORD, that He may cut off their memory from the earth.
Psa.109.15.kjv: Let them be before the Lord continually, that he may cut off the memory of them from the earth.

Psa.109.19.bsb: May it be like a robe wrapped about him, like a belt tied forever around him.
Psa.109.19.kjv: Let it be unto him as the garment which covereth him, and for a girdle wherewith he is girded continually.

Psa.109.20.bsb: May this be the LORD’s reward to my accusers, to those who speak evil against me.
Psa.109.20.kjv: Let this be the reward of mine adversaries from the Lord, and of them that speak evil against my soul.

Psa.109.28.bsb: Though they curse, You will bless. When they rise up, they will be put to shame, but Your servant will rejoice.
Psa.109.28.kjv: Let them curse, but bless thou: when they arise, let them be ashamed; but let thy servant rejoice.

Psa.109.29.bsb: May my accusers be clothed with disgrace; may they wear their shame like a robe.
Psa.109.29.kjv: Let mine adversaries be clothed with shame, and let them cover themselves with their own confusion, as with a mantle.

Psa.119.84.bsb: How many days must Your servant wait? When will You execute judgment on my persecutors?
Psa.119.84.kjv: How many are the days of thy servant? when wilt thou execute judgment on them that persecute me?

Psa.140.9.bsb: May the heads of those who surround me be covered in the trouble their lips have caused.
Psa.140.9.kjv: As for the head of those that compass me about, let the mischief of their own lips cover them.

Psa.140.10.bsb: May burning coals fall on them; may they be thrown into the fire, into the miry pits, never to rise again.
Psa.140.10.kjv: Let burning coals fall upon them: let them be cast into the fire; into deep pits, that they rise not up again.

Psa.143.12.bsb: And in Your loving devotion, cut off my enemies. Destroy all who afflict me, for I am Your servant.
Psa.143.12.kjv: And of thy mercy cut off mine enemies, and destroy all them that afflict my soul: for I am thy servant.

Psa.144.6.bsb: Flash forth Your lightning and scatter them; shoot Your arrows and rout them.
Psa.144.6.kjv: Cast forth lightning, and scatter them: shoot out thine arrows, and destroy them.

Psa.37.4.bsb: Delight yourself in the LORD, and He will give you the desires of your heart.
Psa.37.4.kjv: Delight thyself also in the Lord; and he shall give thee the desires of thine heart.

Psa.38.15.bsb: I wait for You, O LORD; You will answer, O Lord my God.
Psa.38.15.kjv: For in thee, O Lord, do I hope: thou wilt hear, O Lord my God.

Psa.50.14.bsb: Sacrifice a thank offering to God, and fulfill your vows to the Most High.
Psa.50.14.kjv: Offer unto God thanksgiving; and pay thy vows unto the most High:

Psa.69.33.bsb: For the LORD listens to the needy and does not despise His captive people.
Psa.69.33.kjv: For the Lord heareth the poor, and despiseth not his prisoners.

Psa.81.10.bsb: I am the LORD your God, who brought you up out of Egypt. Open wide your mouth, and I will fill it.
Psa.81.10.kjv: I am the Lord thy God, which brought thee out of the land of Egypt: open thy mouth wide, and I will fill it.

Psa.86.6.bsb: Hear my prayer, O LORD, and attend to my plea for mercy.
Psa.86.6.kjv: Give ear, O Lord, unto my prayer; and attend to the voice of my supplications.

Psa.102.17.bsb: He will turn toward the prayer of the destitute; He will not despise their prayer.
Psa.102.17.kjv: He will regard the prayer of the destitute, and not despise their prayer.

Psa.3.4.bsb: To the LORD I cry aloud, and He answers me from His holy mountain. Selah
Psa.3.4.kjv: I cried unto the Lord with my voice, and he heard me out of his holy hill. Selah.

Psa.21.2.bsb: You have granted his heart’s desire and have not withheld the request of his lips. Selah
Psa.21.2.kjv: Thou hast given him his heart’s desire, and hast not withholden the request of his lips. Selah.

Psa.22.24.bsb: For He has not despised or detested the torment of the afflicted. He has not hidden His face from him, but has attended to his cry for help.
Psa.22.24.kjv: For he hath not despised nor abhorred the affliction of the afflicted; neither hath he hid his face from him; but when he cried unto him, he heard.

Psa.30.2.bsb: O LORD my God, I cried to You for help, and You healed me.
Psa.30.2.kjv: O Lord my God, I cried unto thee, and thou hast healed me.

Psa.30.3.bsb: O LORD, You pulled me up from Sheol; You spared me from descending into the Pit.
Psa.30.3.kjv: O Lord, thou hast brought up my soul from the grave: thou hast kept me alive, that I should not go down to the pit.

Psa.31.22.bsb: In my alarm I said, “I am cut off from Your sight!” But You heard my plea for mercy when I called to You for help.
Psa.31.22.kjv: For I said in my haste, I am cut off from before thine eyes: nevertheless thou heardest the voice of my supplications when I cried unto thee.

Psa.66.19.bsb: But God has surely heard; He has attended to the sound of my prayer.
Psa.66.19.kjv: But verily God hath heard me; he hath attended to the voice of my prayer.

Psa.77.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. According to Jeduthun. A Psalm of Asaph. I cried out to God; I cried aloud to God to hear me.
Psa.77.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, to Jeduthun, A Psalm of Asaph. I cried unto God with my voice, even unto God with my voice; and he gave ear unto me.

Psa.77.2.bsb: In the day of trouble I sought the Lord; through the night my outstretched hands did not grow weary; my soul refused to be comforted.
Psa.77.2.kjv: In the day of my trouble I sought the Lord: my sore ran in the night, and ceased not: my soul refused to be comforted.

Psa.81.7.bsb: You called out in distress, and I rescued you; I answered you from the cloud of thunder; I tested you at the waters of Meribah. Selah
Psa.81.7.kjv: Thou calledst in trouble, and I delivered thee; I answered thee in the secret place of thunder: I proved thee at the waters of Meribah. Selah.

Psa.119.26.bsb: I recounted my ways, and You answered me; teach me Your statutes.
Psa.119.26.kjv: I have declared my ways, and thou heardest me: teach me thy statutes.

Psa.120.1.bsb: A song of ascents. In my distress I cried to the LORD, and He answered me.
Psa.120.1.kjv: A Song of degrees. In my distress I cried unto the Lord, and he heard me.

Psa.31.10.bsb: For my life is consumed with grief and my years with groaning; my iniquity has drained my strength, and my bones are wasting away.
Psa.31.10.kjv: For my life is spent with grief, and my years with sighing: my strength faileth because of mine iniquity, and my bones are consumed.

Psa.32.3.bsb: When I kept silent, my bones became brittle from my groaning all day long.
Psa.32.3.kjv: When I kept silence, my bones waxed old through my roaring all the day long.

Psa.38.4.bsb: For my iniquities have overwhelmed me; they are a burden too heavy to bear.
Psa.38.4.kjv: For mine iniquities are gone over mine head: as an heavy burden they are too heavy for me.

Psa.38.5.bsb: My wounds are foul and festering because of my sinful folly.
Psa.38.5.kjv: My wounds stink and are corrupt because of my foolishness.

Psa.38.6.bsb: I am bent and brought low; all day long I go about mourning.
Psa.38.6.kjv: I am troubled; I am bowed down greatly; I go mourning all the day long.

Psa.38.7.bsb: For my loins are full of burning pain, and no soundness remains in my body.
Psa.38.7.kjv: For my loins are filled with a loathsome disease: and there is no soundness in my flesh.

Psa.38.8.bsb: I am numb and badly crushed; I groan in anguish of heart.
Psa.38.8.kjv: I am feeble and sore broken: I have roared by reason of the disquietness of my heart.

Psa.38.10.bsb: My heart pounds, my strength fails, and even the light of my eyes has faded.
Psa.38.10.kjv: My heart panteth, my strength faileth me: as for the light of mine eyes, it also is gone from me.

Psa.38.18.bsb: Yes, I confess my iniquity; I am troubled by my sin.
Psa.38.18.kjv: For I will declare mine iniquity; I will be sorry for my sin.

Psa.69.5.bsb: You know my folly, O God, and my guilt is not hidden from You.
Psa.69.5.kjv: O God, thou knowest my foolishness; and my sins are not hid from thee.

Psa.106.6.bsb: We have sinned like our fathers; we have done wrong and acted wickedly.
Psa.106.6.kjv: We have sinned with our fathers, we have committed iniquity, we have done wickedly.

Psa.106.7.bsb: Our fathers in Egypt did not grasp Your wonders or remember Your abundant kindness; but they rebelled by the sea, there at the Red Sea.
Psa.106.7.kjv: Our fathers understood not thy wonders in Egypt; they remembered not the multitude of thy mercies; but provoked him at the sea, even at the Red sea.

Psa.119.176.bsb: I have strayed like a lost sheep; seek Your servant, for I have not forgotten Your commandments.
Psa.119.176.kjv: I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant; for I do not forget thy commandments.

Psa.22.19.bsb: But You, O LORD, be not far off; O my Strength, come quickly to help me.
Psa.22.19.kjv: But be not thou far from me, O Lord: O my strength, haste thee to help me.

Psa.28.1.bsb: Of David. To You, O LORD, I call; be not deaf to me, O my Rock. For if You remain silent, I will be like those descending to the Pit.
Psa.28.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. Unto thee will I cry, O Lord my rock; be not silent to me: lest, if thou be silent to me, I become like them that go down into the pit.

Psa.35.22.bsb: O LORD, You have seen it; be not silent. O Lord, be not far from me.
Psa.35.22.kjv: This thou hast seen, O Lord: keep not silence: O Lord, be not far from me.

Psa.35.23.bsb: Awake and rise to my defense, to my cause, my God and my Lord!
Psa.35.23.kjv: Stir up thyself, and awake to my judgment, even unto my cause, my God and my Lord.

Psa.86.3.bsb: Be merciful to me, O Lord, for I call to You all day long.
Psa.86.3.kjv: Be merciful unto me, O Lord: for I cry unto thee daily.

Psa.88.2.bsb: May my prayer come before You; incline Your ear to my cry.
Psa.88.2.kjv: Let my prayer come before thee: incline thine ear unto my cry;

Psa.102.1.bsb: A prayer of one who is afflicted, when he grows faint and pours out his lament before the LORD. Hear my prayer, O LORD; let my cry for help come before You.
Psa.102.1.kjv: A Prayer of the afflicted, when he is overwhelmed, and poureth out his complaint before the Lord. Hear my prayer, O Lord, and let my cry come unto thee.

Psa.119.146.bsb: I call to You; save me, that I may keep Your testimonies.
Psa.119.146.kjv: I cried unto thee; save me, and I shall keep thy testimonies.

Psa.130.1.bsb: A song of ascents. Out of the depths I cry to You, O LORD!
Psa.130.1.kjv: A Song of degrees. Out of the depths have I cried unto thee, O Lord.

Psa.130.2.bsb: O Lord, hear my voice; let Your ears be attentive to my plea for mercy.
Psa.130.2.kjv: Lord, hear my voice: let thine ears be attentive to the voice of my supplications.

Psa.141.1.bsb: A Psalm of David. I call upon You, O LORD; come quickly to me. Hear my voice when I call to You.
Psa.141.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. Lord, I cry unto thee: make haste unto me; give ear unto my voice, when I cry unto thee.

Psa.141.2.bsb: May my prayer be set before You like incense; my uplifted hands, like the evening offering.
Psa.141.2.kjv: Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense; and the lifting up of my hands as the evening sacrifice.

Psa.142.2.bsb: I pour out my complaint before Him; I reveal my trouble to Him.
Psa.142.2.kjv: I poured out my complaint before him; I shewed before him my trouble.

Psa.9.19.bsb: Rise up, O LORD, do not let man prevail; let the nations be judged in Your presence.
Psa.9.19.kjv: Arise, O Lord; let not man prevail: let the heathen be judged in thy sight.

Psa.27.9.bsb: Hide not Your face from me, nor turn away Your servant in anger. You have been my helper; do not leave me or forsake me, O God of my salvation.
Psa.27.9.kjv: Hide not thy face far from me; put not thy servant away in anger: thou hast been my help; leave me not, neither forsake me, O God of my salvation.

Psa.69.6.bsb: May those who hope in You not be ashamed through me, O Lord GOD of Hosts; may those who seek You not be dishonored through me, O God of Israel.
Psa.69.6.kjv: Let not them that wait on thee, O Lord God of hosts, be ashamed for my sake: let not those that seek thee be confounded for my sake, O God of Israel.

Psa.69.13.bsb: But my prayer to You, O LORD, is for a time of favor. In Your abundant loving devotion, O God, answer me with Your sure salvation.
Psa.69.13.kjv: But as for me, my prayer is unto thee, O Lord, in an acceptable time: O God, in the multitude of thy mercy hear me, in the truth of thy salvation.

Psa.74.10.bsb: How long, O God, will the enemy taunt You? Will the foe revile Your name forever?
Psa.74.10.kjv: O God, how long shall the adversary reproach? shall the enemy blaspheme thy name for ever?

Psa.74.11.bsb: Why do You withdraw Your strong right hand? Stretch it out to destroy them!
Psa.74.11.kjv: Why withdrawest thou thy hand, even thy right hand? pluck it out of thy bosom.

Psa.74.21.bsb: Do not let the oppressed retreat in shame; may the poor and needy praise Your name.
Psa.74.21.kjv: O let not the oppressed return ashamed: let the poor and needy praise thy name.

Psa.74.22.bsb: Rise up, O God; defend Your cause! Remember how the fool mocks You all day long.
Psa.74.22.kjv: Arise, O God, plead thine own cause: remember how the foolish man reproacheth thee daily.

Psa.74.23.bsb: Do not disregard the clamor of Your adversaries, the uproar of Your enemies that ascends continually.
Psa.74.23.kjv: Forget not the voice of thine enemies: the tumult of those that rise up against thee increaseth continually.

Psa.83.1.bsb: A song. A Psalm of Asaph. O God, be not silent; be not speechless; be not still, O God.
Psa.83.1.kjv: A Song or Psalm of Asaph. Keep not thou silence, O God: hold not thy peace, and be not still, O God.

Psa.86.1.bsb: A prayer of David. Incline Your ear, O LORD, and answer me, for I am poor and needy.
Psa.86.1.kjv: A Prayer of David. Bow down thine ear, O Lord, hear me: for I am poor and needy.

Psa.86.4.bsb: Bring joy to Your servant, for to You, O Lord, I lift up my soul.
Psa.86.4.kjv: Rejoice the soul of thy servant: for unto thee, O Lord, do I lift up my soul.

Psa.86.17.bsb: Show me a sign of Your goodness, that my enemies may see and be ashamed; for You, O LORD, have helped me and comforted me.
Psa.86.17.kjv: Shew me a token for good; that they which hate me may see it, and be ashamed: because thou, Lord, hast holpen me, and comforted me.

Psa.89.49.bsb: Where, O Lord, is Your loving devotion of old, which You faithfully swore to David?
Psa.89.49.kjv: Lord, where are thy former lovingkindnesses, which thou swarest unto David in thy truth?

Psa.89.50.bsb: Remember, O Lord, the reproach of Your servants, which I bear in my heart from so many people—
Psa.89.50.kjv: Remember, Lord, the reproach of thy servants; how I do bear in my bosom the reproach of all the mighty people;

Psa.89.51.bsb: how Your enemies have taunted, O LORD, and have mocked every step of Your anointed one!
Psa.89.51.kjv: Wherewith thine enemies have reproached, O Lord; wherewith they have reproached the footsteps of thine anointed.

Psa.106.47.bsb: Save us, O LORD our God, and gather us from the nations, that we may give thanks to Your holy name, that we may glory in Your praise.
Psa.106.47.kjv: Save us, O Lord our God, and gather us from among the heathen, to give thanks unto thy holy name, and to triumph in thy praise.

Psa.109.21.bsb: But You, O GOD, the Lord, deal kindly with me for the sake of Your name; deliver me by the goodness of Your loving devotion.
Psa.109.21.kjv: But do thou for me, O God the Lord, for thy name’s sake: because thy mercy is good, deliver thou me.

Psa.109.22.bsb: For I am poor and needy; my heart is wounded within me.
Psa.109.22.kjv: For I am poor and needy, and my heart is wounded within me.

Psa.109.23.bsb: I am fading away like a lengthening shadow; I am shaken off like a locust.
Psa.109.23.kjv: I am gone like the shadow when it declineth: I am tossed up and down as the locust.

Psa.109.24.bsb: My knees are weak from fasting, and my body grows lean and gaunt.
Psa.109.24.kjv: My knees are weak through fasting; and my flesh faileth of fatness.

Psa.109.26.bsb: Help me, O LORD my God; save me according to Your loving devotion.
Psa.109.26.kjv: Help me, O Lord my God: O save me according to thy mercy:

Psa.109.27.bsb: Let them know that this is Your hand, that You, O LORD, have done it.
Psa.109.27.kjv: That they may know that this is thy hand; that thou, Lord, hast done it.

Psa.115.1.bsb: Not to us, O LORD, not to us, but to Your name be the glory, because of Your loving devotion, because of Your faithfulness.
Psa.115.1.kjv: Not unto us, O Lord, not unto us, but unto thy name give glory, for thy mercy, and for thy truth’s sake.

Psa.115.2.bsb: Why should the nations say, “Where is their God?”
Psa.115.2.kjv: Wherefore should the heathen say, Where is now their God?

Psa.119.38.bsb: Establish Your word to Your servant, to produce reverence for You.
Psa.119.38.kjv: Stablish thy word unto thy servant, who is devoted to thy fear.

Psa.119.94.bsb: I am Yours; save me, for I have sought Your precepts.
Psa.119.94.kjv: I am thine, save me; for I have sought thy precepts.

Psa.119.116.bsb: Sustain me as You promised, that I may live; let me not be ashamed of my hope.
Psa.119.116.kjv: Uphold me according unto thy word, that I may live: and let me not be ashamed of my hope.

Psa.119.124.bsb: Deal with Your servant according to Your loving devotion, and teach me Your statutes.
Psa.119.124.kjv: Deal with thy servant according unto thy mercy, and teach me thy statutes.

Psa.119.149.bsb: Hear my voice, O LORD, according to Your loving devotion; give me life according to Your justice.
Psa.119.149.kjv: Hear my voice according unto thy lovingkindness: O Lord, quicken me according to thy judgment.

Psa.119.153.bsb: Look upon my affliction and rescue me, for I have not forgotten Your law.
Psa.119.153.kjv: ר RESH. Consider mine affliction, and deliver me: for I do not forget thy law.

Psa.119.173.bsb: May Your hand be ready to help me, for I have chosen Your precepts.
Psa.119.173.kjv: Let thine hand help me; for I have chosen thy precepts.

Psa.119.174.bsb: I long for Your salvation, O LORD, and Your law is my delight.
Psa.119.174.kjv: I have longed for thy salvation, O Lord; and thy law is my delight.

Psa.69.25.bsb: May their place be deserted; let there be no one to dwell in their tents.
Psa.69.25.kjv: Let their habitation be desolate; and let none dwell in their tents.

Psa.109.8.bsb: May his days be few; may another take his position.
Psa.109.8.kjv: Let his days be few; and let another take his office.

Psa.95.8.bsb: do not harden your hearts as you did at Meribah, in the day at Massah in the wilderness,
Psa.95.8.kjv: Harden not your heart, as in the provocation, and as in the day of temptation in the wilderness:

Psa.95.9.bsb: where your fathers tested and tried Me, though they had seen My work.
Psa.95.9.kjv: When your fathers tempted me, proved me, and saw my work.

Psa.95.11.bsb: So I swore on oath in My anger, “They shall never enter My rest.”
Psa.95.11.kjv: Unto whom I sware in my wrath that they should not enter into my rest.

Psa.118.25.bsb: O LORD, save us, we pray. We beseech You, O LORD, cause us to prosper!
Psa.118.25.kjv: Save now, I beseech thee, O Lord: O Lord, I beseech thee, send now prosperity.

Psa.103.7.bsb: He made known His ways to Moses, His deeds to the people of Israel.
Psa.103.7.kjv: He made known his ways unto Moses, his acts unto the children of Israel.

Psa.19.5.bsb: Like a bridegroom emerging from his chamber, like a champion rejoicing to run his course,
Psa.19.5.kjv: Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race.

Psa.19.6.bsb: it rises at one end of the heavens and runs its circuit to the other; nothing is deprived of its warmth.
Psa.19.6.kjv: His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof.

Psa.34.18.bsb: The LORD is near to the brokenhearted; He saves the contrite in spirit.
Psa.34.18.kjv: The Lord is nigh unto them that are of a broken heart; and saveth such as be of a contrite spirit.

Psa.38.3.bsb: There is no soundness in my body because of Your anger; there is no rest in my bones because of my sin.
Psa.38.3.kjv: There is no soundness in my flesh because of thine anger; neither is there any rest in my bones because of my sin.

Psa.41.4.bsb: I said, “O LORD, be gracious to me; heal me, for I have sinned against You.”
Psa.41.4.kjv: I said, Lord, be merciful unto me: heal my soul; for I have sinned against thee.

Psa.119.59.bsb: I considered my ways and turned my steps to Your testimonies.
Psa.119.59.kjv: I thought on my ways, and turned my feet unto thy testimonies.

Psa.68.13.bsb: Though you lie down among the sheepfolds, the wings of the dove are covered with silver, and her feathers with shimmering gold.”
Psa.68.13.kjv: Though ye have lien among the pots, yet shall ye be as the wings of a dove covered with silver, and her feathers with yellow gold.

Psa.1.3.bsb: He is like a tree planted by streams of water, yielding its fruit in season, whose leaf does not wither, and who prospers in all he does.
Psa.1.3.kjv: And he shall be like a tree planted by the rivers of water, that bringeth forth his fruit in his season; his leaf also shall not wither; and whatsoever he doeth shall prosper.

Psa.92.12.bsb: The righteous will flourish like a palm tree, and grow like a cedar in Lebanon.
Psa.92.12.kjv: The righteous shall flourish like the palm tree: he shall grow like a cedar in Lebanon.

Psa.1.1.bsb: Blessed is the man who does not walk in the counsel of the wicked, or set foot on the path of sinners, or sit in the seat of mockers.
Psa.1.1.kjv: Blessed is the man that walketh not in the counsel of the ungodly, nor standeth in the way of sinners, nor sitteth in the seat of the scornful.

Psa.1.2.bsb: But his delight is in the Law of the LORD, and on His law he meditates day and night.
Psa.1.2.kjv: But his delight is in the law of the Lord; and in his law doth he meditate day and night.

Psa.15.4.bsb: who despises the vile but honors those who fear the LORD, who does not revise a costly oath,
Psa.15.4.kjv: In whose eyes a vile person is contemned; but he honoureth them that fear the Lord. He that sweareth to his own hurt, and changeth not.

Psa.15.5.bsb: who lends his money without interest and refuses a bribe against the innocent. He who does these things will never be shaken.
Psa.15.5.kjv: He that putteth not out his money to usury, nor taketh reward against the innocent. He that doeth these things shall never be moved.

Psa.37.30.bsb: The mouth of the righteous man utters wisdom, and his tongue speaks justice.
Psa.37.30.kjv: The mouth of the righteous speaketh wisdom, and his tongue talketh of judgment.

Psa.37.31.bsb: The law of his God is in his heart; his steps do not falter.
Psa.37.31.kjv: The law of his God is in his heart; none of his steps shall slide.

Psa.112.1.bsb: Hallelujah! Blessed is the man who fears the LORD, who greatly delights in His commandments.
Psa.112.1.kjv: Praise ye the Lord. Blessed is the man that feareth the Lord, that delighteth greatly in his commandments.

Psa.112.6.bsb: Surely he will never be shaken; the righteous man will be remembered forever.
Psa.112.6.kjv: Surely he shall not be moved for ever: the righteous shall be in everlasting remembrance.

Psa.119.1.bsb: Blessed are those whose way is blameless, who walk in the Law of the LORD.
Psa.119.1.kjv: א ALEPH. Blessed are the undefiled in the way, who walk in the law of the Lord.

Psa.119.2.bsb: Blessed are those who keep His testimonies and seek Him with all their heart.
Psa.119.2.kjv: Blessed are they that keep his testimonies, and that seek him with the whole heart.

Psa.119.3.bsb: They do no iniquity; they walk in His ways.
Psa.119.3.kjv: They also do no iniquity: they walk in his ways.

Psa.25.11.bsb: For the sake of Your name, O LORD, forgive my iniquity, for it is great.
Psa.25.11.kjv: For thy name’s sake, O Lord, pardon mine iniquity; for it is great.

Psa.25.13.bsb: His soul will dwell in prosperity, and his descendants will inherit the land.
Psa.25.13.kjv: His soul shall dwell at ease; and his seed shall inherit the earth.

Psa.29.11.bsb: The LORD gives His people strength; the LORD blesses His people with peace.
Psa.29.11.kjv: The Lord will give strength unto his people; the Lord will bless his people with peace.

Psa.37.29.bsb: The righteous will inherit the land and dwell in it forever.
Psa.37.29.kjv: The righteous shall inherit the land, and dwell therein for ever.

Psa.97.11.bsb: Light shines on the righteous, gladness on the upright in heart.
Psa.97.11.kjv: Light is sown for the righteous, and gladness for the upright in heart.

Psa.128.1.bsb: A song of ascents. Blessed are all who fear the LORD, who walk in His ways!
Psa.128.1.kjv: A Song of degrees. Blessed is every one that feareth the Lord; that walketh in his ways.

Psa.17.2.bsb: May my vindication come from Your presence; may Your eyes see what is right.
Psa.17.2.kjv: Let my sentence come forth from thy presence; let thine eyes behold the things that are equal.

Psa.24.6.bsb: Such is the generation of those who seek Him, who seek Your face, O God of Jacob. Selah
Psa.24.6.kjv: This is the generation of them that seek him, that seek thy face, O Jacob. Selah.

Psa.40.2.bsb: He lifted me up from the pit of despair, out of the miry clay; He set my feet upon a rock, and made my footsteps firm.
Psa.40.2.kjv: He brought me up also out of an horrible pit, out of the miry clay, and set my feet upon a rock, and established my goings.

Psa.42.2.bsb: My soul thirsts for God, the living God. When shall I come and appear in God’s presence?
Psa.42.2.kjv: My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God: when shall I come and appear before God?

Psa.42.3.bsb: My tears have been my food both day and night, while men ask me all day long, “Where is your God?”
Psa.42.3.kjv: My tears have been my meat day and night, while they continually say unto me, Where is thy God?

Psa.63.1.bsb: A Psalm of David, when he was in the Wilderness of Judah. O God, You are my God. Earnestly I seek You; my soul thirsts for You. My body yearns for You in a dry and weary land without water.
Psa.63.1.kjv: A Psalm of David, when he was in the wilderness of Judah. O God, thou art my God; early will I seek thee: my soul thirsteth for thee, my flesh longeth for thee in a dry and thirsty land, where no water is;

Psa.63.8.bsb: My soul clings to You; Your right hand upholds me.
Psa.63.8.kjv: My soul followeth hard after thee: thy right hand upholdeth me.

Psa.69.32.bsb: The humble will see and rejoice. You who seek God, let your hearts be revived!
Psa.69.32.kjv: The humble shall see this, and be glad: and your heart shall live that seek God.

Psa.77.3.bsb: I remembered You, O God, and I groaned; I mused and my spirit grew faint. Selah
Psa.77.3.kjv: I remembered God, and was troubled: I complained, and my spirit was overwhelmed. Selah.

Psa.77.4.bsb: You have kept my eyes from closing; I am too troubled to speak.
Psa.77.4.kjv: Thou holdest mine eyes waking: I am so troubled that I cannot speak.

Psa.77.5.bsb: I considered the days of old, the years long in the past.
Psa.77.5.kjv: I have considered the days of old, the years of ancient times.

Psa.77.6.bsb: At night I remembered my song; in my heart I mused, and my spirit pondered:
Psa.77.6.kjv: I call to remembrance my song in the night: I commune with mine own heart: and my spirit made diligent search.

Psa.77.7.bsb: “Will the Lord spurn us forever and never show His favor again?
Psa.77.7.kjv: Will the Lord cast off for ever? and will he be favourable no more?

Psa.77.8.bsb: Is His loving devotion gone forever? Has His promise failed for all time?
Psa.77.8.kjv: Is his mercy clean gone for ever? doth his promise fail for evermore?

Psa.77.9.bsb: Has God forgotten to be gracious? Has His anger shut off His compassion?” Selah
Psa.77.9.kjv: Hath God forgotten to be gracious? hath he in anger shut up his tender mercies? Selah.

Psa.119.10.bsb: With all my heart I have sought You; do not let me stray from Your commandments.
Psa.119.10.kjv: With my whole heart have I sought thee: O let me not wander from thy commandments.

Psa.143.6.bsb: I stretch out my hands to You; my soul thirsts for You like a parched land. Selah
Psa.143.6.kjv: I stretch forth my hands unto thee: my soul thirsteth after thee, as a thirsty land. Selah.

Psa.116.16.bsb: Truly, O LORD, I am Your servant; I am Your servant, the son of Your maidservant; You have broken my bonds.
Psa.116.16.kjv: O Lord, truly I am thy servant; I am thy servant, and the son of thine handmaid: thou hast loosed my bonds.

Psa.123.2.bsb: As the eyes of servants look to the hand of their master, as the eyes of a maidservant look to the hand of her mistress, so our eyes are on the LORD our God until He shows us mercy.
Psa.123.2.kjv: Behold, as the eyes of servants look unto the hand of their masters, and as the eyes of a maiden unto the hand of her mistress; so our eyes wait upon the Lord our God, until that he have mercy upon us.

Psa.119.113.bsb: The double-minded I despise, but Your law I love.
Psa.119.113.kjv: ס SAMECH. I hate vain thoughts: but thy law do I love.

Psa.19.12.bsb: Who can discern his own errors? Cleanse me from my hidden faults.
Psa.19.12.kjv: Who can understand his errors? cleanse thou me from secret faults.

Psa.40.11.bsb: O LORD, do not withhold Your mercy from me; Your loving devotion and faithfulness will always guard me.
Psa.40.11.kjv: Withhold not thou thy tender mercies from me, O Lord: let thy lovingkindness and thy truth continually preserve me.

Psa.119.60.bsb: I hurried without hesitating to keep Your commandments.
Psa.119.60.kjv: I made haste, and delayed not to keep thy commandments.

Psa.21.10.bsb: You will wipe their descendants from the earth, and their offspring from the sons of men.
Psa.21.10.kjv: Their fruit shalt thou destroy from the earth, and their seed from among the children of men.

Psa.25.7.bsb: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my rebellious acts; remember me according to Your loving devotion, because of Your goodness, O LORD.
Psa.25.7.kjv: Remember not the sins of my youth, nor my transgressions: according to thy mercy remember thou me for thy goodness’ sake, O Lord.

Psa.25.18.bsb: Consider my affliction and trouble, and take away all my sins.
Psa.25.18.kjv: Look upon mine affliction and my pain; and forgive all my sins.

Psa.9.15.bsb: The nations have fallen into a pit of their making; their feet are caught in the net they have hidden.
Psa.9.15.kjv: The heathen are sunk down in the pit that they made: in the net which they hid is their own foot taken.

Psa.94.23.bsb: He will bring upon them their own iniquity and destroy them for their wickedness. The LORD our God will destroy them.
Psa.94.23.kjv: And he shall bring upon them their own iniquity, and shall cut them off in their own wickedness; yea, the Lord our God shall cut them off.

Psa.141.10.bsb: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, while I pass by in safety.
Psa.141.10.kjv: Let the wicked fall into their own nets, whilst that I withal escape.

Psa.5.4.bsb: For You are not a God who delights in wickedness; no evil can dwell with You.
Psa.5.4.kjv: For thou art not a God that hath pleasure in wickedness: neither shall evil dwell with thee.

Psa.5.5.bsb: The boastful cannot stand in Your presence; You hate all workers of iniquity.
Psa.5.5.kjv: The foolish shall not stand in thy sight: thou hatest all workers of iniquity.

Psa.5.6.bsb: You destroy those who tell lies; the LORD abhors the man of bloodshed and deceit.
Psa.5.6.kjv: Thou shalt destroy them that speak leasing: the Lord will abhor the bloody and deceitful man.

Psa.10.3.bsb: For the wicked man boasts in the cravings of his heart; he blesses the greedy and reviles the LORD.
Psa.10.3.kjv: For the wicked boasteth of his heart’s desire, and blesseth the covetous, whom the Lord abhorreth.

Psa.26.5.bsb: I hate the mob of evildoers, and refuse to sit with the wicked.
Psa.26.5.kjv: I have hated the congregation of evil doers; and will not sit with the wicked.

Psa.26.9.bsb: Do not take my soul away with sinners, or my life with men of bloodshed,
Psa.26.9.kjv: Gather not my soul with sinners, nor my life with bloody men:

Psa.101.3.bsb: I will set no worthless thing before my eyes. I hate the work of those who fall away; it shall not cling to me.
Psa.101.3.kjv: I will set no wicked thing before mine eyes: I hate the work of them that turn aside; it shall not cleave to me.

Psa.101.4.bsb: A perverse heart shall depart from me; I will know nothing of evil.
Psa.101.4.kjv: A froward heart shall depart from me: I will not know a wicked person.

Psa.119.104.bsb: I gain understanding from Your precepts; therefore I hate every false way.
Psa.119.104.kjv: Through thy precepts I get understanding: therefore I hate every false way.

Psa.119.128.bsb: Therefore I admire all Your precepts and hate every false way.
Psa.119.128.kjv: Therefore I esteem all thy precepts concerning all things to be right; and I hate every false way.

Psa.119.163.bsb: I hate and abhor falsehood, but Your law I love.
Psa.119.163.kjv: I hate and abhor lying: but thy law do I love.

Psa.120.2.bsb: Deliver my soul, O LORD, from lying lips and a deceitful tongue.
Psa.120.2.kjv: Deliver my soul, O Lord, from lying lips, and from a deceitful tongue.

Psa.120.5.bsb: Woe to me that I dwell in Meshech, that I live among the tents of Kedar!
Psa.120.5.kjv: Woe is me, that I sojourn in Mesech, that I dwell in the tents of Kedar!

Psa.120.6.bsb: Too long have I dwelt among those who hate peace.
Psa.120.6.kjv: My soul hath long dwelt with him that hateth peace.

Psa.120.7.bsb: I am in favor of peace; but when I speak, they want war.
Psa.120.7.kjv: I am for peace: but when I speak, they are for war.

Psa.18.49.bsb: Therefore I will praise You, O LORD, among the nations; I will sing praises to Your name.
Psa.18.49.kjv: Therefore will I give thanks unto thee, O Lord, among the heathen, and sing praises unto thy name.

Psa.30.12.bsb: that my heart may sing Your praises and not be silent. O LORD my God, I will give thanks forever.
Psa.30.12.kjv: To the end that my glory may sing praise to thee, and not be silent. O Lord my God, I will give thanks unto thee for ever.

Psa.9.2.bsb: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
Psa.9.2.kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.

Psa.13.6.bsb: I will sing to the LORD, for He has been good to me.
Psa.13.6.kjv: I will sing unto the Lord, because he hath dealt bountifully with me.

Psa.30.1.bsb: A Psalm. A song for the dedication of the temple. Of David. I will exalt You, O LORD, for You have lifted me up and have not allowed my foes to rejoice over me.
Psa.30.1.kjv: A Psalm and Song at the dedication of the house of David. I will extol thee, O Lord; for thou hast lifted me up, and hast not made my foes to rejoice over me.

Psa.30.11.bsb: You turned my mourning into dancing; You peeled off my sackcloth and clothed me with joy,
Psa.30.11.kjv: Thou hast turned for me my mourning into dancing: thou hast put off my sackcloth, and girded me with gladness;

Psa.35.9.bsb: Then my soul will rejoice in the LORD and exult in His salvation.
Psa.35.9.kjv: And my soul shall be joyful in the Lord: it shall rejoice in his salvation.

Psa.44.7.bsb: For You save us from our enemies; You put those who hate us to shame.
Psa.44.7.kjv: But thou hast saved us from our enemies, and hast put them to shame that hated us.

Psa.54.6.bsb: Freely I will sacrifice to You; I will praise Your name, O LORD, for it is good.
Psa.54.6.kjv: I will freely sacrifice unto thee: I will praise thy name, O Lord; for it is good.

Psa.54.7.bsb: For He has delivered me from every trouble, and my eyes have looked in triumph on my foes.
Psa.54.7.kjv: For he hath delivered me out of all trouble: and mine eye hath seen his desire upon mine enemies.

Psa.59.16.bsb: But I will sing of Your strength and proclaim Your loving devotion in the morning. For You are my fortress, my refuge in times of trouble.
Psa.59.16.kjv: But I will sing of thy power; yea, I will sing aloud of thy mercy in the morning: for thou hast been my defence and refuge in the day of my trouble.

Psa.66.12.bsb: You let men ride over our heads; we went through fire and water, but You brought us into abundance.
Psa.66.12.kjv: Thou hast caused men to ride over our heads; we went through fire and through water: but thou broughtest us out into a wealthy place.

Psa.66.13.bsb: I will enter Your house with burnt offerings; I will fulfill my vows to You—
Psa.66.13.kjv: I will go into thy house with burnt offerings: I will pay thee my vows,

Psa.66.14.bsb: the vows that my lips promised and my mouth spoke in my distress.
Psa.66.14.kjv: Which my lips have uttered, and my mouth hath spoken, when I was in trouble.

Psa.66.15.bsb: I will offer You fatlings as burnt offerings, with the fragrant smoke of rams; I will offer bulls and goats. Selah
Psa.66.15.kjv: I will offer unto thee burnt sacrifices of fatlings, with the incense of rams; I will offer bullocks with goats. Selah.

Psa.66.16.bsb: Come and listen, all you who fear God, and I will declare what He has done for me.
Psa.66.16.kjv: Come and hear, all ye that fear God, and I will declare what he hath done for my soul.

Psa.71.23.bsb: When I sing praise to You my lips will shout for joy, along with my soul, which You have redeemed.
Psa.71.23.kjv: My lips shall greatly rejoice when I sing unto thee; and my soul, which thou hast redeemed.

Psa.105.12.bsb: When they were few in number, few indeed, and strangers in the land,
Psa.105.12.kjv: When they were but a few men in number; yea, very few, and strangers in it.

Psa.105.13.bsb: they wandered from nation to nation, from one kingdom to another.
Psa.105.13.kjv: When they went from one nation to another, from one kingdom to another people;

Psa.119.160.bsb: The entirety of Your word is truth, and all Your righteous judgments endure forever.
Psa.119.160.kjv: Thy word is true from the beginning: and every one of thy righteous judgments endureth for ever.

Psa.61.5.bsb: For You have heard my vows, O God; You have given me the inheritance reserved for those who fear Your name.
Psa.61.5.kjv: For thou, O God, hast heard my vows: thou hast given me the heritage of those that fear thy name.

Psa.45.3.bsb: Strap your sword at your side, O mighty warrior; appear in your majesty and splendor.
Psa.45.3.kjv: Gird thy sword upon thy thigh, O most mighty, with thy glory and thy majesty.

Psa.45.4.bsb: In your splendor ride forth in victory on behalf of truth and humility and justice; may your right hand show your awesome deeds.
Psa.45.4.kjv: And in thy majesty ride prosperously because of truth and meekness and righteousness; and thy right hand shall teach thee terrible things.

Psa.45.5.bsb: Your arrows pierce the hearts of the king’s foes; the nations fall beneath your feet.
Psa.45.5.kjv: Thine arrows are sharp in the heart of the king’s enemies; whereby the people fall under thee.

Psa.45.8.bsb: All your garments are fragrant with myrrh and aloes and cassia; from palaces of ivory the harps make you glad.
Psa.45.8.kjv: All thy garments smell of myrrh, and aloes, and cassia, out of the ivory palaces, whereby they have made thee glad.

Psa.45.9.bsb: The daughters of kings are among your honored women; the queen stands at your right hand, adorned with the gold of Ophir.
Psa.45.9.kjv: Kings’ daughters were among thy honourable women: upon thy right hand did stand the queen in gold of Ophir.

Psa.40.7.bsb: Then I said, “Here I am, I have come—it is written about me in the scroll:
Psa.40.7.kjv: Then said I, Lo, I come: in the volume of the book it is written of me,

Psa.12.6.bsb: The words of the LORD are flawless, like silver refined in a furnace, like gold purified sevenfold.
Psa.12.6.kjv: The words of the Lord are pure words: as silver tried in a furnace of earth, purified seven times.

Psa.17.4.bsb: As for the deeds of men—by the word of Your lips I have avoided the ways of the violent.
Psa.17.4.kjv: Concerning the works of men, by the word of thy lips I have kept me from the paths of the destroyer.

Psa.19.7.bsb: The Law of the LORD is perfect, reviving the soul; the testimony of the LORD is trustworthy, making wise the simple.
Psa.19.7.kjv: The law of the Lord is perfect, converting the soul: the testimony of the Lord is sure, making wise the simple.

Psa.19.8.bsb: The precepts of the LORD are right, bringing joy to the heart; the commandments of the LORD are radiant, giving light to the eyes.
Psa.19.8.kjv: The statutes of the Lord are right, rejoicing the heart: the commandment of the Lord is pure, enlightening the eyes.

Psa.19.10.bsb: They are more precious than gold, than much pure gold; they are sweeter than honey, than honey from the comb.
Psa.19.10.kjv: More to be desired are they than gold, yea, than much fine gold: sweeter also than honey and the honeycomb.
