Psa.19.11.bsb: By them indeed Your servant is warned; in keeping them is great reward.
Psa.19.11.kjv: Moreover by them is thy servant warned: and in keeping of them there is great reward.

Psa.40.8.bsb: I delight to do Your will, O my God; Your law is within my heart.”
Psa.40.8.kjv: I delight to do thy will, O my God: yea, thy law is within my heart.

Psa.93.5.bsb: Your testimonies are fully confirmed; holiness adorns Your house, O LORD, for all the days to come.
Psa.93.5.kjv: Thy testimonies are very sure: holiness becometh thine house, O Lord, for ever.

Psa.94.12.bsb: Blessed is the man You discipline, O LORD, and teach from Your law,
Psa.94.12.kjv: Blessed is the man whom thou chastenest, O Lord, and teachest him out of thy law;

Psa.119.11.bsb: I have hidden Your word in my heart that I might not sin against You.
Psa.119.11.kjv: Thy word have I hid in mine heart, that I might not sin against thee.

Psa.119.12.bsb: Blessed are You, O LORD; teach me Your statutes.
Psa.119.12.kjv: Blessed art thou, O Lord: teach me thy statutes.

Psa.119.14.bsb: I rejoice in the way of Your testimonies as much as in all riches.
Psa.119.14.kjv: I have rejoiced in the way of thy testimonies, as much as in all riches.

Psa.119.15.bsb: I will meditate on Your precepts and regard Your ways.
Psa.119.15.kjv: I will meditate in thy precepts, and have respect unto thy ways.

Psa.119.16.bsb: I will delight in Your statutes; I will not forget Your word.
Psa.119.16.kjv: I will delight myself in thy statutes: I will not forget thy word.

Psa.119.19.bsb: I am a stranger on the earth; do not hide Your commandments from me.
Psa.119.19.kjv: I am a stranger in the earth: hide not thy commandments from me.

Psa.119.20.bsb: My soul is consumed with longing for Your judgments at all times.
Psa.119.20.kjv: My soul breaketh for the longing that it hath unto thy judgments at all times.

Psa.119.23.bsb: Though rulers sit and slander me, Your servant meditates on Your statutes.
Psa.119.23.kjv: Princes also did sit and speak against me: but thy servant did meditate in thy statutes.

Psa.119.24.bsb: Your testimonies are indeed my delight; they are my counselors.
Psa.119.24.kjv: Thy testimonies also are my delight and my counsellors.

Psa.119.25.bsb: My soul cleaves to the dust; revive me according to Your word.
Psa.119.25.kjv: ד DALETH. My soul cleaveth unto the dust: quicken thou me according to thy word.

Psa.119.28.bsb: My soul melts with sorrow; strengthen me according to Your word.
Psa.119.28.kjv: My soul melteth for heaviness: strengthen thou me according unto thy word.

Psa.119.30.bsb: I have chosen the way of truth; I have set Your ordinances before me.
Psa.119.30.kjv: I have chosen the way of truth: thy judgments have I laid before me.

Psa.119.31.bsb: I cling to Your testimonies, O LORD; let me not be put to shame.
Psa.119.31.kjv: I have stuck unto thy testimonies: O Lord, put me not to shame.

Psa.119.33.bsb: Teach me, O LORD, the way of Your statutes, and I will keep them to the end.
Psa.119.33.kjv: ה HE. Teach me, O Lord, the way of thy statutes; and I shall keep it unto the end.

Psa.119.35.bsb: Direct me in the path of Your commandments, for there I find delight.
Psa.119.35.kjv: Make me to go in the path of thy commandments; for therein do I delight.

Psa.119.41.bsb: May Your loving devotion come to me, O LORD, Your salvation, according to Your promise.
Psa.119.41.kjv: ו VAU. Let thy mercies come also unto me, O Lord, even thy salvation, according to thy word.

Psa.119.45.bsb: And I will walk in freedom, for I have sought Your precepts.
Psa.119.45.kjv: And I will walk at liberty: for I seek thy precepts.

Psa.119.46.bsb: I will speak of Your testimonies before kings, and I will not be ashamed.
Psa.119.46.kjv: I will speak of thy testimonies also before kings, and will not be ashamed.

Psa.119.47.bsb: I delight in Your commandments because I love them.
Psa.119.47.kjv: And I will delight myself in thy commandments, which I have loved.

Psa.119.48.bsb: I lift up my hands to Your commandments, which I love, and I meditate on Your statutes.
Psa.119.48.kjv: My hands also will I lift up unto thy commandments, which I have loved; and I will meditate in thy statutes.

Psa.119.50.bsb: This is my comfort in affliction, that Your promise has given me life.
Psa.119.50.kjv: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me.

Psa.119.51.bsb: The arrogant utterly deride me, but I do not turn from Your law.
Psa.119.51.kjv: The proud have had me greatly in derision: yet have I not declined from thy law.

Psa.119.52.bsb: I remember Your judgments of old, O LORD, and in them I find comfort.
Psa.119.52.kjv: I remembered thy judgments of old, O Lord; and have comforted myself.

Psa.119.54.bsb: Your statutes are songs to me in the house of my pilgrimage.
Psa.119.54.kjv: Thy statutes have been my songs in the house of my pilgrimage.

Psa.119.61.bsb: Though the ropes of the wicked bind me, I do not forget Your law.
Psa.119.61.kjv: The bands of the wicked have robbed me: but I have not forgotten thy law.

Psa.119.66.bsb: Teach me good judgment and knowledge, for I believe in Your commandments.
Psa.119.66.kjv: Teach me good judgment and knowledge: for I have believed thy commandments.

Psa.119.67.bsb: Before I was afflicted, I went astray; but now I keep Your word.
Psa.119.67.kjv: Before I was afflicted I went astray: but now have I kept thy word.

Psa.119.70.bsb: Their hearts are callous and insensitive, but I delight in Your law.
Psa.119.70.kjv: Their heart is as fat as grease; but I delight in thy law.

Psa.119.72.bsb: The law from Your mouth is more precious to me than thousands of pieces of gold and silver.
Psa.119.72.kjv: The law of thy mouth is better unto me than thousands of gold and silver.

Psa.119.77.bsb: May Your compassion come to me, that I may live, for Your law is my delight.
Psa.119.77.kjv: Let thy tender mercies come unto me, that I may live: for thy law is my delight.

Psa.119.82.bsb: My eyes fail, looking for Your promise; I ask, “When will You comfort me?”
Psa.119.82.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy word, saying, When wilt thou comfort me?

Psa.119.83.bsb: Though I am like a wineskin dried up by smoke, I do not forget Your statutes.
Psa.119.83.kjv: For I am become like a bottle in the smoke; yet do I not forget thy statutes.

Psa.119.86.bsb: All Your commandments are faithful; I am persecuted without cause—help me!
Psa.119.86.kjv: All thy commandments are faithful: they persecute me wrongfully; help thou me.

Psa.119.92.bsb: If Your law had not been my delight, then I would have perished in my affliction.
Psa.119.92.kjv: Unless thy law had been my delights, I should then have perished in mine affliction.

Psa.119.93.bsb: I will never forget Your precepts, for by them You have revived me.
Psa.119.93.kjv: I will never forget thy precepts: for with them thou hast quickened me.

Psa.119.96.bsb: I have seen a limit to all perfection, but Your commandment is without limit.
Psa.119.96.kjv: I have seen an end of all perfection: but thy commandment is exceeding broad.

Psa.119.97.bsb: Oh, how I love Your law! All day long it is my meditation.
Psa.119.97.kjv: מ MEM. O how love I thy law! it is my meditation all the day.

Psa.119.98.bsb: Your commandments make me wiser than my enemies, for they are always with me.
Psa.119.98.kjv: Thou through thy commandments hast made me wiser than mine enemies: for they are ever with me.

Psa.119.99.bsb: I have more insight than all my teachers, for Your testimonies are my meditation.
Psa.119.99.kjv: I have more understanding than all my teachers: for thy testimonies are my meditation.

Psa.119.100.bsb: I discern more than the elders, for I obey Your precepts.
Psa.119.100.kjv: I understand more than the ancients, because I keep thy precepts.

Psa.119.103.bsb: How sweet are Your words to my taste—sweeter than honey in my mouth!
Psa.119.103.kjv: How sweet are thy words unto my taste! yea, sweeter than honey to my mouth!

Psa.119.105.bsb: Your word is a lamp to my feet and a light to my path.
Psa.119.105.kjv: נ NUN. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

Psa.119.109.bsb: I constantly take my life in my hands, yet I do not forget Your law.
Psa.119.109.kjv: My soul is continually in my hand: yet do I not forget thy law.

Psa.119.111.bsb: Your testimonies are my heritage forever, for they are the joy of my heart.
Psa.119.111.kjv: Thy testimonies have I taken as an heritage for ever: for they are the rejoicing of my heart.

Psa.119.115.bsb: Depart from me, you evildoers, that I may obey the commandments of my God.
Psa.119.115.kjv: Depart from me, ye evildoers: for I will keep the commandments of my God.

Psa.119.119.bsb: All the wicked on earth You discard like dross; therefore I love Your testimonies.
Psa.119.119.kjv: Thou puttest away all the wicked of the earth like dross: therefore I love thy testimonies.

Psa.119.127.bsb: Therefore I love Your commandments more than gold, even the purest gold.
Psa.119.127.kjv: Therefore I love thy commandments above gold; yea, above fine gold.

Psa.119.129.bsb: Wonderful are Your testimonies; therefore I obey them.
Psa.119.129.kjv: פ PE. Thy testimonies are wonderful: therefore doth my soul keep them.

Psa.119.130.bsb: The unfolding of Your words gives light; it informs the simple.
Psa.119.130.kjv: The entrance of thy words giveth light; it giveth understanding unto the simple.

Psa.119.131.bsb: I open my mouth and pant, longing for Your commandments.
Psa.119.131.kjv: I opened my mouth, and panted: for I longed for thy commandments.

Psa.119.133.bsb: Order my steps in Your word; let no sin rule over me.
Psa.119.133.kjv: Order my steps in thy word: and let not any iniquity have dominion over me.

Psa.119.138.bsb: The testimonies You have laid down are righteous and altogether faithful.
Psa.119.138.kjv: Thy testimonies that thou hast commanded are righteous and very faithful.

Psa.119.140.bsb: Your promise is completely pure; therefore Your servant loves it.
Psa.119.140.kjv: Thy word is very pure: therefore thy servant loveth it.

Psa.119.141.bsb: I am lowly and despised, but I do not forget Your precepts.
Psa.119.141.kjv: I am small and despised: yet do not I forget thy precepts.

Psa.119.143.bsb: Trouble and distress have found me, but Your commandments are my delight.
Psa.119.143.kjv: Trouble and anguish have taken hold on me: yet thy commandments are my delights.

Psa.119.148.bsb: My eyes anticipate the watches of night, that I may meditate on Your word.
Psa.119.148.kjv: Mine eyes prevent the night watches, that I might meditate in thy word.

Psa.119.152.bsb: Long ago I learned from Your testimonies that You have established them forever.
Psa.119.152.kjv: Concerning thy testimonies, I have known of old that thou hast founded them for ever.

Psa.119.157.bsb: Though my persecutors and foes are many, I have not turned from Your testimonies.
Psa.119.157.kjv: Many are my persecutors and mine enemies; yet do I not decline from thy testimonies.

Psa.119.158.bsb: I look on the faithless with loathing because they do not keep Your word.
Psa.119.158.kjv: I beheld the transgressors, and was grieved; because they kept not thy word.

Psa.119.159.bsb: Consider how I love Your precepts, O LORD; give me life according to Your loving devotion.
Psa.119.159.kjv: Consider how I love thy precepts: quicken me, O Lord, according to thy lovingkindness.

Psa.119.161.bsb: Rulers persecute me without cause, but my heart fears only Your word.
Psa.119.161.kjv: ש SCHIN. Princes have persecuted me without a cause: but my heart standeth in awe of thy word.

Psa.119.162.bsb: I rejoice in Your promise like one who finds great spoil.
Psa.119.162.kjv: I rejoice at thy word, as one that findeth great spoil.

Psa.119.165.bsb: Abundant peace belongs to those who love Your law; nothing can make them stumble.
Psa.119.165.kjv: Great peace have they which love thy law: and nothing shall offend them.

Psa.119.167.bsb: I obey Your testimonies and love them greatly.
Psa.119.167.kjv: My soul hath kept thy testimonies; and I love them exceedingly.

Psa.50.16.bsb: To the wicked, however, God says, “What right have you to recite My statutes and to bear My covenant on your lips?
Psa.50.16.kjv: But unto the wicked God saith, What hast thou to do to declare my statutes, or that thou shouldest take my covenant in thy mouth?

Psa.50.17.bsb: For you hate My instruction and cast My words behind you.
Psa.50.17.kjv: Seeing thou hatest instruction, and castest my words behind thee.

Psa.90.17.bsb: May the favor of the Lord our God rest upon us; establish for us the work of our hands—yes, establish the work of our hands!
Psa.90.17.kjv: And let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us: and establish thou the work of our hands upon us; yea, the work of our hands establish thou it.

Psa.106.30.bsb: But Phinehas stood and intervened, and the plague was restrained.
Psa.106.30.kjv: Then stood up Phinehas, and executed judgment: and so the plague was stayed.

Psa.106.31.bsb: It was credited to him as righteousness for endless generations to come.
Psa.106.31.kjv: And that was counted unto him for righteousness unto all generations for evermore.

Psa.26.8.bsb: O LORD, I love the house where You dwell, the place where Your glory resides.
Psa.26.8.kjv: Lord, I have loved the habitation of thy house, and the place where thine honour dwelleth.

Psa.51.19.bsb: Then You will delight in righteous sacrifices, in whole burnt offerings; then bulls will be offered on Your altar.
Psa.51.19.kjv: Then shalt thou be pleased with the sacrifices of righteousness, with burnt offering and whole burnt offering: then shall they offer bullocks upon thine altar.

Psa.103.1.bsb: Of David. Bless the LORD, O my soul; all that is within me, bless His holy name.
Psa.103.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. Bless the Lord, O my soul: and all that is within me, bless his holy name.

Psa.118.18.bsb: The LORD disciplined me severely, but He has not given me over to death.
Psa.118.18.kjv: The Lord hath chastened me sore: but he hath not given me over unto death.

Psa.118.19.bsb: Open to me the gates of righteousness, that I may enter and give thanks to the LORD.
Psa.118.19.kjv: Open to me the gates of righteousness: I will go into them, and I will praise the Lord:

Psa.126.3.bsb: The LORD has done great things for us; we are filled with joy.
Psa.126.3.kjv: The Lord hath done great things for us; whereof we are glad.

Psa.132.7.bsb: Let us go to His dwelling place; let us worship at His footstool.
Psa.132.7.kjv: We will go into his tabernacles: we will worship at his footstool.

Psa.39.9.bsb: I have become mute; I do not open my mouth because of what You have done.
Psa.39.9.kjv: I was dumb, I opened not my mouth; because thou didst it.

Psa.22.13.bsb: They open their jaws against me like lions that roar and maul.
Psa.22.13.kjv: They gaped upon me with their mouths, as a ravening and a roaring lion.

Psa.132.8.bsb: Arise, O LORD, to Your resting place, You and the ark of Your strength.
Psa.132.8.kjv: Arise, O Lord, into thy rest; thou, and the ark of thy strength.

Psa.40.9.bsb: I proclaim righteousness in the great assembly; behold, I do not seal my lips, as You, O LORD, do know.
Psa.40.9.kjv: I have preached righteousness in the great congregation: lo, I have not refrained my lips, O Lord, thou knowest.

Psa.68.11.bsb: The Lord gives the command; a great company of women proclaim it:
Psa.68.11.kjv: The Lord gave the word: great was the company of those that published it.

Psa.12.2.bsb: They lie to one another; they speak with flattering lips and a double heart.
Psa.12.2.kjv: They speak vanity every one with his neighbour: with flattering lips and with a double heart do they speak.

Psa.12.3.bsb: May the LORD cut off all flattering lips and every boastful tongue.
Psa.12.3.kjv: The Lord shall cut off all flattering lips, and the tongue that speaketh proud things:

Psa.75.8.bsb: For a cup is in the hand of the LORD, full of foaming wine mixed with spices. He pours from His cup, and all the wicked of the earth drink it down to the dregs.
Psa.75.8.kjv: For in the hand of the Lord there is a cup, and the wine is red; it is full of mixture; and he poureth out of the same: but the dregs thereof, all the wicked of the earth shall wring them out, and drink them.

Psa.36.4.bsb: Even on his bed he plots wickedness; he sets himself on a path that is not good; he fails to reject evil.
Psa.36.4.kjv: He deviseth mischief upon his bed; he setteth himself in a way that is not good; he abhorreth not evil.

Psa.94.16.bsb: Who will rise up for me against the wicked? Who will stand for me against the workers of iniquity?
Psa.94.16.kjv: Who will rise up for me against the evildoers? or who will stand up for me against the workers of iniquity?

Psa.33.17.bsb: A horse is a vain hope for salvation; even its great strength cannot save.
Psa.33.17.kjv: An horse is a vain thing for safety: neither shall he deliver any by his great strength.

Psa.38.22.bsb: Come quickly to help me, O Lord my Savior.
Psa.38.22.kjv: Make haste to help me, O Lord my salvation.

Psa.40.16.bsb: May all who seek You rejoice and be glad in You; may those who love Your salvation always say, “The LORD be magnified!”
Psa.40.16.kjv: Let all those that seek thee rejoice and be glad in thee: let such as love thy salvation say continually, The Lord be magnified.

Psa.132.9.bsb: May Your priests be clothed with righteousness, and Your saints shout for joy.
Psa.132.9.kjv: Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness; and let thy saints shout for joy.

Psa.132.18.bsb: I will clothe his enemies with shame, but the crown upon him will gleam.”
Psa.132.18.kjv: His enemies will I clothe with shame: but upon himself shall his crown flourish.

Psa.22.11.bsb: Be not far from me, for trouble is near and there is no one to help.
Psa.22.11.kjv: Be not far from me; for trouble is near; for there is none to help.

Psa.30.10.bsb: Hear me, O LORD, and have mercy; O LORD, be my helper.”
Psa.30.10.kjv: Hear, O Lord, and have mercy upon me: Lord, be thou my helper.

Psa.135.20.bsb: O house of Levi, bless the LORD; you who fear the LORD, bless the LORD!
Psa.135.20.kjv: Bless the Lord, O house of Levi: ye that fear the Lord, bless the Lord.

Psa.89.40.bsb: You have broken down all his walls; You have reduced his strongholds to rubble.
Psa.89.40.kjv: Thou hast broken down all his hedges; thou hast brought his strong holds to ruin.

Psa.106.12.bsb: Then they believed His promises and sang His praise.
Psa.106.12.kjv: Then believed they his words; they sang his praise.

Psa.49.4.bsb: I will incline my ear to a proverb; I will express my riddle with the harp:
Psa.49.4.kjv: I will incline mine ear to a parable: I will open my dark saying upon the harp.

Psa.4.7.bsb: You have filled my heart with more joy than when grain and new wine abound.
Psa.4.7.kjv: Thou hast put gladness in my heart, more than in the time that their corn and their wine increased.

Psa.21.6.bsb: For You grant him blessings forever; You cheer him with joy in Your presence.
Psa.21.6.kjv: For thou hast made him most blessed for ever: thou hast made him exceeding glad with thy countenance.

Psa.68.3.bsb: But the righteous will be glad and rejoice before God; they will celebrate with joy.
Psa.68.3.kjv: But let the righteous be glad; let them rejoice before God: yea, let them exceedingly rejoice.

Psa.106.5.bsb: that I may see the prosperity of Your chosen ones, and rejoice in the gladness of Your nation, and give glory with Your inheritance.
Psa.106.5.kjv: That I may see the good of thy chosen, that I may rejoice in the gladness of thy nation, that I may glory with thine inheritance.

Psa.2.10.bsb: Therefore be wise, O kings; be admonished, O judges of the earth.
Psa.2.10.kjv: Be wise now therefore, O ye kings: be instructed, ye judges of the earth.

Psa.16.7.bsb: I will bless the LORD who counsels me; even at night my conscience instructs me.
Psa.16.7.kjv: I will bless the Lord, who hath given me counsel: my reins also instruct me in the night seasons.

Psa.38.1.bsb: A Psalm of David, for remembrance. O LORD, do not rebuke me in Your anger or discipline me in Your wrath.
Psa.38.1.kjv: A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance. O Lord, rebuke me not in thy wrath: neither chasten me in thy hot displeasure.

Psa.19.13.bsb: Keep Your servant also from willful sins; may they not rule over me. Then I will be blameless and cleansed of great transgression.
Psa.19.13.kjv: Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins; let them not have dominion over me: then shall I be upright, and I shall be innocent from the great transgression.

Psa.119.6.bsb: Then I would not be ashamed when I consider all Your commandments.
Psa.119.6.kjv: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments.

Psa.101.6.bsb: My eyes favor the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me; he who walks in the way of integrity shall minister to me.
Psa.101.6.kjv: Mine eyes shall be upon the faithful of the land, that they may dwell with me: he that walketh in a perfect way, he shall serve me.

Psa.22.12.bsb: Many bulls surround me; strong bulls of Bashan encircle me.
Psa.22.12.kjv: Many bulls have compassed me: strong bulls of Bashan have beset me round.

Psa.50.9.bsb: I have no need for a bull from your stall or goats from your pens,
Psa.50.9.kjv: I will take no bullock out of thy house, nor he goats out of thy folds.

Psa.69.31.bsb: And this will please the LORD more than an ox, more than a bull with horns and hooves.
Psa.69.31.kjv: This also shall please the Lord better than an ox or bullock that hath horns and hoofs.

Psa.47.5.bsb: God has ascended amid shouts of joy, the LORD with the sound of the horn.
Psa.47.5.kjv: God is gone up with a shout, the Lord with the sound of a trumpet.

Psa.21.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O LORD, the king rejoices in Your strength. How greatly he exults in Your salvation!
Psa.21.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The king shall joy in thy strength, O Lord; and in thy salvation how greatly shall he rejoice!

Psa.29.1.bsb: A Psalm of David. Ascribe to the LORD, O heavenly beings, ascribe to the LORD glory and strength.
Psa.29.1.kjv: A Psalm of David. Give unto the Lord, O ye mighty, give unto the Lord glory and strength.

Psa.68.28.bsb: Summon Your power, O God; show Your strength, O God, which You have exerted on our behalf.
Psa.68.28.kjv: Thy God hath commanded thy strength: strengthen, O God, that which thou hast wrought for us.

Psa.86.16.bsb: Turn to me and have mercy; grant Your strength to Your servant; save the son of Your maidservant.
Psa.86.16.kjv: O turn unto me, and have mercy upon me; give thy strength unto thy servant, and save the son of thine handmaid.

Psa.35.27.bsb: May those who favor my vindication shout for joy and gladness; may they always say, “Exalted be the LORD who delights in His servant’s well-being.”
Psa.35.27.kjv: Let them shout for joy, and be glad, that favour my righteous cause: yea, let them say continually, Let the Lord be magnified, which hath pleasure in the prosperity of his servant.

Psa.38.17.bsb: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
Psa.38.17.kjv: For I am ready to halt, and my sorrow is continually before me.

Psa.50.8.bsb: I do not rebuke you for your sacrifices, and your burnt offerings are ever before Me.
Psa.50.8.kjv: I will not reprove thee for thy sacrifices or thy burnt offerings, to have been continually before me.

Psa.119.44.bsb: I will always obey Your law, forever and ever.
Psa.119.44.kjv: So shall I keep thy law continually for ever and ever.

Psa.119.117.bsb: Uphold me, and I will be saved, that I may always regard Your statutes.
Psa.119.117.kjv: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe: and I will have respect unto thy statutes continually.

Psa.119.121.bsb: I have done what is just and right; do not leave me to my oppressors.
Psa.119.121.kjv: ע AIN. I have done judgment and justice: leave me not to mine oppressors.

Psa.119.122.bsb: Ensure Your servant’s well-being; do not let the arrogant oppress me.
Psa.119.122.kjv: Be surety for thy servant for good: let not the proud oppress me.

Psa.141.5.bsb: Let the righteous man strike me; let his rebuke be an act of loving devotion. It is oil for my head; let me not refuse it. For my prayer is ever against the deeds of the wicked.
Psa.141.5.kjv: Let the righteous smite me; it shall be a kindness: and let him reprove me; it shall be an excellent oil, which shall not break my head: for yet my prayer also shall be in their calamities.

Psa.88.3.bsb: For my soul is full of troubles, and my life draws near to Sheol.
Psa.88.3.kjv: For my soul is full of troubles: and my life draweth nigh unto the grave.

Psa.89.38.bsb: Now, however, You have spurned and rejected him; You are enraged by Your anointed one.
Psa.89.38.kjv: But thou hast cast off and abhorred, thou hast been wroth with thine anointed.

Psa.132.10.bsb: For the sake of Your servant David, do not reject Your anointed one.
Psa.132.10.kjv: For thy servant David’s sake turn not away the face of thine anointed.

Psa.2.9.bsb: You will break them with an iron scepter; You will shatter them like pottery.”
Psa.2.9.kjv: Thou shalt break them with a rod of iron; thou shalt dash them in pieces like a potter’s vessel.

Psa.27.2.bsb: When the wicked came upon me to devour my flesh, my enemies and foes stumbled and fell.
Psa.27.2.kjv: When the wicked, even mine enemies and my foes, came upon me to eat up my flesh, they stumbled and fell.

Psa.92.11.bsb: My eyes see the downfall of my enemies; my ears hear the wailing of my wicked foes.
Psa.92.11.kjv: Mine eye also shall see my desire on mine enemies, and mine ears shall hear my desire of the wicked that rise up against me.

Psa.106.22.bsb: wondrous works in the land of Ham, and awesome deeds by the Red Sea.
Psa.106.22.kjv: Wondrous works in the land of Ham, and terrible things by the Red sea.

Psa.119.27.bsb: Make clear to me the way of Your precepts; then I will meditate on Your wonders.
Psa.119.27.kjv: Make me to understand the way of thy precepts: so shall I talk of thy wondrous works.

Psa.131.1.bsb: A song of ascents. Of David. My heart is not proud, O LORD, my eyes are not haughty. I do not aspire to great things or matters too lofty for me.
Psa.131.1.kjv: A Song of degrees of David. Lord, my heart is not haughty, nor mine eyes lofty: neither do I exercise myself in great matters, or in things too high for me.

Psa.36.2.bsb: For his eyes are too full of conceit to detect or hate his own sin.
Psa.36.2.kjv: For he flattereth himself in his own eyes, until his iniquity be found to be hateful.

Psa.55.21.bsb: His speech is smooth as butter, but war is in his heart. His words are softer than oil, yet they are swords unsheathed.
Psa.55.21.kjv: The words of his mouth were smoother than butter, but war was in his heart: his words were softer than oil, yet were they drawn swords.

Psa.68.12.bsb: “Kings and their armies flee in haste; she who waits at home divides the plunder.
Psa.68.12.kjv: Kings of armies did flee apace: and she that tarried at home divided the spoil.

Psa.2.11.bsb: Serve the LORD with fear, and rejoice with trembling.
Psa.2.11.kjv: Serve the Lord with fear, and rejoice with trembling.

Psa.13.4.bsb: lest my enemy say, “I have overcome him,” and my foes rejoice when I fall.
Psa.13.4.kjv: Lest mine enemy say, I have prevailed against him; and those that trouble me rejoice when I am moved.

Psa.97.8.bsb: Zion hears and rejoices, and the towns of Judah exult because of Your judgments, O LORD.
Psa.97.8.kjv: Zion heard, and was glad; and the daughters of Judah rejoiced because of thy judgments, O Lord.

Psa.65.8.bsb: Those who live far away fear Your wonders; You make the dawn and sunset shout for joy.
Psa.65.8.kjv: They also that dwell in the uttermost parts are afraid at thy tokens: thou makest the outgoings of the morning and evening to rejoice.

Psa.132.6.bsb: We heard that the ark was in Ephrathah; we found it in the fields of Jaar.
Psa.132.6.kjv: Lo, we heard of it at Ephratah: we found it in the fields of the wood.

Psa.42.11.bsb: Why are you downcast, O my soul? Why the unease within me? Put your hope in God, for I will yet praise Him, my Savior and my God.
Psa.42.11.kjv: Why art thou cast down, O my soul? and why art thou disquieted within me? hope thou in God: for I shall yet praise him, who is the health of my countenance, and my God.

Psa.49.18.bsb: Though in his lifetime he blesses his soul—and men praise you when you prosper—
Psa.49.18.kjv: Though while he lived he blessed his soul: and men will praise thee, when thou doest well to thyself.

Psa.67.5.bsb: Let the peoples praise You, O God; let all the peoples praise You.
Psa.67.5.kjv: Let the people praise thee, O God; let all the people praise thee.

Psa.122.4.bsb: where the tribes go up, the tribes of the LORD, as a testimony for Israel, to give thanks to the name of the LORD.
Psa.122.4.kjv: Whither the tribes go up, the tribes of the Lord, unto the testimony of Israel, to give thanks unto the name of the Lord.

Psa.142.7.bsb: Free my soul from prison, that I may praise Your name. The righteous will gather around me because of Your goodness to me.
Psa.142.7.kjv: Bring my soul out of prison, that I may praise thy name: the righteous shall compass me about; for thou shalt deal bountifully with me.

Psa.12.5.bsb: “For the cause of the oppressed and for the groaning of the needy, I will now arise,” says the LORD. “I will bring safety to him who yearns.”
Psa.12.5.kjv: For the oppression of the poor, for the sighing of the needy, now will I arise, saith the Lord; I will set him in safety from him that puffeth at him.

Psa.18.35.bsb: You have given me Your shield of salvation; Your right hand upholds me, and Your gentleness exalts me.
Psa.18.35.kjv: Thou hast also given me the shield of thy salvation: and thy right hand hath holden me up, and thy gentleness hath made me great.

Psa.18.46.bsb: The LORD lives, and blessed be my Rock! And may the God of my salvation be exalted—
Psa.18.46.kjv: The Lord liveth; and blessed be my rock; and let the God of my salvation be exalted.

Psa.85.7.bsb: Show us Your loving devotion, O LORD, and grant us Your salvation.
Psa.85.7.kjv: Shew us thy mercy, O Lord, and grant us thy salvation.

Psa.106.2.bsb: Who can describe the mighty acts of the LORD or fully proclaim His praise?
Psa.106.2.kjv: Who can utter the mighty acts of the Lord? who can shew forth all his praise?

Psa.109.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. O God of my praise, be not silent.
Psa.109.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Hold not thy peace, O God of my praise;

Psa.66.5.bsb: Come and see the works of God; how awesome are His deeds toward mankind.
Psa.66.5.kjv: Come and see the works of God: he is terrible in his doing toward the children of men.

Psa.141.4.bsb: Do not let my heart be drawn to any evil thing or take part in works of wickedness with men who do iniquity; let me not feast on their delicacies.
Psa.141.4.kjv: Incline not my heart to any evil thing, to practise wicked works with men that work iniquity: and let me not eat of their dainties.

Psa.75.9.bsb: But I will proclaim Him forever; I will sing praise to the God of Jacob.
Psa.75.9.kjv: But I will declare for ever; I will sing praises to the God of Jacob.

Psa.143.5.bsb: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all Your works; I consider the work of Your hands.
Psa.143.5.kjv: I remember the days of old; I meditate on all thy works; I muse on the work of thy hands.

Psa.81.4.bsb: For this is a statute for Israel, an ordinance of the God of Jacob.
Psa.81.4.kjv: For this was a statute for Israel, and a law of the God of Jacob.

Psa.94.20.bsb: Can a corrupt throne be Your ally—one devising mischief by decree?
Psa.94.20.kjv: Shall the throne of iniquity have fellowship with thee, which frameth mischief by a law?

Psa.119.5.bsb: Oh, that my ways were committed to keeping Your statutes!
Psa.119.5.kjv: O that my ways were directed to keep thy statutes!

Psa.119.8.bsb: I will keep Your statutes; do not utterly forsake me.
Psa.119.8.kjv: I will keep thy statutes: O forsake me not utterly.

Psa.119.71.bsb: It was good for me to be afflicted, that I might learn Your statutes.
Psa.119.71.kjv: It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

Psa.119.80.bsb: May my heart be blameless in Your statutes, that I may not be put to shame.
Psa.119.80.kjv: Let my heart be sound in thy statutes; that I be not ashamed.

Psa.119.112.bsb: I have inclined my heart to perform Your statutes, even to the very end.
Psa.119.112.kjv: I have inclined mine heart to perform thy statutes alway, even unto the end.

Psa.119.118.bsb: You reject all who stray from Your statutes, for their deceitfulness is in vain.
Psa.119.118.kjv: Thou hast trodden down all them that err from thy statutes: for their deceit is falsehood.

Psa.119.135.bsb: Make Your face shine upon Your servant, and teach me Your statutes.
Psa.119.135.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant; and teach me thy statutes.

Psa.119.155.bsb: Salvation is far from the wicked because they do not seek Your statutes.
Psa.119.155.kjv: Salvation is far from the wicked: for they seek not thy statutes.

Psa.16.6.bsb: The lines of my boundary have fallen in pleasant places; surely my inheritance is delightful.
Psa.16.6.kjv: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage.

Psa.18.4.bsb: The cords of death encompassed me; the torrents of chaos overwhelmed me.
Psa.18.4.kjv: The sorrows of death compassed me, and the floods of ungodly men made me afraid.

Psa.18.5.bsb: The cords of Sheol entangled me; the snares of death confronted me.
Psa.18.5.kjv: The sorrows of hell compassed me about: the snares of death prevented me.

Psa.140.5.bsb: The proud hide a snare for me; the cords of their net are spread along the path, and lures are set out for me. Selah
Psa.140.5.kjv: The proud have hid a snare for me, and cords; they have spread a net by the wayside; they have set gins for me. Selah.

Psa.26.4.bsb: I do not sit with deceitful men, nor keep company with hypocrites.
Psa.26.4.kjv: I have not sat with vain persons, neither will I go in with dissemblers.

Psa.119.87.bsb: They almost wiped me from the earth, but I have not forsaken Your precepts.
Psa.119.87.kjv: They had almost consumed me upon earth; but I forsook not thy precepts.

Psa.33.8.bsb: Let all the earth fear the LORD; let all the people of the world revere Him.
Psa.33.8.kjv: Let all the earth fear the Lord: let all the inhabitants of the world stand in awe of him.

Psa.3.2.bsb: Many say of me, “God will not deliver him.” Selah
Psa.3.2.kjv: Many there be which say of my soul, There is no help for him in God. Selah.

Psa.67.2.bsb: that Your ways may be known on earth, Your salvation among all nations.
Psa.67.2.kjv: That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

Psa.106.4.bsb: Remember me, O LORD, in Your favor to Your people; visit me with Your salvation,
Psa.106.4.kjv: Remember me, O Lord, with the favour that thou bearest unto thy people: O visit me with thy salvation;

Psa.119.123.bsb: My eyes fail, looking for Your salvation, and for Your righteous promise.
Psa.119.123.kjv: Mine eyes fail for thy salvation, and for the word of thy righteousness.

Psa.55.4.bsb: My heart pounds within me, and the terrors of death assail me.
Psa.55.4.kjv: My heart is sore pained within me: and the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

Psa.18.48.bsb: who delivers me from my enemies. You exalt me above my foes; You rescue me from violent men.
Psa.18.48.kjv: He delivereth me from mine enemies: yea, thou liftest me up above those that rise up against me: thou hast delivered me from the violent man.

Psa.44.9.bsb: But You have rejected and humbled us; You no longer go forth with our armies.
Psa.44.9.kjv: But thou hast cast off, and put us to shame; and goest not forth with our armies.

Psa.68.8.bsb: the earth shook and the heavens poured down rain before God, the One on Sinai, before God, the God of Israel.
Psa.68.8.kjv: The earth shook, the heavens also dropped at the presence of God: even Sinai itself was moved at the presence of God, the God of Israel.

Psa.77.17.bsb: The clouds poured down water; the skies resounded with thunder; Your arrows flashed back and forth.
Psa.77.17.kjv: The clouds poured out water: the skies sent out a sound: thine arrows also went abroad.

Psa.89.43.bsb: You have bent the edge of his sword and have not sustained him in battle.
Psa.89.43.kjv: Thou hast also turned the edge of his sword, and hast not made him to stand in the battle.

Psa.10.4.bsb: In his pride the wicked man does not seek Him; in all his schemes there is no God.
Psa.10.4.kjv: The wicked, through the pride of his countenance, will not seek after God: God is not in all his thoughts.

Psa.17.3.bsb: You have tried my heart; You have visited me in the night. You have tested me and found no evil; I have resolved not to sin with my mouth.
Psa.17.3.kjv: Thou hast proved mine heart; thou hast visited me in the night; thou hast tried me, and shalt find nothing; I am purposed that my mouth shall not transgress.

Psa.30.6.bsb: In prosperity I said, “I will never be shaken.”
Psa.30.6.kjv: And in my prosperity I said, I shall never be moved.

Psa.32.9.bsb: Do not be like the horse or mule, which have no understanding; they must be controlled with bit and bridle to make them come to you.
Psa.32.9.kjv: Be ye not as the horse, or as the mule, which have no understanding: whose mouth must be held in with bit and bridle, lest they come near unto thee.

Psa.49.12.bsb: But a man, despite his wealth, cannot endure; he is like the beasts that perish.
Psa.49.12.kjv: Nevertheless man being in honour abideth not: he is like the beasts that perish.

Psa.58.8.bsb: Like a slug that dissolves in its slime, like a woman’s stillborn child, may they never see the sun.
Psa.58.8.kjv: As a snail which melteth, let every one of them pass away: like the untimely birth of a woman, that they may not see the sun.

Psa.140.11.bsb: May no slanderer be established in the land; may calamity hunt down the man of violence.
Psa.140.11.kjv: Let not an evil speaker be established in the earth: evil shall hunt the violent man to overthrow him.

Psa.60.2.bsb: You have shaken the land and torn it open. Heal its fractures, for it is quaking.
Psa.60.2.kjv: Thou hast made the earth to tremble; thou hast broken it: heal the breaches thereof; for it shaketh.

Psa.49.11.bsb: Their graves are their eternal homes—their dwellings for endless generations—even though their lands were their namesakes.
Psa.49.11.kjv: Their inward thought is, that their houses shall continue for ever, and their dwelling places to all generations; they call their lands after their own names.

Psa.18.33.bsb: He makes my feet like those of a deer and stations me upon the heights.
Psa.18.33.kjv: He maketh my feet like hinds’ feet, and setteth me upon my high places.

Psa.59.14.bsb: They return in the evening, snarling like dogs and prowling around the city.
Psa.59.14.kjv: And at evening let them return; and let them make a noise like a dog, and go round about the city.

Psa.90.6.bsb: in the morning it springs up new, but by evening it fades and withers.
Psa.90.6.kjv: In the morning it flourisheth, and groweth up; in the evening it is cut down, and withereth.

Psa.89.44.bsb: You have ended his splendor and cast his throne to the ground.
Psa.89.44.kjv: Thou hast made his glory to cease, and cast his throne down to the ground.

Psa.122.5.bsb: For there the thrones of judgment stand, the thrones of the house of David.
Psa.122.5.kjv: For there are set thrones of judgment, the thrones of the house of David.

Psa.132.12.bsb: If your sons keep My covenant and the testimony I will teach them, then their sons will also sit on your throne forever and ever.”
Psa.132.12.kjv: If thy children will keep my covenant and my testimony that I shall teach them, their children shall also sit upon thy throne for evermore.

Psa.38.11.bsb: My beloved and friends shun my disease, and my kinsmen stand at a distance.
Psa.38.11.kjv: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my sore; and my kinsmen stand afar off.

Psa.88.5.bsb: I am forsaken among the dead, like the slain who lie in the grave, whom You remember no more, who are cut off from Your care.
Psa.88.5.kjv: Free among the dead, like the slain that lie in the grave, whom thou rememberest no more: and they are cut off from thy hand.

Psa.89.46.bsb: How long, O LORD? Will You hide Yourself forever? Will Your wrath keep burning like fire?
Psa.89.46.kjv: How long, Lord? wilt thou hide thyself for ever? shall thy wrath burn like fire?

Psa.90.9.bsb: For all our days decline in Your fury; we finish our years with a sigh.
Psa.90.9.kjv: For all our days are passed away in thy wrath: we spend our years as a tale that is told.

Psa.102.3.bsb: For my days vanish like smoke, and my bones burn like glowing embers.
Psa.102.3.kjv: For my days are consumed like smoke, and my bones are burned as an hearth.

Psa.141.7.bsb: As when one plows and breaks up the soil, so our bones have been scattered at the mouth of Sheol.
Psa.141.7.kjv: Our bones are scattered at the grave’s mouth, as when one cutteth and cleaveth wood upon the earth.

Psa.26.11.bsb: But I will walk with integrity; redeem me and be merciful to me.
Psa.26.11.kjv: But as for me, I will walk in mine integrity: redeem me, and be merciful unto me.

Psa.44.26.bsb: Rise up; be our help! Redeem us on account of Your loving devotion.
Psa.44.26.kjv: Arise for our help, and redeem us for thy mercies’ sake.

Psa.55.18.bsb: He redeems my soul in peace from the battle waged against me, even though many oppose me.
Psa.55.18.kjv: He hath delivered my soul in peace from the battle that was against me: for there were many with me.

Psa.69.18.bsb: Draw near to my soul and redeem me; ransom me because of my foes.
Psa.69.18.kjv: Draw nigh unto my soul, and redeem it: deliver me because of mine enemies.

Psa.119.134.bsb: Redeem me from the oppression of man, that I may keep Your precepts.
Psa.119.134.kjv: Deliver me from the oppression of man: so will I keep thy precepts.

Psa.27.13.bsb: Still I am certain to see the goodness of the LORD in the land of the living.
Psa.27.13.kjv: I had fainted, unless I had believed to see the goodness of the Lord in the land of the living.

Psa.106.24.bsb: They despised the pleasant land; they did not believe His promise.
Psa.106.24.kjv: Yea, they despised the pleasant land, they believed not his word:

Psa.79.7.bsb: for they have devoured Jacob and devastated his homeland.
Psa.79.7.kjv: For they have devoured Jacob, and laid waste his dwelling place.

Psa.37.20.bsb: But the wicked and enemies of the LORD will perish like the glory of the fields. They will vanish; like smoke they will fade away.
Psa.37.20.kjv: But the wicked shall perish, and the enemies of the Lord shall be as the fat of lambs: they shall consume; into smoke shall they consume away.

Psa.83.7.bsb: of Gebal, Ammon, and Amalek, of Philistia with the people of Tyre.
Psa.83.7.kjv: Gebal, and Ammon, and Amalek; the Philistines with the inhabitants of Tyre;

Psa.90.13.bsb: Return, O LORD! How long will it be? Have compassion on Your servants.
Psa.90.13.kjv: Return, O Lord, how long? and let it repent thee concerning thy servants.

Psa.129.6.bsb: May they be like grass on the rooftops, which withers before it can grow,
Psa.129.6.kjv: Let them be as the grass upon the housetops, which withereth afore it groweth up:

Psa.35.13.bsb: Yet when they were ill, I put on sackcloth; I humbled myself with fasting, but my prayers returned unanswered.
Psa.35.13.kjv: But as for me, when they were sick, my clothing was sackcloth: I humbled my soul with fasting; and my prayer returned into mine own bosom.

Psa.35.7.bsb: For without cause they laid their net for me; without reason they dug a pit for my soul.
Psa.35.7.kjv: For without cause have they hid for me their net in a pit, which without cause they have digged for my soul.

Psa.142.6.bsb: Listen to my cry, for I am brought quite low. Rescue me from my pursuers, for they are too strong for me.
Psa.142.6.kjv: Attend unto my cry; for I am brought very low: deliver me from my persecutors; for they are stronger than I.

Psa.44.24.bsb: Why do You hide Your face and forget our affliction and oppression?
Psa.44.24.kjv: Wherefore hidest thou thy face, and forgettest our affliction and our oppression?

Psa.33.16.bsb: No king is saved by his vast army; no warrior is delivered by his great strength.
Psa.33.16.kjv: There is no king saved by the multitude of an host: a mighty man is not delivered by much strength.

Psa.37.11.bsb: But the meek will inherit the land and delight in abundant prosperity.
Psa.37.11.kjv: But the meek shall inherit the earth; and shall delight themselves in the abundance of peace.

Psa.49.6.bsb: They trust in their wealth and boast in their great riches.
Psa.49.6.kjv: They that trust in their wealth, and boast themselves in the multitude of their riches;

Psa.52.7.bsb: “Look at the man who did not make God his refuge, but trusted in the abundance of his wealth and strengthened himself by destruction.”
Psa.52.7.kjv: Lo, this is the man that made not God his strength; but trusted in the abundance of his riches, and strengthened himself in his wickedness.

Psa.141.3.bsb: Set a guard, O LORD, over my mouth; keep watch at the door of my lips.
Psa.141.3.kjv: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips.

Psa.74.5.bsb: like men wielding axes in a thicket of trees
Psa.74.5.kjv: A man was famous according as he had lifted up axes upon the thick trees.

Psa.79.3.bsb: They have poured out their blood like water all around Jerusalem, and there is no one to bury the dead.
Psa.79.3.kjv: Their blood have they shed like water round about Jerusalem; and there was none to bury them.

Psa.88.4.bsb: I am counted among those descending to the Pit. I am like a man without strength.
Psa.88.4.kjv: I am counted with them that go down into the pit: I am as a man that hath no strength:

Psa.7.5.bsb: then may my enemy pursue me and overtake me; may he trample me to the ground and leave my honor in the dust. Selah
Psa.7.5.kjv: Let the enemy persecute my soul, and take it; yea, let him tread down my life upon the earth, and lay mine honour in the dust. Selah.

Psa.55.6.bsb: I said, “Oh, that I had wings like a dove! I would fly away and find rest.
Psa.55.6.kjv: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! for then would I fly away, and be at rest.

Psa.48.6.bsb: Trembling seized them there, anguish like a woman in labor.
Psa.48.6.kjv: Fear took hold upon them there, and pain, as of a woman in travail.

Psa.119.53.bsb: Rage has taken hold of me because of the wicked who reject Your law.
Psa.119.53.kjv: Horror hath taken hold upon me because of the wicked that forsake thy law.

Psa.137.9.bsb: Blessed is he who seizes your infants and dashes them against the rocks.
Psa.137.9.kjv: Happy shall he be, that taketh and dasheth thy little ones against the stones.

Psa.22.21.bsb: Save me from the mouth of the lion; at the horns of the wild oxen You have answered me!
Psa.22.21.kjv: Save me from the lion’s mouth: for thou hast heard me from the horns of the unicorns.

Psa.75.4.bsb: I say to the proud, ‘Do not boast,’ and to the wicked, ‘Do not lift up your horn.
Psa.75.4.kjv: I said unto the fools, Deal not foolishly: and to the wicked, Lift not up the horn:

Psa.75.5.bsb: Do not lift up your horn against heaven or speak with an outstretched neck.’”
Psa.75.5.kjv: Lift not up your horn on high: speak not with a stiff neck.

Psa.18.34.bsb: He trains my hands for battle; my arms can bend a bow of bronze.
Psa.18.34.kjv: He teacheth my hands to war, so that a bow of steel is broken by mine arms.

Psa.25.4.bsb: Show me Your ways, O LORD; teach me Your paths.
Psa.25.4.kjv: Shew me thy ways, O Lord; teach me thy paths.

Psa.69.22.bsb: May their table become a snare; may it be a retribution and a trap.
Psa.69.22.kjv: Let their table become a snare before them: and that which should have been for their welfare, let it become a trap.

Psa.68.14.bsb: When the Almighty scattered the kings in the land, it was like the snow falling on Zalmon.
Psa.68.14.kjv: When the Almighty scattered kings in it, it was white as snow in Salmon.

Psa.36.3.bsb: The words of his mouth are wicked and deceitful; he has ceased to be wise and well-doing.
Psa.36.3.kjv: The words of his mouth are iniquity and deceit: he hath left off to be wise, and to do good.

Psa.64.9.bsb: Then all mankind will fear and proclaim the work of God; so they will ponder what He has done.
Psa.64.9.kjv: And all men shall fear, and shall declare the work of God; for they shall wisely consider of his doing.

Psa.47.9.bsb: The nobles of the nations have assembled as the people of the God of Abraham; for the shields of the earth belong to God; He is highly exalted.
Psa.47.9.kjv: The princes of the people are gathered together, even the people of the God of Abraham: for the shields of the earth belong unto God: he is greatly exalted.

Psa.83.11.bsb: Make their nobles like Oreb and Zeeb, and all their princes like Zebah and Zalmunna,
Psa.83.11.kjv: Make their nobles like Oreb, and like Zeeb: yea, all their princes as Zebah, and as Zalmunna:

Psa.40.13.bsb: Be pleased, O LORD, to deliver me; hurry, O LORD, to help me.
Psa.40.13.kjv: Be pleased, O Lord, to deliver me: O Lord, make haste to help me.

Psa.49.13.bsb: This is the fate of the foolish and their followers who endorse their sayings. Selah
Psa.49.13.kjv: This their way is their folly: yet their posterity approve their sayings. Selah.

Psa.50.18.bsb: When you see a thief, you befriend him, and throw in your lot with adulterers.
Psa.50.18.kjv: When thou sawest a thief, then thou consentedst with him, and hast been partaker with adulterers.

Psa.85.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. You showed favor to Your land, O LORD; You restored Jacob from captivity.
Psa.85.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. Lord, thou hast been favourable unto thy land: thou hast brought back the captivity of Jacob.

Psa.34.12.bsb: Who is the man who delights in life, who desires to see good days?
Psa.34.12.kjv: What man is he that desireth life, and loveth many days, that he may see good?

Psa.9.5.bsb: You have rebuked the nations; You have destroyed the wicked; You have erased their name forever and ever.
Psa.9.5.kjv: Thou hast rebuked the heathen, thou hast destroyed the wicked, thou hast put out their name for ever and ever.

Psa.9.18.bsb: For the needy will not always be forgotten; nor the hope of the oppressed forever dashed.
Psa.9.18.kjv: For the needy shall not alway be forgotten: the expectation of the poor shall not perish for ever.

Psa.71.9.bsb: Do not discard me in my old age; do not forsake me when my strength fails.
Psa.71.9.kjv: Cast me not off in the time of old age; forsake me not when my strength faileth.

Psa.102.23.bsb: He has broken my strength on the way; He has cut short my days.
Psa.102.23.kjv: He weakened my strength in the way; he shortened my days.

Psa.7.3.bsb: O LORD my God, if I have done this, if injustice is on my hands,
Psa.7.3.kjv: O Lord my God, if I have done this; if there be iniquity in my hands;

Psa.9.6.bsb: The enemy has come to eternal ruin, and You have uprooted their cities; the very memory of them has vanished.
Psa.9.6.kjv: O thou enemy, destructions are come to a perpetual end: and thou hast destroyed cities; their memorial is perished with them.

Psa.13.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. How long, O LORD? Will You forget me forever? How long will You hide Your face from me?
Psa.13.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. How long wilt thou forget me, O Lord? for ever? how long wilt thou hide thy face from me?

Psa.52.5.bsb: Surely God will bring you down to everlasting ruin; He will snatch you up and tear you away from your tent; He will uproot you from the land of the living. Selah
Psa.52.5.kjv: God shall likewise destroy thee for ever, he shall take thee away, and pluck thee out of thy dwelling place, and root thee out of the land of the living. Selah.

Psa.20.8.bsb: They collapse and fall, but we rise up and stand firm.
Psa.20.8.kjv: They are brought down and fallen: but we are risen, and stand upright.

Psa.102.11.bsb: My days are like lengthening shadows, and I wither away like grass.
Psa.102.11.kjv: My days are like a shadow that declineth; and I am withered like grass.

Psa.66.10.bsb: For You, O God, have tested us; You have refined us like silver.
Psa.66.10.kjv: For thou, O God, hast proved us: thou hast tried us, as silver is tried.

Psa.75.2.bsb: “When I choose a time, I will judge fairly.
Psa.75.2.kjv: When I shall receive the congregation I will judge uprightly.

Psa.25.21.bsb: May integrity and uprightness preserve me, because I wait for You.
Psa.25.21.kjv: Let integrity and uprightness preserve me; for I wait on thee.

Psa.81.5.bsb: He ordained it as a testimony for Joseph when he went out over the land of Egypt, where I heard an unfamiliar language:
Psa.81.5.kjv: This he ordained in Joseph for a testimony, when he went out through the land of Egypt: where I heard a language that I understood not.

Psa.119.36.bsb: Turn my heart to Your testimonies and not to covetous gain.
Psa.119.36.kjv: Incline my heart unto thy testimonies, and not to covetousness.

Psa.119.88.bsb: Revive me according to Your loving devotion, that I may obey the testimony of Your mouth.
Psa.119.88.kjv: Quicken me after thy lovingkindness; so shall I keep the testimony of thy mouth.

Psa.32.4.bsb: For day and night Your hand was heavy upon me; my strength was drained as in the summer heat. Selah
Psa.32.4.kjv: For day and night thy hand was heavy upon me: my moisture is turned into the drought of summer. Selah.

Psa.83.6.bsb: the tents of Edom and the Ishmaelites, of Moab and the Hagrites,
Psa.83.6.kjv: The tabernacles of Edom, and the Ishmaelites; of Moab, and the Hagarenes;

Psa.22.9.bsb: Yet You brought me forth from the womb; You made me secure at my mother’s breast.
Psa.22.9.kjv: But thou art he that took me out of the womb: thou didst make me hope when I was upon my mother’s breasts.

Psa.27.3.bsb: Though an army encamps around me, my heart will not fear; though a war breaks out against me, I will keep my trust.
Psa.27.3.kjv: Though an host should encamp against me, my heart shall not fear: though war should rise against me, in this will I be confident.

Psa.44.6.bsb: For I do not trust in my bow, nor does my sword save me.
Psa.44.6.kjv: For I will not trust in my bow, neither shall my sword save me.

Psa.62.10.bsb: Place no trust in extortion or false hope in stolen goods. If your riches increase, do not set your heart upon them.
Psa.62.10.kjv: Trust not in oppression, and become not vain in robbery: if riches increase, set not your heart upon them.

Psa.7.6.bsb: Arise, O LORD, in Your anger; rise up against the fury of my enemies. Awake, my God, and ordain judgment.
Psa.7.6.kjv: Arise, O Lord, in thine anger, lift up thyself because of the rage of mine enemies: and awake for me to the judgment that thou hast commanded.

Psa.60.7.bsb: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
Psa.60.7.kjv: Gilead is mine, and Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

Psa.108.8.bsb: Gilead is Mine, and Manasseh is Mine; Ephraim is My helmet, Judah is My scepter.
Psa.108.8.kjv: Gilead is mine; Manasseh is mine; Ephraim also is the strength of mine head; Judah is my lawgiver;

Psa.66.6.bsb: He turned the sea into dry land; they passed through the waters on foot; there we rejoiced in Him.
Psa.66.6.kjv: He turned the sea into dry land: they went through the flood on foot: there did we rejoice in him.

Psa.93.3.bsb: The floodwaters have risen, O LORD; the rivers have raised their voice; the seas lift up their pounding waves.
Psa.93.3.kjv: The floods have lifted up, O Lord, the floods have lifted up their voice; the floods lift up their waves.

Psa.106.11.bsb: The waters covered their foes; not one of them remained.
Psa.106.11.kjv: And the waters covered their enemies: there was not one of them left.

Psa.68.27.bsb: There is Benjamin, the youngest, ruling them, the princes of Judah in their company, the princes of Zebulun and of Naphtali.
Psa.68.27.kjv: There is little Benjamin with their ruler, the princes of Judah and their council, the princes of Zebulun, and the princes of Naphtali.

Psa.68.15.bsb: A mountain of God is Mount Bashan; a mountain of many peaks is Mount Bashan.
Psa.68.15.kjv: The hill of God is as the hill of Bashan; an high hill as the hill of Bashan.

Psa.50.1.bsb: A Psalm of Asaph. The Mighty One, God the LORD, speaks and summons the earth from where the sun rises to where it sets.
Psa.50.1.kjv: A Psalm of Asaph. The mighty God, even the Lord, hath spoken, and called the earth from the rising of the sun unto the going down thereof.

Psa.31.13.bsb: For I hear the slander of many; there is terror on every side. They conspire against me and plot to take my life.
Psa.31.13.kjv: For I have heard the slander of many: fear was on every side: while they took counsel together against me, they devised to take away my life.

Psa.119.75.bsb: I know, O LORD, that Your judgments are righteous, and that in faithfulness You have afflicted me.
Psa.119.75.kjv: I know, O Lord, that thy judgments are right, and that thou in faithfulness hast afflicted me.

Psa.55.7.bsb: How far away I would flee! In the wilderness I would remain. Selah
Psa.55.7.kjv: Lo, then would I wander far off, and remain in the wilderness. Selah.

Psa.60.3.bsb: You have shown Your people hardship; we are staggered from the wine You made us drink.
Psa.60.3.kjv: Thou hast shewed thy people hard things: thou hast made us to drink the wine of astonishment.

Psa.13.2.bsb: How long must I wrestle in my soul, with sorrow in my heart each day? How long will my enemy dominate me?
Psa.13.2.kjv: How long shall I take counsel in my soul, having sorrow in my heart daily? how long shall mine enemy be exalted over me?

Psa.55.20.bsb: My companion attacks his friends; he violates his covenant.
Psa.55.20.kjv: He hath put forth his hands against such as be at peace with him: he hath broken his covenant.

Psa.89.39.bsb: You have renounced the covenant with Your servant and sullied his crown in the dust.
Psa.89.39.kjv: Thou hast made void the covenant of thy servant: thou hast profaned his crown by casting it to the ground.

Psa.119.32.bsb: I run in the path of Your commandments, for You will enlarge my heart.
Psa.119.32.kjv: I will run the way of thy commandments, when thou shalt enlarge my heart.

Psa.18.44.bsb: When they hear me, they obey me; foreigners cower before me.
Psa.18.44.kjv: As soon as they hear of me, they shall obey me: the strangers shall submit themselves unto me.

Psa.44.11.bsb: You have given us up as sheep to be devoured; You have scattered us among the nations.
Psa.44.11.kjv: Thou hast given us like sheep appointed for meat; and hast scattered us among the heathen.

Psa.74.14.bsb: You crushed the heads of Leviathan; You fed him to the creatures of the desert.
Psa.74.14.kjv: Thou brakest the heads of leviathan in pieces, and gavest him to be meat to the people inhabiting the wilderness.

Psa.79.2.bsb: They have given the corpses of Your servants as food to the birds of the air, the flesh of Your saints to the beasts of the earth.
Psa.79.2.kjv: The dead bodies of thy servants have they given to be meat unto the fowls of the heaven, the flesh of thy saints unto the beasts of the earth.

Psa.26.3.bsb: For Your loving devotion is before my eyes, and I have walked in Your truth.
Psa.26.3.kjv: For thy lovingkindness is before mine eyes: and I have walked in thy truth.

Psa.106.3.bsb: Blessed are those who uphold justice, who practice righteousness at all times.
Psa.106.3.kjv: Blessed are they that keep judgment, and he that doeth righteousness at all times.

Psa.137.8.bsb: O Daughter of Babylon, doomed to destruction, blessed is he who repays you as you have done to us.
Psa.137.8.kjv: O daughter of Babylon, who art to be destroyed; happy shall he be, that rewardeth thee as thou hast served us.

Psa.40.6.bsb: Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but my ears You have opened. Burnt offerings and sin offerings You did not require.
Psa.40.6.kjv: Sacrifice and offering thou didst not desire; mine ears hast thou opened: burnt offering and sin offering hast thou not required.

Psa.68.30.bsb: Rebuke the beast in the reeds, the herd of bulls among the calves of the nations, until it submits, bringing bars of silver. Scatter the nations who delight in war.
Psa.68.30.kjv: Rebuke the company of spearmen, the multitude of the bulls, with the calves of the people, till every one submit himself with pieces of silver: scatter thou the people that delight in war.

Psa.16.3.bsb: As for the saints in the land, they are the excellence in whom all my delight resides.
Psa.16.3.kjv: But to the saints that are in the earth, and to the excellent, in whom is all my delight.

Psa.25.16.bsb: Turn to me and be gracious, for I am lonely and afflicted.
Psa.25.16.kjv: Turn thee unto me, and have mercy upon me; for I am desolate and afflicted.

Psa.119.132.bsb: Turn to me and show me mercy, as You do to those who love Your name.
Psa.119.132.kjv: Look thou upon me, and be merciful unto me, as thou usest to do unto those that love thy name.

Psa.44.25.bsb: For our soul has sunk to the dust; our bodies cling to the earth.
Psa.44.25.kjv: For our soul is bowed down to the dust: our belly cleaveth unto the earth.

Psa.102.5.bsb: Through my loud groaning my skin hangs on my bones.
Psa.102.5.kjv: By reason of the voice of my groaning my bones cleave to my skin.

Psa.58.10.bsb: The righteous will rejoice when they see they are avenged; they will wash their feet in the blood of the wicked.
Psa.58.10.kjv: The righteous shall rejoice when he seeth the vengeance: he shall wash his feet in the blood of the wicked.

Psa.85.13.bsb: Righteousness will go before Him to prepare the way for His steps.
Psa.85.13.kjv: Righteousness shall go before him; and shall set us in the way of his steps.

Psa.18.22.bsb: For all His ordinances are before me; I have not disregarded His statutes.
Psa.18.22.kjv: For all his judgments were before me, and I did not put away his statutes from me.

Psa.109.6.bsb: Set over him a wicked man; let an accuser stand at his right hand.
Psa.109.6.kjv: Set thou a wicked man over him: and let Satan stand at his right hand.

Psa.60.8.bsb: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
Psa.60.8.kjv: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe: Philistia, triumph thou because of me.

Psa.108.9.bsb: Moab is My washbasin; upon Edom I toss My sandal; over Philistia I shout in triumph.”
Psa.108.9.kjv: Moab is my washpot; over Edom will I cast out my shoe; over Philistia will I triumph.

Psa.137.7.bsb: Remember, O LORD, the sons of Edom on the day Jerusalem fell: “Destroy it,” they said, “tear it down to its foundations!”
Psa.137.7.kjv: Remember, O Lord, the children of Edom in the day of Jerusalem; who said, Rase it, rase it, even to the foundation thereof.

Psa.83.9.bsb: Do to them as You did to Midian, as to Sisera and Jabin at the River Kishon,
Psa.83.9.kjv: Do unto them as unto the Midianites; as to Sisera, as to Jabin, at the brook of Kison:

Psa.7.4.bsb: if I have rewarded my ally with evil, if I have plundered my foe without cause,
Psa.7.4.kjv: If I have rewarded evil unto him that was at peace with me; (yea, I have delivered him that without cause is mine enemy:)

Psa.18.20.bsb: The LORD has rewarded me according to my righteousness; He has repaid me according to the cleanness of my hands.
Psa.18.20.kjv: The Lord rewarded me according to my righteousness; according to the cleanness of my hands hath he recompensed me.

Psa.119.17.bsb: Deal bountifully with Your servant, that I may live and keep Your word.
Psa.119.17.kjv: ג GIMEL. Deal bountifully with thy servant, that I may live, and keep thy word.

Psa.17.10.bsb: They have closed their callous hearts; their mouths speak with arrogance.
Psa.17.10.kjv: They are inclosed in their own fat: with their mouth they speak proudly.

Psa.31.8.bsb: You have not delivered me to the enemy; You have set my feet in the open.
Psa.31.8.kjv: And hast not shut me up into the hand of the enemy: thou hast set my feet in a large room.

Psa.81.6.bsb: “I relieved his shoulder of the burden; his hands were freed from the basket.
Psa.81.6.kjv: I removed his shoulder from the burden: his hands were delivered from the pots.

Psa.11.2.bsb: For behold, the wicked bend their bows. They set their arrow on the string to shoot from the shadows at the upright in heart.
Psa.11.2.kjv: For, lo, the wicked bend their bow, they make ready their arrow upon the string, that they may privily shoot at the upright in heart.

Psa.36.10.bsb: Extend Your loving devotion to those who know You, and Your righteousness to the upright in heart.
Psa.36.10.kjv: O continue thy lovingkindness unto them that know thee; and thy righteousness to the upright in heart.

Psa.125.4.bsb: Do good, O LORD, to those who are good, and to the upright in heart.
Psa.125.4.kjv: Do good, O Lord, unto those that be good, and to them that are upright in their hearts.

Psa.17.11.bsb: They have tracked us down, and now surround us; their eyes are set to cast us to the ground,
Psa.17.11.kjv: They have now compassed us in our steps: they have set their eyes bowing down to the earth;

Psa.21.9.bsb: You will place them in a fiery furnace at the time of Your appearing. In His wrath the LORD will engulf them, and the fire will consume them.
Psa.21.9.kjv: Thou shalt make them as a fiery oven in the time of thine anger: the Lord shall swallow them up in his wrath, and the fire shall devour them.

Psa.21.12.bsb: For You will put them to flight when Your bow is trained upon them.
Psa.21.12.kjv: Therefore shalt thou make them turn their back, when thou shalt make ready thine arrows upon thy strings against the face of them.

Psa.88.6.bsb: You have laid me in the lowest Pit, in the darkest of the depths.
Psa.88.6.kjv: Thou hast laid me in the lowest pit, in darkness, in the deeps.

Psa.88.8.bsb: You have removed my friends from me; You have made me repulsive to them; I am confined and cannot escape.
Psa.88.8.kjv: Thou hast put away mine acquaintance far from me; thou hast made me an abomination unto them: I am shut up, and I cannot come forth.

Psa.88.7.bsb: Your wrath weighs heavily upon me; all Your waves have submerged me. Selah
Psa.88.7.kjv: Thy wrath lieth hard upon me, and thou hast afflicted me with all thy waves. Selah.

Psa.94.5.bsb: They crush Your people, O LORD; they oppress Your heritage.
Psa.94.5.kjv: They break in pieces thy people, O Lord, and afflict thine heritage.

Psa.119.107.bsb: I am severely afflicted, O LORD; revive me through Your word.
Psa.119.107.kjv: I am afflicted very much: quicken me, O Lord, according unto thy word.

Psa.83.3.bsb: With cunning they scheme against Your people and conspire against those You cherish,
Psa.83.3.kjv: They have taken crafty counsel against thy people, and consulted against thy hidden ones.

Psa.83.5.bsb: For with one mind they plot together; they form an alliance against You—
Psa.83.5.kjv: For they have consulted together with one consent: they are confederate against thee:

Psa.20.4.bsb: May He give you the desires of your heart and make all your plans succeed.
Psa.20.4.kjv: Grant thee according to thine own heart, and fulfil all thy counsel.

Psa.66.11.bsb: You led us into the net; You laid burdens on our backs.
Psa.66.11.kjv: Thou broughtest us into the net; thou laidst affliction upon our loins.

Psa.37.38.bsb: But the transgressors will all be destroyed; the future of the wicked will be cut off.
Psa.37.38.kjv: But the transgressors shall be destroyed together: the end of the wicked shall be cut off.

Psa.1.5.bsb: Therefore the wicked will not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the assembly of the righteous.
Psa.1.5.kjv: Therefore the ungodly shall not stand in the judgment, nor sinners in the congregation of the righteous.

Psa.7.7.bsb: Let the assembled peoples gather around You; take Your seat over them on high.
Psa.7.7.kjv: So shall the congregation of the people compass thee about: for their sakes therefore return thou on high.

Psa.106.19.bsb: At Horeb they made a calf and worshiped a molten image.
Psa.106.19.kjv: They made a calf in Horeb, and worshipped the molten image.

Psa.22.17.bsb: I can count all my bones; they stare and gloat over me.
Psa.22.17.kjv: I may tell all my bones: they look and stare upon me.

Psa.42.10.bsb: Like the crushing of my bones, my enemies taunt me, while they say to me all day long, “Where is your God?”
Psa.42.10.kjv: As with a sword in my bones, mine enemies reproach me; while they say daily unto me, Where is thy God?

Psa.53.5.bsb: There they are, overwhelmed with dread, where there was nothing to fear. For God has scattered the bones of those who besieged you. You put them to shame, for God has despised them.
Psa.53.5.kjv: There were they in great fear, where no fear was: for God hath scattered the bones of him that encampeth against thee: thou hast put them to shame, because God hath despised them.

Psa.46.9.bsb: He makes wars to cease throughout the earth; He breaks the bow and shatters the spear; He burns the shields in the fire.
Psa.46.9.kjv: He maketh wars to cease unto the end of the earth; he breaketh the bow, and cutteth the spear in sunder; he burneth the chariot in the fire.

Psa.74.8.bsb: They said in their hearts, “We will crush them completely.” They burned down every place where God met us in the land.
Psa.74.8.kjv: They said in their hearts, Let us destroy them together: they have burned up all the synagogues of God in the land.

Psa.106.33.bsb: For they rebelled against His Spirit, and Moses spoke rashly with his lips.
Psa.106.33.kjv: Because they provoked his spirit, so that he spake unadvisedly with his lips.

Psa.7.2.bsb: or they will shred my soul like a lion and tear me to pieces with no one to rescue me.
Psa.7.2.kjv: Lest he tear my soul like a lion, rending it in pieces, while there is none to deliver.

Psa.17.12.bsb: like a lion greedy for prey, like a young lion lurking in ambush.
Psa.17.12.kjv: Like as a lion that is greedy of his prey, and as it were a young lion lurking in secret places.

Psa.2.3.bsb: “Let us break Their chains and cast away Their cords.”
Psa.2.3.kjv: Let us break their bands asunder, and cast away their cords from us.

Psa.22.10.bsb: From birth I was cast upon You; from my mother’s womb You have been my God.
Psa.22.10.kjv: I was cast upon thee from the womb: thou art my God from my mother’s belly.

Psa.102.10.bsb: because of Your indignation and wrath, for You have picked me up and cast me aside.
Psa.102.10.kjv: Because of thine indignation and thy wrath: for thou hast lifted me up, and cast me down.

Psa.3.7.bsb: Arise, O LORD! Save me, O my God! Strike all my enemies on the jaw; break the teeth of the wicked.
Psa.3.7.kjv: Arise, O Lord; save me, O my God: for thou hast smitten all mine enemies upon the cheek bone; thou hast broken the teeth of the ungodly.

Psa.37.15.bsb: But their swords will pierce their own hearts, and their bows will be broken.
Psa.37.15.kjv: Their sword shall enter into their own heart, and their bows shall be broken.

Psa.48.7.bsb: With a wind from the east You wrecked the ships of Tarshish.
Psa.48.7.kjv: Thou breakest the ships of Tarshish with an east wind.

Psa.76.3.bsb: There He shattered the flaming arrows, the shield and sword and weapons of war. Selah
Psa.76.3.kjv: There brake he the arrows of the bow, the shield, and the sword, and the battle. Selah.

Psa.83.4.bsb: saying, “Come, let us erase them as a nation; may the name of Israel be remembered no more.”
Psa.83.4.kjv: They have said, Come, and let us cut them off from being a nation; that the name of Israel may be no more in remembrance.

Psa.83.10.bsb: who perished at Endor and became like dung on the ground.
Psa.83.10.kjv: Which perished at En–dor: they became as dung for the earth.

Psa.36.11.bsb: Let not the foot of the proud come against me, nor the hand of the wicked drive me away.
Psa.36.11.kjv: Let not the foot of pride come against me, and let not the hand of the wicked remove me.

Psa.106.27.bsb: to disperse their offspring among the nations and scatter them throughout the lands.
Psa.106.27.kjv: To overthrow their seed also among the nations, and to scatter them in the lands.

Psa.101.5.bsb: Whoever slanders his neighbor in secret, I will put to silence; the one with haughty eyes and a proud heart, I will not endure.
Psa.101.5.kjv: Whoso privily slandereth his neighbour, him will I cut off: him that hath an high look and a proud heart will not I suffer.

Psa.138.6.bsb: Though the LORD is on high, He attends to the lowly; but the proud He knows from afar.
Psa.138.6.kjv: Though the Lord be high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly: but the proud he knoweth afar off.

Psa.142.4.bsb: Look to my right and see; no one attends to me. There is no refuge for me; no one cares for my soul.
Psa.142.4.kjv: I looked on my right hand, and beheld, but there was no man that would know me: refuge failed me; no man cared for my soul.

Psa.39.3.bsb: My heart grew hot within me; as I mused, the fire burned. Then I spoke with my tongue:
Psa.39.3.kjv: My heart was hot within me, while I was musing the fire burned: then spake I with my tongue,

Psa.104.35.bsb: May sinners vanish from the earth and the wicked be no more. Bless the LORD, O my soul. Hallelujah!
Psa.104.35.kjv: Let the sinners be consumed out of the earth, and let the wicked be no more. Bless thou the Lord, O my soul. Praise ye the Lord.

Psa.22.20.bsb: Deliver my soul from the sword, my precious life from the power of wild dogs.
Psa.22.20.kjv: Deliver my soul from the sword; my darling from the power of the dog.

Psa.68.23.bsb: that your foot may be dipped in the blood of your foes—the tongues of your dogs in the same.”
Psa.68.23.kjv: That thy foot may be dipped in the blood of thine enemies, and the tongue of thy dogs in the same.

Psa.26.10.bsb: in whose hands are wicked schemes, whose right hands are full of bribes.
Psa.26.10.kjv: In whose hands is mischief, and their right hand is full of bribes.

Psa.119.126.bsb: It is time for the LORD to act, for they have broken Your law.
Psa.119.126.kjv: It is time for thee, Lord, to work: for they have made void thy law.

Psa.94.21.bsb: They band together against the righteous and condemn the innocent to death.
Psa.94.21.kjv: They gather themselves together against the soul of the righteous, and condemn the innocent blood.

Psa.6.7.bsb: My eyes fail from grief; they grow dim because of all my foes.
Psa.6.7.kjv: Mine eye is consumed because of grief; it waxeth old because of all mine enemies.

Psa.31.9.bsb: Be merciful to me, O LORD, for I am in distress; my eyes fail from sorrow, my soul and body as well.
Psa.31.9.kjv: Have mercy upon me, O Lord, for I am in trouble: mine eye is consumed with grief, yea, my soul and my belly.

Psa.18.42.bsb: I ground them as dust in the face of the wind; I trampled them like mud in the streets.
Psa.18.42.kjv: Then did I beat them small as the dust before the wind: I did cast them out as the dirt in the streets.

Psa.59.12.bsb: By the sins of their mouths and the words of their lips, let them be trapped in their pride, in the curses and lies they utter.
Psa.59.12.kjv: For the sin of their mouth and the words of their lips let them even be taken in their pride: and for cursing and lying which they speak.

Psa.122.7.bsb: May there be peace within your walls, and prosperity inside your fortresses.”
Psa.122.7.kjv: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces.

Psa.77.15.bsb: With power You redeemed Your people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah
Psa.77.15.kjv: Thou hast with thine arm redeemed thy people, the sons of Jacob and Joseph. Selah.

Psa.106.10.bsb: He saved them from the hand that hated them; He redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.
Psa.106.10.kjv: And he saved them from the hand of him that hated them, and redeemed them from the hand of the enemy.

Psa.119.154.bsb: Defend my cause and redeem me; revive me according to Your word.
Psa.119.154.kjv: Plead my cause, and deliver me: quicken me according to thy word.

Psa.39.5.bsb: You, indeed, have made my days as handbreadths, and my lifetime as nothing before You. Truly each man at his best exists as but a breath. Selah
Psa.39.5.kjv: Behold, thou hast made my days as an handbreadth; and mine age is as nothing before thee: verily every man at his best state is altogether vanity. Selah.

Psa.62.9.bsb: Lowborn men are but a vapor; the exalted are but a lie. Weighed on the scale, they go up; together they are but a vapor.
Psa.62.9.kjv: Surely men of low degree are vanity, and men of high degree are a lie: to be laid in the balance, they are altogether lighter than vanity.

Psa.6.6.bsb: I am weary from groaning; all night I flood my bed with weeping and drench my couch with tears.
Psa.6.6.kjv: I am weary with my groaning; all the night make I my bed to swim; I water my couch with my tears.

Psa.60.4.bsb: You have raised a banner for those who fear You, that they may flee the bow. Selah
Psa.60.4.kjv: Thou hast given a banner to them that fear thee, that it may be displayed because of the truth. Selah.

Psa.119.79.bsb: May those who fear You turn to me, those who know Your testimonies.
Psa.119.79.kjv: Let those that fear thee turn unto me, and those that have known thy testimonies.

Psa.129.1.bsb: A song of ascents. Many a time they have persecuted me from my youth—let Israel now declare—
Psa.129.1.kjv: A Song of degrees. Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth, may Israel now say:

Psa.129.2.bsb: many a time they have persecuted me from my youth, but they have not prevailed against me.
Psa.129.2.kjv: Many a time have they afflicted me from my youth: yet they have not prevailed against me.

Psa.39.2.bsb: I was speechless and still; I remained silent, even from speaking good, and my sorrow was stirred.
Psa.39.2.kjv: I was dumb with silence, I held my peace, even from good; and my sorrow was stirred.

Psa.37.6.bsb: He will bring forth your righteousness like the dawn, your justice like the noonday sun.
Psa.37.6.kjv: And he shall bring forth thy righteousness as the light, and thy judgment as the noonday.

Psa.64.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. Hear, O God, my voice of complaint; preserve my life from dread of the enemy.
Psa.64.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. Hear my voice, O God, in my prayer: preserve my life from fear of the enemy.

Psa.11.3.bsb: If the foundations are destroyed, what can the righteous do?”
Psa.11.3.kjv: If the foundations be destroyed, what can the righteous do?

Psa.28.5.bsb: Since they show no regard for the works of the LORD or what His hands have done, He will tear them down and never rebuild them.
Psa.28.5.kjv: Because they regard not the works of the Lord, nor the operation of his hands, he shall destroy them, and not build them up.

Psa.58.6.bsb: O God, shatter their teeth in their mouths; O LORD, tear out the fangs of the lions.
Psa.58.6.kjv: Break their teeth, O God, in their mouth: break out the great teeth of the young lions, O Lord.

Psa.13.3.bsb: Consider me and respond, O LORD my God. Give light to my eyes, lest I sleep in death,
