Psa.13.3.kjv: Consider and hear me, O Lord my God: lighten mine eyes, lest I sleep the sleep of death;

Psa.35.14.bsb: I paced about as for my friend or brother; I was bowed down with grief, like one mourning for his mother.
Psa.35.14.kjv: I behaved myself as though he had been my friend or brother: I bowed down heavily, as one that mourneth for his mother.

Psa.42.9.bsb: I say to God my Rock, “Why have You forgotten me? Why must I walk in sorrow because of the enemy’s oppression?”
Psa.42.9.kjv: I will say unto God my rock, Why hast thou forgotten me? why go I mourning because of the oppression of the enemy?

Psa.120.4.bsb: Sharp arrows will come from the warrior, with burning coals of the broom tree!
Psa.120.4.kjv: Sharp arrows of the mighty, with coals of juniper.

Psa.18.39.bsb: You have armed me with strength for battle; You have subdued my foes beneath me.
Psa.18.39.kjv: For thou hast girded me with strength unto the battle: thou hast subdued under me those that rose up against me.

Psa.9.17.bsb: The wicked will return to Sheol—all the nations who forget God.
Psa.9.17.kjv: The wicked shall be turned into hell, and all the nations that forget God.

Psa.21.8.bsb: Your hand will apprehend all Your enemies; Your right hand will seize those who hate You.
Psa.21.8.kjv: Thine hand shall find out all thine enemies: thy right hand shall find out those that hate thee.

Psa.60.5.bsb: Respond and save us with Your right hand, that Your beloved may be delivered.
Psa.60.5.kjv: That thy beloved may be delivered; save with thy right hand, and hear me.

Psa.89.42.bsb: You have exalted the right hand of his foes; You have made all his enemies rejoice.
Psa.89.42.kjv: Thou hast set up the right hand of his adversaries; thou hast made all his enemies to rejoice.

Psa.109.31.bsb: For He stands at the right hand of the needy one, to save him from the condemners of his soul.
Psa.109.31.kjv: For he shall stand at the right hand of the poor, to save him from those that condemn his soul.

Psa.81.8.bsb: Hear, O My people, and I will warn you: O Israel, if only you would listen to Me!
Psa.81.8.kjv: Hear, O my people, and I will testify unto thee: O Israel, if thou wilt hearken unto me;

Psa.18.37.bsb: I pursued my enemies and overtook them; I did not turn back until they were consumed.
Psa.18.37.kjv: I have pursued mine enemies, and overtaken them: neither did I turn again till they were consumed.

Psa.38.20.bsb: Those who repay my good with evil attack me for pursuing the good.
Psa.38.20.kjv: They also that render evil for good are mine adversaries; because I follow the thing that good is.

Psa.64.7.bsb: But God will shoot them with arrows; suddenly they will be wounded.
Psa.64.7.kjv: But God shall shoot at them with an arrow; suddenly shall they be wounded.

Psa.81.11.bsb: But My people would not listen to Me, and Israel would not obey Me.
Psa.81.11.kjv: But my people would not hearken to my voice; and Israel would none of me.

Psa.27.12.bsb: Do not hand me over to the will of my foes, for false witnesses rise up against me, breathing out violence.
Psa.27.12.kjv: Deliver me not over unto the will of mine enemies: for false witnesses are risen up against me, and such as breathe out cruelty.

Psa.52.3.bsb: You love evil more than good, falsehood more than speaking truth. Selah
Psa.52.3.kjv: Thou lovest evil more than good; and lying rather than to speak righteousness. Selah.

Psa.63.11.bsb: But the king will rejoice in God; all who swear by Him will exult, for the mouths of liars will be shut.
Psa.63.11.kjv: But the king shall rejoice in God; every one that sweareth by him shall glory: but the mouth of them that speak lies shall be stopped.

Psa.119.29.bsb: Remove me from the path of deceit and graciously grant me Your law.
Psa.119.29.kjv: Remove from me the way of lying: and grant me thy law graciously.

Psa.119.69.bsb: Though the arrogant have smeared me with lies, I keep Your precepts with all my heart.
Psa.119.69.kjv: The proud have forged a lie against me: but I will keep thy precepts with my whole heart.

Psa.28.3.bsb: Do not drag me away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, who speak peace to their neighbors while malice is in their hearts.
Psa.28.3.kjv: Draw me not away with the wicked, and with the workers of iniquity, which speak peace to their neighbours, but mischief is in their hearts.

Psa.7.12.bsb: If one does not repent, God will sharpen His sword; He has bent and strung His bow.
Psa.7.12.kjv: If he turn not, he will whet his sword; he hath bent his bow, and made it ready.

Psa.119.169.bsb: May my cry come before You, O LORD; give me understanding according to Your word.
Psa.119.169.kjv: ת TAU. Let my cry come near before thee, O Lord: give me understanding according to thy word.

Psa.69.2.bsb: I have sunk into the miry depths, where there is no footing; I have drifted into deep waters, where the flood engulfs me.
Psa.69.2.kjv: I sink in deep mire, where there is no standing: I am come into deep waters, where the floods overflow me.

Psa.69.15.bsb: Do not let the floods engulf me or the depths swallow me up; let not the Pit close its mouth over me.
Psa.69.15.kjv: Let not the waterflood overflow me, neither let the deep swallow me up, and let not the pit shut her mouth upon me.

Psa.25.19.bsb: Consider my enemies, for they are many, and they hate me with vicious hatred.
Psa.25.19.kjv: Consider mine enemies; for they are many; and they hate me with cruel hatred.

Psa.44.10.bsb: You have made us retreat from the foe, and those who hate us have plundered us.
Psa.44.10.kjv: Thou makest us to turn back from the enemy: and they which hate us spoil for themselves.

Psa.69.14.bsb: Rescue me from the mire and do not let me sink; deliver me from my foes and out of the deep waters.
Psa.69.14.kjv: Deliver me out of the mire, and let me not sink: let me be delivered from them that hate me, and out of the deep waters.

Psa.69.17.bsb: Hide not Your face from Your servant, for I am in distress. Answer me quickly!
Psa.69.17.kjv: And hide not thy face from thy servant; for I am in trouble: hear me speedily.

Psa.143.7.bsb: Answer me quickly, O LORD; my spirit fails. Do not hide Your face from me, or I will be like those who descend to the Pit.
Psa.143.7.kjv: Hear me speedily, O Lord: my spirit faileth: hide not thy face from me, lest I be like unto them that go down into the pit.

Psa.129.3.bsb: The plowmen plowed over my back; they made their furrows long.
Psa.129.3.kjv: The plowers plowed upon my back: they made long their furrows.

Psa.49.3.bsb: My mouth will impart wisdom, and the meditation of my heart will bring understanding.
Psa.49.3.kjv: My mouth shall speak of wisdom; and the meditation of my heart shall be of understanding.

Psa.74.6.bsb: and smashing all the carvings with hatchets and picks.
Psa.74.6.kjv: But now they break down the carved work thereof at once with axes and hammers.

Psa.75.3.bsb: When the earth and all its dwellers quake, it is I who bear up its pillars. Selah
Psa.75.3.kjv: The earth and all the inhabitants thereof are dissolved: I bear up the pillars of it. Selah.

Psa.88.17.bsb: All day long they engulf me like water; they enclose me on every side.
Psa.88.17.kjv: They came round about me daily like water; they compassed me about together.

Psa.126.4.bsb: Restore our captives, O LORD, like streams in the Negev.
Psa.126.4.kjv: Turn again our captivity, O Lord, as the streams in the south.

Psa.44.18.bsb: Our hearts have not turned back; our steps have not strayed from Your path.
Psa.44.18.kjv: Our heart is not turned back, neither have our steps declined from thy way;

Psa.11.6.bsb: On the wicked He will rain down fiery coals and sulfur; a scorching wind will be their portion.
Psa.11.6.kjv: Upon the wicked he shall rain snares, fire and brimstone, and an horrible tempest: this shall be the portion of their cup.

Psa.102.6.bsb: I am like a desert owl, like an owl among the ruins.
Psa.102.6.kjv: I am like a pelican of the wilderness: I am like an owl of the desert.

Psa.18.45.bsb: Foreigners lose heart and come trembling from their strongholds.
Psa.18.45.kjv: The strangers shall fade away, and be afraid out of their close places.

Psa.38.13.bsb: But like a deaf man, I do not hear; and like a mute man, I do not open my mouth.
Psa.38.13.kjv: But I, as a deaf man, heard not; and I was as a dumb man that openeth not his mouth.

Psa.35.12.bsb: They repay me evil for good, to the bereavement of my soul.
Psa.35.12.kjv: They rewarded me evil for good to the spoiling of my soul.

Psa.41.10.bsb: But You, O LORD, be gracious to me and raise me up, that I may repay them.
Psa.41.10.kjv: But thou, O Lord, be merciful unto me, and raise me up, that I may requite them.

Psa.54.2.bsb: Hear my prayer, O God; listen to the words of my mouth.
Psa.54.2.kjv: Hear my prayer, O God; give ear to the words of my mouth.

Psa.119.170.bsb: May my plea come before You; rescue me according to Your promise.
Psa.119.170.kjv: Let my supplication come before thee: deliver me according to thy word.

Psa.18.21.bsb: For I have kept the ways of the LORD and have not wickedly departed from my God.
Psa.18.21.kjv: For I have kept the ways of the Lord, and have not wickedly departed from my God.

Psa.30.8.bsb: To You, O LORD, I called, and I begged my Lord for mercy:
Psa.30.8.kjv: I cried to thee, O Lord; and unto the Lord I made supplication.

Psa.123.3.bsb: Have mercy on us, O LORD, have mercy, for we have endured much contempt.
Psa.123.3.kjv: Have mercy upon us, O Lord, have mercy upon us: for we are exceedingly filled with contempt.

Psa.119.102.bsb: I have not departed from Your ordinances, for You Yourself have taught me.
Psa.119.102.kjv: I have not departed from thy judgments: for thou hast taught me.

Psa.31.11.bsb: Among all my enemies I am a disgrace, and among my neighbors even more. I am dreaded by my friends—they flee when they see me on the street.
Psa.31.11.kjv: I was a reproach among all mine enemies, but especially among my neighbours, and a fear to mine acquaintance: they that did see me without fled from me.

Psa.74.4.bsb: Your foes have roared within Your meeting place; they have unfurled their banners as signs,
Psa.74.4.kjv: Thine enemies roar in the midst of thy congregations; they set up their ensigns for signs.

Psa.83.8.bsb: Even Assyria has joined them, lending strength to the sons of Lot. Selah
Psa.83.8.kjv: Assur also is joined with them: they have holpen the children of Lot. Selah.

Psa.36.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David, the servant of the LORD. An oracle is in my heart regarding the transgression of the wicked man: There is no fear of God before his eyes.
Psa.36.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David the servant of the Lord. The transgression of the wicked saith within my heart, that there is no fear of God before his eyes.

Psa.48.4.bsb: For behold, the kings assembled; they all advanced together.
Psa.48.4.kjv: For, lo, the kings were assembled, they passed by together.

Psa.44.14.bsb: You have made us a byword among the nations, a laughingstock among the peoples.
Psa.44.14.kjv: Thou makest us a byword among the heathen, a shaking of the head among the people.

Psa.82.6.bsb: I have said, ‘You are gods; you are all sons of the Most High.’
Psa.82.6.kjv: I have said, Ye are gods; and all of you are children of the most High.

Psa.143.4.bsb: My spirit grows faint within me; my heart is dismayed inside me.
Psa.143.4.kjv: Therefore is my spirit overwhelmed within me; my heart within me is desolate.

Psa.10.12.bsb: Arise, O LORD! Lift up Your hand, O God! Do not forget the helpless.
Psa.10.12.kjv: Arise, O Lord; O God, lift up thine hand: forget not the humble.

Psa.31.12.bsb: I am forgotten like a dead man, out of mind. I am like a broken vessel.
Psa.31.12.kjv: I am forgotten as a dead man out of mind: I am like a broken vessel.

Psa.44.17.bsb: All this has come upon us, though we have not forgotten You or betrayed Your covenant.
Psa.44.17.kjv: All this is come upon us; yet have we not forgotten thee, neither have we dealt falsely in thy covenant.

Psa.50.22.bsb: Now consider this, you who forget God, lest I tear you to pieces, with no one to rescue you:
Psa.50.22.kjv: Now consider this, ye that forget God, lest I tear you in pieces, and there be none to deliver.

Psa.106.21.bsb: They forgot God their Savior, who did great things in Egypt,
Psa.106.21.kjv: They forgat God their saviour, which had done great things in Egypt;

Psa.119.139.bsb: My zeal has consumed me because my foes forget Your words.
Psa.119.139.kjv: My zeal hath consumed me, because mine enemies have forgotten thy words.

Psa.44.22.bsb: Yet for Your sake we face death all day long; we are considered as sheep to be slaughtered.
Psa.44.22.kjv: Yea, for thy sake are we killed all the day long; we are counted as sheep for the slaughter.

Psa.52.2.bsb: Your tongue devises destruction like a sharpened razor, O worker of deceit.
Psa.52.2.kjv: Thy tongue deviseth mischiefs; like a sharp razor, working deceitfully.

Psa.6.3.bsb: My soul is deeply distressed. How long, O LORD, how long?
Psa.6.3.kjv: My soul is also sore vexed: but thou, O Lord, how long?

Psa.82.2.bsb: “How long will you judge unjustly and show partiality to the wicked? Selah
Psa.82.2.kjv: How long will ye judge unjustly, and accept the persons of the wicked? Selah.

Psa.94.3.bsb: How long will the wicked, O LORD, how long will the wicked exult?
Psa.94.3.kjv: Lord, how long shall the wicked, how long shall the wicked triumph?

Psa.20.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of David. May the LORD answer you in the day of trouble; may the name of the God of Jacob protect you.
Psa.20.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David. The Lord hear thee in the day of trouble; the name of the God of Jacob defend thee;

Psa.69.3.bsb: I am weary from my crying; my throat is parched. My eyes fail, looking for my God.
Psa.69.3.kjv: I am weary of my crying: my throat is dried: mine eyes fail while I wait for my God.

Psa.131.3.bsb: O Israel, put your hope in the LORD, both now and forevermore.
Psa.131.3.kjv: Let Israel hope in the Lord from henceforth and for ever.

Psa.36.12.bsb: There the evildoers lie fallen, thrown down and unable to rise.
Psa.36.12.kjv: There are the workers of iniquity fallen: they are cast down, and shall not be able to rise.

Psa.53.4.bsb: Will the workers of iniquity never learn? They devour my people like bread; they refuse to call upon God.
Psa.53.4.kjv: Have the workers of iniquity no knowledge? who eat up my people as they eat bread: they have not called upon God.

Psa.59.2.bsb: Deliver me from workers of iniquity, and save me from men of bloodshed.
Psa.59.2.kjv: Deliver me from the workers of iniquity, and save me from bloody men.

Psa.92.9.bsb: For surely Your enemies, O LORD, surely Your enemies will perish; all evildoers will be scattered.
Psa.92.9.kjv: For, lo, thine enemies, O Lord, for, lo, thine enemies shall perish; all the workers of iniquity shall be scattered.

Psa.94.4.bsb: They pour out arrogant words; all workers of iniquity boast.
Psa.94.4.kjv: How long shall they utter and speak hard things? and all the workers of iniquity boast themselves?

Psa.101.8.bsb: Every morning I will remove all the wicked of the land, that I may cut off every evildoer from the city of the LORD.
Psa.101.8.kjv: I will early destroy all the wicked of the land; that I may cut off all wicked doers from the city of the Lord.

Psa.141.9.bsb: Keep me from the snares they have laid for me, and from the lures of evildoers.
Psa.141.9.kjv: Keep me from the snares which they have laid for me, and the gins of the workers of iniquity.

Psa.44.16.bsb: at the voice of the scorner and reviler, because of the enemy, bent on revenge.
Psa.44.16.kjv: For the voice of him that reproacheth and blasphemeth; by reason of the enemy and avenger.

Psa.52.6.bsb: The righteous will see and fear; they will mock the evildoer, saying,
Psa.52.6.kjv: The righteous also shall see, and fear, and shall laugh at him:

Psa.18.36.bsb: You broaden the path beneath me so that my ankles do not give way.
Psa.18.36.kjv: Thou hast enlarged my steps under me, that my feet did not slip.

Psa.64.8.bsb: They will be made to stumble, their own tongues turned against them. All who see will shake their heads.
Psa.64.8.kjv: So they shall make their own tongue to fall upon themselves: all that see them shall flee away.

Psa.18.32.bsb: It is God who arms me with strength and makes my way clear.
Psa.18.32.kjv: It is God that girdeth me with strength, and maketh my way perfect.

Psa.49.2.bsb: both low and high, rich and poor alike.
Psa.49.2.kjv: Both low and high, rich and poor, together.

Psa.4.4.bsb: Be angry, yet do not sin; on your bed, search your heart and be still. Selah
Psa.4.4.kjv: Stand in awe, and sin not: commune with your own heart upon your bed, and be still. Selah.

Psa.12.4.bsb: They say, “With our tongues we will prevail. We own our lips—who can be our master?”
Psa.12.4.kjv: Who have said, With our tongue will we prevail; our lips are our own: who is lord over us?

Psa.38.2.bsb: For Your arrows have pierced me deeply, and Your hand has pressed down on me.
Psa.38.2.kjv: For thine arrows stick fast in me, and thy hand presseth me sore.

Psa.67.7.bsb: God blesses us, that all the ends of the earth shall fear Him.
Psa.67.7.kjv: God shall bless us; and all the ends of the earth shall fear him.

Psa.37.12.bsb: The wicked scheme against the righteous and gnash their teeth at them,
Psa.37.12.kjv: The wicked plotteth against the just, and gnasheth upon him with his teeth.

Psa.3.1.bsb: A Psalm of David, when he fled from his son Absalom. O LORD, how my foes have increased! How many rise up against me!
Psa.3.1.kjv: A Psalm of David, when he fled from Absalom his son. Lord, how are they increased that trouble me! many are they that rise up against me.

Psa.44.15.bsb: All day long my disgrace is before me, and shame has covered my face,
Psa.44.15.kjv: My confusion is continually before me, and the shame of my face hath covered me,

Psa.77.20.bsb: You led Your people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.
Psa.77.20.kjv: Thou leddest thy people like a flock by the hand of Moses and Aaron.

Psa.68.7.bsb: O God, when You went out before Your people, when You marched through the wasteland, Selah
Psa.68.7.kjv: O God, when thou wentest forth before thy people, when thou didst march through the wilderness; Selah:

Psa.18.43.bsb: You have delivered me from the strife of the people; You have made me the head of nations; a people I had not known shall serve me.
Psa.18.43.kjv: Thou hast delivered me from the strivings of the people; and thou hast made me the head of the heathen: a people whom I have not known shall serve me.

Psa.129.8.bsb: May none who pass by say to them, “The blessing of the LORD be on you; we bless you in the name of the LORD.”
Psa.129.8.kjv: Neither do they which go by say, The blessing of the Lord be upon you: we bless you in the name of the Lord.

Psa.119.101.bsb: I have kept my feet from every evil path, that I may keep Your word.
Psa.119.101.kjv: I have refrained my feet from every evil way, that I might keep thy word.

Psa.44.13.bsb: You have made us a reproach to our neighbors, a mockery and derision to those around us.
Psa.44.13.kjv: Thou makest us a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and a derision to them that are round about us.

Psa.79.4.bsb: We have become a reproach to our neighbors, a scorn and derision to those around us.
Psa.79.4.kjv: We are become a reproach to our neighbours, a scorn and derision to them that are round about us.

Psa.89.41.bsb: All who pass by plunder him; he has become a reproach to his neighbors.
Psa.89.41.kjv: All that pass by the way spoil him: he is a reproach to his neighbours.

Psa.119.22.bsb: Remove my scorn and contempt, for I have kept Your testimonies.
Psa.119.22.kjv: Remove from me reproach and contempt; for I have kept thy testimonies.

Psa.119.39.bsb: Turn away the disgrace I dread, for Your judgments are good.
Psa.119.39.kjv: Turn away my reproach which I fear: for thy judgments are good.

Psa.88.16.bsb: Your wrath has swept over me; Your terrors have destroyed me.
Psa.88.16.kjv: Thy fierce wrath goeth over me; thy terrors have cut me off.

Psa.89.45.bsb: You have cut short the days of his youth; You have covered him with shame. Selah
Psa.89.45.kjv: The days of his youth hast thou shortened: thou hast covered him with shame. Selah.

Psa.129.7.bsb: unable to fill the hands of the reaper, or the arms of the binder of sheaves.
Psa.129.7.kjv: Wherewith the mower filleth not his hand; nor he that bindeth sheaves his bosom.

Psa.90.7.bsb: For we are consumed by Your anger and terrified by Your wrath.
Psa.90.7.kjv: For we are consumed by thine anger, and by thy wrath are we troubled.

Psa.119.120.bsb: My flesh trembles in awe of You; I stand in fear of Your judgments.
Psa.119.120.kjv: My flesh trembleth for fear of thee; and I am afraid of thy judgments.

Psa.113.5.bsb: Who is like the LORD our God, the One enthroned on high?
Psa.113.5.kjv: Who is like unto the Lord our God, who dwelleth on high,

Psa.55.5.bsb: Fear and trembling grip me, and horror has overwhelmed me.
Psa.55.5.kjv: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, and horror hath overwhelmed me.

Psa.6.4.bsb: Turn, O LORD, and deliver my soul; save me because of Your loving devotion.
Psa.6.4.kjv: Return, O Lord, deliver my soul: oh save me for thy mercies’ sake.

Psa.49.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. A Psalm of the sons of Korah. Hear this, all you peoples; listen, all inhabitants of the world,
Psa.49.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm for the sons of Korah. Hear this, all ye people; give ear, all ye inhabitants of the world:

Psa.141.6.bsb: When their rulers are thrown down from the cliffs, the people will listen to my words, for they are pleasant.
Psa.141.6.kjv: When their judges are overthrown in stony places, they shall hear my words; for they are sweet.

Psa.48.5.bsb: They saw and were astounded; they fled in terror.
Psa.48.5.kjv: They saw it, and so they marvelled; they were troubled, and hasted away.

Psa.7.13.bsb: He has prepared His deadly weapons; He ordains His arrows with fire.
Psa.7.13.kjv: He hath also prepared for him the instruments of death; he ordaineth his arrows against the persecutors.

Psa.46.8.bsb: Come, see the works of the LORD, who brings devastation upon the earth.
Psa.46.8.kjv: Come, behold the works of the Lord, what desolations he hath made in the earth.

Psa.63.10.bsb: They will fall to the power of the sword; they will become a portion for foxes.
Psa.63.10.kjv: They shall fall by the sword: they shall be a portion for foxes.

Psa.123.4.bsb: We have endured much scorn from the arrogant, much contempt from the proud.
Psa.123.4.kjv: Our soul is exceedingly filled with the scorning of those that are at ease, and with the contempt of the proud.

Psa.119.110.bsb: The wicked have set a snare for me, but I have not strayed from Your precepts.
Psa.119.110.kjv: The wicked have laid a snare for me: yet I erred not from thy precepts.

Psa.34.13.bsb: Keep your tongue from evil and your lips from deceitful speech.
Psa.34.13.kjv: Keep thy tongue from evil, and thy lips from speaking guile.

Psa.119.34.bsb: Give me understanding that I may obey Your law, and follow it with all my heart.
Psa.119.34.kjv: Give me understanding, and I shall keep thy law; yea, I shall observe it with my whole heart.

Psa.119.56.bsb: This is my practice, for I obey Your precepts.
Psa.119.56.kjv: This I had, because I kept thy precepts.

Psa.106.9.bsb: He rebuked the Red Sea, and it dried up; He led them through the depths as through a desert.
Psa.106.9.kjv: He rebuked the Red sea also, and it was dried up: so he led them through the depths, as through the wilderness.

Psa.18.16.bsb: He reached down from on high and took hold of me; He drew me out of deep waters.
Psa.18.16.kjv: He sent from above, he took me, he drew me out of many waters.

Psa.56.2.bsb: My enemies pursue me all day long, for many proudly assail me.
Psa.56.2.kjv: Mine enemies would daily swallow me up: for they be many that fight against me, O thou most High.

Psa.54.3.bsb: For strangers rise up against me, and ruthless men seek my life—men with no regard for God. Selah
Psa.54.3.kjv: For strangers are risen up against me, and oppressors seek after my soul: they have not set God before them. Selah.

Psa.42.7.bsb: Deep calls to deep in the roar of Your waterfalls; all Your breakers and waves have rolled over me.
Psa.42.7.kjv: Deep calleth unto deep at the noise of thy waterspouts: all thy waves and thy billows are gone over me.

Psa.102.7.bsb: I lie awake; I am like a lone bird on a housetop.
Psa.102.7.kjv: I watch, and am as a sparrow alone upon the house top.

Psa.55.8.bsb: I would hurry to my shelter, far from this raging tempest.”
Psa.55.8.kjv: I would hasten my escape from the windy storm and tempest.

Psa.102.9.bsb: For I have eaten ashes like bread and mixed my drink with tears
Psa.102.9.kjv: For I have eaten ashes like bread, and mingled my drink with weeping,

Psa.121.1.bsb: A song of ascents. I lift up my eyes to the hills. From where does my help come?
Psa.121.1.kjv: A Song of degrees. I will lift up mine eyes unto the hills, from whence cometh my help.

Psa.38.12.bsb: Those who seek my life lay snares; those who wish me harm speak destruction, plotting deceit all day long.
Psa.38.12.kjv: They also that seek after my life lay snares for me: and they that seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and imagine deceits all the day long.

Psa.50.19.bsb: You unleash your mouth for evil and harness your tongue to deceit.
Psa.50.19.kjv: Thou givest thy mouth to evil, and thy tongue frameth deceit.

Psa.52.4.bsb: You love every word that devours, O deceitful tongue.
Psa.52.4.kjv: Thou lovest all devouring words, O thou deceitful tongue.

Psa.119.21.bsb: You rebuke the arrogant—the cursed who stray from Your commandments.
Psa.119.21.kjv: Thou hast rebuked the proud that are cursed, which do err from thy commandments.

Psa.122.3.bsb: Jerusalem is built up as a city united together,
Psa.122.3.kjv: Jerusalem is builded as a city that is compact together:

Psa.71.2.bsb: In Your justice, rescue and deliver me; incline Your ear and save me.
Psa.71.2.kjv: Deliver me in thy righteousness, and cause me to escape: incline thine ear unto me, and save me.

Psa.71.4.bsb: Deliver me, O my God, from the hand of the wicked, from the grasp of the unjust and ruthless.
Psa.71.4.kjv: Deliver me, O my God, out of the hand of the wicked, out of the hand of the unrighteous and cruel man.

Psa.46.11.bsb: The LORD of Hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our fortress. Selah
Psa.46.11.kjv: The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge. Selah.

Psa.18.24.bsb: So the LORD has repaid me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in His sight.
Psa.18.24.kjv: Therefore hath the Lord recompensed me according to my righteousness, according to the cleanness of my hands in his eyesight.

Psa.18.23.bsb: And I have been blameless before Him and kept myself from iniquity.
Psa.18.23.kjv: I was also upright before him, and I kept myself from mine iniquity.

Psa.88.15.bsb: From my youth I was afflicted and near death. I have borne Your terrors; I am in despair.
Psa.88.15.kjv: I am afflicted and ready to die from my youth up: while I suffer thy terrors I am distracted.

Psa.39.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. For Jeduthun. A Psalm of David. I said, “I will watch my ways so that I will not sin with my tongue; I will guard my mouth with a muzzle as long as the wicked are present.”
Psa.39.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, even to Jeduthun, A Psalm of David. I said, I will take heed to my ways, that I sin not with my tongue: I will keep my mouth with a bridle, while the wicked is before me.

Psa.120.3.bsb: What will He do to you, and what will be added to you, O deceitful tongue?
Psa.120.3.kjv: What shall be given unto thee? or what shall be done unto thee, thou false tongue?

Psa.118.12.bsb: They swarmed around me like bees, but they were extinguished like burning thorns; in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
Psa.118.12.kjv: They compassed me about like bees; they are quenched as the fire of thorns: for in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

Psa.83.12.bsb: who said, “Let us possess for ourselves the pastures of God.”
Psa.83.12.kjv: Who said, Let us take to ourselves the houses of God in possession.

Psa.115.6.bsb: they have ears, but cannot hear; they have noses, but cannot smell;
Psa.115.6.kjv: They have ears, but they hear not: noses have they, but they smell not:

Psa.44.19.bsb: But You have crushed us in the lair of jackals; You have covered us with deepest darkness.
Psa.44.19.kjv: Though thou hast sore broken us in the place of dragons, and covered us with the shadow of death.

Psa.35.17.bsb: How long, O Lord, will You look on? Rescue my soul from their ravages, my precious life from these lions.
Psa.35.17.kjv: Lord, how long wilt thou look on? rescue my soul from their destructions, my darling from the lions.

Psa.31.16.bsb: Make Your face shine on Your servant; save me by Your loving devotion.
Psa.31.16.kjv: Make thy face to shine upon thy servant: save me for thy mercies’ sake.

Psa.119.106.bsb: I have sworn and confirmed that I will keep Your righteous judgments.
Psa.119.106.kjv: I have sworn, and I will perform it, that I will keep thy righteous judgments.

Psa.106.25.bsb: They grumbled in their tents and did not listen to the voice of the LORD.
Psa.106.25.kjv: But murmured in their tents, and hearkened not unto the voice of the Lord.

Psa.118.11.bsb: They surrounded me on every side, but in the name of the LORD I cut them off.
Psa.118.11.kjv: They compassed me about; yea, they compassed me about: but in the name of the Lord I will destroy them.

Psa.81.12.bsb: So I gave them up to their stubborn hearts to follow their own devices.
Psa.81.12.kjv: So I gave them up unto their own hearts’ lust: and they walked in their own counsels.

Psa.20.3.bsb: May He remember all your gifts and look favorably on your burnt offerings. Selah
Psa.20.3.kjv: Remember all thy offerings, and accept thy burnt sacrifice; Selah.

Psa.50.13.bsb: Do I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?
Psa.50.13.kjv: Will I eat the flesh of bulls, or drink the blood of goats?

Psa.63.9.bsb: But those who seek my life to destroy it will go into the depths of the earth.
Psa.63.9.kjv: But those that seek my soul, to destroy it, shall go into the lower parts of the earth.

Psa.34.16.bsb: But the face of the LORD is against those who do evil, to wipe out all memory of them from the earth.
Psa.34.16.kjv: The face of the Lord is against them that do evil, to cut off the remembrance of them from the earth.

Psa.70.1.bsb: For the choirmaster. Of David. To bring remembrance. Make haste, O God, to deliver me! Hurry, O LORD, to help me!
Psa.70.1.kjv: To the chief Musician, A Psalm of David, to bring to remembrance. Make haste, O God, to deliver me; make haste to help me, O Lord.

Psa.71.12.bsb: Be not far from me, O God. Hurry, O my God, to help me.
Psa.71.12.kjv: O God, be not far from me: O my God, make haste for my help.

Psa.18.38.bsb: I crushed them so they could not rise; they have fallen under my feet.
Psa.18.38.kjv: I have wounded them that they were not able to rise: they are fallen under my feet.

Psa.119.37.bsb: Turn my eyes away from worthless things; revive me with Your word.
Psa.119.37.kjv: Turn away mine eyes from beholding vanity; and quicken thou me in thy way.

Psa.119.95.bsb: The wicked wait to destroy me, but I will ponder Your testimonies.
Psa.119.95.kjv: The wicked have waited for me to destroy me: but I will consider thy testimonies.

Psa.119.125.bsb: I am Your servant; give me understanding, that I may know Your testimonies.
Psa.119.125.kjv: I am thy servant; give me understanding, that I may know thy testimonies.

Psa.76.5.bsb: The valiant lie plundered; they sleep their last sleep. No men of might could lift a hand.
Psa.76.5.kjv: The stouthearted are spoiled, they have slept their sleep: and none of the men of might have found their hands.

Psa.35.25.bsb: Let them not say in their hearts, “Aha, just what we wanted!” Let them not say, “We have swallowed him up!”
Psa.35.25.kjv: Let them not say in their hearts, Ah, so would we have it: let them not say, We have swallowed him up.

Psa.38.21.bsb: Do not forsake me, O LORD; be not far from me, O my God.
Psa.38.21.kjv: Forsake me not, O Lord: O my God, be not far from me.

Psa.88.18.bsb: You have removed my beloved and my friend; darkness is my closest companion.
Psa.88.18.kjv: Lover and friend hast thou put far from me, and mine acquaintance into darkness.

Psa.115.7.bsb: they have hands, but cannot feel; they have feet, but cannot walk; they cannot even clear their throats.
Psa.115.7.kjv: They have hands, but they handle not: feet have they, but they walk not: neither speak they through their throat.

Psa.18.47.bsb: the God who avenges me and subdues nations beneath me,
Psa.18.47.kjv: It is God that avengeth me, and subdueth the people under me.

Psa.38.14.bsb: I am like a man who cannot hear, whose mouth offers no reply.
Psa.38.14.kjv: Thus I was as a man that heareth not, and in whose mouth are no reproofs.

Psa.119.63.bsb: I am a friend to all who fear You, and to those who keep Your precepts.
Psa.119.63.kjv: I am a companion of all them that fear thee, and of them that keep thy precepts.

Psa.49.5.bsb: Why should I fear in times of trouble, when wicked usurpers surround me?
Psa.49.5.kjv: Wherefore should I fear in the days of evil, when the iniquity of my heels shall compass me about?

Psa.119.85.bsb: The arrogant have dug pits for me in violation of Your law.
Psa.119.85.kjv: The proud have digged pits for me, which are not after thy law.

Psa.140.8.bsb: Grant not, O LORD, the desires of the wicked; do not promote their evil plans, lest they be exalted. Selah
Psa.140.8.kjv: Grant not, O Lord, the desires of the wicked: further not his wicked device; lest they exalt themselves. Selah.

Psa.1.4.bsb: Not so the wicked! For they are like chaff driven off by the wind.
Psa.1.4.kjv: The ungodly are not so: but are like the chaff which the wind driveth away.

Psa.106.28.bsb: They yoked themselves to Baal of Peor and ate sacrifices offered to lifeless gods.
Psa.106.28.kjv: They joined themselves also unto Baal–peor, and ate the sacrifices of the dead.

Psa.119.136.bsb: My eyes shed streams of tears because Your law is not obeyed.
Psa.119.136.kjv: Rivers of waters run down mine eyes, because they keep not thy law.

Psa.119.4.bsb: You have ordained Your precepts, that we should keep them diligently.
Psa.119.4.kjv: Thou hast commanded us to keep thy precepts diligently.
